import { useTabularProject } from "../tabular/hooks/useTabularProject";
import { StudioHeader } from "../tabular/components/StudioHeader";
import { CsvImport } from "../tabular/components/CsvImport";
import { DataPreview } from "../tabular/components/DataPreview";
import { ColumnConfig } from "../tabular/components/ColumnConfig";
export function TabularDatasetPage({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const { value, error, loading, refresh } = useTabularProject(id);
  if (loading) return <p role="status">Loading CSV project…</p>;
  if (!value)
    return (
      <p className="error" role="alert">
        {error || "CSV project not found."}
      </p>
    );
  return (
    <>
      <StudioHeader
        id={id}
        title={value.project.name}
        subtitle="Import a CSV, review columns, then choose the target and features."
        step="data"
      />
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="csv-layout">
        <CsvImport
          projectId={id}
          hasDataset={!!value.dataset}
          onImported={refresh}
        />
        {value.dataset && (
          <>
            <DataPreview dataset={value.dataset} />
            <ColumnConfig
              key={value.dataset.hash}
              dataset={value.dataset}
              initial={value.project.config}
              onSaved={refresh}
            />
            <div>
              <a
                className={`btn btn-primary ${!value.project.config ? "disabled" : ""}`}
                aria-disabled={!value.project.config}
                href={
                  value.project.config ? `#/tabular/${id}/train` : undefined
                }
              >
                Continue to CSV training →
              </a>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
        {value.versions.length > 0 && (
          <p>
            <a className="small-link" href={`#/tabular/${id}/predict`}>
              Use your saved CSV model →
            </a>
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

import { useTabularProject } from "../tabular/hooks/useTabularProject";
import { StudioHeader } from "../tabular/components/StudioHeader";
import { PredictionForm } from "../tabular/components/PredictionForm";
import { VersionPanel } from "../tabular/components/VersionPanel";
import { EvaluationPanel } from "../tabular/components/EvaluationPanel";
export function TabularPredictPage({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const { value, error, loading, refresh } = useTabularProject(id);
  if (loading) return <p role="status">Loading CSV model…</p>;
  if (!value)
    return (
      <p className="error" role="alert">
        {error}
      </p>
    );
  const version =
    value.versions.find((v) => v.id === value.project.activeVersionId) ??
    value.versions[0];
  return (
    <>
      <StudioHeader
        id={id}
        title="Put your table’s learning to work."
        subtitle="Saved preprocessing and weights run locally. Use new, representative rows."
        step="predict"
      />
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="csv-layout">
        {version ? (
          <>
            <section className="notice">
              Active task: {version.artifact.config.task} · Target:{" "}
              {version.artifact.config.target}. CSV exports/imports are
              supported; online image-model sharing does not accept CSV
              artifacts.
            </section>
            <PredictionForm key={version.id} artifact={version.artifact} />
            <VersionPanel
              versions={value.versions}
              projectId={id}
              activeId={version.id}
              onActivated={refresh}
            />
            <EvaluationPanel artifact={version.artifact} />
          </>
        ) : (
          <div className="empty-state">
            <h2>No saved CSV model yet</h2>
            <p>
              Train a dataset, or import a supported CSV model from the studio
              home.
            </p>
            <a className="btn btn-primary" href={`#/tabular/${id}/train`}>
              Open CSV training
            </a>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

===== FILE apps/web/src/pages/TabularProjectsPage.tsx | bytes=5535 | sha256=5a0a3bafb82891d046ff0d79511bd2363d53470284c3b8ffee0d4384968e8780 =====
CONTENT START
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  projects,
  createProject,
  deleteProject,
  importModel,
} from "../tabular/repository";
import type { Project } from "../tabular/types";
import { readTabularModel } from "../tabular/model-format";
import { message } from "../tabular/errors";
import { Button } from "../components/ui/Button";
import { Dialog } from "../components/ui/Dialog";
export function TabularProjectsPage() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Project[]>([]),
    [open, setOpen] = useState(false),
    [name, setName] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  async function refresh() {
    try {
      setItems(await projects());
    } catch (e) {
      setError(message(e));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
  }, []);
  async function task(fn: () => Promise<void>) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await fn();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(message(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <>
      <div className="page-heading">
        <div>
          <div className="eyebrow">CSV STUDIO / LOCAL-FIRST LEARNING</div>
          <h1>Your tables. Your models.</h1>
          <p>
            Real classification and regression, trained in local CPU workers. No
            account or cloud training.
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>New CSV project</Button>
      </div>
      <div className="modality-tabs">
        <a href="#/projects">Image projects</a>
        <span className="current">CSV / tabular projects</span>
        <a href="#/settings">Private backups</a>
      </div>
      <div className="notice">
        This studio trains bounded linear models—not arbitrary AI architectures.
        Choose representative data and inspect held-out results. Your rows stay
        in this browser.
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="csv-upload-actions">
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          disabled={busy}
          onClick={() => input.current?.click()}
        >
          Import CSV model
        </Button>
      </div>
      <input
        ref={input}
        hidden
        type="file"
        accept=".json,application/json"
        onChange={(e) => {
          const file = e.target.files?.[0];
          e.target.value = "";
          if (file)
            void task(async () => {
              const artifact = await readTabularModel(file);
              const project = await importModel(artifact);
              location.hash = "/tabular/" + project.id + "/predict";
            });
        }}
      />
      {loading ? (
        <p role="status">Loading CSV projects…</p>
      ) : items.length ? (
        <div className="project-grid">
          {items.map((p) => (
            <article className="project-card" key={p.id}>
              <span className="tag">CSV · {p.config?.task ?? "CONFIGURE"}</span>
              <a className="project-title" href={`#/tabular/${p.id}`}>
                {p.name} ↗
              </a>
              <p>
                {p.activeVersionId
                  ? "Saved model available"
                  : "Ready for your data"}
              </p>
              <div className="project-card-footer">
                <small>{new Date(p.updatedAt).toLocaleDateString()}</small>
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  disabled={busy}
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (
                      confirm(
                        `Delete CSV project “${p.name}”, its dataset and model versions permanently?`,
                      )
                    )
                      void task(async () => {
                        await deleteProject(p.id);
                        await refresh();
                      });
                  }}
                >
                  Delete
                </Button>
              </div>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="empty-state">
          <h2>Give your table something to learn.</h2>
          <p>Create a CSV project or import a previously exported CSV model.</p>
        </div>
      )}
      {open && (
        <Dialog
          title="Create a CSV project"
          onClose={() => !busy && setOpen(false)}
        >
          <form
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              void task(async () => {
                const p = await createProject(name);
                location.hash = "/tabular/" + p.id;
              });
            }}
          >
            <label className="field">
              CSV project name
              <input
                autoFocus
                required
                maxLength={64}
                value={name}
                placeholder="e.g. Equipment measurements"
                onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              />
            </label>
            {error && (
              <p className="error" role="alert">
                {error}
              </p>
            )}
            <Button type="submit" disabled={busy || !name.trim()}>
              Create CSV project
            </Button>
          </form>
        </Dialog>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useTabularProject } from "../tabular/hooks/useTabularProject";
import { StudioHeader } from "../tabular/components/StudioHeader";
import { TrainingControls } from "../tabular/components/TrainingControls";
import { TrainingMonitor } from "../tabular/components/TrainingMonitor";
import { EvaluationPanel } from "../tabular/components/EvaluationPanel";
import { startTraining, type Job } from "../tabular/worker-client";
import type { Options, Progress, Artifact } from "../tabular/types";
import { DEFAULT_OPTIONS } from "../tabular/limits";
import { saveVersion } from "../tabular/repository";
import { message } from "../tabular/errors";
import { runActivity } from "../pwa/update-manager";
export function TabularTrainingPage({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const { value, error: loadError, loading } = useTabularProject(id),
    [options, setOptions] = useState<Options>({ ...DEFAULT_OPTIONS }),
    [progress, setProgress] = useState<Progress | null>(null),
    [running, setRunning] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [artifact, setArtifact] = useState<Artifact | null>(null);
  const job = useRef<Job<Artifact> | null>(null),
    alive = useRef(true),
    lock = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    const before = (e: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
      if (lock.current) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.returnValue = "";
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("beforeunload", before);
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      job.current?.cancel();
      window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", before);
    };
  }, []);
  async function train() {
    if (lock.current || !value?.dataset || !value.project.config) return;
    lock.current = true;
    setRunning(true);
    setError("");
    setArtifact(null);
    setProgress(null);
    try {
      await runActivity(async () => {
        job.current = startTraining(
          { dataset: value.dataset!, config: value.project.config!, options },
          (p) => {
            if (alive.current) setProgress(p);
          },
        );
        const next = await job.current.result;
        if (!alive.current) return;
        await saveVersion(id, next);
        if (alive.current) setArtifact(next);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current) setError(message(e));
    } finally {
      lock.current = false;
      job.current = null;
      if (alive.current) setRunning(false);
    }
  }
  if (loading) return <p role="status">Loading training data…</p>;
  if (!value)
    return (
      <p className="error" role="alert">
        {loadError}
      </p>
    );
  return (
    <>
      <StudioHeader
        id={id}
        title="Teach your table to predict."
        subtitle="Real local worker training. Preprocessing fits training rows only; validation selects; test evaluates."
        step="train"
      />
      {(loadError || error) && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error || loadError}
        </p>
      )}
      {value.dataset && value.project.config ? (
        <div className="csv-training-grid">
          <TrainingControls
            options={options}
            onChange={setOptions}
            dataset={value.dataset}
            config={value.project.config}
            running={running}
            onStart={() => void train()}
            onCancel={() => job.current?.cancel()}
          />
          <TrainingMonitor progress={progress} running={running} />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="empty-state">
          <h2>Configure a dataset first</h2>
          <p>Choose a target and feature columns before training.</p>
          <a className="btn btn-primary" href={`#/tabular/${id}`}>
            Open CSV dataset
          </a>
        </div>
      )}
      {artifact && (
        <>
          <section className="success">
            <h2>CSV model trained and saved</h2>
            <p>
              Best epoch {artifact.provenance.bestEpoch}. Prior versions remain
              available.
            </p>
            <a className="btn btn-primary" href={`#/tabular/${id}/predict`}>
              Try CSV model →
            </a>
          </section>
          <EvaluationPanel artifact={artifact} />
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

===== FILE apps/web/src/tabular/backup.ts | bytes=4407 | sha256=d904c61f16fbb278822085b8bad1b958218113c38234d031ef2e3de840318ef2 =====

import type { Snapshot, Project, Dataset, Version } from "./types";
import { LIMITS } from "./limits";
import { assert } from "./errors";
import { validateTable, validateConfiguration } from "./schema";
import { validateTabularModel } from "./model-format";
import { sha256 } from "../lib/checksums";
import { tabularDB, track } from "./database";
export async function encodeBackup(snapshot: Snapshot) {
  assert(
    snapshot.versions.length <= LIMITS.versions,
    "At most 50 versions per CSV backup. Export individual models if needed.",
  );
  const blob = new Blob(
    [
      JSON.stringify({
        format: "neuron-tabular-backup",
        version: 1,
        ...snapshot,
      }),
    ],
    { type: "application/json" },
  );
  assert(blob.size <= LIMITS.backupBytes, "CSV backup exceeds 64 MB.");
  return blob;
}
export async function decodeBackup(file: Blob): Promise<Snapshot> {
  assert(file.size <= LIMITS.backupBytes, "CSV backup exceeds 64 MB.");
  let a: Snapshot & { format: string; version: number };
  try {
    a = JSON.parse(await file.text());
  } catch {
    throw new Error("Backup is not valid JSON.");
  }
  assert(
    a && a.format === "neuron-tabular-backup" && a.version === 1,
    "Not a CSV studio backup. Image backups are a different format.",
  );
  const p = a.project;
  assert(
    p &&
      typeof p.id === "string" &&
      p.id.length <= 100 &&
      typeof p.name === "string" &&
      p.name.trim().length > 0 &&
      p.name.length <= 64 &&
      Number.isFinite(p.createdAt) &&
      Number.isFinite(p.updatedAt),
    "Invalid backup project.",
  );
  assert(
    Array.isArray(a.versions) && a.versions.length <= LIMITS.versions,
    "Invalid version list.",
  );
  let dataset: Dataset | null = null;
  if (a.dataset) {
    validateTable(a.dataset);
    assert(
      a.dataset.projectId === p.id &&
        typeof a.dataset.fileName === "string" &&
        a.dataset.fileName.length <= 160 &&
        Number.isFinite(a.dataset.createdAt),
      "Invalid dataset metadata.",
    );
    const hash = await sha256(
      JSON.stringify({ headers: a.dataset.headers, rows: a.dataset.rows }),
    );
    assert(hash === a.dataset.hash, "Dataset checksum mismatch.");
    dataset = {
      projectId: p.id,
      fileName: a.dataset.fileName,
      hash,
      headers: a.dataset.headers,
      rows: a.dataset.rows,
      createdAt: a.dataset.createdAt,
    };
  }
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  const versions = a.versions.map((v) => {
    assert(
      v &&
        typeof v.id === "string" &&
        v.id.length > 0 &&
        v.id.length <= 100 &&
        !ids.has(v.id) &&
        v.projectId === p.id &&
        Number.isFinite(v.createdAt),
      "Invalid version reference.",
    );
    ids.add(v.id);
    return {
      id: v.id,
      projectId: p.id,
      createdAt: v.createdAt,
      artifact: validateTabularModel(v.artifact),
    };
  });
  assert(
    !p.activeVersionId || ids.has(p.activeVersionId),
    "Backup active model is missing.",
  );
  const config = p.config
    ? validateConfiguration(p.config, dataset?.headers)
    : null;
  return {
    project: {
      id: p.id,
      name: p.name,
      createdAt: p.createdAt,
      updatedAt: p.updatedAt,
      config,
      activeVersionId: p.activeVersionId,
    },
    dataset,
    versions,
  };
}
export async function restoreBackup(file: Blob) {
  const original = await decodeBackup(file),
    projectId = crypto.randomUUID(),
    mapping = new Map(
      original.versions.map((v) => [v.id, crypto.randomUUID()]),
    );
  const project: Project = {
      ...original.project,
      id: projectId,
      name: (original.project.name.slice(0, 52) + " (restored)").slice(0, 64),
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
      activeVersionId: original.project.activeVersionId
        ? mapping.get(original.project.activeVersionId)
        : undefined,
    },
    versions: Version[] = original.versions.map((v) => ({
      ...v,
      id: mapping.get(v.id)!,
      projectId,
    }));
  const db = await tabularDB(),
    tx = track(
      db.transaction(["projects", "datasets", "versions"], "readwrite"),
    );
  await tx.objectStore("projects").add(project);
  if (original.dataset)
    await tx.objectStore("datasets").add({ ...original.dataset, projectId });
  for (const version of versions) await tx.objectStore("versions").add(version);
  await tx.done;
  return project;
}

===== FILE apps/web/src/tabular/components/BackupPanel.tsx | bytes=4162 | sha256=67102e7604d5b22ec4073543e7b404a39f4255612a6bc86cb807f2ecc389631a =====

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { projects, snapshot } from "../repository";
import type { Project } from "../types";
import { encodeBackup, restoreBackup } from "../backup";
import { downloadBlob, safeFilename } from "../../lib/download";
import { runActivity } from "../../pwa/update-manager";
import { message } from "../errors";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/Button";
export function TabularBackupPanel() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Project[]>([]),
    [selected, setSelected] = useState(""),
    [consent, setConsent] = useState(false),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [status, setStatus] = useState("");
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  async function refresh() {
    const p = await projects();
    setItems(p);
    setSelected((previous) =>
      p.some((x) => x.id === previous) ? previous : (p[0]?.id ?? ""),
    );
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh().catch((e) => setError(message(e)));
  }, []);
  async function task(fn: () => Promise<void>) {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await runActivity(fn);
      await refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(message(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <section className="panel csv-backup-panel">
      <h2>Full CSV project backups</h2>
      <p>
        This separate format includes RAW table rows, configuration and all CSV
        model versions. It is sensitive, unencrypted JSON. Image projects and
        deletion receipts are not included.
      </p>
      <label className="field">
        CSV backup project
        <select
          disabled={busy}
          value={selected}
          onChange={(e) => setSelected(e.target.value)}
        >
          {items.map((p) => (
            <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
              {p.name}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </label>
      <label className="check-label">
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          checked={consent}
          onChange={(e) => setConsent(e.target.checked)}
        />{" "}
        I understand the CSV backup contains my raw table data and is not
        encrypted.
      </label>
      <div className="csv-upload-actions">
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          disabled={!consent || !selected || busy}
          onClick={() =>
            void task(async () => {
              const s = await snapshot(selected);
              downloadBlob(
                await encodeBackup(s),
                safeFilename(s.project.name) + ".neuron-tabular-backup.json",
              );
              setStatus("CSV backup downloaded. Keep it private.");
            })
          }
        >
          Download CSV project backup
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          disabled={busy}
          onClick={() => input.current?.click()}
        >
          Restore CSV backup as new
        </Button>
      </div>
      <input
        ref={input}
        hidden
        type="file"
        accept=".json,application/json"
        onChange={(e) => {
          const file = e.target.files?.[0];
          e.target.value = "";
          if (
            file &&
            confirm(
              "Restore this CSV backup as a NEW project? Existing projects will not be overwritten.",
            )
          )
            void task(async () => {
              const p = await restoreBackup(file);
              setSelected(p.id);
              setStatus(
                "CSV project restored as new. Open CSV studio to use it.",
              );
            });
        }}
      />
      {busy && <p role="status">Processing CSV backup…</p>}
      {status && <p role="status">{status}</p>}
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <p className="phase-note">
        Max 64 MB /50 versions. Full dataset hash and model formats are
        validated before atomic restore. Clearing browser data can still delete
        local projects.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

export function ColumnConfig({
  dataset,
  initial,
  onSaved,
}: {
  dataset: Dataset;
  initial: Configuration | null;
  onSaved: () => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [config, setConfig] = useState<Configuration>(
      initial ?? initialConfiguration(dataset),
    ),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const columns = useMemo(() => profile(dataset), [dataset]);
  function update(next: Configuration) {
    setConfig(next);
    setSaved(false);

    <section className="panel">

        value={config.task}
        disabled={busy}

      />

        Target column
        <select
          value={config.target}
          disabled={busy}
          onChange={(e) =>
            update({
              ...config,
              target: e.target.value,
              features: config.features.filter(
                (f) => f.name !== e.target.value,
              ),
            })
          }
        >
          {dataset.headers.map((h) => (
            <option key={h} value={h}>
              {h}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </label>
      <p className="csv-note">
        Pick 1–30 features. Descriptive profiling is not a guarantee: review
        IDs, leakage, numeric parsing and category quality yourself.
      </p>
      <div className="table-scroll">
        <table className="column-config">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Use</th>
              <th>Column</th>
              <th>Interpret as</th>
              <th>Missing</th>
              <th>Numeric / nonempty</th>
              <th>Distinct</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {columns.map((column) => {
              const feature = config.features.find(
                  (f) => f.name === column.name,
                ),
                isTarget = column.name === config.target;
              return (
                <tr key={column.name}>
                  <td>
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      aria-label={`Use ${column.name}`}
                      disabled={
                        busy ||
                        isTarget ||
                        (!feature && config.features.length >= 30)
                      }
                      checked={!!feature && !isTarget}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        update({
                          ...config,
                          features: e.target.checked
                            ? [
                                ...config.features,
                                { name: column.name, kind: column.kind },
                              ]
                            : config.features.filter(
                                (f) => f.name !== column.name,
                              ),
                        })
                      }
                    />
                  </td>
                  <th scope="row">
                    {column.name}
                    {isTarget ? " · TARGET" : ""}
                    {(column.longValues > 0 ||
                      (column.distinct > 16 &&
                        column.kind === "categorical")) && (
                      <div className="csv-profile-warning">
                        Long/rare levels may group into unseen bucket.
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </th>
                  <td>
                    <select
                      aria-label={`Type for ${column.name}`}
                      disabled={busy || !feature || isTarget}
                      value={feature?.kind ?? column.kind}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        update({
                          ...config,
                          features: config.features.map((f) =>
                            f.name === column.name
                              ? {
                                  ...f,
                                  kind: e.target.value as
                                    | "numeric"
                                    | "categorical",
                                }
                              : f,
                          ),
                        })
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="numeric">Numeric</option>
                      <option value="categorical">Categorical</option>
                    </select>
                  </td>
                  <td>{column.missing}</td>
                  <td>
                    {column.numeric} / {dataset.rows.length - column.missing}
                  </td>
                  <td>{column.distinct}</td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="csv-upload-actions">
        <Button
          disabled={busy}
          onClick={() => {
            setBusy(true);
            setError("");

              .then(onSaved)
              .then(() => setSaved(true))
              .catch((e) => setError(message(e)))
              .finally(() => setBusy(false));
          }}
        >
          Save task configuration
        </Button>
        {saved && <span role="status">Configuration saved.</span>}

      <p className="phase-note">
        Exact duplicate feature groups stay in one split. This does not detect
        target-derived fields or correlated patient/household/time groups.
        Invalid numeric cells are treated as missing.
      </p>
    </section>

===== FILE apps/web/src/tabular/components/CsvImport.tsx | bytes=2875 | sha256=f8d4cd7c517bc7153a2683924e4315ea80d05aa8210715e7d34718fbc0befcda =====

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { parseCSVFile, type Job } from "../worker-client";
import { datasetRecord } from "../profile";
import { replaceDataset } from "../repository";
import type { Dataset, ParsedCSV } from "../types";
import { message } from "../errors";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/Button";
export function CsvImport({
  projectId,
  hasDataset,
  onImported,
}: {
  projectId: string;
  hasDataset: boolean;
  onImported: () => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null),
    job = useRef<Job<{ table: ParsedCSV; hash: string }> | null>(null),
    lock = useRef(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => () => job.current?.cancel(), []);
  async function upload(file: File) {
    if (lock.current) return;
    if (
      hasDataset &&
      !confirm(
        "Replace the current CSV? Its training configuration will reset. Existing model versions remain available.",
      )
    )
      return;
    lock.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      job.current = parseCSVFile(file);
      const result = await job.current.result;
      const dataset: Dataset = datasetRecord(
        projectId,
        file.name,
        result.table,
        result.hash,
      );
      await replaceDataset(dataset);
      await onImported();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(message(e));
    } finally {
      job.current = null;
      lock.current = false;
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <h2>{hasDataset ? "Replace CSV dataset" : "Bring your CSV data"}</h2>
      <p>
        Parsing happens in a local browser Worker. Your rows are not uploaded.
        Choose comma-separated UTF-8 CSV with a header row.
      </p>
      <input
        ref={input}
        type="file"
        hidden
        accept=".csv,text/csv"
        disabled={busy}
        onChange={(e) => {
          const file = e.target.files?.[0];
          e.target.value = "";
          if (file) void upload(file);
        }}
      />
      <div className="csv-upload-actions">
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          disabled={busy}
          onClick={() => input.current?.click()}
        >
          {busy ? "Parsing / saving CSV…" : "Choose CSV file"}
        </Button>
        {busy && (
          <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => job.current?.cancel()}>
            Cancel CSV import
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <p className="phase-note">
        Max 16 MB · 25,000 rows · 100 columns · 500,000 cells. CSV studio
        data/backups are separate from image projects. Keep your source files
        backed up.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

import type { Artifact, Report } from "../types";
import { displayNumber } from "../numeric";
function ReportView({
  report,
  title,
  labels,
}: {
  report: Report;
  title: string;
  labels: string[];
}) {
  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <h2>{title}</h2>
      <p className="csv-note">{report.rows} held-out rows.</p>
      <div className="csv-metric-grid">
        {(report.kind === "classification"
          ? [
              ["Accuracy", `${(report.accuracy * 100).toFixed(2)}%`],
              ["Macro F1", displayNumber(report.macroF1)],
              ["Log loss", displayNumber(report.logLoss)],
            ]
          : [
              ["MAE", displayNumber(report.mae)],
              ["RMSE", displayNumber(report.rmse)],
              [
                "R²",
                report.r2 === null
                  ? "Undefined (constant target)"
                  : displayNumber(report.r2),
              ],
            ]
        ).map(([name, value]) => (
          <div key={name}>
            <small>{name}</small>
            <strong>{value}</strong>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {report.kind === "classification" && (
        <div className="table-scroll">
          <table>
            <caption>
              Confusion matrix — actual rows / predicted columns
            </caption>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th scope="col">Actual / predicted</th>
                {labels.map((l) => (
                  <th key={l} scope="col">
                    {l}
                  </th>
                ))}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {report.confusion.map((row, i) => (
                <tr key={labels[i]}>
                  <th scope="row">{labels[i]}</th>
                  {row.map((n, j) => (
                    <td className={i === j ? "diagonal" : ""} key={j}>
                      {n}
                    </td>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
      {report.kind === "classification" && (
        <div className="table-scroll">
          <table>
            <caption>
              Per-class performance derived from this confusion matrix
            </caption>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Label</th>
                <th>Support</th>
                <th>Precision</th>
                <th>Recall</th>
                <th>F1</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {labels.map((label, i) => {
                const tp = report.confusion[i][i],
                  support = report.confusion[i].reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0),
                  predicted = report.confusion.reduce(
                    (total, row) => total + row[i],
                    0,
                  ),
                  precision = predicted ? tp / predicted : 0,
                  recall = support ? tp / support : 0,
                  f1 =
                    precision + recall
                      ? (2 * precision * recall) / (precision + recall)
                      : 0;
                return (
                  <tr key={label}>
                    <th scope="row">{label}</th>
                    <td>{support}</td>
                    <td>{displayNumber(precision)}</td>
                    <td>{displayNumber(recall)}</td>
                    <td>{displayNumber(f1)}</td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
          <p className="csv-note">
            Zero-denominator precision, recall and F1 use zero, consistent with
            macro F1. Support is the actual held-out class count, not the
            training frequency.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { Artifact, Prediction } from "../types";
import { predictRow, requireBatchHeaders } from "../predict";
import { parseCSVFile, type Job } from "../worker-client";
import type { ParsedCSV } from "../types";
import { LIMITS } from "../limits";
import { assert, message, cancelled } from "../errors";
import { displayNumber } from "../numeric";
import { safeCSV } from "../csv";
import { downloadBlob } from "../../lib/download";
import { runActivity } from "../../pwa/update-manager";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/Button";
export function PredictionForm({ artifact }: { artifact: Artifact }) {
  const [values, setValues] = useState<Record<string, string>>({}),
    [prediction, setPrediction] = useState<Prediction | null>(null),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [status, setStatus] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null),
    job = useRef<Job<{ table: ParsedCSV; hash: string }> | null>(null),
    stop = useRef(false),
    lock = useRef(false);
  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      stop.current = true;
      job.current?.cancel();
    },
    [],
  );
  async function batch(file: File) {
    if (lock.current) return;
    lock.current = true;
    stop.current = false;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    setStatus("Parsing prediction CSV…");
    try {
      await runActivity(async () => {
        job.current = parseCSVFile(file);
        const { table } = await job.current.result;
        assert(
          table.rows.length <= LIMITS.batchRows,
          "Batch predictions support at most 5,000 rows.",
        );
        requireBatchHeaders(artifact, table.headers);
        const rows: (string | number)[][] = [
          artifact.config.task === "classification"
            ? ["row", "prediction", ...artifact.labels.map((l) => "score:" + l)]
            : ["row", "prediction"],
        ];
        for (let i = 0; i < table.rows.length; i++) {
          if (stop.current) throw cancelled();
          const p = predictRow(
            artifact,
            Object.fromEntries(
              table.headers.map((h, j) => [h, table.rows[i][j]]),
            ),
          );
          rows.push(
            p.kind === "classification"
              ? [
                  i + 1,
                  p.label,
                  ...artifact.labels.map(
                    (l) => p.scores.find((s) => s.label === l)!.score,
                  ),
                ]
              : [i + 1, p.value],
          );
          if (i % 50 === 0) {
            setStatus(`Predicting row ${i + 1}/${table.rows.length}`);
            await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
          }
        }
        if (stop.current) throw cancelled();
        downloadBlob(
          new Blob([safeCSV(rows)], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" }),
          "neuron-predictions.csv",
        );
        setStatus(
          `Exported ${table.rows.length} real predictions. Formula-like string cells are escaped.`,
        );
      });
    } catch (e) {
      setError(message(e));
    } finally {
      job.current = null;
      lock.current = false;
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <h2>Predict with this model</h2>
      <p>
        Missing numeric inputs use stored training means; missing/unseen
        categories use separate buckets. No network calls are needed.
      </p>
      <form
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setError("");
          try {
            setPrediction(predictRow(artifact, values));
          } catch (e) {
            setError(message(e));
          }
        }}
      >
        <div className="csv-field-grid">
          {artifact.config.features.map((f) => (
            <label className="field" key={f.name}>
              {f.name}
              <input
                value={values[f.name] ?? ""}
                maxLength={4096}
                inputMode={f.kind === "numeric" ? "decimal" : "text"}
                placeholder={
                  f.kind === "numeric"
                    ? "Number, or leave missing"
                    : "Category, or leave missing"
                }
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setValues({ ...values, [f.name]: e.target.value })
                }
              />
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
        <Button type="submit">Predict row</Button>
      </form>
      {prediction && (
        <div className="csv-prediction" role="status">
          <small>Actual local prediction</small>
          <strong>
            {prediction.kind === "classification"
              ? prediction.label
              : displayNumber(prediction.value)}
          </strong>
          {prediction.kind === "classification" &&
            prediction.scores.map((s) => (
              <div className="csv-probability" key={s.label}>
                <span>{s.label}</span>
                <strong>{(s.score * 100).toFixed(2)}%</strong>
              </div>
            ))}
          <p className="csv-note">
            {prediction.kind === "classification"
              ? "Softmax outputs are not calibrated probabilities."
              : "Numeric output is in the original target units, not a confidence interval."}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
      <hr />
      <h3>Batch CSV prediction</h3>
      <p className="csv-note">
        Requires every selected feature header. Extra columns are ignored. Up to
        5,000 rows. Export contains predictions/scores only, not source feature
        values.
      </p>
      <input
        ref={input}
        hidden
        type="file"
        accept=".csv,text/csv"
        onChange={(e) => {
          const file = e.target.files?.[0];
          e.target.value = "";
          if (file) void batch(file);
        }}
      />
      <div className="csv-upload-actions">
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          disabled={busy}
          onClick={() => input.current?.click()}
        >
          Predict CSV & download results
        </Button>
        {busy && (
          <Button
            variant="danger"
            onClick={() => {
              stop.current = true;
              job.current?.cancel();
            }}
          >
            Cancel batch prediction
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
      {status && <p role="status">{status}</p>}
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

import type { Progress } from "../types";
import { displayNumber } from "../numeric";
export function TrainingMonitor({
  progress,
  running,
}: {
  progress: Progress | null;
  running: boolean;
}) {
  const history = progress?.history ?? [],
    last = history.at(-1),
    max = Math.max(
      0.0001,
      ...history.flatMap((e) => [e.trainLoss, e.validationLoss]),
    );
  const points = (key: "trainLoss" | "validationLoss") =>
    history
      .map(
        (e, i) =>
          `${history.length > 1 ? (i / (history.length - 1)) * 600 : 0},${150 - Math.min(1, e[key] / max) * 140}`,
      )
      .join(" ");
  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <div className="section-heading">
        <h2>Live training monitor</h2>
        <span className="tag">
          {running
            ? "CPU WORKER ACTIVE"
            : history.length
              ? "FINISHED / STOPPED"
              : "READY"}
        </span>
      </div>
      {progress ? (
        <>
          <p role="status">
            {progress.stage} · epoch {progress.epoch}/{progress.total}
          </p>
          <progress value={progress.epoch} max={progress.total} />
          <div className="csv-metric-grid">
            <div>
              <small>Train loss</small>
              <strong>{last ? displayNumber(last.trainLoss) : "—"}</strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <small>Validation loss</small>
              <strong>{last ? displayNumber(last.validationLoss) : "—"}</strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <small>Epochs observed</small>
              <strong>{history.length}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
          <svg
            className="csv-history-chart"
            viewBox="0 0 600 160"
            role="img"
            aria-label="Observed training and validation loss by epoch"

              className="validation-line"
              points={points("validationLoss")}
            />
          </svg>

            log loss; regression uses normalized target MSE. Values are actual

import { LIMITS } from "./limits";
import { assert } from "./errors";
import { validateTable } from "./schema";
export function parseCSV(input: string) {
  assert(
    new TextEncoder().encode(input).length <= LIMITS.fileBytes,
    "CSV exceeds the 16 MB file limit.",
  );
  const text = input.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff ? input.slice(1) : input;
  const records: string[][] = [];
  let row: string[] = [],
    field = "",
    quoted = false,
    closed = false,
    started = false;
  function cell() {
    assert(
      field.length <= LIMITS.cellChars,
      "CSV cell exceeds 4,096 characters.",
    );
    row.push(field);
    assert(row.length <= LIMITS.columns, "CSV exceeds 100 columns.");
    field = "";
    closed = false;
    started = false;
  }
  function record() {
    cell();
    if (row.some((c) => c.trim() !== "")) {
      records.push(row);
      assert(records.length <= LIMITS.rows + 1, "CSV exceeds 25,000 rows.");
      assert(
        records.length * row.length <= LIMITS.cells + LIMITS.columns,
        "CSV exceeds the cell budget.",
      );
    }
    row = [];
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    const c = text[i];
    if (quoted) {
      if (c === '"') {
        if (text[i + 1] === '"') {
          field += '"';
          i++;
        } else {
          quoted = false;
          closed = true;
        }
      } else field += c;
    } else if (closed) {
      if (c === ",") cell();
      else if (c === "\n" || c === "\r") {
        if (c === "\r" && text[i + 1] === "\n") i++;
        record();
      } else
        assert(
          c === " " || c === "\t",
          "Unexpected content after a closing CSV quote.",
        );
    } else if (c === '"') {
      assert(!started && field === "", "Quote inside an unquoted CSV cell.");
      quoted = true;
      started = true;
    } else if (c === ",") cell();
    else if (c === "\n" || c === "\r") {
      if (c === "\r" && text[i + 1] === "\n") i++;
      record();
    } else {
      field += c;
      started = true;
    }
    assert(
      field.length <= LIMITS.cellChars,
      "CSV cell exceeds 4,096 characters.",
    );
  }
  assert(!quoted, "Unclosed quoted CSV cell.");
  if (row.length || field || closed || started) record();
  assert(records.length >= 2, "CSV needs a header and at least one data row.");
  return validateTable({
    headers: records[0].map((h) => h.trim()),
    rows: records.slice(1),
  });
}
export function safeCSV(rows: (string | number)[][]) {
  return (
    "\ufeff" +
    rows
      .map((row) =>
        row
          .map((value) => {
            let s = String(value);
            if (typeof value === "number")
              assert(
                Number.isFinite(value),
                "Cannot export non-finite prediction.",
              );
            else if (
              /^[\s\u0000-\u001f]*[=+\-@]/.test(s) ||
              /^[\t\r\n]/.test(s)
            )
              s = "'" + s;
            return '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
          })
          .join(","),
      )
      .join("\r\n")
  );
}

import { openDB, type DBSchema } from "idb";
import type { Project, Dataset, Version } from "./types";
interface TabularDB extends DBSchema {
  projects: { key: string; value: Project };
  datasets: { key: string; value: Dataset };
  versions: { key: string; value: Version; indexes: { "by-project": string } };
}
let connection: ReturnType<typeof openDB<TabularDB>> | undefined;
export function tabularDB() {
  return (connection ??= openDB<TabularDB>("neuron-tabular", 1, {
    upgrade(db) {
      db.createObjectStore("projects", { keyPath: "id" });
      db.createObjectStore("datasets", { keyPath: "projectId" });
      db.createObjectStore("versions", { keyPath: "id" }).createIndex(
        "by-project",
        "projectId",
      );
    },
    blocking() {
      connection?.then((db) => db.close());
      connection = undefined;
    },
    terminated() {
      connection = undefined;
    },
  }));
}
export async function closeTabularDB() {
  (await connection)?.close();
  connection = undefined;
}
export function track<T extends { done: Promise<unknown> }>(tx: T): T {
  void tx.done.catch(() => {});
  return tx;
}

===== FILE apps/web/src/tabular/hooks/useTabularProject.ts | bytes=906 | sha256=5cd172daddfb3788231c7de9e3dbcc36e61dbd287ddd7f328dfd5b8f82c0eada =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { snapshot } from "../repository";
import type { Snapshot } from "../types";
import { message } from "../errors";
export function useTabularProject(id: string) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<Snapshot | null>(null),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [loading, setLoading] = useState(true),
    alive = useRef(true);
  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const next = await snapshot(id);
      if (alive.current) {
        setValue(next);
        setError("");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current) setError(message(e));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [id]);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    void refresh();
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, [refresh]);
  return { value, error, loading, refresh };
}

===== FILE apps/web/src/tabular/linear.ts | bytes=835 | sha256=09340bf7a569ba88c7a21de281996cf0f60e21f0a11901642b6b565422152bf4 =====

export function logits(
  x: Float32Array,
  weights: ArrayLike<number>,
  bias: ArrayLike<number>,
  outputs: number,
) {
  const values = new Float64Array(outputs);
  for (let k = 0; k < outputs; k++) {
    let total = bias[k];
    for (let j = 0; j < x.length; j++)
      total += weights[k * x.length + j] * x[j];
    values[k] = total;
  }
  return values;
}
export function softmax(values: ArrayLike<number>) {
  let max = -Infinity;
  for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) max = Math.max(max, values[i]);
  const out = Array.from(values, (v) => Math.exp(v - max));
  const total = out.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  return out.map((v) => v / total);
}
export function argmax(values: ArrayLike<number>) {
  let index = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < values.length; i++)
    if (values[i] > values[index]) index = i;
  return index;
}

===== FILE apps/web/src/tabular/metrics.ts | bytes=2240 | sha256=98dd688935256862693e84633d1090ae1485ec9a388c46e460b548bfcec9c10e =====

import type { ClassificationReport, RegressionReport } from "./types";
import { argmax } from "./linear";
import { assert } from "./errors";
export function classificationReport(
  actual: number[],
  probabilities: number[][],
  classes: number,
): ClassificationReport {
  assert(
    actual.length > 0 && actual.length === probabilities.length,
    "Invalid classification evaluation input.",
  );
  const confusion = Array.from({ length: classes }, () =>
    Array<number>(classes).fill(0),
  );
  let loss = 0,
    correct = 0;
  actual.forEach((label, i) => {
    const scores = probabilities[i];
    assert(
      Number.isInteger(label) &&
        label >= 0 &&
        label < classes &&
        scores.length === classes &&
        scores.every((s) => Number.isFinite(s) && s >= 0 && s <= 1),
      "Invalid class probabilities.",
    );
    const predicted = argmax(scores);
    confusion[label][predicted]++;
    if (label === predicted) correct++;
    loss -= Math.log(Math.max(1e-12, scores[label]));
  });
  let f1 = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < classes; k++) {
    const tp = confusion[k][k],
      fp = confusion.reduce((n, row) => n + row[k], 0) - tp,
      fn = confusion[k].reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) - tp;
    f1 += 2 * tp + fp + fn ? (2 * tp) / (2 * tp + fp + fn) : 0;
  }
  return {
    kind: "classification",
    rows: actual.length,
    accuracy: correct / actual.length,
    macroF1: f1 / classes,
    logLoss: loss / actual.length,
    confusion,
  };
}
export function regressionReport(
  actual: number[],
  predicted: number[],
): RegressionReport {
  assert(
    actual.length > 0 &&
      actual.length === predicted.length &&
      [...actual, ...predicted].every(Number.isFinite),
    "Invalid regression evaluation input.",
  );
  const mean = actual.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / actual.length;
  let squared = 0,
    absolute = 0,
    variance = 0;
  actual.forEach((v, i) => {
    squared += (v - predicted[i]) ** 2;
    absolute += Math.abs(v - predicted[i]);
    variance += (v - mean) ** 2;
  });
  return {
    kind: "regression",
    rows: actual.length,
    mae: absolute / actual.length,
    rmse: Math.sqrt(squared / actual.length),
    r2: variance > 1e-18 ? 1 - squared / variance : null,
  };
}

===== FILE apps/web/src/tabular/model-format.ts | bytes=7738 | sha256=080950afedcc9f2a2d689f3b4191a72d199d8214e3a7fa81c4483fbd0caa4cf1 =====

import type { Artifact, Report, Preprocessor } from "./types";
import { validateConfiguration } from "./schema";
import { LIMITS } from "./limits";
import { assert } from "./errors";
import { validHash } from "../lib/checksums";
function finite(n: unknown): n is number {
  return typeof n === "number" && Number.isFinite(n);
}
function report(raw: Report, task: string, classes: number): Report {
  assert(
    raw &&
      Number.isInteger(raw.rows) &&
      raw.rows >= 1 &&
      raw.rows <= LIMITS.rows,
    "Invalid report row count.",
  );
  if (task === "classification") {
    assert(
      raw.kind === "classification" &&
        [raw.accuracy, raw.macroF1, raw.logLoss].every(finite) &&
        raw.accuracy >= 0 &&
        raw.accuracy <= 1 &&
        raw.macroF1 >= 0 &&
        raw.macroF1 <= 1 &&
        raw.logLoss >= 0,
      "Invalid classification report.",
    );
    assert(
      Array.isArray(raw.confusion) && raw.confusion.length === classes,
      "Invalid confusion matrix.",
    );
    let total = 0,
      correct = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < classes; i++) {
      assert(
        Array.isArray(raw.confusion[i]) && raw.confusion[i].length === classes,
        "Invalid confusion shape.",
      );
      for (let j = 0; j < classes; j++) {
        const n = raw.confusion[i][j];
        assert(
          Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 0 && n <= LIMITS.rows,
          "Invalid confusion count.",
        );
        total += n;
        if (i === j) correct += n;
      }
    }
    assert(
      total === raw.rows && Math.abs(correct / total - raw.accuracy) < 1e-8,
      "Inconsistent confusion report.",
    );
    return {
      kind: "classification",
      rows: raw.rows,
      accuracy: raw.accuracy,
      macroF1: raw.macroF1,
      logLoss: raw.logLoss,
      confusion: raw.confusion.map((row) => [...row]),
    };
  }
  assert(
    raw.kind === "regression" &&
      finite(raw.mae) &&
      raw.mae >= 0 &&
      finite(raw.rmse) &&
      raw.rmse >= 0 &&
      (raw.r2 === null || finite(raw.r2)),
    "Invalid regression report.",
  );
  return {
    kind: "regression",
    rows: raw.rows,
    mae: raw.mae,
    rmse: raw.rmse,
    r2: raw.r2,
  };
}
export function validateTabularModel(value: unknown): Artifact {
  const a = value as Artifact;
  assert(
    a && a.format === "neuron-tabular" && a.version === 1,
    "Unsupported CSV model format.",
  );
  const config = validateConfiguration(a.config);
  assert(
    a.algorithm ===
      (config.task === "classification" ? "softmax-linear" : "ridge-linear"),
    "Unsupported algorithm.",
  );
  assert(
    Array.isArray(a.labels) &&
      a.labels.length <= (config.task === "classification" ? 20 : 0) &&
      a.labels.every(
        (l) =>
          typeof l === "string" &&
          l.length > 0 &&
          l.length <= 64 &&
          l === l.trim(),
      ) &&
      new Set(a.labels).size === a.labels.length,
    "Invalid class labels.",
  );
  if (config.task === "classification")
    assert(a.labels.length >= 2, "At least two classes required.");
  assert(
    a.preprocessing &&
      Array.isArray(a.preprocessing.features) &&
      a.preprocessing.features.length === config.features.length,
    "Invalid preprocessing.",
  );
  let width = 0;
  const features: Preprocessor["features"] = a.preprocessing.features.map(
    (f, i) => {
      assert(
        f &&
          f.name === config.features[i].name &&
          f.kind === config.features[i].kind,
        "Preprocessing/config mismatch.",
      );
      if (f.kind === "numeric") {
        assert(
          finite(f.mean) &&
            Math.abs(f.mean) <= 1e12 &&
            finite(f.std) &&
            f.std >= 1e-9 &&
            f.std <= 2e12 &&
            f.clip === 8,
          "Invalid numeric preprocessing.",
        );
        width += 2;
        return {
          kind: "numeric",
          name: f.name,
          mean: f.mean,
          std: f.std,
          clip: 8,
        };
      }
      assert(
        f.kind === "categorical" &&
          Array.isArray(f.levels) &&
          f.levels.length <= LIMITS.levels &&
          f.levels.every(
            (s) =>
              typeof s === "string" &&
              s.trim() === s &&
              s.length > 0 &&
              s.length <= LIMITS.levelChars,
          ) &&
          new Set(f.levels).size === f.levels.length,
        "Invalid category vocabulary.",
      );
      width += f.levels.length + 2;
      return { kind: "categorical", name: f.name, levels: [...f.levels] };
    },
  );
  assert(
    width === a.preprocessing.width && width > 0 && width <= LIMITS.encoded,
    "Invalid encoded dimensions.",
  );
  const outputs = config.task === "classification" ? a.labels.length : 1;
  assert(
    Array.isArray(a.weights) &&
      a.weights.length === width * outputs &&
      a.weights.every((n) => finite(n) && Math.abs(n) <= 1e6) &&
      Array.isArray(a.bias) &&
      a.bias.length === outputs &&
      a.bias.every((n) => finite(n) && Math.abs(n) <= 1e6),
    "Invalid linear weights.",
  );
  assert(
    a.targetScale &&
      finite(a.targetScale.mean) &&
      Math.abs(a.targetScale.mean) <= 1e12 &&
      finite(a.targetScale.std) &&
      a.targetScale.std >= 1e-9 &&
      a.targetScale.std <= 2e12,
    "Invalid target scaling.",
  );
  assert(
    Array.isArray(a.history) &&
      a.history.length >= 1 &&
      a.history.length <= 500,
    "Invalid training history.",
  );
  const history = a.history.map((e, i) => {
    assert(
      e &&
        e.epoch === i + 1 &&
        [e.trainLoss, e.validationLoss, e.validationScore].every(finite) &&
        e.trainLoss >= 0 &&
        e.validationLoss >= 0,
      "Invalid epoch metrics.",
    );
    return {
      epoch: e.epoch,
      trainLoss: e.trainLoss,
      validationLoss: e.validationLoss,
      validationScore: e.validationScore,
    };
  });
  const p = a.provenance;
  assert(
    p &&
      validHash(p.datasetHash) &&
      validHash(p.testHash) &&
      Number.isInteger(p.seed) &&
      p.seed >= 0 &&
      p.seed <= 2147483647 &&
      [p.trainRows, p.validationRows, p.testRows].every(
        (n) => Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0,
      ) &&
      p.trainRows + p.validationRows + p.testRows <= LIMITS.rows &&
      Number.isInteger(p.bestEpoch) &&
      p.bestEpoch >= 1 &&
      p.bestEpoch <= history.length,
    "Invalid model provenance.",
  );
  assert(a.evaluation, "Missing evaluation.");
  const validation = report(a.evaluation.validation, config.task, outputs),
    test = report(a.evaluation.test, config.task, outputs);
  assert(
    validation.rows === p.validationRows && test.rows === p.testRows,
    "Evaluation row counts mismatch.",
  );
  assert(
    finite(a.createdAt) && a.createdAt >= 0 && a.createdAt <= 8.64e15,
    "Invalid model timestamp.",
  );
  return {
    format: "neuron-tabular",
    version: 1,
    algorithm: a.algorithm,
    config,
    preprocessing: { width, features },
    labels: [...a.labels],
    targetScale: { mean: a.targetScale.mean, std: a.targetScale.std },
    weights: [...a.weights],
    bias: [...a.bias],
    history,
    evaluation: { validation, test },
    provenance: {
      datasetHash: p.datasetHash,
      testHash: p.testHash,
      seed: p.seed,
      trainRows: p.trainRows,
      validationRows: p.validationRows,
      testRows: p.testRows,
      bestEpoch: p.bestEpoch,
    },
    createdAt: a.createdAt,
  };
}
export async function readTabularModel(file: Blob) {
  assert(file.size <= LIMITS.modelBytes, "CSV model exceeds 8 MB.");
  let value: unknown;
  try {
    value = JSON.parse(await file.text());
  } catch {
    throw new Error("Model is not valid JSON.");
  }
  return validateTabularModel(value);
}

export function numberValue(raw: string): number | null {
  const s = raw.trim();
  if (!s || !/^[-+]?(?:\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)(?:e[-+]?\d+)?$/i.test(s)) return null;
  const n = Number(s);
  return Number.isFinite(n) && Math.abs(n) <= 1e12 ? n : null;
}
export function moments(values: number[]) {
  let n = 0,
    mean = 0,
    m2 = 0;
  for (const value of values) {
    n++;
    const delta = value - mean;
    mean += delta / n;
    m2 += delta * (value - mean);
  }
  return {
    mean: n ? mean : 0,
    std: n && m2 / n > 1e-18 ? Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, m2 / n)) : 1,
  };
}
export function finiteArray(values: unknown, max: number): values is number[] {
  return (
    Array.isArray(values) &&
    values.length <= max &&
    values.every(
      (x) => typeof x === "number" && Number.isFinite(x) && Math.abs(x) <= 1e12,
    )
  );
}
export function displayNumber(n: number) {
  return Math.abs(n) >= 1e6 || (Math.abs(n) > 0 && Math.abs(n) < 0.0001)
    ? n.toExponential(4)
    : n.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 5 });
}

export class Adam {
  private m: Float64Array;
  private v: Float64Array;
  private step = 0;
  constructor(
    size: number,
    private rate: number,
  ) {
    this.m = new Float64Array(size);
    this.v = new Float64Array(size);
  }
  update(parameters: Float64Array, gradient: Float64Array) {
    this.step++;
    let squared = 0;
    for (const g of gradient) squared += g * g;
    const scale = Math.min(1, 5 / (Math.sqrt(squared) || 1));
    for (let i = 0; i < parameters.length; i++) {
      const g = gradient[i] * scale;
      this.m[i] = 0.9 * this.m[i] + 0.1 * g;
      this.v[i] = 0.999 * this.v[i] + 0.001 * g * g;
      parameters[i] -=
        (this.rate * (this.m[i] / (1 - 0.9 ** this.step))) /
        (Math.sqrt(this.v[i] / (1 - 0.999 ** this.step)) + 1e-8);
      if (!Number.isFinite(parameters[i]))
        throw new Error(
          "Training diverged. Reduce learning rate or clean numeric values.",
        );
    }
  }
}

import type { Artifact, Prediction } from "./types";
import { vectorize } from "./vectorize";
import { logits, softmax, argmax } from "./linear";
import { assert } from "./errors";
export function predictRow(
  artifact: Artifact,
  values: Record<string, string>,
): Prediction {
  const x = vectorize(values, artifact.preprocessing),
    z = logits(x, artifact.weights, artifact.bias, artifact.bias.length);
  if (artifact.config.task === "classification") {
    const p = softmax(z);
    return {
      kind: "classification",
      label: artifact.labels[argmax(p)],
      scores: artifact.labels
        .map((label, i) => ({ label, score: p[i] }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score),
    };
  }
  const value = z[0] * artifact.targetScale.std + artifact.targetScale.mean;
  assert(
    Number.isFinite(value),
    "Prediction is non-finite. Check the model and inputs.",
  );
  return { kind: "regression", value };
}
export function requireBatchHeaders(artifact: Artifact, headers: string[]) {
  for (const f of artifact.config.features)
    assert(
      headers.includes(f.name),
      `Prediction CSV is missing feature: ${f.name}`,
    );
}

import type { ParsedCSV, Configuration, Preprocessor } from "./types";
import { moments, numberValue } from "./numeric";
import { LIMITS } from "./limits";
import { assert } from "./errors";
export function fitPreprocessor(
  table: ParsedCSV,
  config: Configuration,
  training: number[],
): Preprocessor {
  assert(training.length > 0, "No training rows.");
  let width = 0;
  const features = config.features.map((feature) => {
    const index = table.headers.indexOf(feature.name);
    if (feature.kind === "numeric") {
      const values = training
        .map((i) => numberValue(table.rows[i][index]))
        .filter((n): n is number => n !== null);
      const stats = moments(values);
      width += 2;
      return {
        kind: "numeric" as const,
        name: feature.name,
        ...stats,
        clip: 8 as const,
      };
    }
    const counts = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const i of training) {
      const s = table.rows[i][index].trim();
      if (s && s.length <= LIMITS.levelChars)
        counts.set(s, (counts.get(s) ?? 0) + 1);
    }
    const levels = [...counts]
      .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1] || a[0].localeCompare(b[0]))
      .slice(0, LIMITS.levels)
      .map(([s]) => s);
    width += levels.length + 2;
    return { kind: "categorical" as const, name: feature.name, levels };
  });
  assert(
    width <= LIMITS.encoded,
    "Too many encoded features (maximum 512). Select fewer columns/categories.",
  );
  assert(
    width * table.rows.length <= LIMITS.matrix,
    "Encoded matrix exceeds 2,000,000 entries. Reduce rows or selected features.",
  );
  return { width, features };
}

import type { ParsedCSV, FeatureKind } from "./types";
import { numberValue } from "./numeric";
export type ColumnProfile = {
  name: string;
  missing: number;
  numeric: number;
  distinct: number;
  kind: FeatureKind;
  min: number | null;
  max: number | null;
  longValues: number;
};
export function profile(table: ParsedCSV): ColumnProfile[] {
  return table.headers.map((name, index) => {
    let missing = 0,
      numeric = 0,
      min = Infinity,
      max = -Infinity,
      longValues = 0;
    const values = new Set<string>();
    for (const row of table.rows) {
      const s = row[index].trim();
      if (!s) {
        missing++;
        continue;
      }
      values.add(s);
      if (s.length > 128) longValues++;
      const n = numberValue(s);
      if (n !== null) {
        numeric++;
        min = Math.min(min, n);
        max = Math.max(max, n);
      }
    }
    return {
      name,
      missing,
      numeric,
      distinct: values.size,
      kind:
        numeric > 0 && numeric / (table.rows.length - missing) >= 0.95
          ? "numeric"
          : "categorical",
      min: numeric ? min : null,
      max: numeric ? max : null,
      longValues,
    };
  });
}

import type { Dataset, Configuration } from "./types";

export function initialConfiguration(table: ParsedCSV): Configuration {
  const target = table.headers[table.headers.length - 1],
    columns = profile(table);
  return {
    task: "classification",
    target,
    features: columns
      .filter((c) => c.name !== target)
      .slice(0, 30)
      .map((c) => ({ name: c.name, kind: c.kind })),
  };
}

  return {
    projectId,
    fileName: fileName.slice(0, 160),

  };
}

export function random(seed: number) {
  return () => {
    seed |= 0;
    seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}
export function shuffle<T>(items: T[], rng: () => number) {
  const out = [...items];
  for (let i = out.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1));
    [out[i], out[j]] = [out[j], out[i]];
  }
  return out;
}

export async function snapshot(id: string): Promise<Snapshot> {

    tx = track(
      db.transaction(["projects", "datasets", "versions"], "readonly"),
    );
  const [project, dataset, versions] = await Promise.all([
    tx.objectStore("projects").get(id),

import type { ParsedCSV, Configuration, Options } from "./types";
import { LIMITS } from "./limits";
import { assert } from "./errors";
export function validateTable(value: unknown): ParsedCSV {
  const a = value as ParsedCSV;
  assert(
    a &&
      Array.isArray(a.headers) &&
      a.headers.length >= 2 &&
      a.headers.length <= LIMITS.columns,
    "CSV needs 2–100 columns.",
  );
  assert(
    a.headers.every(
      (h) =>
        typeof h === "string" &&
        h.trim() === h &&
        h.length > 0 &&
        h.length <= LIMITS.headerChars,
    ),
    "Headers must be nonempty, trimmed and <=100 characters.",
  );
  assert(
    new Set(a.headers.map((h) => h.toLowerCase())).size === a.headers.length,
    "CSV headers must be unique (case-insensitive).",
  );
  assert(
    Array.isArray(a.rows) && a.rows.length > 0 && a.rows.length <= LIMITS.rows,
    "CSV must have 1–25,000 data rows.",
  );
  assert(
    a.rows.length * a.headers.length <= LIMITS.cells,
    "CSV exceeds 500,000 cells.",
  );
  for (const row of a.rows)
    assert(
      Array.isArray(row) &&
        row.length === a.headers.length &&
        row.every((c) => typeof c === "string" && c.length <= LIMITS.cellChars),
      "CSV contains ragged rows or oversized/non-text cells.",
    );
  return a;
}
export function validateConfiguration(
  value: unknown,
  headers?: string[],
): Configuration {
  const a = value as Configuration;
  assert(
    a &&
      (a.task === "classification" || a.task === "regression") &&
      typeof a.target === "string" &&
      a.target.length > 0 &&
      a.target.length <= 100,
    "Choose a supported task and target.",
  );
  assert(
    Array.isArray(a.features) &&
      a.features.length >= 1 &&
      a.features.length <= LIMITS.features,
    "Choose 1–30 feature columns.",
  );
  const names = new Set<string>();
  for (const f of a.features) {
    assert(
      f &&
        typeof f.name === "string" &&
        f.name.length > 0 &&
        f.name.length <= 100 &&
        (f.kind === "numeric" || f.kind === "categorical"),
      "Invalid feature specification.",
    );
    assert(
      f.name !== a.target && !names.has(f.name),
      "Target cannot be a feature; feature names must be unique.",
    );
    if (headers)
      assert(
        headers.includes(f.name),
        "Selected feature is not in this dataset.",
      );
    names.add(f.name);
  }
  if (headers)
    assert(headers.includes(a.target), "Target is not in this dataset.");
  return {
    task: a.task,
    target: a.target,
    features: a.features.map((f) => ({ name: f.name, kind: f.kind })),
  };
}
export function validateOptions(value: Options) {
  assert(
    Number.isInteger(value.epochs) && value.epochs >= 1 && value.epochs <= 500,
    "Epochs must be between 1 and 500.",
  );
  assert(
    Number.isFinite(value.learningRate) &&
      value.learningRate >= 0.0001 &&
      value.learningRate <= 0.1,
    "Learning rate must be 0.0001–0.1.",
  );
  assert(
    Number.isFinite(value.l2) && value.l2 >= 0 && value.l2 <= 1,
    "L2 must be 0–1.",
  );
  assert(
    Number.isInteger(value.seed) && value.seed >= 0 && value.seed <= 2147483647,
    "Invalid split seed.",
  );
  assert(
    Number.isInteger(value.patience) &&
      value.patience >= 2 &&
      value.patience <= 100,
    "Patience must be 2–100 epochs.",
  );
  assert(
    Number.isInteger(value.batchSize) &&
      value.batchSize >= 4 &&
      value.batchSize <= 256,
    "Batch size must be 4–256.",
  );
  return value;

===== FILE apps/web/src/tabular/split.ts | bytes=2531 | sha256=21e3484f6df5007b2838dcfc78d8f5b173759218bbb7a31761aaaaa8dc12c776 =====

import type { ParsedCSV, Configuration, Split } from "./types";
import { shuffle, random } from "./random";
import { numberValue } from "./numeric";
import { assert } from "./errors";
export function splitRows(
  table: ParsedCSV,
  config: Configuration,
  seed: number,
): Split {
  const target = table.headers.indexOf(config.target),
    features = config.features.map((f) => table.headers.indexOf(f.name));
  const groups = new Map<string, number[]>();
  for (let i = 0; i < table.rows.length; i++) {
    const row = table.rows[i],
      y = row[target].trim();
    assert(
      y !== "",
      "Target contains missing values. Correct the CSV before training.",
    );
    if (config.task === "regression")
      assert(
        numberValue(y) !== null,
        "Regression targets must be valid finite numbers (magnitude <=1e12).",
      );
    else
      assert(y.length <= 64, "Classification labels must be <=64 characters.");
    const key = JSON.stringify(features.map((j) => row[j].trim()));
    const group = groups.get(key) ?? [];
    if (config.task === "classification" && group.length)
      assert(
        table.rows[group[0]][target].trim() === y,
        "Identical feature records have conflicting class labels. Correct or remove the conflict.",
      );
    group.push(i);
    groups.set(key, group);
  }
  const buckets = new Map<string, number[][]>();
  for (const g of groups.values()) {
    const label =
      config.task === "classification"
        ? table.rows[g[0]][target].trim()
        : "regression";
    const bucket = buckets.get(label) ?? [];
    bucket.push(g);
    buckets.set(label, bucket);
  }
  if (config.task === "classification")
    assert(
      buckets.size >= 2 && buckets.size <= 20,
      "Classification needs 2–20 distinct labels.",
    );
  const result: Split = { train: [], validation: [], test: [] },
    rng = random(seed);
  for (const bucket of buckets.values()) {
    assert(
      bucket.length >= (config.task === "classification" ? 10 : 30),
      config.task === "classification"
        ? "Each class needs at least 10 distinct feature groups."
        : "Regression needs at least 30 distinct feature groups.",
    );
    const ordered = shuffle(bucket, rng),
      test = Math.max(1, Math.floor(ordered.length * 0.15)),
      validation = Math.max(1, Math.floor(ordered.length * 0.15));
    ordered.forEach((g, i) =>
      result[
        i < test ? "test" : i < test + validation ? "validation" : "train"
      ].push(...g),
    );
  }
  return result;
}

===== FILE apps/web/src/tabular/train.ts | bytes=6011 | sha256=52db4a700b9fdf224a542ec1fa762929fca79dad48b0dd7ba43b04bc80462abe =====
