import type { TrainingInput, Progress, Artifact, Report } from "./types";
import {
  validateTable,
  validateConfiguration,
  validateOptions,
} from "./schema";
import { splitRows } from "./split";
import { fitPreprocessor } from "./preprocessing";
import { encodeRows } from "./vectorize";
import { moments, numberValue } from "./numeric";
import { Adam } from "./optimizer";
import { logits, softmax } from "./linear";
import { classificationReport, regressionReport } from "./metrics";
import { shuffle, random } from "./random";
import { sha256 } from "../lib/checksums";
import { assert } from "./errors";
export async function trainTabular(
  input: TrainingInput,
  onProgress: (p: Progress) => void = () => {},
): Promise<Artifact> {
  const table = validateTable(input.dataset),
    config = validateConfiguration(input.config, table.headers),
    options = validateOptions(input.options);
  const datasetHash = await sha256(
    JSON.stringify({ headers: table.headers, rows: table.rows }),
  );
  assert(
    datasetHash === input.dataset.hash,
    "Dataset integrity mismatch. Reimport the CSV.",
  );
  const split = splitRows(table, config, options.seed),
    preprocessing = fitPreprocessor(table, config, split.train),
    x = encodeRows(table, preprocessing),
    target = table.headers.indexOf(config.target);
  const labels =
      config.task === "classification"
        ? [...new Set(table.rows.map((r) => r[target].trim()))].sort()
        : [],
    outputs = config.task === "classification" ? labels.length : 1;
  const rawY = table.rows.map((r) =>
    config.task === "classification"
      ? labels.indexOf(r[target].trim())
      : numberValue(r[target])!,
  );
  const targetScale =
      config.task === "regression"
        ? moments(split.train.map((i) => rawY[i]))
        : { mean: 0, std: 1 },
    y = rawY.map((v) =>
      config.task === "classification"
        ? v
        : (v - targetScale.mean) / targetScale.std,
    );
  const size = preprocessing.width * outputs,
    parameters = new Float64Array(size + outputs),
    optimizer = new Adam(parameters.length, options.learningRate),
    rng = random(options.seed),
    history: Artifact["history"] = [];
  let best = Infinity,
    bestEpoch = 0,
    stale = 0,
    bestParameters = new Float64Array(parameters);
  const weights = () => parameters.subarray(0, size),
    bias = () => parameters.subarray(size);
  function outputsFor(i: number) {
    const z = logits(x[i], weights(), bias(), outputs);
    return config.task === "classification" ? softmax(z) : [z[0]];
  }
  function loss(rows: number[]) {
    let total = 0;
    for (const i of rows) {
      const p = outputsFor(i);
      total +=
        config.task === "classification"
          ? -Math.log(Math.max(1e-12, p[y[i]]))
          : (p[0] - y[i]) ** 2;
    }
    return total / rows.length;
  }
  function report(rows: number[]): Report {
    return config.task === "classification"
      ? classificationReport(
          rows.map((i) => y[i]),
          rows.map(outputsFor),
          outputs,
        )
      : regressionReport(
          rows.map((i) => rawY[i]),
          rows.map(
            (i) => outputsFor(i)[0] * targetScale.std + targetScale.mean,
          ),
        );
  }
  for (let epoch = 1; epoch <= options.epochs; epoch++) {
    const order = shuffle(split.train, rng);
    for (let offset = 0; offset < order.length; offset += options.batchSize) {
      const batch = order.slice(offset, offset + options.batchSize),
        gradient = new Float64Array(parameters.length);
      for (const i of batch) {
        const p = outputsFor(i);
        for (let k = 0; k < outputs; k++) {
          const delta =
            config.task === "classification"
              ? p[k] - (y[i] === k ? 1 : 0)
              : 2 * (p[0] - y[i]);
          for (let j = 0; j < preprocessing.width; j++)
            gradient[k * preprocessing.width + j] +=
              (delta * x[i][j]) / batch.length;
          gradient[size + k] += delta / batch.length;
        }
      }
      for (let j = 0; j < size; j++) gradient[j] += options.l2 * parameters[j];
      optimizer.update(parameters, gradient);
    }
    const trainLoss = loss(split.train),
      validationLoss = loss(split.validation),
      validationReport = report(split.validation);
    assert(
      Number.isFinite(trainLoss) && Number.isFinite(validationLoss),
      "Non-finite loss. Clean data or reduce learning rate.",
    );
    history.push({
      epoch,
      trainLoss,
      validationLoss,
      validationScore:
        validationReport.kind === "classification"
          ? validationReport.accuracy
          : validationReport.rmse,
    });
    onProgress({
      stage: "Training linear model",
      epoch,
      total: options.epochs,
      history: [...history],
    });
    if (validationLoss < best - 1e-6) {
      best = validationLoss;
      bestParameters = new Float64Array(parameters);
      bestEpoch = epoch;
      stale = 0;
    } else stale++;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
    if (stale >= options.patience) break;
  }
  parameters.set(bestParameters);
  const testHash = await sha256(
    JSON.stringify({
      config,
      rows: split.test
        .map((i) => table.rows[i])
        .sort((a, b) => JSON.stringify(a).localeCompare(JSON.stringify(b))),
    }),
  );
  return {
    format: "neuron-tabular",
    version: 1,
    algorithm:
      config.task === "classification" ? "softmax-linear" : "ridge-linear",
    config,
    preprocessing,
    labels,
    targetScale,
    weights: Array.from(weights()),
    bias: Array.from(bias()),
    history,
    evaluation: {
      validation: report(split.validation),
      test: report(split.test),
    },
    provenance: {
      datasetHash,
      testHash,
      seed: options.seed,
      trainRows: split.train.length,
      validationRows: split.validation.length,
      testRows: split.test.length,
      bestEpoch,
    },
    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };
}

import type { Preprocessor, ParsedCSV } from "./types";
import { numberValue } from "./numeric";
export function vectorize(
  values: Record<string, string>,
  preprocessor: Preprocessor,
) {
  const out = new Float32Array(preprocessor.width);
  let offset = 0;
  for (const feature of preprocessor.features) {
    const raw = (
      Object.hasOwn(values, feature.name) ? values[feature.name] : ""
    ).trim();
    if (feature.kind === "numeric") {
      const n = numberValue(raw);
      out[offset] =
        n === null
          ? 0
          : Math.max(
              -feature.clip,
              Math.min(feature.clip, (n - feature.mean) / feature.std),
            );
      out[offset + 1] = n === null ? 1 : 0;
      offset += 2;
    } else {
      const index = raw ? feature.levels.indexOf(raw) : -1;
      out[
        offset +
          (raw
            ? index >= 0
              ? index
              : feature.levels.length
            : feature.levels.length + 1)
      ] = 1;
      offset += feature.levels.length + 2;
    }
  }
  return out;
}
export function encodeRows(table: ParsedCSV, preprocessor: Preprocessor) {
  return table.rows.map((row) =>
    vectorize(
      Object.fromEntries(table.headers.map((h, i) => [h, row[i]])),
      preprocessor,
    ),
  );
}

import type { TrainingInput, Progress, Artifact, ParsedCSV } from "./types";
import type { WorkerMessage } from "./worker-protocol";
import { validateProgress } from "./worker-protocol";
import { validateTabularModel } from "./model-format";
import { validateTable } from "./schema";
import { LIMITS } from "./limits";
import { assert, cancelled } from "./errors";
import { validHash } from "../lib/checksums";
import { runActivity } from "../pwa/update-manager";
export type Job<T> = { result: Promise<T>; cancel: () => void };
function workerJob<T>(
  create: () => Worker,
  prepare: () => Promise<{ value: unknown; transfer?: Transferable[] }>,
  decode: (value: unknown) => T,
  onProgress?: (p: Progress) => void,
): Job<T> {
  let worker: Worker | null = null,
    rejectJob: ((error: unknown) => void) | undefined,
    wasCancelled = false;
  const result = runActivity(async () => {
    if (wasCancelled) throw cancelled();
    const input = await prepare();
    if (wasCancelled) throw cancelled();
    return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
      rejectJob = reject;
      try {
        worker = create();
        worker.onerror = () =>
          reject(
            new Error(
              "Browser worker failed to load or execute. Check offline shell installation, memory and JavaScript response headers.",
            ),
          );
        worker.onmessageerror = () =>
          reject(new Error("Worker message could not be decoded."));
        worker.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent<WorkerMessage>) => {
          try {
            const data = event.data;
            assert(
              data && typeof data.type === "string",
              "Invalid worker response.",
            );
            if (data.type === "progress")
              onProgress?.(validateProgress(data.progress));
            else if (data.type === "error")
              reject(
                new Error(
                  typeof data.message === "string"
                    ? data.message.slice(0, 1000)
                    : "Worker failed.",
                ),
              );
            else if (data.type === "result") resolve(decode(data.value));
            else reject(new Error("Unknown worker response."));
          } catch (error) {
            reject(error);
          }
        };
        worker.postMessage(input.value, input.transfer ?? []);
      } catch (error) {
        reject(error);
      }
    });
  }).finally(() => {
    (worker as Worker | null)?.terminate();
  });
  return {
    result,
    cancel() {
      wasCancelled = true;
      (worker as Worker | null)?.terminate();
      rejectJob?.(cancelled());
    },
  };
}
export function startTraining(
  input: TrainingInput,
  onProgress?: (p: Progress) => void,
): Job<Artifact> {
  return workerJob(
    () =>
      new Worker(new URL("../workers/tabular.worker.ts", import.meta.url), {
        type: "module",
      }),
    async () => ({ value: input }),
    validateTabularModel,
    onProgress,
  );
}
export function parseCSVFile(
  file: File,
): Job<{ table: ParsedCSV; hash: string }> {
  return workerJob(
    () =>
      new Worker(new URL("../workers/csv.worker.ts", import.meta.url), {
        type: "module",
      }),
    async () => {
      assert(file.size <= LIMITS.fileBytes, "CSV exceeds 16 MB.");
      assert(
        /\.csv$/i.test(file.name),
        "Choose a .csv file (not Excel, TSV or ZIP).",
      );
      const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
      return { value: bytes, transfer: [bytes] };
    },
    (raw) => {
      const value = raw as { table: ParsedCSV; hash: string };
      assert(value && validHash(value.hash), "Invalid parsed dataset hash.");
      return { table: validateTable(value.table), hash: value.hash };
    },
  );
}

import type { Progress, TrainingInput } from "./types";

  validateConfiguration,
  validateOptions,
  validateTable,
} from "./schema";

export function validateTrainingInput(input: TrainingInput) {
  assert(
    input && input.dataset && validHash(input.dataset.hash),
    "Missing or invalid training dataset.",
  );
  validateTable(input.dataset);
  validateConfiguration(input.config, input.dataset.headers);
  validateOptions(input.options);
  return input;
}
export function validateProgress(p: Progress) {
  assert(
    p &&
      typeof p.stage === "string" &&
      p.stage.length <= 100 &&
      Number.isInteger(p.epoch) &&
      p.epoch >= 1 &&
      p.epoch <= 500 &&
      Number.isInteger(p.total) &&
      p.total >= p.epoch &&
      p.total <= 500 &&
      Array.isArray(p.history) &&
      p.history.length === p.epoch,
    "Invalid worker progress.",
  );
  for (const e of p.history)
    assert(
      e &&
        [e.epoch, e.trainLoss, e.validationLoss, e.validationScore].every(
          Number.isFinite,
        ),
      "Non-finite worker metrics.",
    );
  return p;
}

it("roundtrips raw data and models, restores new IDs without overwriting originals", async () => {
  const p = await createProject("backup"),
    d = { ...(await fixture()), projectId: p.id };
  await replaceDataset(d);
  await saveConfiguration(p.id, d.hash, config);
  await saveVersion(
    p.id,
    await trainTabular({
      dataset: d,
      config,
      options: { ...options, epochs: 2 },
    }),
  );
  const s = await snapshot(p.id),
    blob = await encodeBackup(s),
    decoded = await decodeBackup(blob);
  expect(decoded.dataset?.rows).toEqual(d.rows);
  const restored = await restoreBackup(blob),
    r = await snapshot(restored.id);
  expect(restored.id).not.toBe(p.id);
  expect(r.versions[0].id).not.toBe(s.versions[0].id);
  expect(r.project.activeVersionId).toBe(r.versions[0].id);
  expect(r.dataset?.projectId).toBe(restored.id);
  expect((await snapshot(p.id)).dataset?.rows).toEqual(d.rows);
  await deleteProject(p.id);
  await deleteProject(restored.id);
});

===== FILE apps/web/src/workers/csv.worker.ts | bytes=1046 | sha256=926d1806e6a36e2f111cace8d8fc674cdffad65b9a3ca3c81d78e92ffe7e739c =====

/// <reference lib="webworker" />
import { parseCSV } from "../tabular/csv";
import { LIMITS } from "../tabular/limits";
import { assert, message } from "../tabular/errors";
import { sha256 } from "../lib/checksums";
const scope = globalThis as unknown as DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope;
let used = false;
scope.onmessage = (event) => {
  if (used) return;
  used = true;
  void (async () => {
    assert(
      event.data instanceof ArrayBuffer &&
        event.data.byteLength <= LIMITS.fileBytes,
      "CSV exceeds the file limit or is not a binary file.",
    );
    let text: string;
    try {
      text = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(event.data);
    } catch {
      throw new Error(
        "CSV must be UTF-8 text. Export it as CSV UTF-8 and try again.",
      );
    }
    const table = parseCSV(text),
      hash = await sha256(JSON.stringify(table));
    scope.postMessage({ type: "result", value: { table, hash } });
  })().catch((error) =>
    scope.postMessage({ type: "error", message: message(error) }),
  );
};

/// <reference lib="webworker" />
import { trainTabular } from "../tabular/train";
import { validateTrainingInput } from "../tabular/worker-protocol";
import { message } from "../tabular/errors";
const scope = globalThis as unknown as DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope;
let used = false;
scope.onmessage = (event) => {
  if (used) return;
  used = true;
  void (async () => {
    const input = validateTrainingInput(event.data);
    const artifact = await trainTabular(input, (progress) =>
      scope.postMessage({ type: "progress", progress }),
    );
    scope.postMessage({ type: "result", value: artifact });
  })().catch((error) =>
    scope.postMessage({ type: "error", message: message(error) }),
  );
};

# CSV studio — contracts and operational guide

## Data boundaries

Use UTF-8 CSV with a comma separator and a unique header row. Quoted commas, double-quote escapes, CRLF and quoted multiline cells are supported. Empty records are skipped. Ragged rows, duplicate/blank headers, trailing content after closing quotes and unclosed quotes fail with actionable messages. TSV, semicolon CSV, XLS/XLSX, ZIP and executable imports are not accepted. Source text is never evaluated as code or HTML.

The parser and training each have their own real module Worker. CSV parsing/structured-clone transfer and dataset persistence remain bounded operations, not a claim of zero-copy or unlimited memory. Source file <=16 MB; <=25,000 nonempty records, 100 columns, 500,000 cells, 4,096 chars/cell. Header <=100 chars. Use desktop Chrome/Edge as the initial target; smaller devices may require much smaller data. Cancel terminates a worker; interrupted jobs do not resume or activate partial weights.

## Targets and features

Choose task explicitly. Classification treats trimmed target strings as labels (2–20), with at least 10 distinct input-feature groups per label. Empty targets fail. Regression needs all numeric targets and at least 30 distinct feature groups. Numeric syntax uses dot decimals/scientific notation, finite magnitudes <=1e12. Dates, locale thousands separators and text require preparation before import. Column profiles are descriptive, not automatic semantic guarantees.

Pick 1–30 features, excluding target. Numeric preprocessing is fit only on train rows using Welford mean/std, missing-value mean imputation, standardization, clipping to +/-8 and a missing indicator. Invalid numeric strings become missing; inspect profiles before choosing types. A constant/all-missing numeric column uses std=1. Categorical features use at most 16 frequent nonempty levels <=128 chars; separate unseen/rare and missing buckets prevent collisions with actual literal strings. At most 512 encoded dimensions /2,000,000 total encoded matrix entries. Over-budget jobs fail before matrix allocation. There is no silent truncation of rows.

## Splits and learning

Seeded shuffle assigns distinct groups to train/validation/test approximately 70/15/15, stratified per class when classifying. Every exact selected-feature tuple stays in ONE split. Classification tuples with conflicting labels fail for correction. Regression repeated-feature records are kept in one split even with differing targets. This prevents exact-row leakage, not semantic duplicates, household/patient grouping, chronological leakage or target leakage. Remove identifiers and target-derived inputs yourself. Target normalization for regression is fit only on training targets.

The real engine is regularized softmax linear classification or regularized linear regression trained by mini-batch Adam, finite-value guards and gradient norm clipping. It yields each epoch inside a dedicated Worker. Best validation loss and configured patience select weights. The test split is evaluated only after that selection. No test metrics are used as gradients or early-stopping inputs. Artifact provenance records dataset/test fingerprints, split seed/counts and best epoch. Repeated human tuning against a reused test set still causes selection bias.

Reports: classification accuracy, macro F1, log loss and confusion matrix; regression MAE, RMSE and R-squared (null if target variance is zero). Softmax scores are relative outputs, not calibrated probabilities. A null R-squared is not replaced with a fabricated perfect score. Linear models cannot represent every problem; poor results are not fixed by inventing metrics.

## Persistence and concurrency

`neuron-tabular` IndexedDB v1 stores project metadata, the current CSV dataset, immutable model versions and active selection. Dataset replacement resets training configuration and preserves prior models. Commit checks that dataset/config have not changed since training; a stale result is not silently activated. Activation checks version ownership. Delete cascades only this tabular project's data/versions. Image `neuron-local` and sharing `neuron-sharing` databases are unchanged.

Snapshots use a single read transaction; backup restore validates all records before one atomic write transaction and always remaps IDs to a new project. Model-only import creates a new project with NO dataset. Training a received model again requires supplying data and choosing configuration. Browser quota/eviction/private mode remain failure risks. Keep exports outside the browser. These checks are not a general collaborative editing/conflict-merging system.

## Export safety and privacy

Supported `.neuron-tabular.json` contains only bounded, validated numeric linear weights, preprocessing and reports—never imported executable topology/scripts. It excludes raw training rows but may expose category names, statistics, labels and memorized information. Full `.neuron-tabular-backup.json` includes RAW CSV data and all versions, is not encrypted and needs explicit consent. Limits: 50 versions and a 64 MB backup. Model limit: 8 MB. Existing image full backups and image relay are separate formats and cannot pretend to handle tabular artifacts.

Single-row prediction tolerates missing fields via stored imputation/buckets. Batch CSV requires every model feature header, may include extra columns, and caps 5,000 rows per prediction export. Prediction CSV serialization quotes fields and prefixes formula-like STRING cells (including leading whitespace/control markers) with an apostrophe; finite numeric outputs remain numeric. This mitigates common spreadsheet formula injection; do not treat spreadsheet software as a trusted execution boundary. JSON backups are not spreadsheet exports.

## Offline and release gates

Vite production builds precache the emitted module Worker assets as well as lazy UI bundles. A new build must change the shell revision and be installed before going offline. CSV models need no encoder downloads. Do not cache API/share responses. Existing safe-update activity locks wrap worker parsing/training and backup processing. Closing a page cancels its worker; it does not delete already saved versions. Browser tests verify actual workers and offline behavior on the tested environment, not every hardware/browser. Deployment remains root-origin, HTTPS/localhost, correct JS MIME/CSP and provider-specific response headers.

Not included: arbitrary neural architectures, boosted trees, text embeddings, temporal/group-aware splitting beyond exact tuples, causal/fairness guarantees, a universal AutoML search, distributed datasets, SQL execution, automatic online uploads or tabular encrypted share links. Those require explicit implementation and validation rather than a working-looking button.

===== FILE ARCHITECTURE.md | bytes=6999 | sha256=fccda599b349d4a94c665fa3a167ade5376e0d9646bc9b454fcdd669e26a48a8 =====

# NEURON application architecture — implemented through Phase 5

This document describes executed code, not all filenames in the original scaffold. The detailed path ledger in `docs/implementation-roadmap.md` is authoritative for unfinished paths.

## Running boundaries

- `apps/web`: React 18 / TypeScript / Vite app. Hash routing uses a typed parser. AppShell composes the actual Header/Sidebar modules. Providers hold camera/motion preferences and synchronize changes through same-origin storage events. The keyboard skip link focuses the workspace without navigating away from the hash route.
- Image studio: local project/class/sample CRUD; explicit camera still capture or JPEG/PNG/WebP imports; true normalization module Worker when Worker/OffscreenCanvas/createImageBitmap exist; DOM canvas fallback only when capability detection says these are unavailable. Unsupported/invalid worker content fails instead of silently claiming success. Images normalize to JPEG with <=768px longest side and white alpha background.
- Image training/inference: existing pinned MobileNet image embeddings plus learned softmax head, TensorFlow.js WebGL/CPU on the page. Classifier fitting is NOT moved to a worker by Phase 5. Image results are validation-set performance, not a separate unbiased final test. The view/hooks/components now live in the originally planned feature files rather than monolithic pages.
- CSV studio: Phase 4 parser and mini-batch linear-model trainer in real dedicated Workers; train-only preprocessing, grouped/stratified seeded splits, validation weight selection, held-out final test, immutable saved versions and row/batch prediction. No encoder download.
- Sharing: explicit encrypted image-model uploads to the optional relay. Raw datasets and deletion receipts are not included. CSV relay sharing, WebRTC/P2P and arbitrary model graphs are not implemented.
- Relay: actual R2 ciphertext storage, SQLite Durable Object rate limits, retained Phase 3 format/auth/origin/size/TTL/deletion checks and scheduled cleanup. The production configuration is deliberately fail-closed until an operator provisions private resources and exact allowed origins. Local Miniflare is not cloud deployment certification.

## Persistence

`neuron-local` IndexedDB v2 stores images/projects/model versions/feedback. `neuron-tabular` v1 stores CSV projects/current dataset/model versions. `neuron-sharing` v1 stores separate sensitive deletion receipts. Schema versions remain unchanged in this phase. Preferences alone use `neuron-preferences-v1` localStorage; blocked preference storage degrades to tab-local settings without resetting project databases.

Dataset class additions/renames transact against the latest project, avoiding lost updates from two simultaneous edits. Image-training commits now optionally check the original class vocabulary and exact sample ID/label membership inside the write transaction before saving/activating weights. Normal application samples are immutable records; deletion/addition changes membership. This is NOT content-version control for external/manual database tampering or a general multi-user synchronization protocol.

All backups restore NEW IDs. Model-only image import now also creates a NEW project; it no longer offers the old destructive “replace vocabulary/delete current images” Settings flow. Numeric model validation and whitelisted image-share serialization reject imported executable topology or hidden fields. User-reviewed export is local download, not publication.

## Camera lifecycle and privacy

The browser requests video only, never audio. No getUserMedia call occurs until explicit Use camera. A generation counter closes late streams after a cancelled/superseded permission request. Tracks stop on stop, unmount, hidden document, pagehide, disabled camera preference, or ended devices. The UI captures only an explicit still frame and applies normal image ingestion/prediction. Cross-tab preference events stop camera components in the other open tabs. Physical-device permission denial and busy/not-found cases have actionable file-import alternatives.

Tests use Chromium's synthetic media device to exercise the actual MediaStream API/canvas/Worker/IndexedDB path. That is not a claim of physical webcam testing or support for every permission UI/browser. The page-owned camera indicator is the browser's own indicator, not a fabricated privacy signal.

## Storage inspection

StorageManager inventories actual databases and browser storage estimates. Its cancellable, read-only scan checks project/class/active-version/feedback references, stored image hashes, full CSV dataset hashes and numeric model formats. It does not repair/delete, decode every image, prove model quality, verify old image hashes that were never stored, or authenticate imported metrics. Snapshots across separate databases are not a global transaction; avoid editing other tabs during a scan.

Metadata-only diagnostics include aggregate counts, byte/quota estimates, persistence state and integrity totals only. They exclude project names/IDs, paths/URLs, labels, raw rows/images, hashes, user agent, stacks, weights, encryption keys and deletion tokens. Diagnostics are not recoverable backups.

## Offline and jobs

The existing production service worker precaches emitted application/lazy/worker assets using a build revision. API/share responses are not cached. Image encoder packs retain their independent pinned size/hash verification. Shared activity locks prevent applying a waiting service-worker update while a tracked worker/training/backup job is active. Worker failure/cancel/timeout handlers terminate workers and release locks. Image normalization is bounded and has a 60-second timeout.

`pnpm dev` intentionally does not install a service worker. Build/production-preview and wait for installation before offline tests. Origin changes isolate browser data. HTTPS/localhost, correct JS MIME and compatible CSP are required. Browser cache/IndexedDB eviction remains possible; private full backups are essential.

## Local release gates

`pnpm release:check --browser` executes the environment/import-boundary checks, actual frontend/relay typechecks, unit/runtime tests, production builds, dependency audit and explicit implemented Playwright specs. It never deploys. The static import scan detects reachable planned stubs and Node/relay dependencies in the browser graph; it is not a complete AST/security audit. Unfinished scaffold test files are excluded explicitly rather than being counted as passing tests.

CI runs the same gate on Node 22.23.4/pnpm 9.15.5 with a reviewed frozen lockfile and installed Chromium. The scheduled security workflow audits dependencies without write permissions or deployment secrets. Local execution of these commands does not establish that hosted GitHub Actions has already run. Operator deployment workflows remain unfinished and must not be represented as automatic working deployment.

# Changelog

All notable changes to NEURON. The project is built in phases; each phase is complete, tested and
pushed as a working slice — not a mockup. Anything not listed here does not exist yet.

Format loosely follows [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/). The project does not yet
declare a semantic version beyond the workspace version.

---

## [0.3.0] — Phase 3 · Encrypted model sharing

### Added
- In-browser AES-256-GCM encryption of a sanitized model artifact; the key never leaves the client.
- Cloudflare Worker relay (`services/relay`) with R2 object storage and a Durable Object rate limiter.
- `POST /api/shares`, `GET /api/shares/{id}`, `DELETE /api/shares/{id}`, `GET /api/shares/health`.
- Expiry choices of 15 minutes, 1 hour and 24 hours; hourly cron physically removes expired objects.
- Separate IndexedDB database for deletion receipts, so deleting a project does not lose revocation access.
- `Receive` and `Shares` pages, key-stripping from the visible address bar.
- `docs/sharing-protocol.md` — framing, API, limits and threat notes.
- 22 new tests (web + relay).

### Changed
- Workspace now requires **Node 22.12+** for the relay toolchain.
- `pnpm build` builds the web app *and* the worker bundle.

### Security
- Uploads are **disabled by default** in `wrangler.toml` (fail-closed).
- Origin allow-listing, application headers and per-IP/global budget checks on mutation routes.
- Root pnpm overrides pin Miniflare's `undici` and `sharp` to advisory-free versions.

---

## [0.2.0] — Phase 2 · Offline, backups, reviewed evolution

### Added
- Build-generated service worker that precaches all emitted assets, including lazy routes.
- Web Locks–guarded *Apply safe update* so training/download/backup jobs block updates.
- Verified offline encoder pack: five pinned MobileNet v2 files (~14 MB), SHA-256 + byte-size pins,
  streamed bounded download, cancel support, staging cache and a single-pointer commit.
- Full project backup/restore (images, classes, versions, feedback) with schema, shape, hash and JPEG
  validation before an atomic write; always restores into a new project.
- Consent-based feedback queue: approve → dataset, discard → delete; manual retraining only.
- Byte-level duplicate detection on ingest.
- Dataset and validation fingerprints recorded in training artifacts; comparison warnings when they differ.
- Additive IndexedDB migration from version 1 → 2 (existing data preserved).
- 22 new tests.

### Changed
- Training and dataset services now run inside cross-tab activity locks.
- Offline banner and updated runtime/backup settings panels.

---

## [0.1.0] — Phase 1 · Real on-device image classification

### Added
- Responsive dark navy / cyan / violet UI (hash router, 10 pages, accessible modal focus handling,
  visible focus rings, reduced-motion rules).
- Local projects in IndexedDB with deletion.
- Dataset builder: 2–20 classes, JPEG/PNG/WebP ingest, bounded JPEG normalization, per-class counts.
- Real TensorFlow.js transfer learning: frozen MobileNet v2 encoder (1,280 features) + trainable
  softmax head, WebGL preferred with CPU fallback and honest runtime reporting.
- Seeded stratified 20 % validation split, real epoch metrics, cancellation, confusion matrix.
- Immutable saved model versions with activate/rollback.
- Saved-file prediction and one-shot camera-frame prediction.
- Strictly validated `.neuron.json` export/import (tensor names and shapes checked; no arbitrary graphs).
- Storage estimates, persistence request, capability checks.
- 18 automated tests.

===== FILE README.md | bytes=4367 | sha256=88638d4535294c73213bde77ebffb6b7e4a86c204d22757b708241a76fdbe1eb =====
CONTENT START
# NEURON — Phase 4

Requires the cumulative Phases 1–3 baseline. Node 22.12+ and pnpm 9.15.5. Preserve the Phase 3 dependency overrides and real generated lockfile.

    pnpm install
    pnpm typecheck
    pnpm test
    pnpm build
    pnpm dev

Optional encrypted IMAGE-model sharing still uses `pnpm dev:relay` in a second terminal. CSV training/inference never needs that relay. No API key is needed.

## New: real CSV studio

Open CSV studio in navigation or from My projects. Create a named project, upload a comma-delimited UTF-8 CSV with headers, select classification or regression and a target column, choose numeric/categorical features, save configuration, train, and inspect held-out test metrics. Training runs in a dedicated browser module Worker; cancellation terminates it without saving a partial model. Classification is regularized linear softmax; regression is regularized linear regression, both optimized with mini-batch Adam. These are real bounded algorithms, not foundation models, synthetic predictions or a universal AutoML service.

Fit preprocessing ONLY on the training split: numeric imputation/standardization/missing indicators, categorical vocabulary with separate unseen/missing buckets. Training selects best weights with validation loss/early stopping; a distinct test split is evaluated only after selection. Repeated experiments on a reused test set can still introduce selection bias. Exact duplicate feature records are grouped into one split; semantically related groups/time series need an explicit domain-specific splitting policy that is not yet implemented.

Saved versions, activation/rollback, single-row and batch CSV prediction, formula-hardened prediction CSV export, model import/export and full CSV project backup/restore are implemented. Models and backups are separate formats. Tabular projects use their own IndexedDB database; existing image databases and sensitive share receipts are unchanged. Backups are sensitive unencrypted JSON. Prediction/model artifacts can expose feature names, categories and distribution statistics; do not assume they anonymize data.

## Offline and origins

`pnpm build`, then `pnpm --filter @neuron/web preview --port 4173 --strictPort`. Wait for production shell installation in Settings before disconnecting. Tabular algorithms have no remote weights; precached worker files enable offline training/prediction. Image inference still needs its verified encoder pack. Development deliberately does not install a service worker. Different scheme/host/port means different storage; transfer using the appropriate project backup. Image and CSV backups are explicitly different. Share receipts remain separate and are excluded from both.

## Limits and supported tasks

UTF-8 comma CSV only, <=16 MB, 25,000 rows, 100 columns, 500,000 cells; cells <=4,096 characters. Up to 30 selected source features and 512 encoded features, <=2,000,000 matrix entries. Classification: 2–20 labels, <=64 characters and >=10 distinct feature groups per class. Regression: >=30 distinct feature groups. Numeric magnitudes <=1e12, decimal point/scientific notation; locale thousands separators are not automatically interpreted. Categorical vocabulary retains at most 16 frequent levels of <=128 characters per feature. Long/rare/unseen values are explicitly grouped. Training caps 500 epochs. See docs/tabular-guide.md.

The model is linear: not appropriate for every nonlinear, temporal, relational or text task. No automatic fairness audit, causal inference, calibrated certainty, safety certification or universal accuracy promise. Training cannot make reliable predictions from inherently uninformative examples. Inspect leakage, identifiers, target quality and representative held-out data.

## Remaining release work

CSV-model public sharing is NOT connected to the Phase 3 image-only relay format. Use local CSV model export/import; do not silently upload datasets. Still no text/audio/video model training, P2P, image-training workers, full independent physical-device/browser/accessibility/security/license certification, resumable jobs or general simultaneous-edit conflict resolution. Browser storage/caches can be evicted; export private backups. Existing image workflow and real sharing relay remain available and tested, but cloud deployment is still an explicit operator task.

function currentRoute() {
  return location.hash.slice(1) || "/";
}
export function App() {
  const [route, setRoute] = useState(currentRoute);
  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => {
      setRoute(currentRoute());
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    };
    window.addEventListener("hashchange", update);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("hashchange", update);
  }, []);
  const parsed = parseRoute(route);
  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = routeTitle(parsed) + " · NEURON";
  }, [route]);
  let page;
  switch (parsed.kind) {
    case "home":
      page = <HomePage />;
      break;
    case "projects":
      page = <ProjectsPage />;
      break;
    case "settings":
      page = <SettingsPage />;
      break;
    case "shares":
      page = <SharesPage />;
      break;
    case "receive":
      page = (
        <ReceivePage key={parsed.id} id={parsed.id} secret={parsed.secret} />
      );
      break;
    case "tabular-home":
      page = <TabularProjectsPage />;
      break;
    case "tabular":
      page =
        parsed.step === "train" ? (
          <TabularTrainingPage key={route} id={parsed.id} />
        ) : parsed.step === "predict" ? (
          <TabularPredictPage key={route} id={parsed.id} />
        ) : (
          <TabularDatasetPage key={route} id={parsed.id} />
        );
      break;
    case "image":
      page =
        parsed.step === "train" ? (
          <TrainingPage key={route} id={parsed.id} />
        ) : parsed.step === "predict" ? (
          <PredictPage key={route} id={parsed.id} />
        ) : parsed.step === "evolve" ? (
          <EvolutionPage key={route} id={parsed.id} />
        ) : (
          <ProjectPage key={route} id={parsed.id} />
        );
      break;
    default:
      page = <NotFoundPage />;
  }
  return (
    <AppShell route={route}>
      <Suspense fallback={<p role="status">Loading workspace…</p>}>
        {page}
      </Suspense>
    </AppShell>
  );
}

import { Component, type ReactNode } from "react";
export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<
  { children: ReactNode },
  { error: string | null }
> {
  state: { error: string | null } = { error: null };
  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error) {
    return { error: error.message };
  }
  render() {
    return this.state.error ? (
      <main className="fatal">
        <h1>NEURON needs to restart</h1>
        <p role="alert">{this.state.error}</p>
        <p>Your previously saved projects have not been deleted.</p>
        <button onClick={() => location.reload()}>Reload application</button>
      </main>
    ) : (
      this.props.children
    );
  }
}

===== FILE apps/web/src/app/providers.tsx | bytes=2361 | sha256=d29a30227b70bc8df99b7865d1a4af43d9a4c6a4ec1e0bbed48ecd6e643b6b9a =====

import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
export type Preferences = { cameraEnabled: boolean; reducedMotion: boolean };
export const PREFERENCE_KEY = "neuron-preferences-v1";
export const DEFAULT_PREFERENCES: Preferences = {
  cameraEnabled: true,
  reducedMotion: false,
};
export function decodePreferences(raw: string | null): Preferences {
  try {
    const p = JSON.parse(raw ?? "null");
    if (
      p &&
      typeof p.cameraEnabled === "boolean" &&
      typeof p.reducedMotion === "boolean"
    )
      return { cameraEnabled: p.cameraEnabled, reducedMotion: p.reducedMotion };
  } catch {}
  return { ...DEFAULT_PREFERENCES };
}
function read() {
  try {
    return decodePreferences(localStorage.getItem(PREFERENCE_KEY));
  } catch {
    return { ...DEFAULT_PREFERENCES };
  }
}
const Context = createContext<{
  preferences: Preferences;
  update: (next: Preferences) => void;
  storageWarning: string;
}>({
  preferences: DEFAULT_PREFERENCES,
  update: () => {
    throw new Error("Preferences provider missing.");
  },
  storageWarning: "",
});
export function Providers({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [preferences, setPreferences] = useState(read),
    [storageWarning, setStorageWarning] = useState("");
  const update = useCallback((next: Preferences) => {
    const safe = decodePreferences(JSON.stringify(next));
    setPreferences(safe);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(PREFERENCE_KEY, JSON.stringify(safe));
      setStorageWarning("");
    } catch {
      setStorageWarning(
        "Preferences apply to this tab only because browser preference storage is blocked. Your project storage is separate.",
      );
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    const sync = (e: StorageEvent) => {
      if (e.key === PREFERENCE_KEY || e.key === null) setPreferences(read());
    };
    window.addEventListener("storage", sync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("storage", sync);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.reduceMotion = String(
      preferences.reducedMotion,
    );
  }, [preferences.reducedMotion]);
  return (
    <Context.Provider value={{ preferences, update, storageWarning }}>
      {children}
    </Context.Provider>
  );
}
export function usePreferences() {
  return useContext(Context);
}

===== FILE apps/web/src/app/router.tsx | bytes=1994 | sha256=d0ab1482298a0e136c70f8ee58f187579fd0f1870283da895d3af8f47cbf5df1 =====
CONTENT START
export type Route =
  | {
      kind:
        | "home"
        | "projects"
        | "settings"
        | "shares"
        | "tabular-home"
        | "not-found";
    }
  | { kind: "image"; id: string; step: "data" | "train" | "predict" | "evolve" }
  | { kind: "tabular"; id: string; step: "data" | "train" | "predict" }
  | { kind: "receive"; id: string; secret: string };
export function parseRoute(input: string): Route {
  const value = input.startsWith("#") ? input.slice(1) : input;
  if (value === "" || value === "/") return { kind: "home" };
  if (value === "/projects") return { kind: "projects" };
  if (value === "/settings") return { kind: "settings" };
  if (value === "/shares") return { kind: "shares" };
  if (value === "/tabular") return { kind: "tabular-home" };
  const image = value.match(
    /^\/projects\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100})(?:\/(train|predict|evolve))?$/,
  );
  if (image)
    return {
      kind: "image",
      id: image[1],
      step: (image[2] ?? "data") as "data" | "train" | "predict" | "evolve",
    };
  const table = value.match(
    /^\/tabular\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100})(?:\/(train|predict))?$/,
  );
  if (table)
    return {
      kind: "tabular",
      id: table[1],
      step: (table[2] ?? "data") as "data" | "train" | "predict",
    };
  const receive = value.match(
    /^\/receive\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{32})(?:\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}))?$/,
  );
  if (receive)
    return { kind: "receive", id: receive[1], secret: receive[2] ?? "" };
  return { kind: "not-found" };
}
export function routeTitle(route: Route) {
  switch (route.kind) {
    case "home":
      return "Overview";
    case "projects":
      return "My projects";
    case "settings":
      return "Privacy & storage";
    case "shares":
      return "Encrypted shares";
    case "receive":
      return "Receive a model";
    case "tabular-home":
    case "tabular":
      return "CSV studio";
    case "image":
      return "Image studio";
    default:
      return "Page not found";
  }
}

===== FILE apps/web/src/components/layout/OfflineBanner.tsx | bytes=2045 | sha256=380fcb4b203017486885b5a6daaf7869d0e83a1e8de802e26aad50de5effe9b8 =====

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  getRegistration,
  offlineState,
  subscribeOffline,
} from "../../pwa/register";
import { installUpdate } from "../../pwa/update-manager";
import { errorMessage } from "../../lib/types";
export function OfflineBanner({ tabular = false }: { tabular?: boolean }) {
  const [online, setOnline] = useState(navigator.onLine),
    [, render] = useState(0),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => setOnline(navigator.onLine);
    window.addEventListener("online", update);
    window.addEventListener("offline", update);
    const unsub = subscribeOffline(() => render((n) => n + 1));
    return () => {
      unsub();
      window.removeEventListener("online", update);
      window.removeEventListener("offline", update);
    };
  }, []);
  return (
    <>
      {!online && (
        <div className="notice offline-notice">
          You are offline. Saved projects remain local.{" "}
          {tabular
            ? "CSV training and predictions need no encoder pack after the production shell is installed."
            : "Image training and predictions require the verified encoder pack."}{" "}
          <a href="#/settings">Check readiness →</a>
        </div>
      )}
      {offlineState.updateAvailable && (
        <div className="notice offline-notice">
          A new app version is ready. Save your work first.{" "}
          <button
            className="btn btn-secondary"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => {
              const r = getRegistration();
              if (!r) return;
              setBusy(true);
              void installUpdate(r)
                .catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)))
                .finally(() => setBusy(false));
            }}
          >
            Apply safe update
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
export function Dialog({
  title,
  children,
  onClose,
}: {
  title: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const dialog = ref.current!;
    dialog.showModal();
    return () => dialog.close();
  }, []);
  return (
    <dialog
      ref={ref}
      className="dialog"
      aria-labelledby="dialog-title"
      onCancel={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div className="section-heading">
        <h2 id="dialog-title">{title}</h2>
        <button
          className="icon-btn"
          aria-label="Close dialog"
          onClick={onClose}
        >
          ×
        </button>
      </div>
      {children}
    </dialog>

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { UploadCloud } from "lucide-react";
export function FileDropzone({
  onFiles,
  disabled = false,
  multiple = true,
  accept = "image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp",
  label = "Drop images here, or browse",
}: {
  onFiles: (files: File[]) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  multiple?: boolean;
  accept?: string;
  label?: string;
}) {
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [over, setOver] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div
      className={`dropzone ${over ? "over" : ""}`}
      onDragOver={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!disabled) setOver(true);
      }}
      onDragLeave={() => setOver(false)}
      onDrop={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setOver(false);
        if (!disabled) onFiles(Array.from(e.dataTransfer.files));
      }}
    >
      <UploadCloud size={26} />
      <button
        type="button"
        className="drop-action"
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => input.current?.click()}
      >
        {label}
      </button>
      <small>JPEG, PNG, WebP · 15 MB per image</small>
      <input
        ref={input}
        type="file"
        hidden
        multiple={multiple}
        accept={accept}
        disabled={disabled}
        onChange={(e) => {
          onFiles(Array.from(e.target.files ?? []));
          e.target.value = "";
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

export function Progress({
  value,
  total,
  label,
}: {
  value: number;
  total: number;
  label: string;
}) {
  const safeTotal = Number.isFinite(total) && total > 0 ? total : 1,
    safeValue = Number.isFinite(value)
      ? Math.max(0, Math.min(safeTotal, value))
      : 0;
  return (
    <div className="job-progress">
      <span role="status">{label}</span>
      <progress aria-label={label} value={safeValue} max={safeTotal} />
      <small>
        {Math.round(safeValue)} / {Math.round(safeTotal)}
      </small>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE apps/web/src/features/datasets/SampleGrid.tsx | bytes=1959 | sha256=079498558e3c66e8787f5ab1d2ce6d8c0df2d2e9713e7f6650029aca1744277d =====

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { Sample } from "../../lib/types";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/Button";
function Thumbnail({
  sample,
  disabled,
  onRemove,
}: {
  sample: Sample;
  disabled: boolean;
  onRemove: () => void;
}) {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    const next = URL.createObjectURL(sample.blob);
    setUrl(next);
    return () => URL.revokeObjectURL(next);
  }, [sample.blob]);
  return (
    <div className="sample-thumb">
      <img src={url} alt="Training sample" loading="lazy" />
      <button disabled={disabled} aria-label="Remove sample" onClick={onRemove}>
        ×
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
export function SampleGrid({
  samples,
  disabled,
  onRemove,
}: {
  samples: Sample[];
  disabled: boolean;
  onRemove: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0),
    size = 48,
    pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(samples.length / size)),
    current = Math.min(page, pages - 1);
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="sample-grid">
        {samples.slice(current * size, (current + 1) * size).map((sample) => (
          <Thumbnail
            key={sample.id}
            sample={sample}
            disabled={disabled}
            onRemove={() => onRemove(sample.id)}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
      {samples.length > size && (
        <div className="sample-toolbar">
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            disabled={current === 0}
            onClick={() => setPage(current - 1)}
          >
            Previous samples
          </Button>
          <small role="status">
            Page {current + 1}/{pages} · {samples.length} samples
          </small>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            disabled={current === pages - 1}
            onClick={() => setPage(current + 1)}
          >
            Next samples
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { oneShotWorker } from "../../lib/worker-client";
import { trackTransaction } from "../../lib/db";
import { database } from "../../lib/db";
import { sha256 } from "../../lib/checksums";

export const MAX_SAMPLES = 1000;
export async function decodeImage(blob: Blob): Promise<ImageBitmap> {
  try {
    return await createImageBitmap(blob, { imageOrientation: "from-image" });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(
      "Could not decode this image. Use a valid JPEG, PNG or WebP.",
    );
  }
}
export async function normalizeImage(file: File): Promise<Blob> {
  if (!["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp"].includes(file.type))
    throw new Error(`${file.name}: only JPEG, PNG and WebP are supported.`);
  if (file.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024)
    throw new Error(`${file.name}: maximum upload size is 15 MB.`);
  if (
    typeof Worker !== "undefined" &&
    typeof OffscreenCanvas !== "undefined" &&
    typeof createImageBitmap === "function"
  ) {
    return oneShotWorker(
      () =>
        new Worker(
          new URL("../../workers/dataset.worker.ts", import.meta.url),
          { type: "module" },
        ),
      file,
      (value) => {
        if (
          !(value instanceof Blob) ||
          value.type !== "image/jpeg" ||
          !value.size ||
          value.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024
        )
          throw new Error("Invalid normalized worker image.");
        return value;
      },
    );
  }
  const bitmap = await decodeImage(file);
  try {
    if (bitmap.width * bitmap.height > 40_000_000)
      throw new Error("Image exceeds the 40-megapixel safety limit.");
    const scale = Math.min(1, 768 / Math.max(bitmap.width, bitmap.height));
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.width * scale));
    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.height * scale));
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) throw new Error("Canvas unavailable.");
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    return await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) =>
      canvas.toBlob(
        (b) => (b ? resolve(b) : reject(new Error("Image encoding failed."))),
        "image/jpeg",
        0.88,
      ),
    );
  } finally {
    bitmap.close();
  }
}
export async function addImages(
  projectId: string,
  labelId: string,
  files: File[],
  currentCount: number,
  onProgress: (n: number) => void,
) {
  if (currentCount + files.length > MAX_SAMPLES)
    throw new Error(
      `This phase supports at most ${MAX_SAMPLES} samples per project.`,
    );
  const errors: string[] = [];
  let saved = 0;
  for (const file of files) {
    try {
      const blob = await normalizeImage(file);
      const sample: Sample = {
        id: uid(),
        projectId,
        labelId,
        blob,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
      };
      sample.hash = await sha256(blob);
      const db = await database();
      // Lazily hash Phase 1 samples without recreating records deleted by another tab.
      for (const old of await db.getAllFromIndex(
        "samples",
        "by-project",
        projectId,
      )) {
        if (old.hash) continue;
        const hash = await sha256(old.blob);
        const update = trackTransaction(db.transaction("samples", "readwrite"));
        const current = await update.store.get(old.id);
        if (current) await update.store.put({ ...current, hash });
        await update.done;
      }
      const tx = trackTransaction(
        db.transaction(["projects", "samples"], "readwrite"),
      );
      const project = await tx.objectStore("projects").get(projectId);
      const current = await tx
        .objectStore("samples")
        .index("by-project")
        .getAll(projectId);
      if (
        !project ||
        !project.labels.some((l) => l.id === labelId) ||
        current.length >= MAX_SAMPLES ||
        current.some((s) => s.hash === sample.hash)
      ) {
        tx.abort();
        await tx.done.catch(() => {});
        throw new Error(
          !project
            ? "Project deleted."
            : current.some((s) => s.hash === sample.hash)
              ? "Duplicate image already exists in this project."
              : "Class changed or project sample limit reached.",
        );
      }
      await tx.objectStore("samples").add(sample);
      await tx
        .objectStore("projects")
        .put({ ...project, updatedAt: Date.now() });
      await tx.done;
      saved++;
    } catch (e) {
      errors.push(
        `${file.name}: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Save failed"}`,
      );
      if (e instanceof DOMException && e.name === "QuotaExceededError") break;
    }
    onProgress(saved);
  }
  return { saved, errors };
}
export async function removeSample(id: string) {
  await (await database()).delete("samples", id);
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  snapshotProject,
  database,
  trackTransaction,
  deleteLabel,
} from "../../lib/db";
import { cleanName } from "../projects/project.service";

import { explainError, requireCondition } from "../../lib/errors";
import { runActivity } from "../../pwa/update-manager";
export async function changeClass(
  projectId: string,
  change:
    | { kind: "add"; name: string }
    | { kind: "rename"; id: string; name: string },
) {
  const name = cleanName(change.name),
    db = await database(),
    tx = trackTransaction(db.transaction("projects", "readwrite")),
    p = await tx.store.get(projectId);
  requireCondition(p, "Project was deleted.");
  requireCondition(
    !p.labels.some(
      (l) =>
        (change.kind === "add" || l.id !== change.id) &&
        l.name.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase(),
    ),
    "Class name already exists.",
  );
  if (change.kind === "add")
    requireCondition(p.labels.length < 20, "At most 20 classes are supported.");
  else
    requireCondition(
      p.labels.some((l) => l.id === change.id),
      "Class was deleted in another tab.",
    );
  const labels =
    change.kind === "add"
      ? [...p.labels, { id: uid(), name }]
      : p.labels.map((l) => (l.id === change.id ? { ...l, name } : l));
  await tx.store.put({ ...p, labels, updatedAt: Date.now() });
  await tx.done;
}
export function useDataset(id: string) {
  const [project, setProject] = useState<Project | null>(null),
    [samples, setSamples] = useState<Sample[]>([]),
    [loading, setLoading] = useState(true),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [status, setStatus] = useState("");
  const alive = useRef(true),
    lock = useRef(false),
    request = useRef(0);
  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    const ticket = ++request.current;
    try {
      const s = await snapshotProject(id);
      if (alive.current && ticket === request.current) {
        setProject(s.project);
        setSamples(s.samples);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current && ticket === request.current)
        setError(explainError(e).message);
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [id]);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    void refresh();
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      request.current++;
    };
  }, [refresh]);
  async function mutate(action: () => Promise<unknown>) {
    if (lock.current) return false;
    lock.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await runActivity(action);
      if (alive.current) await refresh();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current) setError(explainError(e).message);
      return false;
    } finally {
      lock.current = false;
      if (alive.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  async function upload(labelId: string, files: File[]) {
    if (!files.length) return;
    await mutate(async () => {
      const result = await addImages(
        id,
        labelId,
        files,
        samples.length,
        (n) => {
          if (alive.current) setStatus(`Saved ${n} of ${files.length} images`);
        },
      );
      if (alive.current) {
        setStatus(`Added ${result.saved} images.`);
        if (result.errors.length)
          setError(result.errors.slice(0, 5).join("\n"));
      }
    });
  }
  return {
    project,
    samples,
    loading,
    busy,
    error,
    status,
    refresh,
    upload,
    rename: (labelId: string, name: string) =>
      mutate(() => changeClass(id, { kind: "rename", id: labelId, name })),
    add: (name: string) => mutate(() => changeClass(id, { kind: "add", name })),
    remove: (sampleId: string) => mutate(() => removeSample(sampleId)),
    deleteClass: (labelId: string) =>
      mutate(async () => {
        requireCondition(project, "Project not found.");
        await deleteLabel(project, labelId);
      }),
  };
}

function ReviewImage({ blob }: { blob: Blob }) {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    const u = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    setUrl(u);
    return () => URL.revokeObjectURL(u);
  }, [blob]);
  return (
    <img
      className="review-image"
      src={url}
      alt="Feedback image awaiting approval"
    />
  );
}
export function FeedbackQueue({ project }: { project: Project }) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<FeedbackItem[]>([]),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  async function refresh() {
    setItems(await listFeedback(project.id));
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh().catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)));
  }, [project.id]);
  async function task(action: () => Promise<unknown>) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await action();
      await refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <h2>Review queue · {items.length}/100</h2>
      <p>
        Approve adds an image to its chosen training class. Your saved model
        does not change until you retrain and activate a new version.
      </p>
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      {message && <p role="status">{message}</p>}
      {!items.length ? (
        <p className="muted">
          No pending feedback. Add a prediction image from the Predict page.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <div className="review-grid">
          {items.map((item) => (
            <article key={item.id}>
              <ReviewImage blob={item.blob} />
              <strong>
                {project.labels.find((l) => l.id === item.labelId)?.name ??
                  "Class removed"}
              </strong>
              <p>Predicted: {item.predictedLabel}</p>
              <div className="inline">
                <Button
                  disabled={busy}
                  onClick={() =>
                    void task(async () => {
                      await approveFeedback(item.id);
                      setMessage("Added to the dataset. Retrain when ready.");
                    })
                  }
                >
                  Approve
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  disabled={busy}
                  onClick={() => void task(() => discardFeedback(item.id))}
                >
                  Discard
                </Button>
              </div>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      <a className="btn btn-secondary" href={`#/projects/${project.id}/train`}>
        Retrain with approved examples
      </a>
    </section>
  );
}

import { trackTransaction } from "../../lib/db";
import { database, activateVersion } from "../../lib/db";
import { sha256 } from "../../lib/checksums";
import {
  uid,
  type FeedbackItem,
  type ModelVersion,
  type Sample,
} from "../../lib/types";
import { runActivity } from "../../pwa/update-manager";
export function comparable(a: ModelVersion, b: ModelVersion) {
  return (
    !!a.artifact.provenance?.validationHash &&
    a.artifact.provenance.validationHash ===
      b.artifact.provenance?.validationHash
  );
}
export async function queueFeedback(
  projectId: string,
  versionId: string,
  labelId: string,
  blob: Blob,
  predictedLabel: string,
) {
  if (blob.type !== "image/jpeg" || blob.size > 1024 * 1024)
    throw new Error("Feedback must be a normalized JPEG under 1 MB.");
  const db = await database(),
    tx = trackTransaction(
      db.transaction(["projects", "versions", "feedback"], "readwrite"),
    ),
    p = await tx.objectStore("projects").get(projectId),
    v = await tx.objectStore("versions").get(versionId);
  const existing = await tx
    .objectStore("feedback")
    .index("by-project")
    .getAllKeys(projectId);
  if (
    !p ||
    !v ||
    v.projectId !== projectId ||
    !p.labels.some((l) => l.id === labelId) ||
    existing.length >= 100
  ) {
    tx.abort();
    await tx.done.catch(() => {});
    throw new Error(
      "Class/model changed or feedback queue has reached 100 items.",
    );
  }
  const item: FeedbackItem = {
    id: uid(),
    projectId,
    versionId,
    labelId,
    blob,
    predictedLabel: predictedLabel.slice(0, 64),
    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };
  await tx.objectStore("feedback").add(item);
  await tx.done;
  return item;
}
export async function listFeedback(projectId: string) {
  return (await database()).getAllFromIndex(
    "feedback",
    "by-project",
    projectId,
  );
}
export async function discardFeedback(id: string) {
  await (await database()).delete("feedback", id);
}
export async function approveFeedback(id: string) {
  return runActivity(async () => {
    const db = await database(),
      item = await db.get("feedback", id);
    if (!item) throw new Error("Feedback no longer exists.");
    const hash = await sha256(item.blob);
    // Legacy samples can be hashed before opening the final write transaction.
    for (const old of await db.getAllFromIndex(
      "samples",
      "by-project",
      item.projectId,
    )) {
      if (old.hash) continue;
      const value = await sha256(old.blob);
      const t = trackTransaction(db.transaction("samples", "readwrite"));
      const current = await t.store.get(old.id);
      if (current) await t.store.put({ ...current, hash: value });
      await t.done;
    }
    const tx = trackTransaction(
      db.transaction(["projects", "samples", "feedback"], "readwrite"),
    );
    const live = await tx.objectStore("feedback").get(id),
      p = await tx.objectStore("projects").get(item.projectId),
      samples = await tx
        .objectStore("samples")
        .index("by-project")
        .getAll(item.projectId);
    if (
      !live ||
      !p ||
      !p.labels.some((l) => l.id === item.labelId) ||
      samples.length >= 1000 ||
      samples.some((s) => s.hash === hash)
    ) {
      tx.abort();
      await tx.done.catch(() => {});
      throw new Error(
        "Feedback changed, image already exists, or sample limit reached. Discard duplicates.",
      );
    }
    const sample: Sample = {
      id: uid(),
      projectId: item.projectId,
      labelId: item.labelId,
      blob: item.blob,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      hash,
    };
    await tx.objectStore("samples").add(sample);
    await tx.objectStore("feedback").delete(id);
    await tx.objectStore("projects").put({ ...p, updatedAt: Date.now() });
    await tx.done;
  });
}

      session.current.stop();

      window.removeEventListener("hashchange", stop);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", hidden);
    };
  }, [stop]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!preferences.cameraEnabled) stop();
  }, [preferences.cameraEnabled, stop]);

        setError(explainError(e).message);
    } finally {
      if (ticket === generation.current) {
        requesting.current = false;
        if (alive.current) setPending(false);
      }
    }
  }
  async function capture() {

    capturing.current = true;

      if (alive.current) await onCapture(file);
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current) setError(explainError(e).message);
    } finally {
      capturing.current = false;
      if (alive.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <div className="camera-panel">
      <CapabilityNotice
        supported={cameraSupported()}
        title="Camera unavailable"
      >
        Use HTTPS/localhost and a supported browser, or import JPEG/PNG/WebP

      </CapabilityNotice>

          : permission}

          </Button>

            variant="secondary"
            disabled={

            }
            onClick={() => void start()}
          >
            Use camera
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
      {stream && (
        <video
          className="camera-video"
          ref={video}
          autoPlay
          muted
          playsInline
          aria-label="Camera preview"
          onLoadedData={() => setFrameReady(true)}
        />
      )}
      <p className="camera-status">
        {stream
          ? frameReady
            ? "Preview ready. Capture only when you choose."
            : "Waiting for first camera frame…"
          : pending
            ? "Waiting for browser permission…"
            : "Camera is stopped."}
      </p>
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );

===== FILE apps/web/src/features/inference/inference.service.ts | bytes=1473 | sha256=66f771ab126bc2d3ae95fbfc777f2b53c6c3e4bf125f415e12f8d75534ea0d1f =====

import { embed, makeHead, tf, initializeRuntime } from "../../lib/ml";
import { fromBase64, validateArtifact } from "../../lib/model-format";
import type { ModelArtifact, Prediction } from "../../lib/types";
export async function predictor(value: ModelArtifact) {
  const artifact = validateArtifact(value);
  await initializeRuntime();
  const head = makeHead(artifact.labels.length, 1);
  try {
    const decoded = tf.io.decodeWeights(
      fromBase64(artifact.weightData),
      artifact.weightSpecs,
    );
    try {
      head.setWeights(artifact.weightSpecs.map((s) => decoded[s.name]));
    } finally {
      Object.values(decoded).forEach((t) => t.dispose());
    }
  } catch (e) {
    head.dispose();
    throw e;
  }
  let disposed = false;
  return {
    async predict(blob: Blob): Promise<Prediction[]> {
      if (disposed) throw new Error("Predictor has been disposed.");
      const vector = await embed(blob);
      if (disposed) throw new Error("Predictor has been disposed.");
      const result = tf.tidy(
        () => head.predict(tf.tensor2d(vector, [1, 1280])) as tf.Tensor,
      );
      try {
        const scores = await result.data();
        return artifact.labels
          .map((l, i) => ({ label: l.name, score: scores[i] }))
          .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
      } finally {
        result.dispose();
      }
    },
    dispose() {
      if (!disposed) {
        disposed = true;
        head.dispose();
      }
    },
  };
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { getProject, listVersions, activateVersion } from "../../lib/db";
import type { Project, ModelVersion, Prediction } from "../../lib/types";
import { predictor } from "./inference.service";
import { normalizeImage } from "../datasets/dataset.service";
import { explainError } from "../../lib/errors";
import { runActivity } from "../../pwa/update-manager";
export function useImageInference(id: string) {
  const [project, setProject] = useState<Project | null>(null),
    [versions, setVersions] = useState<ModelVersion[]>([]),
    [selected, setSelected] = useState(""),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [ready, setReady] = useState(false),
    [results, setResults] = useState<Prediction[]>([]),
    [preview, setPreview] = useState(""),
    [feedbackBlob, setFeedbackBlob] = useState<Blob | null>(null),
    [latency, setLatency] = useState(0),
    [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const alive = useRef(true),
    inFlight = useRef(false),
    engine = useRef<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof predictor>> | null>(null),
    generation = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    Promise.all([getProject(id), listVersions(id)])
      .then(([p, v]) => {
        if (alive.current) {
          setProject(p ?? null);
          setVersions(v);
          setSelected(p?.activeVersionId ?? v[0]?.id ?? "");
          if (!p) setError("Project not found.");
        }
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (alive.current) setError(explainError(e).message);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (alive.current) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      generation.current++;
    };
  }, [id]);
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const ticket = ++generation.current;
    setReady(false);
    setResults([]);
    setFeedbackBlob(null);
    setPreview("");
    const version = versions.find((v) => v.id === selected);
    if (!version) return;
    void predictor(version.artifact)
      .then((p) => {
        if (cancelled || !alive.current || ticket !== generation.current)
          p.dispose();
        else {
          engine.current = p;
          setReady(true);
        }
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (!cancelled && alive.current) setError(explainError(e).message);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      engine.current?.dispose();
      engine.current = null;
    };
  }, [selected, versions]);
  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      if (preview) URL.revokeObjectURL(preview);
    },
    [preview],
  );
  async function fromFile(files: File[]) {
    if (!files[0] || !engine.current || inFlight.current) return;
    inFlight.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    const ticket = generation.current,
      start = performance.now(),
      current = engine.current;
    try {
      await runActivity(async () => {
        const blob = await normalizeImage(files[0]);
        const predictions = await current.predict(blob);
        if (alive.current && ticket === generation.current) {
          setResults(predictions);
          setLatency(performance.now() - start);
          setFeedbackBlob(blob);
          setPreview(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current && ticket === generation.current)
        setError(explainError(e).message);
    } finally {
      inFlight.current = false;
      if (alive.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  async function makeActive() {
    if (!project || busy) return;
    try {
      await activateVersion(id, selected);
      if (alive.current) setProject({ ...project, activeVersionId: selected });
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current) setError(explainError(e).message);
    }
  }
  return {
    project,
    versions,
    selected,
    setSelected,
    error,
    busy,
    ready,
    results,
    preview,
    feedbackBlob,
    latency,
    loading,
    fromFile,
    makeActive,
  };
}

import { saveProject } from "../../lib/db";
import { uid, type Project, type Label } from "../../lib/types";
export function cleanName(value: string, max = 64) {
  const s = value.trim();
  if (!s || s.length > max)
    throw new Error(`Use between 1 and ${max} characters.`);
  return s;
}
export function validateLabels(labels: Label[]) {
  if (labels.length < 2 || labels.length > 20)
    throw new Error("Use between 2 and 20 classes.");
  const names = labels.map((l) => cleanName(l.name).toLocaleLowerCase());
  if (new Set(names).size !== names.length)
    throw new Error("Class names must be unique.");
}
export async function createProject(name: string): Promise<Project> {
  const now = Date.now();
  const p: Project = {
    id: uid(),
    name: cleanName(name),
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
    labels: [
      { id: uid(), name: "Class 1" },
      { id: uid(), name: "Class 2" },
    ],
  };
  await saveProject(p);
  return p;
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { listProjects, deleteProject } from "../../lib/db";
import type { Project } from "../../lib/types";
import { explainError } from "../../lib/errors";
export function useProjects() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Project[]>([]),
    [loading, setLoading] = useState(true),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  const alive = useRef(true),
    lock = useRef(false);
  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const p = await listProjects();
      if (alive.current) setItems(p);
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current) setError(explainError(e).message);
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    void refresh();
    const focus = () => {
      if (!lock.current) void refresh();
    };
    window.addEventListener("focus", focus);
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      window.removeEventListener("focus", focus);
    };
  }, [refresh]);
  async function remove(project: Project) {
    if (
      lock.current ||
      !confirm(
        `Permanently delete “${project.name}”, its images and all model versions? This cannot be undone. Export a full backup first.`,
      )
    )
      return;
    lock.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await deleteProject(project.id);
      await refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current) setError(explainError(e).message);
    } finally {
      lock.current = false;
      if (alive.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return { items, loading, busy, error, refresh, remove };
}

export async function restoreProject(file: Blob) {
  const snapshot = await decodeBackup(file);
  // Decode images before transaction; never keep IDB transactions alive across canvas work.
  for (const s of [...snapshot.samples, ...snapshot.feedback]) {
    const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(s.blob);
    try {
      if (bitmap.width > 768 || bitmap.height > 768)
        throw new Error("Backup image exceeds normalized dimensions.");
    } finally {
      bitmap.close();
    }
  }
  const db = await database(),
    tx = trackTransaction(
      db.transaction(
        ["projects", "samples", "versions", "feedback"],
        "readwrite",
      ),
    );
  await tx.objectStore("projects").add(snapshot.project);
  for (const s of snapshot.samples) await tx.objectStore("samples").add(s);
  for (const v of snapshot.versions) await tx.objectStore("versions").add(v);
  for (const f of snapshot.feedback) await tx.objectStore("feedback").add(f);
  await tx.done;
  return snapshot.project;
}
