import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { packStatus, downloadPack, removePack } from "../../pwa/asset-manager";
import {
  getRegistration,
  offlineState,
  subscribeOffline,
} from "../../pwa/register";
import { bytes } from "../../lib/capabilities";
import { errorMessage } from "../../lib/types";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/Button";
export function RuntimeSettings() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState({ ready: false, bytes: 0, error: "" }),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [progress, setProgress] = useState(0),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [, render] = useState(0);
  const control = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    void packStatus().then(setStatus);
    const unsubscribe = subscribeOffline(() => render((n) => n + 1));
    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
      control.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);
  async function download() {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    const c = new AbortController();
    control.current = c;
    try {
      await downloadPack(c.signal, (done, total) => setProgress(done / total));
      setStatus(await packStatus());
    } catch (e) {
      setError(
        c.signal.aborted
          ? "Download cancelled. No incomplete pack was installed."
          : errorMessage(e),
      );
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      control.current = null;
    }
  }
  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <h2>Offline readiness</h2>
      <dl className="summary-list">
        <div>
          <dt>Application shell</dt>
          <dd>
            {offlineState.controlled
              ? "Installed"
              : import.meta.env.DEV
                ? "Development mode"
                : "Installing / unavailable"}
          </dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt>Image encoder</dt>
          <dd>
            {status.ready ? `Verified · ${bytes(status.bytes)}` : "Not ready"}
          </dd>
        </div>
      </dl>
      <p>
        Both the production app shell and verified encoder must be installed
        before disconnecting. Storage can still be cleared or evicted by your
        browser.
      </p>
      {busy ? (
        <>
          <progress value={progress} max={1} />
          <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => control.current?.abort()}>
            Cancel download
          </Button>
        </>
      ) : (
        <div className="inline wrap">
          <Button disabled={status.ready} onClick={() => void download()}>
            Download image encoder (~14 MB)
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            disabled={!status.ready}
            onClick={() => {
              if (
                confirm(
                  "Remove the cached encoder? Existing models and images remain, but future page sessions need another download.",
                )
              )
                void removePack()
                  .then(() => packStatus())
                  .then(setStatus)
                  .catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)));
            }}
          >
            Remove encoder pack
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            onClick={() => void packStatus().then(setStatus)}
          >
            Verify pack
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
      {(error || status.error || offlineState.error) && (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {error || status.error || offlineState.error}
        </p>
      )}
      <Button
        variant="ghost"
        onClick={() =>
          void getRegistration()
            ?.update()
            .catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)))
        }
      >
        Check for app update
      </Button>
      <p className="phase-note">
        Offline reload works in a production build only: pnpm build, then pnpm
        --filter @neuron/web preview. Open localhost:4173, wait for shell
        installation and download the encoder. Development Vite sessions
        deliberately do not install a service worker.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { database, trackTransaction } from "../../lib/db";
import { tabularDB, track } from "../../tabular/database";
import { listReceipts } from "../sharing/receipt.repository";
import { storageInfo, bytes } from "../../lib/capabilities";
import { sha256 } from "../../lib/checksums";
import { validateArtifact } from "../../lib/model-format";
import { validateTabularModel } from "../../tabular/model-format";
import { validateTable } from "../../tabular/schema";
import {
  runActivity,
  activeJobs,
  subscribeJobs,
} from "../../pwa/update-manager";
import { explainError } from "../../lib/errors";
import { downloadBlob } from "../../lib/download";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/Button";
export type Inventory = {
  image: {
    projects: number;
    samples: number;
    versions: number;
    feedback: number;
    blobBytes: number;
  };
  tabular: {
    projects: number;
    datasets: number;
    rows: number;
    versions: number;
  };
  receipts: number;
  originStorage: { usage: number; quota: number; persistent: boolean };
};
export async function localInventory(): Promise<Inventory> {
  const images = await database(),
    tx = trackTransaction(
      images.transaction(
        ["projects", "samples", "versions", "feedback"],
        "readonly",
      ),
    );
  const [projects, samples, versions, feedback] = await Promise.all([
    tx.objectStore("projects").count(),
    tx.objectStore("samples").getAll(),
    tx.objectStore("versions").count(),
    tx.objectStore("feedback").getAll(),
  ]);
  await tx.done;
  const csv = await tabularDB(),
    tab = track(
      csv.transaction(["projects", "datasets", "versions"], "readonly"),
    );
  const [tabProjects, datasets, tabVersions] = await Promise.all([
    tab.objectStore("projects").count(),
    tab.objectStore("datasets").getAll(),
    tab.objectStore("versions").count(),
  ]);
  await tab.done;
  return {
    image: {
      projects,
      samples: samples.length,
      versions,
      feedback: feedback.length,
      blobBytes: [...samples, ...feedback].reduce(
        (sum, s) => sum + s.blob.size,
        0,
      ),
    },
    tabular: {
      projects: tabProjects,
      datasets: datasets.length,
      rows: datasets.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.rows.length, 0),
      versions: tabVersions,
    },
    receipts: (await listReceipts()).length,
    originStorage: await storageInfo(),
  };
}
export type IntegrityResult = {
  checked: number;
  issues: string[];
  complete: boolean;
};
export async function inspectLocalIntegrity(
  signal: AbortSignal,
  onProgress: (text: string) => void = () => {},
): Promise<IntegrityResult> {
  return runActivity(async () => {
    const result: IntegrityResult = { checked: 0, issues: [], complete: false };
    let sequence = 0;
    const check = async () => {
      signal.throwIfAborted();
      if (++sequence % 10 === 0) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
      signal.throwIfAborted();
    };
    const issue = (text: string) => {
      if (result.issues.length < 100) result.issues.push(text);
    };
    const db = await database(),
      tx = trackTransaction(
        db.transaction(
          ["projects", "samples", "versions", "feedback"],
          "readonly",
        ),
      );
    const [projects, samples, versions, feedback] = await Promise.all([
      tx.objectStore("projects").getAll(),
      tx.objectStore("samples").getAll(),
      tx.objectStore("versions").getAll(),
      tx.objectStore("feedback").getAll(),
    ]);
    await tx.done;
    const projectMap = new Map(projects.map((p) => [p.id, p])),
      versionMap = new Map(versions.map((v) => [v.id, v]));
    onProgress("Checking image project references…");
    for (const p of projects) {
      await check();
      result.checked++;
      if (
        p.activeVersionId &&
        versionMap.get(p.activeVersionId)?.projectId !== p.id
      )
        issue("An image project references a missing/foreign active model.");
    }
    for (const sample of samples) {
      await check();
      result.checked++;
      const p = projectMap.get(sample.projectId);
      if (!p || !p.labels.some((l) => l.id === sample.labelId))
        issue("An image sample has a missing project/class reference.");
      if (sample.hash && (await sha256(sample.blob)) !== sample.hash)
        issue("An image sample checksum does not match its stored content.");
    }
    for (const v of versions) {
      await check();
      result.checked++;
      if (!projectMap.has(v.projectId))
        issue("An image model has a missing project reference.");
      try {
        validateArtifact(v.artifact);
      } catch {
        issue("An image model failed numeric format validation.");
      }
    }
    for (const f of feedback) {
      await check();
      result.checked++;
      const p = projectMap.get(f.projectId);
      if (
        !p ||
        !p.labels.some((l) => l.id === f.labelId) ||
        versionMap.get(f.versionId)?.projectId !== f.projectId
      )
        issue("A feedback item has a missing project/class/model reference.");
    }
    onProgress("Checking CSV datasets and saved model formats…");
    const csv = await tabularDB(),
      tab = track(
        csv.transaction(["projects", "datasets", "versions"], "readonly"),
      );
    const [tables, datasets, models] = await Promise.all([
      tab.objectStore("projects").getAll(),
      tab.objectStore("datasets").getAll(),
      tab.objectStore("versions").getAll(),
    ]);
    await tab.done;
    const tableIds = new Set(tables.map((p) => p.id)),
      modelsById = new Map(models.map((v) => [v.id, v]));
    for (const p of tables) {
      await check();
      result.checked++;
      if (
        p.activeVersionId &&
        modelsById.get(p.activeVersionId)?.projectId !== p.id
      )
        issue("A CSV project references a missing/foreign active model.");
    }
    for (const d of datasets) {
      await check();
      result.checked++;
      if (!tableIds.has(d.projectId))
        issue("A CSV dataset has a missing project reference.");
      try {
        validateTable(d);
        if (
          (await sha256(
            JSON.stringify({ headers: d.headers, rows: d.rows }),
          )) !== d.hash
        )
          issue("A CSV dataset checksum does not match its stored content.");
      } catch {
        issue("A CSV dataset failed schema validation.");
      }
    }
    for (const v of models) {
      await check();
      result.checked++;
      if (!tableIds.has(v.projectId))
        issue("A CSV model has a missing project reference.");
      try {
        validateTabularModel(v.artifact);
      } catch {
        issue("A CSV model failed numeric format validation.");
      }
    }
    signal.throwIfAborted();
    result.complete = true;
    return result;
  });
}
// Intentionally no user-controlled names, IDs, URLs, hashes, labels, examples,
// artifacts, encryption/deletion secrets, user-agent strings or stack traces.
export function diagnosticSummary(
  inventory: Inventory,
  integrity: IntegrityResult | null,
) {
  return {
    format: "neuron-local-diagnostics",
    version: 1,
    applicationPhase: 5,
    inventory,
    integrity: integrity
      ? {
          complete: integrity.complete,
          checked: integrity.checked,
          issueCount: integrity.issues.length,
        }
      : null,
  };
}
export function StorageManager() {
  const [inventory, setInventory] = useState<Inventory | null>(null),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [status, setStatus] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [result, setResult] = useState<IntegrityResult | null>(null),
    [jobs, setJobs] = useState(activeJobs());
  const controller = useRef<AbortController | null>(null),
    lock = useRef(false),
    alive = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    void localInventory()
      .then((v) => {
        if (alive.current) setInventory(v);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (alive.current) setError(explainError(e).message);
      });
    const unsubscribe = subscribeJobs(() => setJobs(activeJobs()));
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      controller.current?.abort();
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, []);
  async function refresh() {
    if (lock.current) return;
    lock.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const next = await localInventory();
      if (alive.current) {
        setInventory(next);
        setStatus("Local storage inventory refreshed.");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current) setError(explainError(e).message);
    } finally {
      lock.current = false;
      if (alive.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  async function scan() {
    if (lock.current) return;
    lock.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    setResult(null);
    const c = new AbortController();
    controller.current = c;
    try {
      const next = await inspectLocalIntegrity(c.signal, (text) => {
        if (alive.current) setStatus(text);
      });
      if (alive.current) {
        setResult(next);
        setStatus(
          `Integrity scan complete: ${next.checked} records checked, ${next.issues.length}${next.issues.length === 100 ? "+" : ""} issues.`,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current) setError(explainError(e).message);
    } finally {
      controller.current = null;
      lock.current = false;
      if (alive.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <section className="panel storage-manager">
      <h2>Browser storage & integrity</h2>
      <p>
        Inventory is local and read-only. It never uploads raw images, CSV data,
        model weights or deletion receipts. Estimates cover the entire origin,
        including caches, and are not exact database byte totals.
      </p>
      {inventory ? (
        <>
          <div className="storage-number">
            {bytes(inventory.originStorage.usage)}
            <small> used by this origin</small>
          </div>
          <p className="muted">
            Estimated quota: {bytes(inventory.originStorage.quota)} ·
            Persistence:{" "}
            {inventory.originStorage.persistent ? "Granted" : "Not guaranteed"}
          </p>
          <dl className="summary-list">
            <div>
              <dt>Image projects / samples / model versions</dt>
              <dd>
                {inventory.image.projects} / {inventory.image.samples} /{" "}
                {inventory.image.versions}
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Feedback queue / image blobs</dt>
              <dd>
                {inventory.image.feedback} / {bytes(inventory.image.blobBytes)}
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>CSV projects / datasets / rows / versions</dt>
              <dd>
                {inventory.tabular.projects} / {inventory.tabular.datasets} /{" "}
                {inventory.tabular.rows} / {inventory.tabular.versions}
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Private deletion receipts</dt>
              <dd>{inventory.receipts}</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
        </>
      ) : (
        <p role="status">Reading local inventory…</p>
      )}
      <div className="csv-upload-actions">
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          disabled={busy}
          onClick={() => void refresh()}
        >
          Refresh local inventory
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          disabled={busy || jobs > 0}
          onClick={() => void scan()}
        >
          Scan local data integrity
        </Button>
        {busy && controller.current && (
          <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => controller.current?.abort()}>
            Cancel integrity scan
          </Button>
        )}
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          disabled={!inventory || busy}
          onClick={() => {
            if (inventory)
              downloadBlob(
                new Blob(
                  [
                    JSON.stringify(
                      diagnosticSummary(inventory, result),
                      null,
                      2,
                    ),
                  ],
                  { type: "application/json" },
                ),
                "neuron-local-diagnostics.json",
              );
          }}
        >
          Download metadata-only diagnostics
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          disabled={busy || !navigator.storage?.persist}
          onClick={() => {
            void navigator.storage
              .persist()
              .then((granted) => {
                setStatus(
                  granted
                    ? "Persistent storage granted. Still keep private backups."
                    : "The browser did not grant persistence. Export important projects.",
                );
                return refresh();
              })
              .catch((e) => setError(explainError(e).message));
          }}
        >
          Request persistent storage
        </Button>
      </div>
      {jobs > 0 && !busy && (
        <p className="phase-note">
          Finish/cancel this tab's active jobs before starting an integrity
          scan.
        </p>
      )}
      {status && <p role="status">{status}</p>}
      {result && (
        <div className="storage-report">
          {result.issues.length
            ? result.issues.map((s, i) => `${i + 1}. ${s}`).join("\n")
            : "No reference, stored checksum or numeric model-format issues were found in the checked records."}
        </div>
      )}
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <p className="phase-note">
        The scan uses snapshots, not a global multi-database lock: avoid edits
        in other tabs while scanning. Older images without stored hashes get
        reference checks only. This is not semantic dataset validation or proof
        that stored images decode. No automatic repair/deletion is performed.
        Back up first and investigate any issue. Diagnostics are not project
        backups.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

export function ImportDialog({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null),
    lock = useRef(false);

===== FILE apps/web/src/features/sharing/crypto.ts | bytes=2956 | sha256=f37fd9a4a6f7bef12a536b02e1ea479a31cddb6219b3146b3419824c80d61c25 =====

const MAGIC = new Uint8Array([78, 82, 78, 1]);
const AAD = new TextEncoder().encode("NEURON-MODEL-SHARE:v1");
export const MAX_CIPHER_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024 + 64;
export function base64url(bytes: Uint8Array) {
  let raw = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 8192)
    raw += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(i, i + 8192));
  return btoa(raw).replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_").replace(/=+$/, "");
}
export function unbase64url(value: string, bytes: number) {
  if (
    !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(value) ||
    value.length !== Math.ceil((bytes * 4) / 3)
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid secret encoding.");
  let raw: string;
  try {
    raw = atob(
      value.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/") +
        "=".repeat((4 - (value.length % 4)) % 4),
    );
  } catch {
    throw new Error("Invalid secret encoding.");
  }
  const data = Uint8Array.from(raw, (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
  if (data.length !== bytes || base64url(data) !== value)
    throw new Error("Noncanonical secret encoding.");
  return data;
}
export function randomSecret() {
  return base64url(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32)));
}
export async function secretHash(value: string) {
  unbase64url(value, 32);
  const bytes = await crypto.subtle.digest(
    "SHA-256",
    new TextEncoder().encode(value),
  );
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(bytes), (b) =>
    b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"),
  ).join("");
}
export async function encryptModel(plaintext: Uint8Array) {
  if (plaintext.length > MAX_CIPHER_BYTES - 32)
    throw new Error("Model is too large to share.");
  const secret = randomSecret(),
    iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "raw",
    unbase64url(secret, 32),
    { name: "AES-GCM" },
    false,
    ["encrypt"],
  );
  const encrypted = await crypto.subtle.encrypt(
    { name: "AES-GCM", iv, additionalData: AAD, tagLength: 128 },
    key,
    plaintext as BufferSource,
  );
  const output = new Uint8Array(16 + encrypted.byteLength);
  output.set(MAGIC);
  output.set(iv, 4);
  output.set(new Uint8Array(encrypted), 16);
  return { secret, bytes: output };
}
export async function decryptModel(envelope: Uint8Array, secret: string) {
  if (
    envelope.length < 33 ||
    envelope.length > MAX_CIPHER_BYTES ||
    !MAGIC.every((b, i) => envelope[i] === b)
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid encrypted model envelope.");
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "raw",
    unbase64url(secret, 32),
    { name: "AES-GCM" },
    false,
    ["decrypt"],
  );
  try {
    return new Uint8Array(
      await crypto.subtle.decrypt(
        {
          name: "AES-GCM",
          iv: envelope.slice(4, 16),
          additionalData: AAD,
          tagLength: 128,
        },
        key,
        envelope.slice(16),
      ),
    );
  } catch {
    throw new Error(
      "Cannot decrypt this model. The key is incorrect or the encrypted file was altered.",
    );
  }
}

import { openDB } from "idb";
import { parseShareLink, validShareId } from "./share-links";
import { unbase64url } from "./crypto";
export type ShareReceipt = {
  format: "neuron-share-receipt";
  version: 1;
  id: string;
  projectId: string;
  versionId: string;
  name: string;
  createdAt: number;
  expiresAt: number;
  deleteToken: string;
  link: string;
};
const db = () =>
  openDB("neuron-sharing", 1, {
    upgrade(database) {
      database.createObjectStore("receipts", { keyPath: "id" });
    },
  });
export function validateReceipt(value: unknown): ShareReceipt {
  const r = value as ShareReceipt;
  if (
    !r ||
    r.format !== "neuron-share-receipt" ||
    r.version !== 1 ||
    !validShareId(r.id ?? "") ||
    typeof r.projectId !== "string" ||
    r.projectId.length > 100 ||
    typeof r.versionId !== "string" ||
    r.versionId.length > 100 ||
    typeof r.name !== "string" ||
    !r.name.trim() ||
    r.name.length > 64 ||
    !Number.isFinite(r.createdAt) ||
    !Number.isFinite(r.expiresAt) ||
    r.expiresAt <= r.createdAt ||
    typeof r.link !== "string" ||
    r.link.length > 2048
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid share receipt.");
  unbase64url(r.deleteToken, 32);
  if (parseShareLink(r.link).id !== r.id)
    throw new Error("Receipt link does not match its reference.");
  return structuredClone(r);
}
export async function saveReceipt(receipt: ShareReceipt) {
  const database = await db();
  try {
    const safe = validateReceipt(receipt);
    const tx = database.transaction("receipts", "readwrite");
    void tx.done.catch(() => {});
    const existing = await tx.store.get(safe.id);
    if (
      existing &&
      (existing.link !== safe.link || existing.deleteToken !== safe.deleteToken)
    ) {
      tx.abort();
      await tx.done.catch(() => {});
      throw new Error(
        "A conflicting receipt already exists. Existing access/deletion capabilities were not replaced.",
      );
    }
    await tx.store.put(safe);
    await tx.done;
  } finally {
    database.close();
  }
}
export async function listReceipts(): Promise<ShareReceipt[]> {
  const database = await db();
  try {
    return (await database.getAll("receipts"))
      .map(validateReceipt)
      .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
  } finally {
    database.close();
  }
}
export async function forgetReceipt(id: string) {
  const database = await db();
  try {
    await database.delete("receipts", id);
  } finally {
    database.close();
  }
}
export async function importReceipt(file: File, origin: string) {
  if (file.size > 16384) throw new Error("Receipt exceeds the 16 KB limit.");
  const receipt = validateReceipt(JSON.parse(await file.text()));
  if (parseShareLink(receipt.link).origin !== origin)
    throw new Error(
      "This receipt belongs to another application origin. Open that origin to manage it.",
    );
  await saveReceipt(receipt);
  return receipt;
}

===== FILE apps/web/src/features/sharing/relay-client.ts | bytes=4248 | sha256=2e4023c580b72a69d8f19804d933b2c6ab0433643c57816a96981706f10783c6 =====

import { MAX_CIPHER_BYTES } from "./crypto";
import { validShareId } from "./share-links";
export type RelayHealth = {
  service: "neuron-encrypted-relay";
  version: 1;
  uploadsEnabled: boolean;
  maxBytes: number;
  maxTtlSeconds: number;
};
async function bounded(response: Response, limit: number) {
  if (!response.body) throw new Error("Relay returned an empty response.");
  const reader = response.body.getReader(),
    chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let size = 0;
  try {
    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      size += value.byteLength;
      if (size > limit) {
        await reader.cancel();
        throw new Error("Relay response exceeds the safety limit.");
      }
      chunks.push(value);
    }
  } finally {
    reader.releaseLock();
  }
  const result = new Uint8Array(size);
  let i = 0;
  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    result.set(chunk, i);
    i += chunk.length;
  }
  return result;
}
async function request(
  path: string,
  options: RequestInit = {},
  signal?: AbortSignal,
) {
  let response: Response;
  try {
    response = await fetch("/api/shares" + path, {
      ...options,
      credentials: "omit",
      cache: "no-store",
      redirect: "error",
      signal: signal
        ? AbortSignal.any([signal, AbortSignal.timeout(60000)])
        : AbortSignal.timeout(60000),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    if (signal?.aborted)
      throw new DOMException("Sharing cancelled.", "AbortError");
    throw new Error(
      "Sharing relay is unreachable. Start pnpm dev:relay or configure a same-origin /api/shares route. " +
        (e instanceof Error ? e.message : ""),
    );
  }
  if (!response.ok) {
    let detail = "";
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(
        new TextDecoder().decode(await bounded(response, 8192)),
      );
      if (typeof data.error === "string") detail = data.error.slice(0, 300);
    } catch {
      /* never display untrusted HTML */
    }
    throw new Error(
      `Relay ${response.status}: ${detail || (response.status >= 500 ? "Sharing relay unavailable. Start pnpm dev:relay or check same-origin routing." : "request failed")}`,
    );
  }
  return response;
}
export async function relayHealth(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<RelayHealth> {
  const data = JSON.parse(
    new TextDecoder().decode(
      await bounded(await request("/health", {}, signal), 8192),
    ),
  );
  if (
    data.service !== "neuron-encrypted-relay" ||
    data.version !== 1 ||
    typeof data.uploadsEnabled !== "boolean" ||
    !Number.isInteger(data.maxBytes) ||
    !Number.isInteger(data.maxTtlSeconds)
  )
    throw new Error("Incompatible sharing relay.");
  return data;
}
export async function uploadEncrypted(
  bytes: Uint8Array,
  deleteHash: string,
  ttl: number,
  signal: AbortSignal,
) {
  if (
    bytes.length > MAX_CIPHER_BYTES ||
    !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(deleteHash) ||
    ![60, 900, 3600, 86400].includes(ttl)
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid upload parameters.");
  const response = await request(
    "",
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream",
        "X-Neuron-Client": "1",
        "X-Neuron-Delete-Hash": deleteHash,
        "X-Neuron-TTL": String(ttl),
      },
      body: bytes as BodyInit,
    },
    signal,
  );
  const result = JSON.parse(
    new TextDecoder().decode(await bounded(response, 8192)),
  );
  if (
    !validShareId(result.id ?? "") ||
    !Number.isFinite(result.expiresAt) ||
    result.expiresAt <= 0
  )
    throw new Error("Relay returned invalid share metadata.");
  return result as { id: string; expiresAt: number };
}
export async function downloadEncrypted(id: string, signal: AbortSignal) {
  if (!validShareId(id)) throw new Error("Invalid share reference.");
  return bounded(await request("/" + id, {}, signal), MAX_CIPHER_BYTES);
}
export async function revokeEncrypted(
  id: string,
  token: string,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
) {
  if (!validShareId(id) || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/.test(token))
    throw new Error("Invalid deletion capability.");
  await request(
    "/" + id,
    {
      method: "DELETE",
      headers: { "X-Neuron-Client": "1", Authorization: "Bearer " + token },
    },
    signal,
  );
}

import { validateArtifact } from "../../lib/model-format";
import type { ModelArtifact } from "../../lib/types";
export type SharedModel = {
  format: "neuron-shared-model";
  version: 1;
  name: string;
  artifact: ModelArtifact;
};
export function shareableArtifact(value: unknown): ModelArtifact {
  const a = validateArtifact(value);
  // Whitelist fields. Unknown fields in an imported model must not hitchhike into shares.
  return {
    format: a.format,
    version: a.version,
    encoder: a.encoder,
    embeddingSize: a.embeddingSize,
    labels: a.labels.map((l) => ({ id: l.id, name: l.name })),
    weightSpecs: a.weightSpecs.map((s) => ({
      name: s.name,
      shape: [...s.shape],
      dtype: s.dtype,
    })),
    weightData: a.weightData,
    epochs: a.epochs.map((e) => ({
      epoch: e.epoch,
      loss: e.loss,
      accuracy: e.accuracy,
      valLoss: e.valLoss,
      valAccuracy: e.valAccuracy,
    })),
    evaluation: {
      accuracy: a.evaluation.accuracy,
      total: a.evaluation.total,
      matrix: a.evaluation.matrix.map((row) => [...row]),
    },
    createdAt: a.createdAt,
    ...(a.provenance
      ? {
          provenance: {
            datasetHash: a.provenance.datasetHash,
            validationHash: a.provenance.validationHash,
            seed: a.provenance.seed,
            sampleCount: a.provenance.sampleCount,
          },
        }
      : {}),
  };
}
export function encodeShared(name: string, artifact: ModelArtifact) {
  if (!name.trim() || name.length > 64) throw new Error("Invalid model name.");
  const payload: SharedModel = {
    format: "neuron-shared-model",
    version: 1,
    name: name.trim(),
    artifact: shareableArtifact(artifact),
  };
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(payload));
  if (bytes.length > 8 * 1024 * 1024)
    throw new Error("Model exceeds the 8 MB sharing limit.");
  return bytes;
}
export function decodeShared(bytes: Uint8Array): SharedModel {
  if (bytes.length > 8 * 1024 * 1024)
    throw new Error("Shared model exceeds the size limit.");
  let value: SharedModel;
  try {
    value = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes));
  } catch {
    throw new Error("Decrypted model is not valid UTF-8 JSON.");
  }
  if (
    !value ||
    value.format !== "neuron-shared-model" ||
    value.version !== 1 ||
    typeof value.name !== "string" ||
    !value.name.trim() ||
    value.name.length > 64
  )
    throw new Error("Unsupported shared model format.");
  return {
    format: "neuron-shared-model",
    version: 1,
    name: value.name,
    artifact: shareableArtifact(value.artifact),
  };
}

===== FILE apps/web/src/features/sharing/share-links.ts | bytes=976 | sha256=615a8317c0a22a116b635806918fe4fef97178cde8dd808c855dbb54c9174b55 =====

import { unbase64url } from "./crypto";
export const validShareId = (id: string) => /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32}$/.test(id);
export function shareLink(origin: string, id: string, secret: string) {
  if (!validShareId(id)) throw new Error("Invalid share reference.");
  unbase64url(secret, 32);
  const url = new URL(origin);
  if (!["https:", "http:"].includes(url.protocol) || url.origin !== origin)
    throw new Error("Invalid application origin.");
  return `${origin}/#/receive/${id}/${secret}`;
}
export function parseShareLink(value: string) {
  const url = new URL(value);
  const match = url.hash.match(
    /^#\/receive\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{32})\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})$/,
  );
  if (
    !match ||
    url.username ||
    url.password ||
    url.search ||
    url.pathname !== "/" ||
    !["https:", "http:"].includes(url.protocol)
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid NEURON share link.");
  unbase64url(match[2], 32);
  return { id: match[1], secret: match[2], origin: url.origin };
}

export async function createShare(
  project: Project,
  version: ModelVersion,
  ttl: number,
  origin: string,

    const token = randomSecret(),
      encoded = encodeShared(project.name, version.artifact),
      encrypted = await encryptModel(encoded);
    signal.throwIfAborted();
    const remote = await uploadEncrypted(
      encrypted.bytes,
      await secretHash(token),
      ttl,
      signal,
    );
    const receipt: ShareReceipt = {
      format: "neuron-share-receipt",
      version: 1,
      id: remote.id,
      projectId: project.id,
      versionId: version.id,
      name: project.name,
      createdAt: remote.expiresAt - ttl * 1000,
      expiresAt: remote.expiresAt,
      deleteToken: token,
      link: shareLink(origin, remote.id, encrypted.secret),
    };
    let persisted = true;
    try {
      await saveReceipt(receipt);
    } catch {
      persisted = false;
    }
    return { receipt, persisted };
  });
}
export async function receiveShare(
  id: string,
  secret: string,
  signal: AbortSignal,
) {
  return runActivity(async () =>
    decodeShared(
      await decryptModel(await downloadEncrypted(id, signal), secret),
    ),
  );
}
export async function importReceived(model: SharedModel) {
  return runActivity(async () => {
    const safe = decodeShared(encodeShared(model.name, model.artifact)),
      now = Date.now(),
      project: Project = {
        id: uid(),
        name: safe.name,
        labels: safe.artifact.labels,
        createdAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
      },
      version: ModelVersion = {
        id: uid(),
        projectId: project.id,
        artifact: safe.artifact,
        createdAt: now,
      };
    project.activeVersionId = version.id;
    const db = await database(),
      tx = trackTransaction(
        db.transaction(["projects", "versions"], "readwrite"),
      );
    await tx.objectStore("projects").add(project);
    await tx.objectStore("versions").add(version);
    await tx.done;
    return project;
  });
}
export async function revokeShare(receipt: ShareReceipt, origin: string) {
  if (parseShareLink(receipt.link).origin !== origin)
    throw new Error(
      "Manage this receipt from its original application origin.",
    );
  return runActivity(async () => {
    await revokeEncrypted(receipt.id, receipt.deleteToken);
    await forgetReceipt(receipt.id);
  });
}

import { tf, embed, makeHead } from "../../lib/ml";
import { toBase64 } from "../../lib/model-format";
import type {
  Project,
  Sample,
  EpochMetric,
  Evaluation,
  ModelArtifact,
} from "../../lib/types";
import { sha256 } from "../../lib/checksums";
import { runActivity } from "../../pwa/update-manager";
import { validateLabels } from "../projects/project.service";
export function random(seed: number) {
  return () => {
    seed |= 0;
    seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}
export function splitIndices(labels: number[], seed: number) {
  const rng = random(seed),
    train: number[] = [],
    validation: number[] = [];
  for (const label of [...new Set(labels)]) {
    const indices = labels
      .map((v, i) => (v === label ? i : -1))
      .filter((i) => i !== -1);
    if (indices.length < 5)
      throw new Error("Every class needs at least 5 images.");
    for (let i = indices.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1));
      [indices[i], indices[j]] = [indices[j], indices[i]];
    }
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.floor(indices.length * 0.2));
    validation.push(...indices.slice(0, count));
    train.push(...indices.slice(count));
  }
  return { train, validation };
}
export function evaluate(
  actual: number[],
  predicted: number[],
  classes: number,
): Evaluation {
  if (!actual.length || actual.length !== predicted.length)
    throw new Error("Invalid evaluation data.");
  const matrix = Array.from({ length: classes }, () =>
    Array<number>(classes).fill(0),
  );
  let correct = 0;
  actual.forEach((a, i) => {
    const p = predicted[i];
    if (
      a < 0 ||
      a >= classes ||
      p < 0 ||
      p >= classes ||
      !Number.isInteger(a) ||
      !Number.isInteger(p)
    )
      throw new Error("Invalid prediction index.");
    matrix[a][p]++;
    if (a === p) correct++;
  });
  return { accuracy: correct / actual.length, matrix, total: actual.length };
}
export type TrainingOptions = {
  epochs: number;
  learningRate: number;
  seed: number;
};
export type TrainingProgress = {
  stage: string;
  done: number;
  total: number;
  metrics: EpochMetric[];
};
async function trainInternal(
  project: Project,
  samples: Sample[],
  options: TrainingOptions,
  signal: AbortSignal,
  progress: (p: TrainingProgress) => void,
): Promise<ModelArtifact> {
  validateLabels(project.labels);
  if (
    !Number.isInteger(options.epochs) ||
    options.epochs < 1 ||
    options.epochs > 100 ||
    options.learningRate < 0.00001 ||
    options.learningRate > 0.1 ||
    !Number.isFinite(options.learningRate)
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid training settings.");
  const ids = project.labels.map((l) => l.id);
  const targets = samples.map((s) => ids.indexOf(s.labelId));
  if (targets.some((i) => i < 0))
    throw new Error("Dataset contains an unknown class.");
  const { train: training, validation } = splitIndices(targets, options.seed);
  const check = () => {
    if (signal.aborted)
      throw new DOMException("Training cancelled.", "AbortError");
  };
  const vectors: Float32Array[] = [];
  const metrics: EpochMetric[] = [];
  progress({
    stage: "Downloading / loading image encoder",
    done: 0,
    total: samples.length,
    metrics: [],
  });
  for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
    check();
    vectors.push(await embed(samples[i].blob));
    progress({
      stage: "Extracting image features",
      done: i + 1,
      total: samples.length,
      metrics: [],
    });
    await tf.nextFrame();
  }
  check();
  const makeX = (indices: number[]) =>
    tf.tensor2d(
      indices.map((i) => Array.from(vectors[i])),
      [indices.length, 1280],
    );
  const makeY = (indices: number[]) =>
    tf.tidy(() =>
      tf.oneHot(
        tf.tensor1d(
          indices.map((i) => targets[i]),
          "int32",
        ),
        ids.length,
      ),
    );
  let x: ReturnType<typeof makeX> | undefined,
    y: tf.Tensor | undefined,
    vx: ReturnType<typeof makeX> | undefined,
    vy: tf.Tensor | undefined;
  const head = makeHead(ids.length, options.seed);
  const optimizer = tf.train.adam(options.learningRate);
  try {
    x = makeX(training);
    y = makeY(training);
    vx = makeX(validation);
    vy = makeY(validation);
    head.compile({
      optimizer,
      loss: "categoricalCrossentropy",
      metrics: ["accuracy"],
    });
    await head.fit(x, y, {
      epochs: options.epochs,
      batchSize: Math.min(16, training.length),
      shuffle: true,
      validationData: [vx, vy],
      callbacks: {
        onBatchEnd: async () => {
          if (signal.aborted) head.stopTraining = true;
          await tf.nextFrame();
        },
        onEpochEnd: async (epoch, logs) => {
          const metric: EpochMetric = {
            epoch: epoch + 1,
            loss: Number(logs?.loss ?? 0),
            accuracy: Number(logs?.acc ?? logs?.accuracy ?? 0),
            valLoss: Number(logs?.val_loss ?? 0),
            valAccuracy: Number(logs?.val_acc ?? logs?.val_accuracy ?? 0),
          };
          if (!Object.values(metric).every(Number.isFinite)) {
            head.stopTraining = true;
            throw new Error("Training diverged. Reduce learning rate.");
          }
          metrics.push(metric);
          progress({
            stage: "Training classifier",
            done: epoch + 1,
            total: options.epochs,
            metrics: [...metrics],
          });
        },
      },
    });
    check();
    const predicted = tf.tidy(() =>
      (head.predict(vx!) as tf.Tensor).argMax(-1),
    );
    let indices: number[];
    try {
      indices = Array.from(await predicted.data());
    } finally {
      predicted.dispose();
    }
    const evaluation = evaluate(
      validation.map((i) => targets[i]),
      indices,
      ids.length,
    );
    // getWeights() references model-owned variables. encode before head disposal.
    const weights = head.getWeights();
    const named: tf.NamedTensorMap = {};
    weights.forEach((w, i) => (named[`head_${i}`] = w));
    const encoded = await tf.io.encodeWeights(named);
    check();
    const rows = await Promise.all(
      samples.map(async (s) => ({
        hash: await sha256(s.blob),
        labelId: s.labelId,
      })),
    );
    const provenance = {
      datasetHash: await sha256(
        JSON.stringify({
          labels: project.labels,
          rows: [...rows].sort((a, b) =>
            (a.hash + a.labelId).localeCompare(b.hash + b.labelId),
          ),
        }),
      ),
      validationHash: await sha256(
        JSON.stringify({
          labels: project.labels,
          rows: validation
            .map((i) => rows[i])
            .sort((a, b) =>
              (a.hash + a.labelId).localeCompare(b.hash + b.labelId),
            ),
        }),
      ),
      seed: options.seed,
      sampleCount: samples.length,
    };
    return {
      provenance,
      format: "neuron-image",
      version: 1,
      encoder: "mobilenet-v2-1.0",
      embeddingSize: 1280,
      labels: structuredClone(project.labels),
      weightSpecs: encoded.specs as ModelArtifact["weightSpecs"],
      weightData: toBase64(encoded.data),
      epochs: metrics,
      evaluation,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
    };
  } finally {
    x?.dispose();
    y?.dispose();
    vx?.dispose();
    vy?.dispose();
    head.dispose();
    optimizer.dispose();
  }
}

export function train(...args: Parameters<typeof trainInternal>) {
  return runActivity(() => trainInternal(...args));
}

import { runActivity } from "../../pwa/update-manager";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { getProject, listSamples, commitVersion } from "../../lib/db";
import { train, type TrainingProgress } from "./training.service";
import {
  type Project,
  type Sample,
  type ModelArtifact,
  errorMessage,
  uid,
} from "../../lib/types";
export function useImageTraining(id: string) {
  const [project, setProject] = useState<Project | null>(null),
    [samples, setSamples] = useState<Sample[]>([]),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [epochs, setEpochs] = useState(20),
    [rate, setRate] = useState(0.001),
    [running, setRunning] = useState(false),
    [progress, setProgress] = useState<TrainingProgress | null>(null),
    [result, setResult] = useState<ModelArtifact | null>(null);
  const controller = useRef<AbortController | null>(null),
    alive = useRef(true),
    lock = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    Promise.all([getProject(id), listSamples(id)])
      .then(([p, s]) => {
        if (alive.current) {
          if (!p) setError("Project not found.");
          setProject(p ?? null);
          setSamples(s);
        }
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (alive.current) setError(errorMessage(e));
      });
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      controller.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [id]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const warn = (e: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
      if (lock.current) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.returnValue = "";
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("beforeunload", warn);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", warn);
  }, []);
  async function start() {
    if (!project || lock.current) return;
    lock.current = true;
    setRunning(true);
    setError("");
    setResult(null);
    setProgress(null);
    const c = new AbortController();
    controller.current = c;
    try {
      await runActivity(async () => {
        const artifact = await train(
          project,
          samples,
          { epochs, learningRate: rate, seed: 42 },
          c.signal,
          (p) => {
            if (alive.current) setProgress(p);
          },
        );
        if (c.signal.aborted) return;
        await commitVersion(
          { id: uid(), projectId: id, artifact, createdAt: Date.now() },
          {
            labels: project.labels,
            samples: samples.map((s) => ({ id: s.id, labelId: s.labelId })),
          },
        );
        if (alive.current) setResult(artifact);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current)
        setError(
          e instanceof DOMException && e.name === "AbortError"
            ? "Training cancelled. The previous saved model is unchanged."
            : errorMessage(e),
        );
    } finally {
      lock.current = false;
      if (alive.current) setRunning(false);
      controller.current = null;
    }
  }

  const ready =
    !!project &&
    project.labels.every(
      (l) => samples.filter((s) => s.labelId === l.id).length >= 5,
    );
  return {
    project,
    samples,
    error,
    epochs,
    setEpochs,
    rate,
    setRate,
    running,
    progress,
    result,
    ready,
    start,
    cancel: () => controller.current?.abort(),
  };
}

===== FILE apps/web/src/lib/backup-format.ts | bytes=6741 | sha256=b6025c3f63d1668b007732c107d6f18ae593715c25027b986ba4a4841c005461 =====

import type { Project, Sample, ModelVersion, FeedbackItem } from "./types";
import { uid } from "./types";
import { sha256, validHash } from "./checksums";
import { toBase64, fromBase64, validateArtifact } from "./model-format";
export const BACKUP_LIMIT = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
const MEDIA_LIMIT = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
type Media = {
  id: string;
  labelId: string;
  data: string;
  hash: string;
  createdAt: number;
  versionId?: string;
  predictedLabel?: string;
};
export type Backup = {
  format: "neuron-project";
  version: 1;
  project: Project;
  samples: Media[];
  versions: ModelVersion[];
  feedback: Media[];
  createdAt: number;
};
export type Snapshot = {
  project: Project;
  samples: Sample[];
  versions: ModelVersion[];
  feedback: FeedbackItem[];
};
function text(x: unknown, max = 100): x is string {
  return typeof x === "string" && x.trim().length > 0 && x.length <= max;
}
export function validateBackupShape(value: unknown): Backup {
  const b = value as Backup;
  if (
    !b ||
    b.format !== "neuron-project" ||
    b.version !== 1 ||
    !b.project ||
    !text(b.project.id) ||
    !text(b.project.name, 64) ||
    !Array.isArray(b.project.labels) ||
    b.project.labels.length < 2 ||
    b.project.labels.length > 20
  )
    throw new Error("Unsupported NEURON project backup.");
  const labelIds = new Set<string>(),
    names = new Set<string>();
  for (const l of b.project.labels) {
    if (
      !l ||
      !text(l.id) ||
      !text(l.name, 64) ||
      labelIds.has(l.id) ||
      names.has(l.name.toLowerCase())
    )
      throw new Error("Invalid backup classes.");
    labelIds.add(l.id);
    names.add(l.name.toLowerCase());
  }
  if (
    ![b.project.createdAt, b.project.updatedAt, b.createdAt].every(
      Number.isFinite,
    ) ||
    !Array.isArray(b.samples) ||
    b.samples.length > 1000 ||
    !Array.isArray(b.versions) ||
    b.versions.length > 50 ||
    !Array.isArray(b.feedback) ||
    b.feedback.length > 100
  )
    throw new Error("Backup exceeds supported record limits.");
  const versionIds = new Set<string>();
  for (const v of b.versions) {
    if (
      !v ||
      !text(v.id) ||
      versionIds.has(v.id) ||
      v.projectId !== b.project.id ||
      !Number.isFinite(v.createdAt)
    )
      throw new Error("Invalid model version.");
    versionIds.add(v.id);
    validateArtifact(v.artifact);
  }
  if (b.project.activeVersionId && !versionIds.has(b.project.activeVersionId))
    throw new Error("Active model is missing from backup.");
  const allIds = new Set<string>();
  let chars = 0;
  for (const [list, feedback] of [
    [b.samples, false],
    [b.feedback, true],
  ] as const)
    for (const m of list) {
      if (
        !m ||
        !text(m.id) ||
        allIds.has(m.id) ||
        !labelIds.has(m.labelId) ||
        !Number.isFinite(m.createdAt) ||
        !validHash(m.hash) ||
        typeof m.data !== "string" ||
        m.data.length > 2 * 1024 * 1024 ||
        !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$/.test(m.data)
      )
        throw new Error("Invalid image record in backup.");
      if (
        feedback &&
        (!text(m.versionId) ||
          !versionIds.has(m.versionId!) ||
          typeof m.predictedLabel !== "string" ||
          m.predictedLabel.length > 64)
      )
        throw new Error("Invalid feedback record.");
      allIds.add(m.id);
      chars += m.data.length;
    }
  if (chars > Math.ceil((MEDIA_LIMIT * 4) / 3) + 4096)
    throw new Error("Backup images exceed the 32 MB media budget.");
  return b;
}
export async function encodeBackup(snapshot: Snapshot): Promise<Blob> {
  let bytes = 0;
  async function encode(s: Sample | FeedbackItem): Promise<Media> {
    bytes += s.blob.size;
    if (bytes > MEDIA_LIMIT)
      throw new Error(
        "This phase supports at most 32 MB of image/feedback data per backup.",
      );
    return {
      id: s.id,
      labelId: s.labelId,
      createdAt: s.createdAt,
      data: toBase64(await s.blob.arrayBuffer()),
      hash: await sha256(s.blob),
      ...("versionId" in s
        ? { versionId: s.versionId, predictedLabel: s.predictedLabel }
        : {}),
    };
  }
  const samples: Media[] = [],
    feedback: Media[] = [];
  for (const s of snapshot.samples) samples.push(await encode(s));
  for (const f of snapshot.feedback) feedback.push(await encode(f));
  const b: Backup = {
    format: "neuron-project",
    version: 1,
    project: snapshot.project,
    samples,
    feedback,
    versions: snapshot.versions,
    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };
  validateBackupShape(b);
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(b)], { type: "application/json" });
  if (blob.size > BACKUP_LIMIT)
    throw new Error("Backup exceeds the 64 MB file limit.");
  return blob;
}
export async function decodeBackup(file: Blob): Promise<Snapshot> {
  if (file.size > BACKUP_LIMIT)
    throw new Error("Backup exceeds the 64 MB file limit.");
  let raw: unknown;
  try {
    raw = JSON.parse(await file.text());
  } catch {
    throw new Error("Backup is not valid JSON.");
  }
  const b = validateBackupShape(raw),
    projectId = uid(),
    versionMap = new Map(b.versions.map((v) => [v.id, uid()]));
  async function media(m: Media) {
    const data = fromBase64(m.data);
    if ((await sha256(data)) !== m.hash)
      throw new Error("Backup image checksum mismatch. No data was restored.");
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(data);
    if (
      bytes.length < 4 ||
      bytes[0] !== 255 ||
      bytes[1] !== 216 ||
      bytes[2] !== 255
    )
      throw new Error("Only normalized JPEG images are supported in backups.");
    return new Blob([data], { type: "image/jpeg" });
  }
  const samples: Sample[] = [],
    feedback: FeedbackItem[] = [];
  for (const m of b.samples)
    samples.push({
      id: uid(),
      projectId,
      labelId: m.labelId,
      createdAt: m.createdAt,
      blob: await media(m),
      hash: m.hash,
    });
  for (const m of b.feedback)
    feedback.push({
      id: uid(),
      projectId,
      labelId: m.labelId,
      createdAt: m.createdAt,
      blob: await media(m),
      versionId: versionMap.get(m.versionId!)!,
      predictedLabel: m.predictedLabel!,
    });
  const project: Project = {
    id: projectId,
    name: (b.project.name.slice(0, 52) + " (restored)").slice(0, 64),
    labels: b.project.labels,
    createdAt: b.project.createdAt,
    updatedAt: Date.now(),
    activeVersionId: b.project.activeVersionId
      ? versionMap.get(b.project.activeVersionId)
      : undefined,
  };
  return {
    project,
    samples,
    feedback,
    versions: b.versions.map((v) => ({
      id: versionMap.get(v.id)!,
      projectId,
      createdAt: v.createdAt,
      artifact: validateArtifact(v.artifact),
    })),
  };
}

    quota: e?.quota ?? 0,
    persistent: (await navigator.storage?.persisted?.()) ?? false,
  };
}
export function bytes(n: number) {
  return n >= 1073741824
    ? `${(n / 1073741824).toFixed(1)} GB`
    : n >= 1048576
      ? `${(n / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB`
      : `${Math.round(n / 1024)} KB`;
}

export async function sha256(value: Blob | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array | string) {
  const data =
    typeof value === "string"
      ? new TextEncoder().encode(value)
      : value instanceof Blob
        ? await value.arrayBuffer()
        : value;
  const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data as BufferSource);
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hash), (b) =>
    b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"),
  ).join("");
}
export function validHash(value: unknown): value is string {
  return typeof value === "string" && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(value);
}

import { openDB, type DBSchema } from "idb";
import type { Project, Sample, ModelVersion, FeedbackItem } from "./types";
export interface NeuronDB extends DBSchema {
  projects: { key: string; value: Project };
  samples: { key: string; value: Sample; indexes: { "by-project": string } };
  versions: {
    key: string;
    value: ModelVersion;
    indexes: { "by-project": string };
  };
  feedback: {
    key: string;
    value: FeedbackItem;
    indexes: { "by-project": string };

let connection: ReturnType<typeof openDB<NeuronDB>> | undefined;
export function database() {
  if (!("indexedDB" in globalThis))
    throw new Error("IndexedDB unavailable. Use a normal browser window.");
  return (connection ??= openDB<NeuronDB>("neuron-local", 2, {
    upgrade(db, oldVersion) {
      if (oldVersion < 1) {
        db.createObjectStore("projects", { keyPath: "id" });
        db.createObjectStore("samples", { keyPath: "id" }).createIndex(
          "by-project",
          "projectId",
        );
        db.createObjectStore("versions", { keyPath: "id" }).createIndex(
          "by-project",
          "projectId",
        );
      }
      if (oldVersion < 2)
        db.createObjectStore("feedback", { keyPath: "id" }).createIndex(
          "by-project",
          "projectId",
        );
    },
    blocking() {
      connection?.then((db) => db.close());
      connection = undefined;
    },
    terminated() {
      connection = undefined;
    },
  }));
}
export async function closeDatabase() {
  const db = await connection;
  db?.close();
  connection = undefined;
}
export async function saveProject(project: Project) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = trackTransaction(db.transaction("projects", "readwrite"));
  const previous = await tx.store.get(project.id);
  // Creation uses a fresh UUID. Existing callers may edit metadata, but cannot inject raw samples.
  await tx.store.put({
    ...project,
    updatedAt: Math.max(project.updatedAt, previous?.updatedAt ?? 0),
  });
  await tx.done;
}
export async function listProjects() {
  return (await (await database()).getAll("projects")).sort(
    (a, b) => b.updatedAt - a.updatedAt,
  );
}
export async function getProject(id: string) {
  return (await database()).get("projects", id);
}
export async function listSamples(id: string) {
  return (await database()).getAllFromIndex("samples", "by-project", id);
}
export async function listVersions(id: string) {
  return (
    await (await database()).getAllFromIndex("versions", "by-project", id)
  ).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
}
export async function deleteProject(id: string) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = trackTransaction(
    db.transaction(
      ["projects", "samples", "versions", "feedback"],
      "readwrite",
    ),
  );
  await tx.objectStore("projects").delete(id);
  for (const name of ["samples", "versions", "feedback"] as const)
    for (const key of await tx
      .objectStore(name)
      .index("by-project")
      .getAllKeys(id))
      await tx.objectStore(name).delete(key);
  await tx.done;
}
export async function commitVersion(
  version: ModelVersion,
  expected?: {
    labels: Project["labels"];
    samples: { id: string; labelId: string }[];
  },
) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = trackTransaction(
    db.transaction(["projects", "versions", "samples"], "readwrite"),
  );
  const project = await tx.objectStore("projects").get(version.projectId);
  if (!project) {
    tx.abort();
    await tx.done.catch(() => {});
    throw new Error("Project no longer exists.");
  }
  if (expected) {
    const current = await tx
      .objectStore("samples")
      .index("by-project")
      .getAll(version.projectId);
    const signature = (rows: { id: string; labelId: string }[]) =>
      JSON.stringify(
        rows
          .map((s) => [s.id, s.labelId])
          .sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0])),
      );
    if (
      JSON.stringify(project.labels) !== JSON.stringify(expected.labels) ||
      signature(current) !== signature(expected.samples)
    ) {
      tx.abort();
      await tx.done.catch(() => {});
      throw new Error(
        "Dataset/classes changed during training. The result was not saved; previous model versions are unchanged. Reload the training page.",
      );
    }
  }
  await tx.objectStore("versions").add(version);
  await tx
    .objectStore("projects")
    .put({ ...project, activeVersionId: version.id, updatedAt: Date.now() });
  await tx.done;
}
export async function activateVersion(projectId: string, versionId: string) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = trackTransaction(
    db.transaction(["projects", "versions"], "readwrite"),
  );
  const p = await tx.objectStore("projects").get(projectId),
    v = await tx.objectStore("versions").get(versionId);
  if (!p || !v || v.projectId !== projectId) {
    tx.abort();
    await tx.done.catch(() => {});
    throw new Error("Model version not found.");
  }
  await tx
    .objectStore("projects")
    .put({ ...p, activeVersionId: versionId, updatedAt: Date.now() });
  await tx.done;
}
export async function deleteLabel(project: Project, labelId: string) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = trackTransaction(
    db.transaction(["projects", "samples", "feedback"], "readwrite"),
  );
  const current = await tx.objectStore("projects").get(project.id);
  if (!current || current.labels.length <= 2) {
    tx.abort();
    await tx.done.catch(() => {});
    throw new Error("At least two classes are required.");
  }
  for (const store of ["samples", "feedback"] as const)
    for (const s of await tx
      .objectStore(store)
      .index("by-project")
      .getAll(project.id))
      if (s.labelId === labelId) await tx.objectStore(store).delete(s.id);
  await tx.objectStore("projects").put({
    ...current,
    labels: current.labels.filter((l) => l.id !== labelId),
    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  });
  await tx.done;
}
export async function importVersion(project: Project, version: ModelVersion) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = trackTransaction(
    db.transaction(
      ["projects", "samples", "versions", "feedback"],
      "readwrite",
    ),
  );
  const current = await tx.objectStore("projects").get(project.id);
  if (!current) {
    tx.abort();
    await tx.done.catch(() => {});
    throw new Error("Project no longer exists.");
  }
  for (const store of ["samples", "feedback"] as const)
    for (const key of await tx
      .objectStore(store)
      .index("by-project")
      .getAllKeys(project.id))
      await tx.objectStore(store).delete(key);
  await tx.objectStore("versions").add(version);
  await tx.objectStore("projects").put({
    ...current,
    labels: version.artifact.labels,
    activeVersionId: version.id,
    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  });
  await tx.done;
}
export async function snapshotProject(id: string) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = trackTransaction(
    db.transaction(["projects", "samples", "versions", "feedback"], "readonly"),
  );
  const [project, samples, versions, feedback] = await Promise.all([
    tx.objectStore("projects").get(id),
    tx.objectStore("samples").index("by-project").getAll(id),
    tx.objectStore("versions").index("by-project").getAll(id),
    tx.objectStore("feedback").index("by-project").getAll(id),
  ]);
  await tx.done;
  if (!project) throw new Error("Project not found.");
  return { project, samples, versions, feedback };
}

export function trackTransaction<T extends { done: Promise<unknown> }>(
  tx: T,
): T {
  void tx.done.catch(() => {});
  return tx;
}

export type FailureCode =
  | "cancelled"
  | "permission"
  | "quota"
  | "storage"
  | "invalid"
  | "unexpected";
export type Failure = {
  code: FailureCode;
  message: string;
  retryable: boolean;
};
export function explainError(error: unknown): Failure {
  const name =
    error && typeof error === "object" && "name" in error
      ? String(error.name)
      : "";
  const detail =
    error instanceof Error
      ? error.message
      : "The operation failed. Retry or export a backup before changing browser settings.";
  if (name === "AbortError")
    return {
      code: "cancelled",
      message: "Operation cancelled. Previously saved data is unchanged.",
      retryable: true,
    };
  if (name === "NotAllowedError" || name === "SecurityError")
    return {
      code: "permission",
      message:
        "Camera access was blocked. Use HTTPS/localhost, allow this site in browser permissions, or import a file instead.",
      retryable: true,
    };
  if (name === "NotFoundError" || name === "DevicesNotFoundError")
    return {
      code: "permission",
      message:
        "No camera was found. Connect a camera or import image files instead.",
      retryable: true,
    };
  if (name === "NotReadableError" || name === "TrackStartError")
    return {
      code: "permission",
      message:
        "The camera is busy or unavailable. Close other camera apps and retry, or import a file.",
      retryable: true,
    };
  if (name === "QuotaExceededError")
    return {
      code: "quota",
      message:
        "Browser storage is full. Export private backups, then delete unneeded projects. Do not clear site data before backing up.",
      retryable: false,
    };
  if (name === "InvalidStateError" || name === "VersionError")
    return {
      code: "storage",
      message:
        "Browser storage is unavailable or an older tab is open. Close other NEURON tabs and reopen. Keep backups; do not reset storage blindly.",
      retryable: true,
    };
  return {
    code: "unexpected",
    message: detail.slice(0, 2000),
    retryable: true,
  };
}
export function cancelled(message = "Operation cancelled.") {
  return new DOMException(message, "AbortError");
}
export function requireCondition(
  condition: unknown,
  message: string,
): asserts condition {
  if (!condition) throw new Error(message);
}

import * as tf from "@tensorflow/tfjs";
import * as mobilenet from "@tensorflow-models/mobilenet";
import { encoderArtifacts } from "../pwa/asset-manager";
import { decodeImage } from "../features/datasets/dataset.service";
let encoderPromise: Promise<mobilenet.MobileNet> | undefined;
let initPromise: Promise<void> | undefined;
export async function initializeRuntime() {
  return (initPromise ??= (async () => {
    try {
      if (!(await tf.setBackend("webgl"))) throw new Error("WebGL unavailable");
      await tf.ready();
    } catch {
      await tf.setBackend("cpu");
      await tf.ready();
    }
  })());
}
export async function encoder() {
  await initializeRuntime();
  if (!encoderPromise)
    encoderPromise = mobilenet
      .load({
        version: 2,
        alpha: 1.0,
        inputRange: [0, 1],
        modelUrl: { load: encoderArtifacts },
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        encoderPromise = undefined;
        throw new Error(
          `Encoder unavailable. Check Settings → Offline readiness, then retry. ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : ""}`,
        );
      });
  return encoderPromise;
}
export async function embed(blob: Blob) {
  const net = await encoder();
  const bitmap = await decodeImage(blob);
  try {
    // mobilenet's published input union omits ImageBitmap; use a bounded canvas.
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = 224;
    canvas.height = 224;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) throw new Error("Canvas unavailable.");
    ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, 224, 224);
    const t = net.infer(canvas, true) as tf.Tensor;
    try {
      return Float32Array.from(await t.data());
    } finally {
      t.dispose();
    }
  } finally {
    bitmap.close();
  }
}
export function makeHead(classes: number, seed: number) {
  const model = tf.sequential();
  model.add(
    tf.layers.dense({
      inputShape: [1280],
      units: classes,
      activation: "softmax",
      kernelInitializer: tf.initializers.glorotUniform({ seed }),
      biasInitializer: "zeros",
    }),
  );
  return model;
}
export function backendName() {
  return tf.getBackend() || "not initialized";
}

import type { ModelArtifact } from "./types";
export const MAX_MODEL_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
export function toBase64(buffer: ArrayBuffer) {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
  let result = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 8192)
    result += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(i, i + 8192));
  return btoa(result);
}
export function fromBase64(s: string): ArrayBuffer {
  const raw = atob(s);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(raw.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) bytes[i] = raw.charCodeAt(i);
  return bytes.buffer;
}
function fail(): never {
  throw new Error("Invalid or incompatible NEURON image model.");
}
export function validateArtifact(value: unknown): ModelArtifact {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return fail();
  const a = value as ModelArtifact;
  if (
    a.format !== "neuron-image" ||
    a.version !== 1 ||
    a.encoder !== "mobilenet-v2-1.0" ||
    a.embeddingSize !== 1280
  )
    return fail();
  if (!Array.isArray(a.labels) || a.labels.length < 2 || a.labels.length > 20)
    return fail();
  const ids = new Set<string>(),
    names = new Set<string>();
  for (const l of a.labels) {
    if (
      !l ||
      typeof l.id !== "string" ||
      !l.id ||
      l.id.length > 100 ||
      typeof l.name !== "string" ||
      !l.name.trim() ||
      l.name.length > 64 ||
      ids.has(l.id) ||
      names.has(l.name.trim().toLowerCase())
    )
      return fail();
    ids.add(l.id);
    names.add(l.name.trim().toLowerCase());
  }
  const n = a.labels.length;
  if (!Array.isArray(a.weightSpecs) || a.weightSpecs.length !== 2)
    return fail();
  const expected = [[1280, n], [n]];
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    const s = a.weightSpecs[i];
    if (
      !s ||
      s.dtype !== "float32" ||
      s.name !== `head_${i}` ||
      JSON.stringify(s.shape) !== JSON.stringify(expected[i])
    )
      return fail();
  }
  if (
    typeof a.weightData !== "string" ||
    a.weightData.length > MAX_MODEL_BYTES ||
    !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$/.test(a.weightData)
  )
    return fail();
  let buffer: ArrayBuffer;
  try {
    buffer = fromBase64(a.weightData);
  } catch {
    return fail();
  }
  if (buffer.byteLength !== (1280 * n + n) * 4) return fail();
  for (const x of new Float32Array(buffer))
    if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return fail();
  if (
    !Number.isFinite(a.createdAt) ||
    !Array.isArray(a.epochs) ||
    a.epochs.length > 100
  )
    return fail();
  for (const e of a.epochs)
    if (
      !e ||
      ![e.epoch, e.loss, e.accuracy, e.valLoss, e.valAccuracy].every(
        Number.isFinite,
      )
    )
      return fail();
  const v = a.evaluation;
  if (
    !v ||
    !Number.isInteger(v.total) ||
    v.total < 1 ||
    v.total > 1000 ||
    !Number.isFinite(v.accuracy) ||
    v.accuracy < 0 ||
    v.accuracy > 1 ||
    !Array.isArray(v.matrix) ||
    v.matrix.length !== n
  )
    return fail();
  let total = 0,
    correct = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const row = v.matrix[i];
    if (!Array.isArray(row) || row.length !== n) return fail();
    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
      const c = row[j];
      if (!Number.isInteger(c) || c < 0) return fail();
      total += c;
      if (i === j) correct += c;
    }
  }
  if (total !== v.total || Math.abs(correct / total - v.accuracy) > 1e-6)
    return fail();
  if (a.provenance) {
    const p = a.provenance;
    if (
      !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(p.datasetHash) ||
      !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(p.validationHash) ||
      !Number.isInteger(p.seed) ||
      !Number.isInteger(p.sampleCount) ||
      p.sampleCount < 10 ||
      p.sampleCount > 1000
    )
      return fail();
  }
  return structuredClone(a);
}
export async function readModel(file: File) {
  if (file.size > MAX_MODEL_BYTES)
    throw new Error("Model file exceeds the 8 MB safety limit.");
  let value: unknown;
  try {
    value = JSON.parse(await file.text());
  } catch {
    throw new Error("This file is not valid JSON.");
  }
  return validateArtifact(value);
}
export function exportModel(artifact: ModelArtifact, name: string) {
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(validateArtifact(artifact))], {
    type: "application/json",
  });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `${name.replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/gi, "_")}.neuron.json`;
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}

import { cancelled, requireCondition } from "./errors";
export function cameraSupported() {
  return (
    typeof navigator !== "undefined" &&
    !!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia &&
    globalThis.isSecureContext !== false
  );
}
export async function cameraPermission(): Promise<
  PermissionState | "unsupported"
> {
  try {
    if (!navigator.permissions?.query) return "unsupported";
    return (
      await navigator.permissions.query({ name: "camera" as PermissionName })
    ).state;
  } catch {
    return "unsupported";
  }
}
export function stopTracks(stream: MediaStream | null) {
  stream?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
}
// A monotonically increasing generation also handles a user stopping while the
// browser's permission dialog is still open. Late-arriving streams are closed.
export class CameraSession {
  private generation = 0;
  private stream: MediaStream | null = null;
  async start(): Promise<MediaStream> {
    requireCondition(
      cameraSupported(),
      "Camera requires HTTPS/localhost and browser media-device support. Import an image instead.",
    );
    const generation = ++this.generation;
    stopTracks(this.stream);
    this.stream = null;
    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      video: {
        width: { ideal: 640 },
        height: { ideal: 480 },
        facingMode: "user",
      },
      audio: false,
    });
    if (generation !== this.generation) {
      stopTracks(stream);
      throw cancelled("Camera request cancelled.");
    }
    this.stream = stream;
    return stream;
  }
  stop() {
    this.generation++;
    stopTracks(this.stream);
    this.stream = null;
  }
}
export async function captureFrame(video: HTMLVideoElement): Promise<File> {
  requireCondition(
    video.readyState >= 2 && video.videoWidth > 0 && video.videoHeight > 0,
    "Camera has no ready frame yet. Wait for the preview.",
  );
  const scale = Math.min(
    1,
    768 / Math.max(video.videoWidth, video.videoHeight),
  );
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(video.videoWidth * scale));
  canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(video.videoHeight * scale));
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  requireCondition(ctx, "Canvas unavailable. Use an image file instead.");
  ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  const blob = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) =>
    canvas.toBlob(
      (b) =>
        b
          ? resolve(b)
          : reject(new Error("Camera frame could not be encoded.")),
      "image/jpeg",
      0.9,
    ),
  );
  return new File([blob], "camera-" + Date.now() + ".jpg", {
    type: "image/jpeg",
  });
}

import { requireCondition } from "./errors";
export function safeExternalURL(value: string) {
  const u = new URL(value);
  requireCondition(
    u.protocol === "https:" && !u.username && !u.password,
    "Only HTTPS URLs without credentials are allowed.",
  );
  return u.href;
}
export function safeLocalRoute(value: string) {
  requireCondition(
    value.startsWith("/") &&
      !value.startsWith("//") &&
      !/[\\\u0000-\u0020?#]/.test(value),
    "Invalid internal route.",
  );
  return "#" + value;
}
export function projectRoute(
  id: string,
  step?: "train" | "predict" | "evolve",
) {
  requireCondition(
    /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$/.test(id),
    "Invalid project identifier.",
  );
  return safeLocalRoute("/projects/" + id + (step ? "/" + step : ""));
}
export function downloadName(name: string, extension: string) {
  requireCondition(
    /^\.[a-z0-9.-]+$/i.test(extension),
    "Invalid download extension.",
  );
  return (
    (name.replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/gi, "_").slice(0, 64) || "neuron") + extension
  );
}

===== FILE apps/web/src/lib/worker-client.ts | bytes=2178 | sha256=173de86f99a38880f1b6deb7aac5dd6b642739bfd3fddb58b027e7eb2895edc4 =====
CONTENT START
import { cancelled } from "./errors";
import { runActivity } from "../pwa/update-manager";
export type WorkerReply =
  | { ok: true; value: unknown }
  | { ok: false; error: string };
export async function oneShotWorker<T>(
  create: () => Worker,
  input: unknown,
  decode: (value: unknown) => T,
  options: {
    signal?: AbortSignal;
    timeoutMs?: number;
    transfer?: Transferable[];
  } = {},
): Promise<T> {
  return runActivity(async () => {
    options.signal?.throwIfAborted();
    let worker: Worker | undefined,
      timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined,
      abort: () => void = () => {};
    try {
      return await new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
        abort = () => reject(cancelled());
        options.signal?.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
        worker = create();
        worker.onerror = () =>
          reject(
            new Error(
              "Image worker failed. Verify that the production shell is installed, JavaScript is allowed and memory is available.",
            ),
          );
        worker.onmessageerror = () =>
          reject(new Error("Worker response could not be decoded."));
        worker.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent<WorkerReply>) => {
          try {
            const value = event.data;
            if (!value || typeof value.ok !== "boolean")
              throw new Error("Invalid worker protocol.");
            if (value.ok) resolve(decode(value.value));
            else
              reject(
                new Error(
                  typeof value.error === "string"
                    ? value.error.slice(0, 1000)
                    : "Worker failed.",
                ),
              );
          } catch (error) {
            reject(error);
          }
        };
        timer = setTimeout(
          () =>
            reject(new Error("Image worker timed out. Try a smaller image.")),
          options.timeoutMs ?? 60000,
        );
        worker.postMessage(input, options.transfer ?? []);
      });
    } finally {
      if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
      options.signal?.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
      worker?.terminate();
    }
  });
}

export function ReceivePage({ id, secret }: { id: string; secret: string }) {
  const [key, setKey] = useState(secret),
    [consent, setConsent] = useState(false),
    [model, setModel] = useState<SharedModel | null>(null),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  const abort = useRef<AbortController | null>(null),
    lock = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (secret) {
      setKey(secret);
      setModel(null);
      setError("");
    }
    if (secret)
      history.replaceState(
        null,
        "",
        location.pathname + location.search + "#/receive/" + id,
      );
    return () => abort.current?.abort();
  }, [id, secret]);
  async function inspect() {
    if (lock.current) return;
    lock.current = true;

      setModel(await receiveShare(id, key, c.signal));

      setError(errorMessage(e));

      lock.current = false;
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <section className="panel receive-panel">
      <div className="eyebrow">ENCRYPTED MODEL TRANSFER</div>
      <h1>A model, shared with you.</h1>

              type="password"

              spellCheck={false}

              onChange={(e) => setKey(e.target.value)}
              maxLength={43}
            />
          </label>

export function SharesPage() {

export const PACK_ID = "mobilenet-v2-1.0-pinned-2026-11";
export const MODEL_FILES = [
  {
    name: "model.json",
    bytes: 86414,
