  INDEX_URL = "/__neuron_pack_index__";
const source =
  "https://tfhub.dev/google/imagenet/mobilenet_v2_100_224/classification/2/";
function key(name: string) {
  return new URL("/__neuron_pack__/" + PACK_ID + "/" + name, location.origin)
    .href;
}
export function validateEncoderManifest(value: unknown) {
  const model = value as {
    modelTopology?: object;
    weightsManifest?: Array<{
      paths: string[];
      weights: io.WeightsManifestEntry[];
    }>;
    signature?: io.ModelArtifacts["signature"];
    userDefinedMetadata?: io.ModelArtifacts["userDefinedMetadata"];
  };
  if (
    !model ||
    typeof model.modelTopology !== "object" ||
    !Array.isArray(model.weightsManifest) ||
    model.weightsManifest.length !== 1
  )
    throw new Error("Unsupported encoder manifest.");
  if (
    JSON.stringify(model.weightsManifest[0].paths) !==
    JSON.stringify(MODEL_FILES.slice(1).map((f) => f.name))
  )
    throw new Error("Unexpected encoder shard paths.");
  return model;
}
async function pointer() {
  if (!("caches" in globalThis))
    throw new Error(
      "Persistent model packs require Cache Storage in HTTPS or localhost.",
    );
  const response = await (await caches.open(INDEX_CACHE)).match(INDEX_URL);
  if (!response) return null;
  try {
    const p = await response.json();
    return p.id === PACK_ID &&
      typeof p.cache === "string" &&
      p.cache.startsWith("neuron-pack-")
      ? (p.cache as string)
      : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
async function verified(cache: Cache, name: string) {
  const spec = MODEL_FILES.find((f) => f.name === name);
  if (!spec) throw new Error("Unknown asset.");
  const response = await cache.match(key(name));
  if (!response) throw new Error("Model pack is incomplete.");
  const data = await response.arrayBuffer();
  if (data.byteLength !== spec.bytes || (await sha256(data)) !== spec.hash)
    throw new Error(
      "Model pack integrity check failed. Remove and download the pack again.",
    );
  return data;
}
export async function packStatus() {
  try {
    const p = await pointer();
    if (!p) return { ready: false, bytes: 0, error: "" };
    const cache = await caches.open(p);
    for (const file of MODEL_FILES) await verified(cache, file.name);
    return {
      ready: true,
      bytes: MODEL_FILES.reduce((n, f) => n + f.bytes, 0),
      error: "",
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return {
      ready: false,
      bytes: 0,
      error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Pack unavailable",
    };
  }
}
async function fetchBounded(url: string, limit: number, signal: AbortSignal) {
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    signal,
    cache: "no-store",
    referrerPolicy: "no-referrer",
  });
  if (!response.ok || !response.body)
    throw new Error(`Asset download failed (${response.status}).`);
  const reader = response.body.getReader(),
    chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let total = 0;
  try {
    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      total += value.byteLength;
      if (total > limit) {
        await reader.cancel();
        throw new Error("Asset exceeded its pinned size.");
      }
      chunks.push(value);
    }
  } finally {
    reader.releaseLock();
  }
  const result = new Uint8Array(total);
  let offset = 0;
  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    result.set(chunk, offset);
    offset += chunk.length;
  }
  return result;
}
export async function downloadPack(
  signal: AbortSignal,
  onProgress: (done: number, total: number) => void = () => {},
) {
  const execute = () =>
    runActivity(async () => {
      if ((await packStatus()).ready) return;
      const cacheName = "neuron-pack-" + crypto.randomUUID(),
        cache = await caches.open(cacheName);
      let committed = false,
        done = 0;
      const total = MODEL_FILES.reduce((n, f) => n + f.bytes, 0);
      try {
        for (const file of MODEL_FILES) {
          signal.throwIfAborted();
          const bytes = await fetchBounded(
            source + file.name + "?tfjs-format=file",
            file.bytes,
            signal,
          );
          if (
            bytes.length !== file.bytes ||
            (await sha256(bytes)) !== file.hash
          )
            throw new Error(
              "Downloaded encoder differs from the pinned version. No unverified weights were installed.",
            );
          await cache.put(key(file.name), new Response(bytes as BodyInit));
          done += file.bytes;
          onProgress(done, total);
        }
        signal.throwIfAborted();
        await verified(cache, "model.json");
        validateEncoderManifest(
          JSON.parse(
            new TextDecoder().decode(await verified(cache, "model.json")),
          ),
        );
        await (
          await caches.open(INDEX_CACHE)
        ).put(
          INDEX_URL,
          new Response(JSON.stringify({ id: PACK_ID, cache: cacheName })),
        );
        committed = true;
      } finally {
        if (!committed) await caches.delete(cacheName);
      }
    });
  if (navigator.locks)
    return navigator.locks.request(
      "neuron-assets",
      { mode: "exclusive" },
      execute,
    );
  return execute();
}
export async function removePack() {
  const remove = async () => {
    await (await caches.open(INDEX_CACHE)).delete(INDEX_URL);
    for (const name of await caches.keys())
      if (name.startsWith("neuron-pack-")) await caches.delete(name);
  };
  if (navigator.locks)
    return navigator.locks.request("neuron-assets", { mode: "exclusive" }, () =>
      runActivity(remove),
    );
  return runActivity(remove);
}
export async function encoderArtifacts(): Promise<io.ModelArtifacts> {
  if (!(await packStatus()).ready) {
    if (!navigator.onLine)
      throw new Error(
        "No verified image encoder is cached. Reconnect and download it in Settings.",
      );
    await downloadPack(new AbortController().signal);
  }
  const name = await pointer();
  if (!name) throw new Error("Encoder pack was removed. Retry to reinstall.");
  const cache = await caches.open(name);
  const model = validateEncoderManifest(
    JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(await verified(cache, "model.json"))),
  );
  const parts = await Promise.all(
    MODEL_FILES.slice(1).map((f) => verified(cache, f.name)),
  );
  const data = new Uint8Array(parts.reduce((n, p) => n + p.byteLength, 0));
  let offset = 0;
  for (const p of parts) {
    data.set(new Uint8Array(p), offset);
    offset += p.byteLength;
  }
  return {
    modelTopology: model.modelTopology!,
    weightSpecs: model.weightsManifest![0].weights,
    weightData: data.buffer,
    signature: model.signature,
    userDefinedMetadata: model.userDefinedMetadata,
  };
}

let registration: ServiceWorkerRegistration | undefined;
const subscribers = new Set<() => void>();
function changed() {
  subscribers.forEach((fn) => fn());
}
export const offlineState = {
  supported: false,
  controlled: false,
  updateAvailable: false,
  error: "",
};
export function subscribeOffline(fn: () => void) {
  subscribers.add(fn);
  return () => {
    subscribers.delete(fn);
  };
}
export function getRegistration() {
  return registration;
}
export async function registerOffline() {
  const icon = document.createElement("link");
  icon.rel = "icon";
  icon.href = "/favicon.svg";
  document.head.append(icon);
  const manifest = document.createElement("link");
  manifest.rel = "manifest";
  manifest.href = "/manifest.webmanifest";
  document.head.append(manifest);
  if (!import.meta.env.PROD) return;
  if (!("serviceWorker" in navigator) || !window.isSecureContext) {
    offlineState.error =
      "Offline installation requires HTTPS or localhost and service-worker support.";
    changed();
    return;
  }
  offlineState.supported = true;
  try {
    registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.register(
      "/service-worker.js",
      { type: "module", scope: "/" },
    );
    function inspect() {
      offlineState.controlled = !!navigator.serviceWorker.controller;
      offlineState.updateAvailable = !!registration?.waiting;
      changed();
    }
    inspect();
    navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener("controllerchange", inspect);
    registration.addEventListener("updatefound", () => {
      registration?.installing?.addEventListener("statechange", inspect);
    });
    await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
    inspect();
  } catch (e) {
    offlineState.error =
      e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Offline installation failed.";
    changed();
  }
}

/// <reference lib="webworker" />
export {};
const worker = globalThis as unknown as ServiceWorkerGlobalScope;
// Replaced by the production Vite plugin, never evaluated dynamically.
const ASSETS: string[] = __NEURON_PRECACHE__;
const CACHE = "neuron-shell-__NEURON_REVISION__";
declare const __NEURON_PRECACHE__: string[];
worker.addEventListener("install", (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    (async () => {
      const cache = await caches.open(CACHE);
      try {
        await cache.addAll(
          ASSETS.map((path) => new Request(path, { cache: "reload" })),
        );
      } catch (e) {
        await caches.delete(CACHE);
        throw e;
      }
      // Do not skipWaiting: an existing tab must explicitly authorize the update.
    })(),
  );
});
worker.addEventListener("activate", (event) =>
  event.waitUntil(
    (async () => {
      // Keep prior shell caches. Existing tabs may still reference old lazy chunks.
      // Their explicit cleanup is a later feature, not a destructive automatic action.
      await worker.clients.claim();
    })(),
  ),
);
worker.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  if (event.data?.type === "ACTIVATE_UPDATE")
    event.waitUntil(worker.skipWaiting());
});
worker.addEventListener("fetch", (event) => {
  const request = event.request,
    url = new URL(request.url);
  if (url.pathname.startsWith("/api/shares")) return;
  if (request.method !== "GET" || url.origin !== worker.location.origin) return;
  if (request.mode === "navigate") {
    event.respondWith(
      (async () => {
        const cache = await caches.open(CACHE);
        return (
          (await cache.match("/index.html")) ??
          (await cache.match("/offline.html")) ??
          new Response("Offline app unavailable.", { status: 503 })
        );
      })(),
    );
    return;
  }
  if (
    ASSETS.includes(url.pathname) ||
    /^\/assets\/[^/]+\.(js|css)$/.test(url.pathname)
  )
    event.respondWith(
      (async () => {
        const current = await caches.open(CACHE);
        const hit = await current.match(url.pathname);
        if (hit) return hit;
        // A previous tab can still reference a previous content-hashed lazy chunk.
        for (const name of await caches.keys()) {
          if (name === CACHE || !name.startsWith("neuron-shell-")) continue;
          const cached = await (await caches.open(name)).match(url.pathname);
          if (cached) return cached;
        }
        return fetch(request);
      })(),
    );
});

===== FILE apps/web/src/pwa/update-manager.ts | bytes=2003 | sha256=e8753be511c9f14ea4300ee33e1a1db6954595e04c7bf640e1aa43dbf4ae4e7b =====

let jobs = 0;
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
function notify() {
  for (const fn of listeners) fn();
}
export function activeJobs() {
  return jobs;
}
export function subscribeJobs(fn: () => void) {
  listeners.add(fn);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(fn);
  };
}
export async function runActivity<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const run = async () => {
    jobs++;
    notify();
    try {
      return await task();
    } finally {
      jobs--;
      notify();
    }
  };
  if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.locks)
    return navigator.locks.request("neuron-busy", { mode: "shared" }, run);
  return run();
}
export async function installUpdate(registration: ServiceWorkerRegistration) {
  if (!registration.waiting) throw new Error("No waiting update is available.");
  if (!navigator.locks)
    throw new Error(
      "Safe cross-tab updates require Web Locks. Close ALL NEURON tabs and reopen to apply the waiting update.",
    );
  await navigator.locks.request(
    "neuron-busy",
    { mode: "exclusive", ifAvailable: true },
    async (lock) => {
      if (!lock || jobs)
        throw new Error(
          "A job is active in a NEURON tab. Finish or cancel it before updating.",
        );
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          navigator.serviceWorker.removeEventListener(
            "controllerchange",
            changed,
          );
          reject(
            new Error("Update timed out. Close all NEURON tabs and reopen."),
          );
        }, 15000);
        const changed = () => {
          clearTimeout(timer);
          navigator.serviceWorker.removeEventListener(
            "controllerchange",
            changed,
          );
          resolve();
        };
        navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener("controllerchange", changed);
        registration.waiting?.postMessage({ type: "ACTIVATE_UPDATE" });
      });
      location.reload();
    },
  );
}

import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import {
  encodeBackup,
  decodeBackup,
  validateBackupShape,
  type Snapshot,
} from "../lib/backup-format";
import { sha256 } from "../lib/checksums";
function snapshot(): Snapshot {
  return {
    project: {
      id: "p",
      name: "Plants",
      labels: [
        { id: "a", name: "A" },
        { id: "b", name: "B" },
      ],
      createdAt: 1,
      updatedAt: 2,
    },
    samples: [
      {
        id: "s",
        projectId: "p",
        labelId: "a",
        createdAt: 1,
        blob: new Blob([new Uint8Array([255, 216, 255, 224, 0, 0])], {
          type: "image/jpeg",
        }),
      },
    ],
    versions: [],
    feedback: [],
  };
}
describe("full project backup", () => {
  it("hashes known vectors", async () =>
    expect(await sha256("abc")).toBe(
      "ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad",
    ));
  it("round trips media and remaps IDs without overwriting the source", async () => {
    const s = snapshot(),
      file = await encodeBackup(s),
      restored = await decodeBackup(file);
    expect(restored.project.id).not.toBe("p");
    expect(restored.samples[0].id).not.toBe("s");
    expect(restored.samples[0].projectId).toBe(restored.project.id);
    expect(
      new Uint8Array(await restored.samples[0].blob.arrayBuffer()),
    ).toEqual(new Uint8Array(await s.samples[0].blob.arrayBuffer()));
  });
  it("rejects corrupted media before restore", async () => {
    const raw = JSON.parse(await (await encodeBackup(snapshot())).text());
    raw.samples[0].hash = "0".repeat(64);
    await expect(decodeBackup(new Blob([JSON.stringify(raw)]))).rejects.toThrow(
      "checksum",
    );
  });
  it("rejects missing active versions", async () => {
    const raw = JSON.parse(await (await encodeBackup(snapshot())).text());
    raw.project.activeVersionId = "absent";
    expect(() => validateBackupShape(raw)).toThrow("Active model");
  });
  it("rejects duplicate labels", async () => {
    const raw = JSON.parse(await (await encodeBackup(snapshot())).text());
    raw.project.labels[1].name = "A";
    expect(() => validateBackupShape(raw)).toThrow("classes");
  });
  it("rejects unknown backup formats", async () =>
    await expect(
      decodeBackup(new Blob(['{"format":"javascript"}'])),
    ).rejects.toThrow());
  it("rejects invalid JSON", async () =>
    await expect(decodeBackup(new Blob(["{"]))).rejects.toThrow("JSON"));
  it("enforces sample count", async () => {
    const raw = JSON.parse(await (await encodeBackup(snapshot())).text());
    raw.samples = Array(1001).fill(raw.samples[0]);
    expect(() => validateBackupShape(raw)).toThrow("limits");
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import {
  encryptModel,
  decryptModel,
  randomSecret,
  secretHash,
  base64url,
  unbase64url,
} from "../features/sharing/crypto";
describe("authenticated model encryption", () => {
  it("roundtrips bytes with a fresh key and IV", async () => {
    const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode("sensitive weights");
    const a = await encryptModel(bytes),
      b = await encryptModel(bytes);
    expect(a.secret).not.toBe(b.secret);
    expect(a.bytes).not.toEqual(b.bytes);
    expect(await decryptModel(a.bytes, a.secret)).toEqual(bytes);
  });
  it("rejects wrong keys", async () => {
    const a = await encryptModel(new Uint8Array([1]));
    await expect(decryptModel(a.bytes, randomSecret())).rejects.toThrow(
      "Cannot decrypt",
    );
  });
  it("rejects authenticated ciphertext tampering", async () => {
    const a = await encryptModel(new Uint8Array([1]));
    a.bytes[a.bytes.length - 1] ^= 1;
    await expect(decryptModel(a.bytes, a.secret)).rejects.toThrow("altered");
  });
  it("rejects version/magic tampering", async () => {
    const a = await encryptModel(new Uint8Array([1]));
    a.bytes[3] = 2;
    await expect(decryptModel(a.bytes, a.secret)).rejects.toThrow("envelope");
  });
  it("validates canonical key encodings", () => {
    const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
    expect(unbase64url(base64url(bytes), 32)).toEqual(bytes);
    expect(() => unbase64url("a".repeat(43), 32)).toThrow();
  });
  it("hashes deletion tokens deterministically without returning the token", async () => {
    const token = randomSecret();
    expect(await secretHash(token)).toMatch(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
    expect(await secretHash(token)).toBe(await secretHash(token));
  });
});

    expect(() => validateReceipt(r)).toThrow();

    r.expiresAt = 0;

import "fake-indexeddb/auto";
import { beforeEach, afterAll, describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { openDB, deleteDB } from "idb";
import {
  activateVersion,
  database,
  closeDatabase,
  getProject,
  deleteProject,
  snapshotProject,
} from "../lib/db";
import {
  queueFeedback,
  approveFeedback,
  discardFeedback,
  listFeedback,
  comparable,
} from "../features/evolution/evolution.service";
import type { ModelVersion, Project } from "../lib/types";
const project: Project = {
  id: "p",
  name: "Test",
  labels: [
    { id: "a", name: "A" },
    { id: "b", name: "B" },
  ],
  createdAt: 1,
  updatedAt: 1,
};

  format: "neuron-image",
  version: 1,
  labels: project.labels,
} as unknown as ModelVersion["artifact"];
const version: ModelVersion = {
  id: "v",
  projectId: "p",
  createdAt: 1,
  artifact,

  await closeDatabase();
  await deleteDB("neuron-local");

afterAll(closeDatabase);
async function setup() {
  const db = await database();
  await db.put("projects", project);
  await db.put("versions", version);
  return db;
}
describe("storage migration and consent workflow", () => {
  it("activation preserves the latest class vocabulary", async () => {
    const db = await setup();
    await db.put("projects", {
      ...project,
      labels: [
        { id: "a", name: "Updated A" },
        { id: "b", name: "B" },
      ],
    });
    await activateVersion("p", "v");
    expect((await getProject("p"))?.labels[0].name).toBe("Updated A");
    expect((await getProject("p"))?.activeVersionId).toBe("v");
  });
  it("rejects activating a version from another project", async () => {
    const db = await setup();
    await db.put("versions", {
      ...version,
      id: "foreign",
      projectId: "different",
    });
    await expect(activateVersion("p", "foreign")).rejects.toThrow("not found");
    expect((await getProject("p"))?.activeVersionId).toBeUndefined();
  });
  it("preserves original v1 records during additive upgrade", async () => {
    const old = await openDB("neuron-local", 1, {
      upgrade(db) {
        db.createObjectStore("projects", { keyPath: "id" });
        db.createObjectStore("samples", { keyPath: "id" }).createIndex(
          "by-project",
          "projectId",
        );
        db.createObjectStore("versions", { keyPath: "id" }).createIndex(
          "by-project",
          "projectId",
        );
      },
    });
    await old.put("projects", project);
    await old.put("versions", version);
    await old.put("samples", {
      id: "legacy",
      projectId: "p",
      labelId: "a",
      createdAt: 1,
      blob: new Blob(["jpeg"], { type: "image/jpeg" }),
    });
    old.close();
    expect(await getProject("p")).toEqual(project);
    const snapshot = await snapshotProject("p");
    expect(snapshot.samples).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(snapshot.versions).toHaveLength(1);
    expect((await database()).objectStoreNames.contains("feedback")).toBe(true);
  });
  it("does not approve a queued image until explicit review", async () => {
    await setup();
    const f = await queueFeedback(
      "p",
      "v",
      "a",
      new Blob(["jpeg"], { type: "image/jpeg" }),
      "B",
    );
    expect((await snapshotProject("p")).samples).toHaveLength(0);
    await approveFeedback(f.id);
    expect((await snapshotProject("p")).samples).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(await listFeedback("p")).toHaveLength(0);
  });
  it("rejects duplicate feedback without consuming the pending item", async () => {
    await setup();
    const blob = new Blob(["same"], { type: "image/jpeg" });
    const a = await queueFeedback("p", "v", "a", blob, "A");
    await approveFeedback(a.id);
    const b = await queueFeedback("p", "v", "b", blob, "A");
    await expect(approveFeedback(b.id)).rejects.toThrow("already exists");
    expect(await listFeedback("p")).toHaveLength(1);
  });
  it("discard does not modify training samples", async () => {
    await setup();
    const f = await queueFeedback(
      "p",
      "v",
      "a",
      new Blob(["jpeg"], { type: "image/jpeg" }),
      "A",
    );
    await discardFeedback(f.id);
    expect((await snapshotProject("p")).samples).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(await listFeedback("p")).toHaveLength(0);
  });
  it("deleting a project deletes related feedback too", async () => {
    await setup();
    await queueFeedback(
      "p",
      "v",
      "a",
      new Blob(["jpeg"], { type: "image/jpeg" }),
      "A",
    );
    await deleteProject("p");
    expect(await listFeedback("p")).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(await getProject("p")).toBeUndefined();
  });
  it("rejects removed classes", async () => {
    await setup();
    await expect(
      queueFeedback(
        "p",
        "v",
        "missing",
        new Blob(["jpeg"], { type: "image/jpeg" }),
        "A",
      ),
    ).rejects.toThrow();
  });
  it("warns on incomparable legacy models", () =>
    expect(comparable(version, version)).toBe(false));
  it("compares only identical validation fingerprints", () => {
    const a = {
      ...version,
      artifact: {
        ...artifact,
        provenance: {
          datasetHash: "1".repeat(64),
          validationHash: "2".repeat(64),
          seed: 42,
          sampleCount: 10,
        },
      },
    };
    expect(comparable(a, a)).toBe(true);
    expect(
      comparable(a, {
        ...a,
        artifact: {
          ...a.artifact,
          provenance: {
            ...a.artifact.provenance,
            validationHash: "3".repeat(64),
          },
        },
      }),
    ).toBe(false);
  });
});

===== FILE apps/web/src/workers/dataset.worker.ts | bytes=1614 | sha256=fd671fd71f6c792c8bc40f934450204a8c5005bd7692542fd9ca472a9f290fb1 =====

/// <reference lib="webworker" />
import { requireCondition, explainError } from "../lib/errors";
const scope = globalThis as unknown as DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope;
let used = false;
scope.onmessage = (event) => {
  if (used) return;
  used = true;
  void (async () => {
    const file = event.data;
    requireCondition(
      file instanceof Blob &&
        ["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp"].includes(file.type) &&
        file.size <= 15 * 1024 * 1024,
      "Unsupported image type or size.",
    );
    const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(file, {
      imageOrientation: "from-image",
    });
    try {
      requireCondition(
        bitmap.width > 0 &&
          bitmap.height > 0 &&
          bitmap.width * bitmap.height <= 40000000,
        "Image exceeds the 40-megapixel safety limit.",
      );
      const scale = Math.min(1, 768 / Math.max(bitmap.width, bitmap.height)),
        canvas = new OffscreenCanvas(
          Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.width * scale)),
          Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.height * scale)),
        ),
        ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      requireCondition(ctx, "Worker 2D canvas unavailable.");
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      const blob = await canvas.convertToBlob({
        type: "image/jpeg",
        quality: 0.88,
      });
      scope.postMessage({ ok: true, value: blob });
    } finally {
      bitmap.close();
    }
  })().catch((e) =>
    scope.postMessage({ ok: false, error: explainError(e).message }),
  );
};

import { defineConfig, transformWithEsbuild, type Plugin } from "vite";
import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
function offlineShell(): Plugin {
  return {
    name: "neuron-offline-shell",
    apply: "build",
    enforce: "post",
    async generateBundle(_, bundle) {
      const paths = [
        "/offline.html",
        "/favicon.svg",
        "/manifest.webmanifest",
        ...Object.keys(bundle)
          .filter((p) => !p.endsWith(".map"))
          .map((p) => "/" + p),
      ].sort();
      const workerTemplate = readFileSync(
        new URL("./src/pwa/service-worker.ts", import.meta.url),
        "utf8",
      );
      const publicRevision = [
        "offline.html",
        "favicon.svg",
        "manifest.webmanifest",
      ]
        .map((name) =>
          readFileSync(new URL("./public/" + name, import.meta.url), "utf8"),
        )
        .join("\n");
      const revision = createHash("sha256")
        .update(workerTemplate)
        .update(publicRevision)
        .update(paths.join("\n"))
        .update(
          String(
            bundle["index.html"]?.type === "asset"
              ? bundle["index.html"].source
              : "",
          ),
        )
        .digest("hex")
        .slice(0, 16);
      const source = readFileSync(
        new URL("./src/pwa/service-worker.ts", import.meta.url),
        "utf8",
      )
        .replace("__NEURON_PRECACHE__", JSON.stringify(paths))
        .replace("__NEURON_REVISION__", revision);
      const compiled = await transformWithEsbuild(source, "service-worker.ts", {
        loader: "ts",
        target: "es2022",
        minify: true,
      });
      this.emitFile({
        type: "asset",
        fileName: "service-worker.js",
        source: compiled.code,
      });
    },
  };
}

if (
  !["http:", "https:"].includes(relayURL.protocol) ||
  relayURL.username ||
  relayURL.password
)
  throw new Error("Invalid NEURON_RELAY_TARGET");

'tests/unit/storage-migrations.test.ts', 'tsconfig.base.json']

def initial_content(name):
    suffix = Path(name).suffix
    if name == '.gitignore':
        return 'node_modules/\ndist/\n.env\n.env.*\n!.env.example\n.dev.vars\ncoverage/\nplaywright-report/\ntest-results/\n.DS_Store\n'
    if name == 'README.md':
        return '# NEURON\n\nStatus: architecture scaffold, not an implemented application.\n\nEvery planned file has been created. Implement and test each module before use.\nSee ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/implementation-roadmap.md.\n'
    if name.endswith('package.json'):
        parent = Path(name).parent.as_posix()
        label = 'neuron' if parent == '.' else '@neuron/' + parent.split('/')[-1]
        return json.dumps({'name':label, 'version':'0.0.0', 'private':True, 'type':'module'}, indent=2)+'\n'
    if name == 'pnpm-workspace.yaml':
        return 'packages:\n  - "apps/*"\n  - "packages/*"\n  - "services/*"\n'
    if suffix in ('.ts', '.tsx', '.mjs'):
        return '// PLANNED MODULE: '+name+'\n// Not implemented. See the architecture and acceptance criteria.\nexport {};\n'
    if suffix == '.json': return '{}\n'
    if suffix == '.md': return '# '+Path(name).stem.replace('-', ' ').title()+'\n\nPlanned document. Not yet implemented.\n'
    if suffix in ('.yaml','.yml','.toml') or Path(name).name.startswith('.'):
        return '# Planned configuration: '+name+'\n'
    if suffix == '.css': return '/* Planned stylesheet: '+name+' */\n'
    if suffix in ('.html','.svg','.webmanifest'): return ''
    return ''

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--root',default='neuron')
    args=parser.parse_args()
    root=Path(args.root).expanduser().resolve()
    # Refuse existing files before writing anything: never silently overwrite work.
    collisions=[p for p in FILES if (root/p).exists()]
    blocked=[p for p in FILES if any(x.exists() and not x.is_dir() for x in (root/p).parents)]
    if collisions or blocked:
        parser.error('No files written. Existing paths conflict: '+', '.join((collisions+blocked)[:10]))
    root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    for name in FILES:
        dest=root/name
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        dest.write_text(initial_content(name),encoding='utf-8')
    missing=[p for p in FILES if not (root/p).is_file()]
    if missing: raise SystemExit('Verification failed: '+str(missing))
    print(f'Created and verified {len(FILES)} planned files in {root}')
    print('Scaffold only: no application features or dependencies have been implemented yet.')

if __name__=='__main__': main()
CONTENT END

===== FILE docs/acceptance-criteria.md | bytes=4366 | sha256=7cf239e7721435c0999c7423eec1471718b4b4f49cf6f9592fdf56d3b9a3fcb2 =====
CONTENT START
# Cumulative acceptance criteria — Phase 5

## Required local checks

Use Node >=22.12 and pnpm 9.15.5 from repository root. Run `pnpm install` after applying the handoff and review/commit the regenerated lockfile. Then:

```
pnpm check:env
pnpm check:boundaries
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build
pnpm audit
pnpm --filter @neuron/web exec playwright install chromium
pnpm test:e2e
```

On Linux CI, install browser OS dependencies too: `pnpm --filter @neuron/web exec playwright install --with-deps chromium`. Alternatively use `pnpm release:check --browser` after installing browsers. `pnpm release:check` without `--browser` explicitly reports that its browser gate was skipped. A frozen install needs the updated committed lockfile; do not weaken CI by ignoring lock drift.

## Added Phase 5 acceptance gates

- The browser's rendered app imports no reachable planned stubs; app route parser does not accept nested/malformed project IDs or turn unknown routes into working pages.
- Skip navigation focuses main content while preserving the SPA hash route. Settings/project/CSV navigation renders at desktop/mobile sizes. Serious/critical automated axe checks run on the three named landing/settings pages, not the entire app or every dialog. Manual accessibility review is still required.
- Create/edit image project classes through the planned feature components. Concurrent class additions transact against current metadata. Missing classes, duplicate class names and stale image-training commits fail without saving a new active model.
- File import uses the actual image normalization Worker on supported Chromium, produces JPEG bounded to 768px, detects invalid source data and retains existing exact normalized-image duplicate checks. The fallback is capability-based, not silent error suppression.
- Camera opens only on explicit start, requests no audio, saves/predicts only an explicit frame, supports denial/cancel/late permission, stops on navigation/hidden/stop/preferences and does not issue a dataset upload. The automated device is synthetic; physical hardware is not certified.
- SampleGrid paginates all samples instead of making images after the first 120 inaccessible. Object URLs are revoked when thumbnails/previews unmount/change.
- Image training emits actual old metrics through the new Controls/Charts/Report modules. Inference uses one active engine, guards overlapping predictions and disposes stale engines. Feedback and existing encrypted sharing remain wired.
- Model export requires explicit local-download consent. Model import validates first and creates a new project; existing raw examples and models are not overwritten/deleted.
- Settings displays real inventory, quota and persistence results. The cancellable read-only scan detects injected stored checksum/reference errors without deleting records. Diagnostics contain only aggregate metadata and cannot restore a project.
- Camera and reduced-motion preferences synchronize same-origin tabs and survive reload where localStorage is allowed. Reset preferences does not reset databases/caches/receipts.

## Preserved cumulative gates

Phase 1–3 image training/inference/feedback/backup/restore and encrypted image-model relay tests must still pass. Phase 4 CSV classification/regression, grouped splits, train-only preprocessing, test evaluation, worker cancel, row/batch inference, model import/export and atomic backup restore must still work offline with an installed production shell. Image tests must install/verify the pinned encoder before disconnecting.

Run destructive/corruption scenarios only in isolated browser contexts/test databases, never on the user's real data. Do not clear site storage to conceal a failed migration/test. Do not remove tests, accept corrupt artifacts, replace real training with timers, or invent metrics to make gates pass.

## Honest scope

See the complete original-scaffold ledger. Phase 5 does not claim to finish the remaining audio/text/video/custom-model/P2P modules, unused package scaffolds, deployment automation or every test filename. Deployment certification, physical-device fleet testing, general concurrent editing resolution, complete human accessibility/fairness/security/license review and guaranteed task accuracy remain out of scope. Passing synthetic examples verifies execution, not universal performance.

NEURON — PHASE 1 IMPLEMENTATION HANDOFF
========================================
40 complete source/configuration/documentation files. No ellipses or omitted code.

READ THIS FIRST — FOR THE VS CODE AGENT
--------------------------------------
The user already has the original NEURON scaffold (262 planned paths plus the
create_neuron.py script). Apply this bundle to THAT SAME PROJECT ROOT.
Do not create another neuron/ folder underneath it.

1. Inspect the current workspace; back up or commit user edits before replacing files.
2. For each BEGIN FILE / END FILE section below, write the exact enclosed content
   to the specified relative path. Do not include the delimiter lines in the file.
3. Replace the 34 listed existing scaffold files; create the 6 listed new files.
   Preserve all other scaffold files. Do not import or pretend to implement their stubs.
4. There are exactly 40 numbered file sections. Check you applied all 40.
5. Use Node.js 20.19+ or 22.12+; this was verified on Node.js 20.20.2.
6. From the repository root, execute in order:

       npm install --global pnpm@9.15.5
       pnpm install
       pnpm typecheck
       pnpm test
       pnpm build
       pnpm dev

   pnpm dev is long-running; open the local URL it prints (usually http://localhost:5173).
   If PowerShell blocks pnpm.ps1, use pnpm.cmd for these commands instead.
   If global installation is not allowed, use npx --yes pnpm@9.15.5 in place of pnpm.
   No .env file or API key is needed for Phase 1.
7. Commit the real generated pnpm-lock.yaml after reviewing the installation.
   Do not fabricate a lockfile and do not add a second package manager's lockfile.
8. Report actual command outputs and failures. Do not replace the ML with fake
   predictions, simulated training timers, random metrics or hosted AI APIs.
9. Do not deploy yet. This phase has explicit remaining production release gates.

WHAT THIS PHASE DELIVERS
------------------------
- Screenshot-inspired responsive dark navy / cyan / violet NEURON interface.
- Accessible primary navigation, native modal focus handling, visible focus rings,
  reduced-motion rules, and mobile layouts. Not a substitute for an accessibility audit.
- Local projects with real IndexedDB persistence and deletion.
- 2–20 editable classes; JPEG / PNG / WebP import, bounded JPEG normalization,
  sample removal and per-class counts. Maximum 1,000 images in this phase.
- Real TensorFlow.js MobileNet v2 transfer-learning image classifier.
- A frozen 1,280-feature encoder and trainable softmax dense classification head.
- WebGL execution when available, CPU fallback, honest device/runtime reporting.
- Minimum 5 images/class; seeded stratified 20% validation split, epoch progress,
  real loss and accuracy, cancellation and confusion matrix.
- Immutable saved model versions and explicit active-version selection/rollback.
- Saved-model file predictions and user-triggered camera-frame predictions.
- Validated .neuron.json model export/import, strict tensor sizes/names and no
  arbitrary imported executable graph topology. No raw images in model exports.
- Storage estimates, persistence request, browser capability checks and clear warnings.
- Eighteen executable automated tests.

WHAT THIS PHASE DOES NOT CLAIM
------------------------------
This is an implemented image-classification phase, not the entire completed product
or a promise of a perfect production application. No fabricated functionality is used.

Still to implement: service-worker offline reload, cached model asset packs,
worker-isolated training, robust large-dataset/resource scheduling, independent test
sets and deeper leakage detection, encrypted asynchronous share links, WebRTC,
text/audio/tabular/video adapters, feedback-driven evolution, dataset backup/restore,
full deployment automation, security/accessibility audits and a verified device matrix.
The six modality tiles on the homepage are a noninteractive decorative preview;
only image classification is active, with the others explicitly labeled Later phase.

The encoder requires network access on the first training/inference in each fresh
page session. Subsequent use reuses the in-memory encoder. Do not advertise full
offline support. Browser HTTP caching is not a guaranteed offline asset strategy.
Training yields asynchronously but is not moved to a Web Worker in this phase.
Camera predictions are triggered by the Predict this frame button, not continuous
streaming inference. No camera or microphone data is silently uploaded.

Validation accuracy is not an independent test score, and softmax scores are not
calibrated probabilities. Near-duplicate images can inflate validation results.
Five samples/class is a minimum for functionality, not enough for most useful models.
A seed fixes split and initialization, but GPU execution / fit shuffling need not be
bit-for-bit deterministic across runs or hardware.

Model imports into an existing project require confirmation: the incoming vocabulary
replaces project classes and its dataset is cleared. Old model versions remain usable.
Export your models and keep original images separately. Browser storage can be evicted.
Model exports do not constitute dataset backups and may leak learned information.

Public/_headers supplies header rules for hosts that understand that format. It is
NOT applied by every host (including Vercel) and is not a Vite development-server CSP.
Before hosting, configure equivalent actual response headers for the chosen provider,
verify the Google/Kaggle model-download redirect chain, and test camera permissions.
Do not deploy the existing scaffold's infra/vercel.json as if it were implemented.

# NEURON — Phase 1

A real local image-classification workflow. No account or API key required.

## Run

Install Node.js 20.19+ or 22.12+. With pnpm 9 available:

    pnpm install
    pnpm dev
    pnpm typecheck
    pnpm test
    pnpm build

Open the URL printed by Vite. Use Chrome/Edge desktop for the initial support target. Camera requires HTTPS or localhost. A WebGL-compatible browser is recommended. Training can fall back to the much slower TensorFlow.js CPU backend. Allow time for the initial MobileNet download; an internet connection is required for each fresh page session's first encoder load in this phase.

## What works

Create/delete local projects, add/rename/delete classes, import JPEG/PNG/WebP, remove samples, real MobileNet transfer-learning, stratified held-out validation, real epoch progress/cancellation, confusion matrix, IndexedDB model history, activate/rollback, JSON model export/import and local file/camera inference. Camera mode predicts individual frames on request, not a continuous streaming pipeline. Training uses a frozen MobileNet embedding and a newly trained dense classifier; it is not foundation-model training.

A class needs at least five samples; diverse examples (30+ per class) are strongly recommended. Validation is held out from fitting, but is not an independent test set and must not be presented as final generalization performance. Do not split near-duplicate frames across classes/validation.

## Privacy and persistence

Images and training stay in this browser. The image encoder weights are fetched from Google's model distribution endpoints; those requests expose connection metadata, never your samples. Imported images are decoded and re-encoded to a bounded JPEG before storage (metadata is not preserved). IndexedDB is browser-profile storage, not a durable backup. Private browsing, eviction, clearing site data or changing origins can remove access. Exported model files contain weights and class labels, not your source images; they do NOT back up the dataset. Models may still leak training information.

## Phase boundaries

This phase does NOT implement a service worker/full offline reload, encrypted share links, WebRTC, worker-based training, non-image modalities, automatic model evolution, or a cross-browser certification. The UI does not pretend these exist. TensorFlow.js training remains on the browser thread with asynchronous yields; large jobs can still affect responsiveness. Frozen encoder assets are fetched using @tensorflow-models/mobilenet. Use only images you have rights to process. Model asset licensing/distribution and a real-device GPU/memory audit remain release gates.

Dataset state and model versions are persisted; camera streams are stopped on unmount. Interrupted training is not resumable; the previous saved model remains intact. Stored models are immutable version artifacts. Export imports are schema/shape/size checked; arbitrary model code/topologies are never accepted. A model imported into another project replaces its class vocabulary and clears that project's existing dataset after explicit confirmation in Settings.

## Agent handoff

The Phase 1 text bundle is authoritative for its 40 files only. Preserve the other scaffold files, but do not import their stubs or claim they work. Lockfile is produced by the real installation and should be committed after review. Do not invent test results. Tests cover pure validation/splitting/metrics and artifact rules; real-browser training and camera require the manual checks in the supplied handoff text.
----- CONTENT END -----

import { Component, type ReactNode } from "react";
export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<
  { children: ReactNode },
  { error: string | null }
> {
  state: { error: string | null } = { error: null };
  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error) {
    return { error: error.message };
  }
  render() {
    return this.state.error ? (
      <main className="fatal">
        <h1>NEURON needs to restart</h1>
        <p role="alert">{this.state.error}</p>
        <p>Your previously saved projects have not been deleted.</p>
        <button onClick={() => location.reload()}>Reload application</button>
      </main>
    ) : (
      this.props.children
    );
  }
}
----- CONTENT END -----

import { openDB, type DBSchema } from "idb";
import type { Project, Sample, ModelVersion } from "./types";
interface NeuronDB extends DBSchema {
  projects: { key: string; value: Project };
  samples: { key: string; value: Sample; indexes: { "by-project": string } };
  versions: {
    key: string;
    value: ModelVersion;
    indexes: { "by-project": string };
  };
}
let connection: ReturnType<typeof openDB<NeuronDB>> | undefined;
export function database() {
  if (!("indexedDB" in globalThis))
    throw new Error(
      "This browser does not support IndexedDB. Use a normal Chrome or Edge window.",
    );
  return (connection ??= openDB<NeuronDB>("neuron-local", 1, {
    upgrade(db) {
      db.createObjectStore("projects", { keyPath: "id" });
      db.createObjectStore("samples", { keyPath: "id" }).createIndex(
        "by-project",
        "projectId",
      );
      db.createObjectStore("versions", { keyPath: "id" }).createIndex(
        "by-project",
        "projectId",
      );
    },
    blocking() {
      connection?.then((db) => db.close());
      connection = undefined;
    },
    terminated() {
      connection = undefined;
    },
  }));
}

export async function deleteProject(id: string) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = db.transaction(["projects", "samples", "versions"], "readwrite");
  await tx.objectStore("projects").delete(id);
  for (const name of ["samples", "versions"] as const) {
    for (const key of await tx
      .objectStore(name)
      .index("by-project")
      .getAllKeys(id))
      await tx.objectStore(name).delete(key);
  }
  await tx.done;
}
export async function commitVersion(version: ModelVersion) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = db.transaction(["projects", "versions"], "readwrite");
  const project = await tx.objectStore("projects").get(version.projectId);
  if (!project) throw new Error("Project no longer exists.");
  await tx.objectStore("versions").put(version);
  await tx
    .objectStore("projects")
    .put({ ...project, activeVersionId: version.id, updatedAt: Date.now() });
  await tx.done;
}
export async function deleteLabel(project: Project, labelId: string) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = db.transaction(["projects", "samples"], "readwrite");
  const samples = await tx
    .objectStore("samples")
    .index("by-project")
    .getAll(project.id);
  for (const s of samples)
    if (s.labelId === labelId) await tx.objectStore("samples").delete(s.id);
  await tx
    .objectStore("projects")
    .put({
      ...project,
      labels: project.labels.filter((l) => l.id !== labelId),
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    });
  await tx.done;
}
export async function importVersion(project: Project, version: ModelVersion) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = db.transaction(["projects", "samples", "versions"], "readwrite");

    .objectStore("samples")
    .index("by-project")
    .getAllKeys(project.id))

  await tx.objectStore("versions").put(version);
  await tx
    .objectStore("projects")
    .put({
      ...project,
      labels: version.artifact.labels,
      activeVersionId: version.id,
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    });
  await tx.done;
}

export function bytes(n: number) {
  return n >= 1073741824
    ? `${(n / 1073741824).toFixed(1)} GB`
    : n >= 1048576
      ? `${(n / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB`
      : `${Math.round(n / 1024)} KB`;
}

import { database } from "../../lib/db";
import { uid, type Sample } from "../../lib/types";
export const MAX_SAMPLES = 1000;
export async function decodeImage(blob: Blob): Promise<ImageBitmap> {
  try {
    return await createImageBitmap(blob, { imageOrientation: "from-image" });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(
      "Could not decode this image. Use a valid JPEG, PNG or WebP.",
    );
  }
}
export async function normalizeImage(file: File): Promise<Blob> {
  if (!["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp"].includes(file.type))
    throw new Error(`${file.name}: only JPEG, PNG and WebP are supported.`);
  if (file.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024)
    throw new Error(`${file.name}: maximum upload size is 15 MB.`);
  const bitmap = await decodeImage(file);
  try {
    if (bitmap.width * bitmap.height > 40_000_000)
      throw new Error("Image exceeds the 40-megapixel safety limit.");
    const scale = Math.min(1, 768 / Math.max(bitmap.width, bitmap.height));
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.width * scale));
    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.height * scale));
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) throw new Error("Canvas unavailable.");
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    return await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) =>
      canvas.toBlob(
        (b) => (b ? resolve(b) : reject(new Error("Image encoding failed."))),
        "image/jpeg",
        0.88,
      ),
    );
  } finally {
    bitmap.close();
  }
}
export async function addImages(
  projectId: string,
  labelId: string,
  files: File[],
  currentCount: number,
  onProgress: (n: number) => void,
) {
  if (currentCount + files.length > MAX_SAMPLES)
    throw new Error(
      `This phase supports at most ${MAX_SAMPLES} samples per project.`,
    );
  const errors: string[] = [];
  let saved = 0;
  for (const file of files) {
    try {
      const blob = await normalizeImage(file);
      const sample: Sample = {
        id: uid(),
        projectId,
        labelId,
        blob,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
      };
      await (await database()).put("samples", sample);
      saved++;
    } catch (e) {
      errors.push(
        `${file.name}: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Save failed"}`,
      );
      if (e instanceof DOMException && e.name === "QuotaExceededError") break;
    }
    onProgress(saved);
  }
  return { saved, errors };
}
export async function removeSample(id: string) {
  await (await database()).delete("samples", id);
}

import * as tf from "@tensorflow/tfjs";
import * as mobilenet from "@tensorflow-models/mobilenet";
import { decodeImage } from "../features/datasets/dataset.service";
let encoderPromise: Promise<mobilenet.MobileNet> | undefined;
let initPromise: Promise<void> | undefined;
export async function initializeRuntime() {
  return (initPromise ??= (async () => {
    try {
      if (!(await tf.setBackend("webgl"))) throw new Error("WebGL unavailable");
      await tf.ready();
    } catch {
      await tf.setBackend("cpu");
      await tf.ready();
    }
  })());
}
export async function encoder() {
  await initializeRuntime();
  if (!encoderPromise)
    encoderPromise = mobilenet.load({ version: 2, alpha: 1.0 }).catch((e) => {
      encoderPromise = undefined;
      throw new Error(
        `Encoder download failed. Check your internet connection and retry. ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : ""}`,
      );
    });
  return encoderPromise;
}
export async function embed(blob: Blob) {
  const net = await encoder();
  const bitmap = await decodeImage(blob);
  try {
    // mobilenet's published input union omits ImageBitmap; use a bounded canvas.
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = 224;
    canvas.height = 224;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) throw new Error("Canvas unavailable.");
    ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, 224, 224);
    const t = net.infer(canvas, true) as tf.Tensor;
    try {
      return Float32Array.from(await t.data());
    } finally {
      t.dispose();
    }
  } finally {
    bitmap.close();
  }
}
export function makeHead(classes: number, seed: number) {
  const model = tf.sequential();
  model.add(
    tf.layers.dense({
      inputShape: [1280],
      units: classes,
      activation: "softmax",
      kernelInitializer: tf.initializers.glorotUniform({ seed }),
      biasInitializer: "zeros",
    }),
  );
  return model;
}
export function backendName() {
  return tf.getBackend() || "not initialized";
}
export { tf };

import type { ModelArtifact } from "./types";
export const MAX_MODEL_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
export function toBase64(buffer: ArrayBuffer) {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
  let result = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 8192)
    result += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(i, i + 8192));
  return btoa(result);
}
export function fromBase64(s: string): ArrayBuffer {
  const raw = atob(s);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(raw.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) bytes[i] = raw.charCodeAt(i);
  return bytes.buffer;
}
function fail(): never {
  throw new Error("Invalid or incompatible NEURON image model.");
}
export function validateArtifact(value: unknown): ModelArtifact {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return fail();
  const a = value as ModelArtifact;
  if (
    a.format !== "neuron-image" ||
    a.version !== 1 ||
    a.encoder !== "mobilenet-v2-1.0" ||
    a.embeddingSize !== 1280
  )
    return fail();
  if (!Array.isArray(a.labels) || a.labels.length < 2 || a.labels.length > 20)
    return fail();
  const ids = new Set<string>(),
    names = new Set<string>();
  for (const l of a.labels) {
    if (
      !l ||
      typeof l.id !== "string" ||
      !l.id ||
      l.id.length > 100 ||
      typeof l.name !== "string" ||
      !l.name.trim() ||
      l.name.length > 64 ||
      ids.has(l.id) ||
      names.has(l.name.trim().toLowerCase())
    )
      return fail();
    ids.add(l.id);
    names.add(l.name.trim().toLowerCase());
  }
  const n = a.labels.length;
  if (!Array.isArray(a.weightSpecs) || a.weightSpecs.length !== 2)
    return fail();
  const expected = [[1280, n], [n]];
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    const s = a.weightSpecs[i];
    if (
      !s ||
      s.dtype !== "float32" ||
      s.name !== `head_${i}` ||
      JSON.stringify(s.shape) !== JSON.stringify(expected[i])
    )
      return fail();
  }
  if (
    typeof a.weightData !== "string" ||
    a.weightData.length > MAX_MODEL_BYTES ||
    !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$/.test(a.weightData)
  )
    return fail();
  let buffer: ArrayBuffer;
  try {
    buffer = fromBase64(a.weightData);
  } catch {
    return fail();
  }
  if (buffer.byteLength !== (1280 * n + n) * 4) return fail();
  for (const x of new Float32Array(buffer))
    if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return fail();
  if (
    !Number.isFinite(a.createdAt) ||
    !Array.isArray(a.epochs) ||
    a.epochs.length > 100
  )
    return fail();
  for (const e of a.epochs)
    if (
      !e ||
      ![e.epoch, e.loss, e.accuracy, e.valLoss, e.valAccuracy].every(
        Number.isFinite,
      )
    )
      return fail();
  const v = a.evaluation;
  if (
    !v ||
    !Number.isInteger(v.total) ||
    v.total < 1 ||
    v.total > 1000 ||
    !Number.isFinite(v.accuracy) ||
    v.accuracy < 0 ||
    v.accuracy > 1 ||
    !Array.isArray(v.matrix) ||
    v.matrix.length !== n
  )
    return fail();
  let total = 0,
    correct = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const row = v.matrix[i];
    if (!Array.isArray(row) || row.length !== n) return fail();
    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
      const c = row[j];
      if (!Number.isInteger(c) || c < 0) return fail();
      total += c;
      if (i === j) correct += c;
    }
  }
  if (total !== v.total || Math.abs(correct / total - v.accuracy) > 1e-6)
    return fail();
  return structuredClone(a);
}
export async function readModel(file: File) {
  if (file.size > MAX_MODEL_BYTES)
    throw new Error("Model file exceeds the 8 MB safety limit.");
  let value: unknown;
  try {
    value = JSON.parse(await file.text());
  } catch {
    throw new Error("This file is not valid JSON.");
  }
  return validateArtifact(value);
}
export function exportModel(artifact: ModelArtifact, name: string) {
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(validateArtifact(artifact))], {
    type: "application/json",
  });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `${name.replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/gi, "_")}.neuron.json`;
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}

import { tf, embed, makeHead } from "../../lib/ml";
import { toBase64 } from "../../lib/model-format";
import type {
  Project,
  Sample,
  EpochMetric,
  Evaluation,
  ModelArtifact,
} from "../../lib/types";
import { validateLabels } from "../projects/project.service";
export function random(seed: number) {
  return () => {
    seed |= 0;
    seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}
export function splitIndices(labels: number[], seed: number) {
  const rng = random(seed),
    train: number[] = [],
    validation: number[] = [];
  for (const label of [...new Set(labels)]) {
    const indices = labels
      .map((v, i) => (v === label ? i : -1))
      .filter((i) => i !== -1);
    if (indices.length < 5)
      throw new Error("Every class needs at least 5 images.");
    for (let i = indices.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1));
      [indices[i], indices[j]] = [indices[j], indices[i]];
    }
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.floor(indices.length * 0.2));
    validation.push(...indices.slice(0, count));
    train.push(...indices.slice(count));
  }
  return { train, validation };
}
export function evaluate(
  actual: number[],
  predicted: number[],
  classes: number,
): Evaluation {
  if (!actual.length || actual.length !== predicted.length)
    throw new Error("Invalid evaluation data.");
  const matrix = Array.from({ length: classes }, () =>
    Array<number>(classes).fill(0),
  );
  let correct = 0;
  actual.forEach((a, i) => {
    const p = predicted[i];
    if (
      a < 0 ||
      a >= classes ||
      p < 0 ||
      p >= classes ||
      !Number.isInteger(a) ||
      !Number.isInteger(p)
    )
      throw new Error("Invalid prediction index.");
    matrix[a][p]++;
    if (a === p) correct++;
  });
  return { accuracy: correct / actual.length, matrix, total: actual.length };
}
export type TrainingOptions = {
  epochs: number;
  learningRate: number;
  seed: number;
};
export type TrainingProgress = {
  stage: string;
  done: number;
  total: number;
  metrics: EpochMetric[];
};
export async function train(
  project: Project,
  samples: Sample[],
  options: TrainingOptions,
  signal: AbortSignal,
  progress: (p: TrainingProgress) => void,
): Promise<ModelArtifact> {
  validateLabels(project.labels);
  if (
    !Number.isInteger(options.epochs) ||
    options.epochs < 1 ||
    options.epochs > 100 ||
    options.learningRate < 0.00001 ||
    options.learningRate > 0.1 ||
    !Number.isFinite(options.learningRate)
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid training settings.");
  const ids = project.labels.map((l) => l.id);
  const targets = samples.map((s) => ids.indexOf(s.labelId));
  if (targets.some((i) => i < 0))
    throw new Error("Dataset contains an unknown class.");
  const { train: training, validation } = splitIndices(targets, options.seed);
  const check = () => {
    if (signal.aborted)
      throw new DOMException("Training cancelled.", "AbortError");
  };
  const vectors: Float32Array[] = [];
  const metrics: EpochMetric[] = [];
  progress({
    stage: "Downloading / loading image encoder",
    done: 0,
    total: samples.length,
    metrics: [],
  });
  for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
    check();
    vectors.push(await embed(samples[i].blob));
    progress({
      stage: "Extracting image features",
      done: i + 1,
      total: samples.length,
      metrics: [],
    });
    await tf.nextFrame();
  }
  check();
  const makeX = (indices: number[]) =>
    tf.tensor2d(
      indices.map((i) => Array.from(vectors[i])),
      [indices.length, 1280],
    );
  const makeY = (indices: number[]) =>
    tf.tidy(() =>
      tf.oneHot(
        tf.tensor1d(
          indices.map((i) => targets[i]),
          "int32",
        ),
        ids.length,
      ),
    );
  let x: ReturnType<typeof makeX> | undefined,
    y: tf.Tensor | undefined,
    vx: ReturnType<typeof makeX> | undefined,
    vy: tf.Tensor | undefined;
  const head = makeHead(ids.length, options.seed);
  const optimizer = tf.train.adam(options.learningRate);
  try {
    x = makeX(training);
    y = makeY(training);
    vx = makeX(validation);
    vy = makeY(validation);
    head.compile({
      optimizer,
      loss: "categoricalCrossentropy",
      metrics: ["accuracy"],
    });
    await head.fit(x, y, {
      epochs: options.epochs,
      batchSize: Math.min(16, training.length),
      shuffle: true,
      validationData: [vx, vy],
      callbacks: {
        onBatchEnd: async () => {
          if (signal.aborted) head.stopTraining = true;
          await tf.nextFrame();
        },
        onEpochEnd: async (epoch, logs) => {
          const metric: EpochMetric = {
            epoch: epoch + 1,
            loss: Number(logs?.loss ?? 0),
            accuracy: Number(logs?.acc ?? logs?.accuracy ?? 0),
            valLoss: Number(logs?.val_loss ?? 0),
            valAccuracy: Number(logs?.val_acc ?? logs?.val_accuracy ?? 0),
          };
          if (!Object.values(metric).every(Number.isFinite)) {
            head.stopTraining = true;
            throw new Error("Training diverged. Reduce learning rate.");
          }
          metrics.push(metric);
          progress({
            stage: "Training classifier",
            done: epoch + 1,
            total: options.epochs,
            metrics: [...metrics],
          });
        },
      },
    });
    check();
    const predicted = tf.tidy(() =>
      (head.predict(vx!) as tf.Tensor).argMax(-1),
    );
    let indices: number[];
    try {
      indices = Array.from(await predicted.data());
    } finally {
      predicted.dispose();
    }
    const evaluation = evaluate(
      validation.map((i) => targets[i]),
      indices,
      ids.length,
    );
    // getWeights() references model-owned variables. encode before head disposal.
    const weights = head.getWeights();
    const named: tf.NamedTensorMap = {};
    weights.forEach((w, i) => (named[`head_${i}`] = w));
    const encoded = await tf.io.encodeWeights(named);
    check();
    return {
      format: "neuron-image",
      version: 1,
      encoder: "mobilenet-v2-1.0",
      embeddingSize: 1280,
      labels: structuredClone(project.labels),
      weightSpecs: encoded.specs as ModelArtifact["weightSpecs"],
      weightData: toBase64(encoded.data),
      epochs: metrics,
      evaluation,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
    };
  } finally {
    x?.dispose();
    y?.dispose();
    vx?.dispose();
    vy?.dispose();
    head.dispose();
    optimizer.dispose();
  }
}

import { embed, makeHead, tf, initializeRuntime } from "../../lib/ml";
import { fromBase64, validateArtifact } from "../../lib/model-format";
import type { ModelArtifact, Prediction } from "../../lib/types";
export async function predictor(value: ModelArtifact) {
  const artifact = validateArtifact(value);
  await initializeRuntime();
  const head = makeHead(artifact.labels.length, 1);
  try {
    const decoded = tf.io.decodeWeights(
      fromBase64(artifact.weightData),
      artifact.weightSpecs,
    );
    try {
      head.setWeights(artifact.weightSpecs.map((s) => decoded[s.name]));
    } finally {
      Object.values(decoded).forEach((t) => t.dispose());
    }
  } catch (e) {
    head.dispose();
    throw e;
  }
  let disposed = false;
  return {
    async predict(blob: Blob): Promise<Prediction[]> {
      if (disposed) throw new Error("Predictor has been disposed.");
      const vector = await embed(blob);
      if (disposed) throw new Error("Predictor has been disposed.");
      const result = tf.tidy(
        () => head.predict(tf.tensor2d(vector, [1, 1280])) as tf.Tensor,
      );
      try {
        const scores = await result.data();
        return artifact.labels
          .map((l, i) => ({ label: l.name, score: scores[i] }))
          .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
      } finally {
        result.dispose();
      }
    },
    dispose() {
      if (!disposed) {
        disposed = true;
        head.dispose();
      }
    },
  };
}

import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
export function Dialog({
  title,
  children,
  onClose,
}: {
  title: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const dialog = ref.current!;
    dialog.showModal();
    return () => dialog.close();
  }, []);
  return (
    <dialog
      ref={ref}
      className="dialog"
      aria-labelledby="dialog-title"
      onCancel={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div className="section-heading">
        <h2 id="dialog-title">{title}</h2>
        <button
          className="icon-btn"
          aria-label="Close dialog"
          onClick={onClose}
        >
          ×
        </button>
      </div>
      {children}
    </dialog>
  );
}

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { UploadCloud } from "lucide-react";
export function FileDropzone({
  onFiles,
  disabled = false,
  multiple = true,
  accept = "image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp",
  label = "Drop images here, or browse",
}: {
  onFiles: (files: File[]) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  multiple?: boolean;
  accept?: string;
  label?: string;
}) {
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [over, setOver] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div
      className={`dropzone ${over ? "over" : ""}`}
      onDragOver={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!disabled) setOver(true);
      }}
      onDragLeave={() => setOver(false)}
      onDrop={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setOver(false);
        if (!disabled) onFiles(Array.from(e.dataTransfer.files));
      }}
    >
      <UploadCloud size={26} />
      <button
        type="button"
        className="drop-action"
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => input.current?.click()}
      >
        {label}
      </button>
      <small>JPEG, PNG, WebP · 15 MB per image</small>
      <input
        ref={input}
        type="file"
        hidden
        multiple={multiple}
        accept={accept}
        disabled={disabled}
        onChange={(e) => {
          onFiles(Array.from(e.target.files ?? []));
          e.target.value = "";
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState, lazy, Suspense } from "react";
import { AppShell } from "../components/layout/AppShell";
import { HomePage } from "../pages/HomePage";
import { ProjectsPage } from "../pages/ProjectsPage";
import { ProjectPage } from "../pages/ProjectPage";
const TrainingPage = lazy(() =>
  import("../pages/TrainingPage").then((m) => ({ default: m.TrainingPage })),
);
const PredictPage = lazy(() =>
  import("../pages/PredictPage").then((m) => ({ default: m.PredictPage })),
);
import { SettingsPage } from "../pages/SettingsPage";
import { NotFoundPage } from "../pages/NotFoundPage";
function currentRoute() {
  return location.hash.slice(1) || "/";
}
export function App() {
  const [route, setRoute] = useState(currentRoute);
  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => {
      setRoute(currentRoute());
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    };
    window.addEventListener("hashchange", update);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("hashchange", update);
  }, []);
  const match = route.match(/^\/projects\/([^/]+)(?:\/(train|predict))?$/);
  let page;
  if (route === "/") page = <HomePage />;
  else if (route === "/projects") page = <ProjectsPage />;
  else if (route === "/settings") page = <SettingsPage />;
  else if (match) {
    const id = match[1];
    page =
      match[2] === "train" ? (
        <TrainingPage key={route} id={id} />
      ) : match[2] === "predict" ? (
        <PredictPage key={route} id={id} />
      ) : (
        <ProjectPage key={route} id={id} />
      );
  } else page = <NotFoundPage />;
  return (
    <AppShell route={route}>
      <Suspense fallback={<p role="status">Loading image studio…</p>}>
        {page}
      </Suspense>
    </AppShell>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { FolderPlus, ArrowUpRight, Trash2, Image } from "lucide-react";
import { listProjects, deleteProject } from "../lib/db";
import { createProject } from "../features/projects/project.service";
import { type Project, errorMessage } from "../lib/types";
import { Button } from "../components/ui/Button";
import { Dialog } from "../components/ui/Dialog";
export function ProjectsPage() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Project[]>([]),
    [loading, setLoading] = useState(true),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [open, setOpen] = useState(false),
    [name, setName] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const refresh = async () => {
    try {
      setItems(await listProjects());
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
  }, []);
  async function create() {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const project = await createProject(name);
      location.hash = `/projects/${project.id}`;
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  async function remove(p: Project) {
    if (
      !confirm(
        `Permanently delete “${p.name}”, its images and all model versions? This cannot be undone.`,
      )
    )
      return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await deleteProject(p.id);
      await refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <>
      <div className="page-heading">
        <div>
          <div className="eyebrow">YOUR LOCAL WORKSPACE</div>
          <h1>

        <p className="error" role="alert">

        </p>

        <p role="status">Loading projects…</p>

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { ArrowRight, Plus, Trash2, Image as ImageIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { getProject, listSamples, saveProject, deleteLabel } from "../lib/db";
import { type Project, type Sample, uid, errorMessage } from "../lib/types";
import { cleanName } from "../features/projects/project.service";
import { addImages, removeSample } from "../features/datasets/dataset.service";
import { Button } from "../components/ui/Button";
import { FileDropzone } from "../components/ui/FileDropzone";
function Thumbnail({
  sample,
  onRemove,
  disabled,
}: {
  sample: Sample;
  onRemove: () => void;
  disabled: boolean;
}) {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    const u = URL.createObjectURL(sample.blob);
    setUrl(u);
    return () => URL.revokeObjectURL(u);
  }, [sample.blob]);
  return (
    <div className="sample-thumb">
      <img src={url} alt="Training sample" />
      <button aria-label="Remove sample" disabled={disabled} onClick={onRemove}>
        ×
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
export function ProjectPage({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const [project, setProject] = useState<Project | null>(null),
    [samples, setSamples] = useState<Sample[]>([]),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [loading, setLoading] = useState(true),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [status, setStatus] = useState("");
  async function refresh() {
    try {
      const [p, s] = await Promise.all([getProject(id), listSamples(id)]);
      if (!p) throw new Error("Project not found.");
      setProject(p);
      setSamples(s);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
  }, [id]);
  async function mutate(action: () => Promise<unknown>) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await action();
      await refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  async function upload(labelId: string, files: File[]) {
    if (!files.length || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const result = await addImages(id, labelId, files, samples.length, (n) =>
        setStatus(`Saved ${n} of ${files.length} images`),
      );
      setStatus(`Added ${result.saved} images.`);
      if (result.errors.length) setError(result.errors.slice(0, 5).join("\n"));
      await refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  async function rename(labelId: string, current: string) {
    if (!project) return;
    const name = prompt("Class name", current);
    if (name === null) return;
    await mutate(async () => {
      const clean = cleanName(name);
      if (
        project.labels.some(
          (l) =>
            l.id !== labelId && l.name.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase(),
        )
      )
        throw new Error("Class name already exists.");
      await saveProject({
        ...project,
        labels: project.labels.map((l) =>
          l.id === labelId ? { ...l, name: clean } : l,
        ),
        updatedAt: Date.now(),
      });
    });
  }
  if (loading) return <p role="status">Loading your project…</p>;
  if (!project)
    return (
      <p className="error" role="alert">
        {error || "Project not found."}
      </p>
    );
  const ready = project.labels.every(
    (l) => samples.filter((s) => s.labelId === l.id).length >= 5,
  );
  return (
    <>
      <a className="back-link" href="#/projects">
        ← All projects
      </a>
      <div className="page-heading">
        <div>
          <div className="eyebrow">01 / CHOOSE YOUR DATA</div>
          <h1>{project.name}</h1>
          <p>
            Give each class a name, then add diverse examples. At least 5 images
            per class.
          </p>
        </div>
        <a
          className={`btn btn-primary ${!ready || busy ? "disabled" : ""}`}
          aria-disabled={!ready || busy}
          href={ready && !busy ? `#/projects/${id}/train` : undefined}
        >
          Train model <ArrowRight size={17} />
        </a>
      </div>
      <div className="workflow-tabs">
        <span className="current">1. Dataset</span>
        <a href={`#/projects/${id}/train`}>2. Train & evaluate</a>
        <a href={`#/projects/${id}/predict`}>3. Predict & export</a>
      </div>
      <div className="notice">
        <ImageIcon size={18} />
        <span>
          Your images are processed locally. Uploads are resized to at most
          768px and stored in this browser. Existing models keep their original
          class names until retrained.
        </span>
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      {status && (
        <p role="status" className="muted">
          {status}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="dataset-grid">
        {project.labels.map((label, index) => {
          const images = samples.filter((s) => s.labelId === label.id);
          return (
            <section className="panel class-panel" key={label.id}>
              <div className="section-heading">
                <div className="class-heading">
                  <span className="class-number">
                    {String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    className="class-name"
                    title="Rename class"
                    disabled={busy}
                    onClick={() => void rename(label.id, label.name)}
                  >
                    {label.name} <small>edit</small>
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div className="inline">
                  <span className="count-pill">{images.length}</span>
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    disabled={busy || project.labels.length <= 2}
                    aria-label={`Delete ${label.name}`}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (confirm(`Delete ${label.name} and its samples?`))
                        void mutate(() => deleteLabel(project, label.id));
                    }}
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={15} />
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <FileDropzone
                disabled={busy}
                onFiles={(files) => void upload(label.id, files)}
              />
              <div className="sample-grid">
                {images.slice(0, 120).map((s) => (
                  <Thumbnail
                    key={s.id}
                    sample={s}
                    disabled={busy}
                    onRemove={() => void mutate(() => removeSample(s.id))}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
              {images.length > 120 && (
                <small>Showing the first 120 of {images.length} images.</small>
              )}
              <p
                className={`sample-status ${images.length >= 5 ? "ready" : ""}`}
              >
                {images.length >= 5
                  ? "✓ Ready to train"
                  : `${5 - images.length} more images needed`}
              </p>
            </section>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <Button
        variant="secondary"
        disabled={busy || project.labels.length >= 20}
        onClick={() =>
          void mutate(async () => {
            const name = prompt("New class name");
            if (name === null) return;
            const clean = cleanName(name);
            if (
              project.labels.some(
                (l) => l.name.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase(),
              )
            )
              throw new Error("Class name already exists.");
            await saveProject({
              ...project,
              labels: [...project.labels, { id: uid(), name: clean }],
              updatedAt: Date.now(),
            });
          })
        }
      >
        <Plus size={16} /> Add class
      </Button>
      <p className="phase-note">
        {samples.length} / 1,000 images · Diverse backgrounds and lighting
        improve your model. Avoid duplicate frames: they can inflate validation
        scores.
      </p>
    </>
  );
}
