import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ArrowRight, Play, Square, Activity } from "lucide-react";
import { getProject, listSamples, commitVersion } from "../lib/db";
import {
  train,
  type TrainingProgress,
} from "../features/training/training.service";
import { backendName } from "../lib/ml";
import {
  type Project,
  type Sample,
  type ModelArtifact,
  errorMessage,
  uid,
} from "../lib/types";
import { Button } from "../components/ui/Button";
export function TrainingPage({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const [project, setProject] = useState<Project | null>(null),
    [samples, setSamples] = useState<Sample[]>([]),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [epochs, setEpochs] = useState(20),
    [rate, setRate] = useState(0.001),
    [running, setRunning] = useState(false),
    [progress, setProgress] = useState<TrainingProgress | null>(null),
    [result, setResult] = useState<ModelArtifact | null>(null);
  const controller = useRef<AbortController | null>(null),
    alive = useRef(true),
    lock = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    Promise.all([getProject(id), listSamples(id)])
      .then(([p, s]) => {
        if (alive.current) {
          if (!p) setError("Project not found.");
          setProject(p ?? null);
          setSamples(s);
        }
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (alive.current) setError(errorMessage(e));
      });
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      controller.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [id]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const warn = (e: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
      if (lock.current) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.returnValue = "";
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("beforeunload", warn);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", warn);
  }, []);
  async function start() {
    if (!project || lock.current) return;
    lock.current = true;
    setRunning(true);
    setError("");
    setResult(null);
    const c = new AbortController();
    controller.current = c;
    try {
      const artifact = await train(
        project,
        samples,
        { epochs, learningRate: rate, seed: 42 },
        c.signal,
        (p) => {
          if (alive.current) setProgress(p);
        },
      );
      if (c.signal.aborted) return;
      await commitVersion({
        id: uid(),
        projectId: id,
        artifact,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
      });
      if (alive.current) setResult(artifact);
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current)
        setError(
          e instanceof DOMException && e.name === "AbortError"
            ? "Training cancelled. The previous saved model is unchanged."
            : errorMessage(e),
        );
    } finally {
      lock.current = false;
      if (alive.current) setRunning(false);
      controller.current = null;
    }
  }
  const last = progress?.metrics.at(-1);
  const ready =
    project &&
    project.labels.every(
      (l) => samples.filter((s) => s.labelId === l.id).length >= 5,
    );
  return (
    <>
      <a className="back-link" href={`#/projects/${id}`}>
        ← Dataset
      </a>
      <div className="page-heading">
        <div>
          <div className="eyebrow">02 / TRAIN ON YOUR DEVICE</div>
          <h1>Let your model learn.</h1>
          <p>Real image features. Real weight updates. No cloud training.</p>
        </div>
        <span className="tag">{project?.name ?? "IMAGE STUDIO"}</span>
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="training-layout">
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>Training settings</h2>
          <p className="muted">
            MobileNet v2 extracts image features; a local classifier learns your
            classes.
          </p>
          <label className="field">
            Epochs
            <input
              type="number"
              min="1"
              max="100"
              step="1"
              value={epochs}
              disabled={running}
              onChange={(e) => setEpochs(Number(e.target.value))}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="field">
            Learning rate
            <select
              value={rate}
              disabled={running}
              onChange={(e) => setRate(Number(e.target.value))}
            >
              <option value="0.0001">0.0001 — careful</option>
              <option value="0.001">0.001 — recommended</option>
              <option value="0.01">0.01 — aggressive</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <dl className="summary-list">
            <div>
              <dt>Dataset</dt>
              <dd>{samples.length} images</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Classes</dt>
              <dd>{project?.labels.length ?? 0}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Validation split</dt>
              <dd>20% per class</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Split seed</dt>
              <dd>42</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
          {running ? (
            <Button
              variant="danger"
              onClick={() => controller.current?.abort()}
            >
              <Square size={15} /> Cancel training
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <Button disabled={!ready} onClick={() => void start()}>
              <Play size={16} /> Train model
            </Button>
          )}
          {!ready && (
            <p className="muted">
              Add at least 5 images to each class to begin.
            </p>
          )}
          <p className="phase-note">
            First run downloads encoder weights. Keep this page open; leaving
            cancels the job. CPU fallback can be slow.
          </p>
        </section>
        <section className="panel training-monitor">
          <div className="section-heading">
            <h2>
              <Activity size={19} /> Training monitor
            </h2>
            <span className="tag">
              {running ? "RUNNING" : result ? "SAVED" : "READY"}
            </span>
          </div>
          {progress ? (
            <>
              <p role="status">
                {progress.stage} · {progress.done}/{progress.total}
              </p>
              <progress
                className="progress"
                value={progress.done}
                max={progress.total}
              />
              <div className="metric-grid">
                <div>
                  <small>Training accuracy</small>
                  <strong>
                    {last ? `${(last.accuracy * 100).toFixed(1)}%` : "—"}
                  </strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <small>Validation accuracy</small>
                  <strong>
                    {last ? `${(last.valAccuracy * 100).toFixed(1)}%` : "—"}
                  </strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <small>Training loss</small>
                  <strong>{last?.loss.toFixed(4) ?? "—"}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <small>Runtime</small>
                  <strong>{backendName()}</strong>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div
                className="chart"
                aria-label="Epoch training and validation accuracy chart"
              >
                {progress.metrics.map((m) => (
                  <div
                    className="chart-pair"
                    key={m.epoch}
                    title={`Epoch ${m.epoch}: training ${(m.accuracy * 100).toFixed(1)}%, validation ${(m.valAccuracy * 100).toFixed(1)}%`}
                  >
                    <span
                      style={{ height: `${Math.max(1, m.accuracy * 100)}%` }}
                    />
                    <span
                      style={{ height: `${Math.max(1, m.valAccuracy * 100)}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <p className="chart-legend">
                <span>● Training</span>
                <span>● Validation</span>
              </p>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div className="empty-monitor">
              <Activity size={40} />
              <h3>Your training journey starts here</h3>
              <p>
                Live progress and actual epoch metrics will appear when training
                begins.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
          {result && (
            <div className="success">
              <h3>Model trained and saved</h3>
              <p>
                Held-out validation:{" "}
                {(result.evaluation.accuracy * 100).toFixed(1)}% on{" "}
                {result.evaluation.total} images.
              </p>
              <a className="btn btn-primary" href={`#/projects/${id}/predict`}>
                Try your model <ArrowRight size={16} />
              </a>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
      {result && (
        <section className="panel evaluation">
          <h2>Validation confusion matrix</h2>
          <p className="muted">
            Rows: actual class. Columns: predicted class. This is validation
            performance, not a separate test set.
          </p>
          <div className="table-scroll">
            <table>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th scope="col">Actual / predicted</th>
                  {result.labels.map((l) => (
                    <th scope="col" key={l.id}>
                      {l.name}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {result.evaluation.matrix.map((row, i) => (
                  <tr key={result.labels[i].id}>
                    <th scope="row">{result.labels[i].name}</th>
                    {row.map((n, j) => (
                      <td className={i === j ? "diagonal" : ""} key={j}>
                        {n}
                      </td>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Camera, Download, Image, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { getProject, listVersions, saveProject } from "../lib/db";
import {
  type Project,
  type ModelVersion,
  type Prediction,
  errorMessage,
} from "../lib/types";
import { predictor } from "../features/inference/inference.service";
import { normalizeImage } from "../features/datasets/dataset.service";
import { exportModel } from "../lib/model-format";
import { Button } from "../components/ui/Button";
import { FileDropzone } from "../components/ui/FileDropzone";
export function PredictPage({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const [project, setProject] = useState<Project | null>(null),
    [versions, setVersions] = useState<ModelVersion[]>([]),
    [selected, setSelected] = useState(""),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [ready, setReady] = useState(false),
    [results, setResults] = useState<Prediction[]>([]),
    [preview, setPreview] = useState(""),
    [camera, setCamera] = useState(false),
    [latency, setLatency] = useState(0);
  const engine = useRef<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof predictor>> | null>(null),
    stream = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null),
    video = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null),
    alive = useRef(true),
    inFlight = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    Promise.all([getProject(id), listVersions(id)])
      .then(([p, v]) => {
        if (!alive.current) return;
        setProject(p ?? null);
        setVersions(v);
        setSelected(p?.activeVersionId ?? v[0]?.id ?? "");
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (alive.current) setError(errorMessage(e));
      });
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      stream.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
    };
  }, [id]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!camera || !video.current || !stream.current) return;
    video.current.srcObject = stream.current;
    void video.current.play().catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)));
  }, [camera]);
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setReady(false);
    setResults([]);
    const version = versions.find((v) => v.id === selected);
    if (!version) return;
    predictor(version.artifact)
      .then((p) => {
        if (cancelled) p.dispose();
        else {
          engine.current = p;
          setReady(true);
        }
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (!cancelled) setError(errorMessage(e));
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      engine.current?.dispose();
      engine.current = null;
    };
  }, [selected, versions]);
  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      if (preview) URL.revokeObjectURL(preview);
    },
    [preview],
  );
  async function predict(blob: Blob) {
    if (!engine.current || inFlight.current) return;
    inFlight.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    const start = performance.now();
    try {
      const result = await engine.current.predict(blob);
      if (alive.current) {
        setResults(result);
        setLatency(performance.now() - start);
        setPreview(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current) setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      inFlight.current = false;
      if (alive.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  async function fromFile(files: File[]) {
    if (!files[0] || inFlight.current) return;
    setError("");
    try {
      await predict(await normalizeImage(files[0]));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    }
  }
  async function startCamera() {
    try {
      if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia)
        throw new Error(
          "Camera requires HTTPS or localhost and browser camera support.",
        );
      const s = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { width: 640, height: 480 },
        audio: false,
      });
      if (!alive.current) {
        s.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
        return;
      }
      stream.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      stream.current = s;
      setCamera(true);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    }
  }
  function stopCamera() {
    stream.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
    stream.current = null;
    setCamera(false);
  }
  async function capture() {
    const v = video.current;
    if (!v || !v.videoWidth || busy) return;
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = v.videoWidth;
    canvas.height = v.videoHeight;
    canvas.getContext("2d")!.drawImage(v, 0, 0);
    const blob = await new Promise<Blob | null>((resolve) =>
      canvas.toBlob(resolve, "image/jpeg", 0.9),
    );
    if (blob) await predict(blob);
  }
  const version = versions.find((v) => v.id === selected);
  return (
    <>
      <a className="back-link" href={`#/projects/${id}`}>
        ← Dataset
      </a>
      <div className="page-heading">
        <div>
          <div className="eyebrow">03 / ACTIVATE YOUR IDEA</div>
          <h1>Meet your model.</h1>
          <p>
            Test a new image or a camera frame. Predictions run on this device.
          </p>
        </div>
        {version && (
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={() => {
              try {
                exportModel(version.artifact, project?.name ?? "model");
              } catch (e) {
                setError(errorMessage(e));
              }
            }}
          >
            <Download size={16} /> Export model
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      {!versions.length ? (
        <div className="empty-state">
          <Image size={40} />
          <h2>No saved model yet</h2>
          <p>
            Train your dataset first, or import a supported model in Settings.
          </p>
          <a className="btn btn-primary" href={`#/projects/${id}/train`}>
            Go to training
          </a>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <section className="panel version-bar">
            <label className="field">
              Model version
              <select
                disabled={busy}
                value={selected}
                onChange={(e) => setSelected(e.target.value)}
              >
                {versions.map((v, i) => (
                  <option value={v.id} key={v.id}>
                    Version {versions.length - i} ·{" "}
                    {new Date(v.createdAt).toLocaleString()} ·{" "}
                    {(v.artifact.evaluation.accuracy * 100).toFixed(1)}%
                    validation
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              disabled={
                busy || !project || selected === project.activeVersionId
              }
              onClick={() => {
                if (!project) return;
                void saveProject({
                  ...project,
                  activeVersionId: selected,
                  updatedAt: Date.now(),
                })
                  .then(() =>
                    setProject({ ...project, activeVersionId: selected }),
                  )
                  .catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)));
              }}
            >
              Make active
            </Button>
          </section>
          <div className="prediction-layout">
            <section className="panel">
              <h2>Give it something new</h2>
              <FileDropzone
                multiple={false}
                disabled={!ready || busy}
                onFiles={(files) => void fromFile(files)}
              />
              <div className="camera-actions">
                {camera ? (
                  <>
                    <Button
                      variant="secondary"
                      disabled={busy || !ready}
                      onClick={() => void capture()}
                    >
                      <Camera size={16} /> Predict this frame
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="ghost" onClick={stopCamera}>
                      Stop camera
                    </Button>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    onClick={() => void startCamera()}
                  >
                    <Camera size={16} /> Use camera
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
              {camera && (
                <video
                  className="camera-video"
                  ref={video}
                  autoPlay
                  muted
                  playsInline
                  aria-label="Camera preview"
                />
              )}
              {preview && !camera && (
                <img
                  className="prediction-image"
                  src={preview}
                  alt="Image being classified"
                />
              )}
            </section>
            <section className="panel">
              <div className="section-heading">
                <h2>Predictions</h2>
                <span className="tag">
                  {busy ? "PROCESSING" : ready ? "LOCAL INFERENCE" : "LOADING"}
                </span>
              </div>
              {results.length ? (
                <>
                  <div className="prediction-winner">
                    {results[0].label}
                    <strong>{(results[0].score * 100).toFixed(1)}%</strong>
                  </div>
                  {results.map((r) => (
                    <div className="prediction-row" key={r.label}>
                      <div>
                        <span>{r.label}</span>
                        <strong>{(r.score * 100).toFixed(1)}%</strong>
                      </div>
                      <progress value={r.score} max={1} />
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  <p className="phase-note">
                    {Math.round(latency)} ms including feature extraction.
                    Scores are relative softmax outputs, not calibrated
                    probabilities or proof of correctness.
                  </p>
                </>
              ) : (
                <div className="empty-monitor">
                  <RefreshCw size={34} />
                  <p>
                    {ready
                      ? "Add an unseen image to see actual predictions."
                      : "Loading the saved classifier…"}
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="notice">
                No image is uploaded. The first prediction needs the encoder
                download. Camera frames are processed only when you choose
                “Predict this frame”.
              </div>
            </section>
          </div>

===== BEGIN FILE 34/40: apps/web/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx =====
SHA256: 5438c3f4b6e7ee4e562b8f55f2a83fc47a2cd15eed49e3568d4e67a952c4fb26
----- CONTENT START -----
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ShieldCheck, Upload, HardDrive } from "lucide-react";
import { storageInfo, bytes, capabilities } from "../lib/capabilities";
import { listProjects, importVersion } from "../lib/db";
import { readModel } from "../lib/model-format";
import { type Project, errorMessage, uid } from "../lib/types";
import { Button } from "../components/ui/Button";
export function SettingsPage() {
  const [storage, setStorage] = useState<Awaited<
      ReturnType<typeof storageInfo>
    > | null>(null),
    [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]),
    [selected, setSelected] = useState(""),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [message, setMessage] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const support = capabilities();
  useEffect(() => {
    storageInfo()
      .then(setStorage)
      .catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)));
    listProjects()
      .then((p) => {
        setProjects(p);
        setSelected(p[0]?.id ?? "");
      })
      .catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)));
  }, []);
  async function importFile(file: File) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
    try {
      const artifact = await readModel(file);
      const p = projects.find((p) => p.id === selected);
      if (!p) throw new Error("Create and select a project first.");
      if (
        !confirm(
          `Import this model into “${p.name}”? Its class vocabulary will be replaced and all its existing training images deleted. Existing saved model versions remain available. Export does not restore images.`,
        )
      )
        return;
      await importVersion(p, {
        id: uid(),
        projectId: p.id,
        artifact,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
      });
      setMessage("Model imported. Open this project’s Predict page to use it.");
      setProjects(await listProjects());
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <>
      <div className="page-heading">
        <div>
          <div className="eyebrow">YOUR WORKSPACE, YOUR RULES</div>
          <h1>Privacy & storage</h1>
          <p>Understand what stays here—and what needs a backup.</p>
        </div>
        <ShieldCheck className="accent-icon" size={36} />
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      {message && (
        <p className="success" role="status">
          {message}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="settings-grid">
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>
            <HardDrive size={20} /> Browser storage
          </h2>
          <div className="storage-number">
            {storage ? bytes(storage.usage) : "…"}
            <small> used by this origin</small>
          </div>
          <p className="muted">
            Estimated quota: {storage ? bytes(storage.quota) : "…"}. Browser
            estimates can change.
          </p>
          <p>
            Persistence:{" "}
            <strong>
              {storage?.persistent ? "Granted" : "Not guaranteed"}
            </strong>
          </p>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={() =>
              void (async () => {
                try {
                  const granted = await navigator.storage?.persist?.();
                  setMessage(
                    granted
                      ? "Persistent storage granted. Still keep backups."
                      : "Your browser did not grant persistence. Export important models.",
                  );
                  setStorage(await storageInfo());
                } catch (e) {
                  setError(errorMessage(e));
                }
              })()
            }
          >
            Request persistent storage
          </Button>
          <p className="phase-note">
            Clearing browser/site data deletes projects. Model exports do not
            include training images. Dataset backup is not implemented in Phase
            1.
          </p>
        </section>
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>
            <Upload size={20} /> Import a model
          </h2>
          <p className="muted">
            Only validated NEURON image models exported by this phase. Maximum 8
            MB. Arbitrary TensorFlow graphs or scripts are not accepted.
          </p>
          <label className="field">
            Target project
            <select
              value={selected}
              disabled={busy}
              onChange={(e) => setSelected(e.target.value)}
            >
              {projects.map((p) => (
                <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                  {p.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <input
            ref={input}
            hidden
            type="file"
            accept=".json,application/json"
            onChange={(e) => {
              const file = e.target.files?.[0];
              e.target.value = "";
              if (file) void importFile(file);
            }}
          />
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            disabled={busy || !selected}
            onClick={() => input.current?.click()}
          >
            <Upload size={16} />
            {busy ? "Importing…" : "Choose model file"}
          </Button>
          {!projects.length && (
            <p>
              <a href="#/projects">Create a project first →</a>
            </p>
          )}
        </section>
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>Device capabilities</h2>
          <dl className="summary-list">
            <div>
              <dt>IndexedDB</dt>
              <dd>{support.storage ? "Available" : "Unavailable"}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Camera API</dt>
              <dd>{support.camera ? "Available" : "Unavailable"}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Secure context</dt>
              <dd>{support.secure ? "Yes" : "No"}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>WebGPU API</dt>
              <dd>{support.webgpu ? "Detected (not used)" : "Not detected"}</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
          <p className="phase-note">
            This phase trains with WebGL or CPU—not WebGPU. Detection is not a
            certification of training performance.
          </p>
        </section>
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>The local-first promise</h2>
          <ul className="privacy-list">
            <li>No account or application backend for this workflow.</li>
            <li>No analytics or sample uploads.</li>
            <li>
              Encoder weights download from Google-hosted model endpoints.
            </li>
            <li>Exporting a model is an explicit user action.</li>
            <li>Private mode or storage eviction can remove local data.</li>
            <li>Offline reload and online share links are later phases.</li>
          </ul>
        </section>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import {
  splitIndices,
  evaluate,
  random,
} from "../features/training/training.service";
import {
  cleanName,
  validateLabels,
} from "../features/projects/project.service";
describe("stratified split", () => {
  it("is deterministic, disjoint and preserves every class", () => {
    const y = [...Array(10).fill(0), ...Array(15).fill(1)];
    const a = splitIndices(y, 42);
    expect(a).toEqual(splitIndices(y, 42));
    expect(a.validation).toHaveLength(5);
    expect(new Set([...a.train, ...a.validation]).size).toBe(25);
    expect(a.train.some((i) => a.validation.includes(i))).toBe(false);
    expect(new Set(a.validation.map((i) => y[i])).size).toBe(2);
  });
  it("rejects undersized classes", () =>
    expect(() => splitIndices([0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1], 42)).toThrow(
      "at least 5",
    ));
  it("creates repeatable random numbers", () => {
    const a = random(7),
      b = random(7);
    expect([a(), a(), a()]).toEqual([b(), b(), b()]);
  });
});
describe("evaluation", () => {
  it("computes actual confusion counts", () =>
    expect(evaluate([0, 0, 1, 1], [0, 1, 1, 1], 2)).toEqual({
      accuracy: 0.75,
      total: 4,
      matrix: [
        [1, 1],
        [0, 2],
      ],
    }));
  it("rejects invalid labels", () =>
    expect(() => evaluate([0], [2], 2)).toThrow());
  it("rejects empty data", () => expect(() => evaluate([], [], 2)).toThrow());
});
describe("project validation", () => {
  it("trims names", () => expect(cleanName("  Plants ")).toBe("Plants"));
  it("rejects whitespace", () => expect(() => cleanName(" ")).toThrow());
  it("rejects duplicate classes", () =>
    expect(() =>
      validateLabels([
        { id: "1", name: "Cat" },
        { id: "2", name: "cat" },
      ]),
    ).toThrow("unique"));
});

      { name: "head_1", shape: [2], dtype: "float32" },
    ],
    weightData: toBase64(new Float32Array(2562).buffer),
    epochs: [],
    evaluation: {
      accuracy: 1,
      total: 2,
      matrix: [
        [1, 0],
        [0, 1],
      ],
    },
    createdAt: 1,
  };
}
describe("model boundary", () => {
  it("round trips binary data", () => {
    const data = new Float32Array([0.1, -0.9, 42]);
    expect(new Float32Array(fromBase64(toBase64(data.buffer)))).toEqual(data);
  });
  it("accepts valid bounded artifacts and returns an isolated clone", () => {
    const a = fixture();
    const b = validateArtifact(a);
    expect(b).toEqual(a);
    expect(b).not.toBe(a);
  });
  it("rejects unknown formats", () =>
    expect(() =>
      validateArtifact({ ...fixture(), format: "javascript" }),
    ).toThrow());
  it("rejects mismatched tensor dimensions", () => {
    const a = fixture();
    a.weightSpecs[0].shape = [2, 1280];
    expect(() => validateArtifact(a)).toThrow();
  });
  it("rejects truncated weights", () => {
    const a = fixture();
    a.weightData = "AAAA";
    expect(() => validateArtifact(a)).toThrow();
  });
  it("rejects nonfinite weights", () => {
    const a = fixture();
    const w = new Float32Array(2562);
    w[0] = NaN;
    a.weightData = toBase64(w.buffer);
    expect(() => validateArtifact(a)).toThrow();
  });
  it("rejects executable/arbitrary tensor names", () => {
    const a = fixture();
    a.weightSpecs[0].name = "__proto__";
    expect(() => validateArtifact(a)).toThrow();
  });
  it("rejects inconsistent validation reports", () => {
    const a = fixture();
    a.evaluation.accuracy = 0;
    expect(() => validateArtifact(a)).toThrow();
  });
  it("rejects duplicate class names", () => {
    const a = fixture();
    a.labels[1].name = "cats";
    expect(() => validateArtifact(a)).toThrow();
  });
});

PHASE 2 WORKING FEATURES
------------------------
1. Production offline app shell
   - Build-generated service worker precaches JS/CSS including lazy routes.
   - Revision includes worker template, public shell resources and emitted assets.
   - A failed new cache installation does not replace the active shell cache.
   - Waiting updates do not force skipWaiting. Explicit update UI uses Web Locks
     to coordinate active training/download/backup tasks across same-origin tabs.
   - Retained prior shell chunks can serve already-open older tabs. Old shell caches
     are not automatically purged yet; this favors compatibility over disk cleanup.
2. Persistent encoder pack
   - Exact 5-file MobileNet V2 pack: JSON plus four weight shards, about 14 MB.
   - SHA-256 and byte-size pins were obtained from actual downloaded assets.
   - Streamed bounded downloads, cancel, staging cache, one-pointer commit.
   - Each cached artifact is integrity-checked before use. No unverified fallback.
   - TensorFlow.js IOHandler loads directly from verified Cache Storage, so cold-page
     offline training/inference does not depend on remote model endpoints.
3. Full project backup and restore
   - Includes normalized JPEG samples, classes, all model versions, active selection
     and pending feedback; model-only export remains separate.
   - Explicit consent before exporting unencrypted image-containing backups.
   - Bounded JSON (no ZIP decompression), schema/shape checks, image SHA checks,
     JPEG decoding and 768px dimension limits before atomic database writes.
   - Always creates a new project, remapping record/model IDs. Never overwrites an
     existing project. Failed parsing/validation leaves existing projects intact.
4. Reviewed evolution
   - Explicit consent saves the prediction image and corrected class into a local
     queue. Review before approving. No silent dataset collection or retraining.
   - Approval moves the item into the dataset; discard deletes only the queue item.
   - Retrain manually, compare saved versions, then activate or roll back a model.
   - Byte-level duplicate detection prevents the same normalized image being added
     twice to a project, even with different labels. It is not semantic detection.
5. Honest comparison
   - Training artifacts now record dataset and actual validation-set fingerprints.
   - Comparison warns when held-out image sets/classes differ or metadata is absent.
   - Phase 1 models remain accepted; their comparison provenance is simply unknown.
6. Additive DB migration, focused tests, and matching responsive dark UI.

BOUNDARIES AND LIMITS — DO NOT HIDE THESE FROM THE USER
-------------------------------------------------------
This phase is real code, but the entire planned multi-modality product is NOT done.
No encrypted online sharing, WebRTC, non-image training, worker-isolated training,
continuous camera streaming, independent test-set UI, resumable training or universal
hardware guarantee yet. Training still uses asynchronous main-thread TFJS work.
WebGL is preferred with CPU fallback; WebGPU is not a claimed training backend.

Browser storage/caches can be cleared/evicted. Persistent-storage requests do not
replace backups. Cache corruption is detected; user can remove/reinstall the pack.
If the upstream model changes, pins intentionally fail closed; investigate and review
license/provenance before intentionally updating them. Do not disable hash checks.
Encoder-source requests expose connection metadata; your images are not uploaded.

Backups contain sensitive image data and are NOT ENCRYPTED. Limits: 1,000 samples,
100 queued feedback items, 50 model versions, 32 MB image data / 64 MB total JSON.
A model-only export is not a dataset backup. Both models and labels can leak info.
Validation performance is not independent test performance, and scores are not
calibrated probabilities. Fingerprints do not remove model-selection bias or detect
near-duplicate frames. Staged downloads are cancellable, not resumable across reloads.

Updates without Web Locks: close ALL NEURON tabs and reopen to activate the waiting
worker safely. Guarded tasks include training, encoder downloads and backup work;
this is not a general database lock against every simultaneous manual tab edit.
Finish edits before applying updates. Do not promise unlimited concurrent editing.

Deployment assumes origin root /. Use HTTPS except localhost. Configure real host
security headers and correct JS MIME types. The Phase 1 public/_headers file applies
only on hosts that support it; hosting infrastructure remains an explicit later task.
OS/browser PWA installability varies; a manifest with an SVG icon is not an install
certification for every phone. Physical-device, accessibility, security, operational
and model-license reviews remain release gates, not tests this bundle invents.

import { defineConfig, transformWithEsbuild, type Plugin } from "vite";
import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
function offlineShell(): Plugin {
  return {
    name: "neuron-offline-shell",
    apply: "build",
    enforce: "post",
    async generateBundle(_, bundle) {
      const paths = [
        "/offline.html",
        "/favicon.svg",
        "/manifest.webmanifest",
        ...Object.keys(bundle)
          .filter((p) => !p.endsWith(".map"))
          .map((p) => "/" + p),
      ].sort();
      const workerTemplate = readFileSync(
        new URL("./src/pwa/service-worker.ts", import.meta.url),
        "utf8",
      );
      const publicRevision = [
        "offline.html",
        "favicon.svg",
        "manifest.webmanifest",
      ]
        .map((name) =>
          readFileSync(new URL("./public/" + name, import.meta.url), "utf8"),
        )
        .join("\n");
      const revision = createHash("sha256")
        .update(workerTemplate)
        .update(publicRevision)
        .update(paths.join("\n"))
        .update(
          String(
            bundle["index.html"]?.type === "asset"
              ? bundle["index.html"].source
              : "",
          ),
        )
        .digest("hex")
        .slice(0, 16);
      const source = readFileSync(
        new URL("./src/pwa/service-worker.ts", import.meta.url),
        "utf8",
      )
        .replace("__NEURON_PRECACHE__", JSON.stringify(paths))
        .replace("__NEURON_REVISION__", revision);
      const compiled = await transformWithEsbuild(source, "service-worker.ts", {
        loader: "ts",
        target: "es2022",
        minify: true,
      });
      this.emitFile({
        type: "asset",
        fileName: "service-worker.js",
        source: compiled.code,
      });
    },
  };
}
export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react(), offlineShell()],
  server: { host: "0.0.0.0", allowedHosts: [".e2b.app", "localhost"] },
  preview: { host: "0.0.0.0", allowedHosts: [".e2b.app", "localhost"] },
  build: {
    target: "es2022",
    rollupOptions: {
      output: {
        manualChunks(id) {
          if (id.includes("@tensorflow")) return "tensorflow";
        },
      },
    },
  },
});

export interface NeuronDB extends DBSchema {

  samples: { key: string; value: Sample; indexes: { "by-project": string } };

    indexes: { "by-project": string };
  };
  feedback: {
    key: string;
    value: FeedbackItem;
    indexes: { "by-project": string };
  };
}
let connection: ReturnType<typeof openDB<NeuronDB>> | undefined;
export function database() {
  if (!("indexedDB" in globalThis))
    throw new Error("IndexedDB unavailable. Use a normal browser window.");
  return (connection ??= openDB<NeuronDB>("neuron-local", 2, {
    upgrade(db, oldVersion) {
      if (oldVersion < 1) {
        db.createObjectStore("projects", { keyPath: "id" });
        db.createObjectStore("samples", { keyPath: "id" }).createIndex(
          "by-project",
          "projectId",
        );
        db.createObjectStore("versions", { keyPath: "id" }).createIndex(
          "by-project",
          "projectId",
        );
      }
      if (oldVersion < 2)
        db.createObjectStore("feedback", { keyPath: "id" }).createIndex(
          "by-project",
          "projectId",
        );
    },
    blocking() {
      connection?.then((db) => db.close());
      connection = undefined;
    },
    terminated() {
      connection = undefined;
    },
  }));
}
export async function closeDatabase() {
  const db = await connection;
  db?.close();
  connection = undefined;
}
export async function saveProject(project: Project) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = trackTransaction(db.transaction("projects", "readwrite"));
  const previous = await tx.store.get(project.id);
  // Creation uses a fresh UUID. Existing callers may edit metadata, but cannot inject raw samples.
  await tx.store.put({
    ...project,
    updatedAt: Math.max(project.updatedAt, previous?.updatedAt ?? 0),
  });
  await tx.done;
}
export async function listProjects() {
  return (await (await database()).getAll("projects")).sort(
    (a, b) => b.updatedAt - a.updatedAt,
  );
}
export async function getProject(id: string) {
  return (await database()).get("projects", id);
}
export async function listSamples(id: string) {
  return (await database()).getAllFromIndex("samples", "by-project", id);
}
export async function listVersions(id: string) {
  return (
    await (await database()).getAllFromIndex("versions", "by-project", id)
  ).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
}
export async function deleteProject(id: string) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = trackTransaction(
    db.transaction(
      ["projects", "samples", "versions", "feedback"],
      "readwrite",
    ),
  );
  await tx.objectStore("projects").delete(id);
  for (const name of ["samples", "versions", "feedback"] as const)
    for (const key of await tx
      .objectStore(name)
      .index("by-project")
      .getAllKeys(id))
      await tx.objectStore(name).delete(key);
  await tx.done;
}
export async function commitVersion(version: ModelVersion) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = trackTransaction(
    db.transaction(["projects", "versions"], "readwrite"),
  );
  const project = await tx.objectStore("projects").get(version.projectId);
  if (!project) {
    tx.abort();
    await tx.done.catch(() => {});
    throw new Error("Project no longer exists.");
  }
  await tx.objectStore("versions").add(version);
  await tx
    .objectStore("projects")
    .put({ ...project, activeVersionId: version.id, updatedAt: Date.now() });
  await tx.done;
}
export async function activateVersion(projectId: string, versionId: string) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = trackTransaction(
    db.transaction(["projects", "versions"], "readwrite"),
  );
  const p = await tx.objectStore("projects").get(projectId),
    v = await tx.objectStore("versions").get(versionId);
  if (!p || !v || v.projectId !== projectId) {
    tx.abort();
    await tx.done.catch(() => {});
    throw new Error("Model version not found.");
  }
  await tx
    .objectStore("projects")
    .put({ ...p, activeVersionId: versionId, updatedAt: Date.now() });
  await tx.done;
}
export async function deleteLabel(project: Project, labelId: string) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = trackTransaction(
    db.transaction(["projects", "samples", "feedback"], "readwrite"),
  );
  const current = await tx.objectStore("projects").get(project.id);
  if (!current || current.labels.length <= 2) {
    tx.abort();
    await tx.done.catch(() => {});
    throw new Error("At least two classes are required.");
  }
  for (const store of ["samples", "feedback"] as const)
    for (const s of await tx
      .objectStore(store)
      .index("by-project")
      .getAll(project.id))
      if (s.labelId === labelId) await tx.objectStore(store).delete(s.id);
  await tx
    .objectStore("projects")
    .put({
      ...current,
      labels: current.labels.filter((l) => l.id !== labelId),
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    });
  await tx.done;
}
export async function importVersion(project: Project, version: ModelVersion) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = trackTransaction(
    db.transaction(
      ["projects", "samples", "versions", "feedback"],
      "readwrite",
    ),
  );
  const current = await tx.objectStore("projects").get(project.id);
  if (!current) {
    tx.abort();
    await tx.done.catch(() => {});
    throw new Error("Project no longer exists.");
  }
  for (const store of ["samples", "feedback"] as const)
    for (const key of await tx
      .objectStore(store)
      .index("by-project")
      .getAllKeys(project.id))
      await tx.objectStore(store).delete(key);
  await tx.objectStore("versions").add(version);
  await tx
    .objectStore("projects")
    .put({
      ...current,
      labels: version.artifact.labels,
      activeVersionId: version.id,
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
    });
  await tx.done;
}
export async function snapshotProject(id: string) {
  const db = await database();
  const tx = trackTransaction(
    db.transaction(["projects", "samples", "versions", "feedback"], "readonly"),
  );
  const [project, samples, versions, feedback] = await Promise.all([
    tx.objectStore("projects").get(id),
    tx.objectStore("samples").index("by-project").getAll(id),
    tx.objectStore("versions").index("by-project").getAll(id),
    tx.objectStore("feedback").index("by-project").getAll(id),
  ]);
  await tx.done;
  if (!project) throw new Error("Project not found.");
  return { project, samples, versions, feedback };
}

export function trackTransaction<T extends { done: Promise<unknown> }>(
  tx: T,
): T {
  void tx.done.catch(() => {});
  return tx;
}

export async function sha256(value: Blob | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array | string) {
  const data =
    typeof value === "string"
      ? new TextEncoder().encode(value)
      : value instanceof Blob
        ? await value.arrayBuffer()
        : value;
  const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data as BufferSource);
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hash), (b) =>
    b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"),
  ).join("");
}
export function validHash(value: unknown): value is string {
  return typeof value === "string" && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(value);
}

let jobs = 0;
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
function notify() {
  for (const fn of listeners) fn();
}
export function activeJobs() {
  return jobs;
}
export function subscribeJobs(fn: () => void) {
  listeners.add(fn);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(fn);
  };
}
export async function runActivity<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const run = async () => {
    jobs++;
    notify();
    try {
      return await task();
    } finally {
      jobs--;
      notify();
    }
  };
  if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.locks)
    return navigator.locks.request("neuron-busy", { mode: "shared" }, run);
  return run();
}
export async function installUpdate(registration: ServiceWorkerRegistration) {
  if (!registration.waiting) throw new Error("No waiting update is available.");
  if (!navigator.locks)
    throw new Error(
      "Safe cross-tab updates require Web Locks. Close ALL NEURON tabs and reopen to apply the waiting update.",
    );
  await navigator.locks.request(
    "neuron-busy",
    { mode: "exclusive", ifAvailable: true },
    async (lock) => {
      if (!lock || jobs)
        throw new Error(
          "A job is active in a NEURON tab. Finish or cancel it before updating.",
        );
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          navigator.serviceWorker.removeEventListener(
            "controllerchange",
            changed,
          );
          reject(
            new Error("Update timed out. Close all NEURON tabs and reopen."),
          );
        }, 15000);
        const changed = () => {
          clearTimeout(timer);
          navigator.serviceWorker.removeEventListener(
            "controllerchange",
            changed,
          );
          resolve();
        };
        navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener("controllerchange", changed);
        registration.waiting?.postMessage({ type: "ACTIVATE_UPDATE" });
      });
      location.reload();
    },
  );
}

let registration: ServiceWorkerRegistration | undefined;
const subscribers = new Set<() => void>();
function changed() {
  subscribers.forEach((fn) => fn());
}
export const offlineState = {
  supported: false,
  controlled: false,
  updateAvailable: false,
  error: "",
};
export function subscribeOffline(fn: () => void) {
  subscribers.add(fn);
  return () => {
    subscribers.delete(fn);
  };
}
export function getRegistration() {
  return registration;
}
export async function registerOffline() {
  const icon = document.createElement("link");
  icon.rel = "icon";
  icon.href = "/favicon.svg";
  document.head.append(icon);
  const manifest = document.createElement("link");
  manifest.rel = "manifest";
  manifest.href = "/manifest.webmanifest";
  document.head.append(manifest);
  if (!import.meta.env.PROD) return;
  if (!("serviceWorker" in navigator) || !window.isSecureContext) {
    offlineState.error =
      "Offline installation requires HTTPS or localhost and service-worker support.";
    changed();
    return;
  }
  offlineState.supported = true;
  try {
    registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.register(
      "/service-worker.js",
      { type: "module", scope: "/" },
    );
    function inspect() {
      offlineState.controlled = !!navigator.serviceWorker.controller;
      offlineState.updateAvailable = !!registration?.waiting;
      changed();
    }
    inspect();
    navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener("controllerchange", inspect);
    registration.addEventListener("updatefound", () => {
      registration?.installing?.addEventListener("statechange", inspect);
    });
    await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
    inspect();
  } catch (e) {
    offlineState.error =
      e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Offline installation failed.";
    changed();
  }
}

/// <reference lib="webworker" />
export {};
const worker = globalThis as unknown as ServiceWorkerGlobalScope;
// Replaced by the production Vite plugin, never evaluated dynamically.
const ASSETS: string[] = __NEURON_PRECACHE__;
const CACHE = "neuron-shell-__NEURON_REVISION__";
declare const __NEURON_PRECACHE__: string[];
worker.addEventListener("install", (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    (async () => {
      const cache = await caches.open(CACHE);
      try {
        await cache.addAll(
          ASSETS.map((path) => new Request(path, { cache: "reload" })),
        );
      } catch (e) {
        await caches.delete(CACHE);
        throw e;
      }
      // Do not skipWaiting: an existing tab must explicitly authorize the update.
    })(),
  );

worker.addEventListener("activate", (event) =>
  event.waitUntil(
    (async () => {
      // Keep prior shell caches. Existing tabs may still reference old lazy chunks.
      // Their explicit cleanup is a later feature, not a destructive automatic action.
      await worker.clients.claim();
    })(),
  ),
);
worker.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  if (event.data?.type === "ACTIVATE_UPDATE")
    event.waitUntil(worker.skipWaiting());
});
worker.addEventListener("fetch", (event) => {
  const request = event.request,
    url = new URL(request.url);
  if (request.method !== "GET" || url.origin !== worker.location.origin) return;
  if (request.mode === "navigate") {
    event.respondWith(
      (async () => {
        const cache = await caches.open(CACHE);
        return (
          (await cache.match("/index.html")) ??
          (await cache.match("/offline.html")) ??
          new Response("Offline app unavailable.", { status: 503 })
        );
      })(),
    );
    return;
  }
  if (
    ASSETS.includes(url.pathname) ||
    /^\/assets\/[^/]+\.(js|css)$/.test(url.pathname)
  )
    event.respondWith(
      (async () => {
        const current = await caches.open(CACHE);
        const hit = await current.match(url.pathname);
        if (hit) return hit;
        // A previous tab can still reference a previous content-hashed lazy chunk.
        for (const name of await caches.keys()) {
          if (name === CACHE || !name.startsWith("neuron-shell-")) continue;
          const cached = await (await caches.open(name)).match(url.pathname);
          if (cached) return cached;
        }
        return fetch(request);
      })(),
    );
});

import type { io } from "@tensorflow/tfjs";
import { sha256 } from "../lib/checksums";
import { runActivity } from "./update-manager";
export const PACK_ID = "mobilenet-v2-1.0-pinned-2026-11";
export const MODEL_FILES = [
  {
    name: "model.json",
    bytes: 86414,
    hash: "62c47d7f217d49a68528ea88d4bbbf1b09d0a13892eeff14b3e41ff6878de099",

  INDEX_URL = "/__neuron_pack_index__";
const source =
  "https://tfhub.dev/google/imagenet/mobilenet_v2_100_224/classification/2/";
function key(name: string) {
  return new URL("/__neuron_pack__/" + PACK_ID + "/" + name, location.origin)
    .href;
}
export function validateEncoderManifest(value: unknown) {
  const model = value as {
    modelTopology?: object;
    weightsManifest?: Array<{
      paths: string[];
      weights: io.WeightsManifestEntry[];
    }>;
    signature?: io.ModelArtifacts["signature"];
    userDefinedMetadata?: io.ModelArtifacts["userDefinedMetadata"];
  };
  if (
    !model ||
    typeof model.modelTopology !== "object" ||
    !Array.isArray(model.weightsManifest) ||
    model.weightsManifest.length !== 1
  )
    throw new Error("Unsupported encoder manifest.");
  if (
    JSON.stringify(model.weightsManifest[0].paths) !==
    JSON.stringify(MODEL_FILES.slice(1).map((f) => f.name))
  )
    throw new Error("Unexpected encoder shard paths.");
  return model;
}
async function pointer() {
  if (!("caches" in globalThis))
    throw new Error(
      "Persistent model packs require Cache Storage in HTTPS or localhost.",
    );
  const response = await (await caches.open(INDEX_CACHE)).match(INDEX_URL);
  if (!response) return null;
  try {
    const p = await response.json();
    return p.id === PACK_ID &&
      typeof p.cache === "string" &&
      p.cache.startsWith("neuron-pack-")
      ? (p.cache as string)
      : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
async function verified(cache: Cache, name: string) {
  const spec = MODEL_FILES.find((f) => f.name === name);
  if (!spec) throw new Error("Unknown asset.");
  const response = await cache.match(key(name));
  if (!response) throw new Error("Model pack is incomplete.");
  const data = await response.arrayBuffer();
  if (data.byteLength !== spec.bytes || (await sha256(data)) !== spec.hash)
    throw new Error(
      "Model pack integrity check failed. Remove and download the pack again.",
    );
  return data;
}
export async function packStatus() {
  try {
    const p = await pointer();
    if (!p) return { ready: false, bytes: 0, error: "" };
    const cache = await caches.open(p);
    for (const file of MODEL_FILES) await verified(cache, file.name);
    return {
      ready: true,
      bytes: MODEL_FILES.reduce((n, f) => n + f.bytes, 0),
      error: "",
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return {
      ready: false,
      bytes: 0,
      error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Pack unavailable",
    };
  }
}
async function fetchBounded(url: string, limit: number, signal: AbortSignal) {
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    signal,
    cache: "no-store",
    referrerPolicy: "no-referrer",
  });
  if (!response.ok || !response.body)
    throw new Error(`Asset download failed (${response.status}).`);
  const reader = response.body.getReader(),
    chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let total = 0;
  try {
    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      total += value.byteLength;
      if (total > limit) {
        await reader.cancel();
        throw new Error("Asset exceeded its pinned size.");
      }
      chunks.push(value);
    }
  } finally {
    reader.releaseLock();
  }
  const result = new Uint8Array(total);
  let offset = 0;
  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    result.set(chunk, offset);
    offset += chunk.length;
  }
  return result;
}
export async function downloadPack(
  signal: AbortSignal,
  onProgress: (done: number, total: number) => void = () => {},
) {
  const execute = () =>
    runActivity(async () => {
      if ((await packStatus()).ready) return;
      const cacheName = "neuron-pack-" + crypto.randomUUID(),
        cache = await caches.open(cacheName);
      let committed = false,
        done = 0;
      const total = MODEL_FILES.reduce((n, f) => n + f.bytes, 0);
      try {
        for (const file of MODEL_FILES) {
          signal.throwIfAborted();
          const bytes = await fetchBounded(
            source + file.name + "?tfjs-format=file",
            file.bytes,
            signal,
          );
          if (
            bytes.length !== file.bytes ||
            (await sha256(bytes)) !== file.hash
          )
            throw new Error(
              "Downloaded encoder differs from the pinned version. No unverified weights were installed.",
            );
          await cache.put(key(file.name), new Response(bytes as BodyInit));
          done += file.bytes;
          onProgress(done, total);
        }
        signal.throwIfAborted();
        await verified(cache, "model.json");
        validateEncoderManifest(
          JSON.parse(
            new TextDecoder().decode(await verified(cache, "model.json")),
          ),
        );
        await (
          await caches.open(INDEX_CACHE)
        ).put(
          INDEX_URL,
          new Response(JSON.stringify({ id: PACK_ID, cache: cacheName })),
        );
        committed = true;
      } finally {
        if (!committed) await caches.delete(cacheName);
      }
    });
  if (navigator.locks)
    return navigator.locks.request(
      "neuron-assets",
      { mode: "exclusive" },
      execute,
    );
  return execute();
}
export async function removePack() {
  const remove = async () => {
    await (await caches.open(INDEX_CACHE)).delete(INDEX_URL);
    for (const name of await caches.keys())
      if (name.startsWith("neuron-pack-")) await caches.delete(name);
  };
  if (navigator.locks)
    return navigator.locks.request("neuron-assets", { mode: "exclusive" }, () =>
      runActivity(remove),
    );
  return runActivity(remove);
}
export async function encoderArtifacts(): Promise<io.ModelArtifacts> {
  if (!(await packStatus()).ready) {
    if (!navigator.onLine)
      throw new Error(
        "No verified image encoder is cached. Reconnect and download it in Settings.",
      );
    await downloadPack(new AbortController().signal);
  }
  const name = await pointer();
  if (!name) throw new Error("Encoder pack was removed. Retry to reinstall.");
  const cache = await caches.open(name);
  const model = validateEncoderManifest(
    JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(await verified(cache, "model.json"))),
  );
  const parts = await Promise.all(
    MODEL_FILES.slice(1).map((f) => verified(cache, f.name)),
  );
  const data = new Uint8Array(parts.reduce((n, p) => n + p.byteLength, 0));
  let offset = 0;
  for (const p of parts) {
    data.set(new Uint8Array(p), offset);
    offset += p.byteLength;
  }
  return {
    modelTopology: model.modelTopology!,
    weightSpecs: model.weightsManifest![0].weights,
    weightData: data.buffer,
    signature: model.signature,
    userDefinedMetadata: model.userDefinedMetadata,
  };
}

import * as tf from "@tensorflow/tfjs";
import * as mobilenet from "@tensorflow-models/mobilenet";
import { encoderArtifacts } from "../pwa/asset-manager";
import { decodeImage } from "../features/datasets/dataset.service";
let encoderPromise: Promise<mobilenet.MobileNet> | undefined;
let initPromise: Promise<void> | undefined;
export async function initializeRuntime() {
  return (initPromise ??= (async () => {
    try {
      if (!(await tf.setBackend("webgl"))) throw new Error("WebGL unavailable");
      await tf.ready();
    } catch {
      await tf.setBackend("cpu");
      await tf.ready();
    }
  })());
}
export async function encoder() {
  await initializeRuntime();
  if (!encoderPromise)
    encoderPromise = mobilenet
      .load({
        version: 2,
        alpha: 1.0,
        inputRange: [0, 1],
        modelUrl: { load: encoderArtifacts },
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        encoderPromise = undefined;
        throw new Error(
          `Encoder unavailable. Check Settings → Offline readiness, then retry. ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : ""}`,
        );
      });
  return encoderPromise;
}
export async function embed(blob: Blob) {
  const net = await encoder();
  const bitmap = await decodeImage(blob);
  try {
    // mobilenet's published input union omits ImageBitmap; use a bounded canvas.
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = 224;
    canvas.height = 224;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) throw new Error("Canvas unavailable.");
    ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, 224, 224);
    const t = net.infer(canvas, true) as tf.Tensor;
    try {
      return Float32Array.from(await t.data());
    } finally {
      t.dispose();
    }
  } finally {
    bitmap.close();
  }
}
export function makeHead(classes: number, seed: number) {
  const model = tf.sequential();
  model.add(
    tf.layers.dense({
      inputShape: [1280],
      units: classes,
      activation: "softmax",
      kernelInitializer: tf.initializers.glorotUniform({ seed }),
      biasInitializer: "zeros",
    }),
  );
  return model;
}
export function backendName() {
  return tf.getBackend() || "not initialized";
}
export { tf };

export function downloadBlob(blob: Blob, name: string) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = name;
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 2000);
}

import type { Project, Sample, ModelVersion, FeedbackItem } from "./types";
import { uid } from "./types";
import { sha256, validHash } from "./checksums";
import { toBase64, fromBase64, validateArtifact } from "./model-format";
export const BACKUP_LIMIT = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
const MEDIA_LIMIT = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
type Media = {
  id: string;
  labelId: string;
  data: string;
  hash: string;
  createdAt: number;
  versionId?: string;
  predictedLabel?: string;
};
export type Backup = {
  format: "neuron-project";
  version: 1;
  project: Project;
  samples: Media[];
  versions: ModelVersion[];
  feedback: Media[];
  createdAt: number;
};
export type Snapshot = {
  project: Project;
  samples: Sample[];
  versions: ModelVersion[];
  feedback: FeedbackItem[];
};
function text(x: unknown, max = 100): x is string {
  return typeof x === "string" && x.trim().length > 0 && x.length <= max;
}
export function validateBackupShape(value: unknown): Backup {
  const b = value as Backup;
  if (
    !b ||
    b.format !== "neuron-project" ||
    b.version !== 1 ||
    !b.project ||
    !text(b.project.id) ||
    !text(b.project.name, 64) ||
    !Array.isArray(b.project.labels) ||
    b.project.labels.length < 2 ||
    b.project.labels.length > 20
  )
    throw new Error("Unsupported NEURON project backup.");
  const labelIds = new Set<string>(),
    names = new Set<string>();
  for (const l of b.project.labels) {
    if (
      !l ||
      !text(l.id) ||
      !text(l.name, 64) ||
      labelIds.has(l.id) ||
      names.has(l.name.toLowerCase())
    )
      throw new Error("Invalid backup classes.");
    labelIds.add(l.id);
    names.add(l.name.toLowerCase());
  }
  if (
    ![b.project.createdAt, b.project.updatedAt, b.createdAt].every(
      Number.isFinite,
    ) ||
    !Array.isArray(b.samples) ||
    b.samples.length > 1000 ||
    !Array.isArray(b.versions) ||
    b.versions.length > 50 ||
    !Array.isArray(b.feedback) ||
    b.feedback.length > 100
  )
    throw new Error("Backup exceeds supported record limits.");
  const versionIds = new Set<string>();
  for (const v of b.versions) {
    if (
      !v ||
      !text(v.id) ||
      versionIds.has(v.id) ||
      v.projectId !== b.project.id ||
      !Number.isFinite(v.createdAt)
    )
      throw new Error("Invalid model version.");
    versionIds.add(v.id);
    validateArtifact(v.artifact);
  }
  if (b.project.activeVersionId && !versionIds.has(b.project.activeVersionId))
    throw new Error("Active model is missing from backup.");
  const allIds = new Set<string>();
  let chars = 0;
  for (const [list, feedback] of [
    [b.samples, false],
    [b.feedback, true],
  ] as const)
    for (const m of list) {
      if (
        !m ||
        !text(m.id) ||
        allIds.has(m.id) ||
        !labelIds.has(m.labelId) ||
        !Number.isFinite(m.createdAt) ||
        !validHash(m.hash) ||
        typeof m.data !== "string" ||
        m.data.length > 2 * 1024 * 1024 ||
        !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$/.test(m.data)
      )
        throw new Error("Invalid image record in backup.");
      if (
        feedback &&
        (!text(m.versionId) ||
          !versionIds.has(m.versionId!) ||
          typeof m.predictedLabel !== "string" ||
          m.predictedLabel.length > 64)
      )
        throw new Error("Invalid feedback record.");
      allIds.add(m.id);
      chars += m.data.length;
    }
  if (chars > Math.ceil((MEDIA_LIMIT * 4) / 3) + 4096)
    throw new Error("Backup images exceed the 32 MB media budget.");
  return b;
}
export async function encodeBackup(snapshot: Snapshot): Promise<Blob> {
  let bytes = 0;
  async function encode(s: Sample | FeedbackItem): Promise<Media> {
    bytes += s.blob.size;
    if (bytes > MEDIA_LIMIT)
      throw new Error(
        "This phase supports at most 32 MB of image/feedback data per backup.",
      );
    return {
      id: s.id,
      labelId: s.labelId,
      createdAt: s.createdAt,
      data: toBase64(await s.blob.arrayBuffer()),
      hash: await sha256(s.blob),
      ...("versionId" in s
        ? { versionId: s.versionId, predictedLabel: s.predictedLabel }
        : {}),
    };
  }
  const samples: Media[] = [],
    feedback: Media[] = [];
  for (const s of snapshot.samples) samples.push(await encode(s));
  for (const f of snapshot.feedback) feedback.push(await encode(f));
  const b: Backup = {
    format: "neuron-project",
    version: 1,
    project: snapshot.project,
    samples,
    feedback,
    versions: snapshot.versions,
    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };
  validateBackupShape(b);
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(b)], { type: "application/json" });
  if (blob.size > BACKUP_LIMIT)
    throw new Error("Backup exceeds the 64 MB file limit.");
  return blob;
}
export async function decodeBackup(file: Blob): Promise<Snapshot> {
  if (file.size > BACKUP_LIMIT)
    throw new Error("Backup exceeds the 64 MB file limit.");
  let raw: unknown;
  try {
    raw = JSON.parse(await file.text());
  } catch {
    throw new Error("Backup is not valid JSON.");
  }
  const b = validateBackupShape(raw),
    projectId = uid(),
    versionMap = new Map(b.versions.map((v) => [v.id, uid()]));
  async function media(m: Media) {
    const data = fromBase64(m.data);
    if ((await sha256(data)) !== m.hash)
      throw new Error("Backup image checksum mismatch. No data was restored.");
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(data);
    if (
      bytes.length < 4 ||
      bytes[0] !== 255 ||
      bytes[1] !== 216 ||
      bytes[2] !== 255
    )
      throw new Error("Only normalized JPEG images are supported in backups.");
    return new Blob([data], { type: "image/jpeg" });
  }
  const samples: Sample[] = [],
    feedback: FeedbackItem[] = [];
  for (const m of b.samples)
    samples.push({
      id: uid(),
      projectId,
      labelId: m.labelId,
      createdAt: m.createdAt,
      blob: await media(m),
      hash: m.hash,
    });
  for (const m of b.feedback)
    feedback.push({
      id: uid(),
      projectId,
      labelId: m.labelId,
      createdAt: m.createdAt,
      blob: await media(m),
      versionId: versionMap.get(m.versionId!)!,
      predictedLabel: m.predictedLabel!,
    });
  const project: Project = {
    id: projectId,
    name: (b.project.name.slice(0, 52) + " (restored)").slice(0, 64),
    labels: b.project.labels,
    createdAt: b.project.createdAt,
    updatedAt: Date.now(),
    activeVersionId: b.project.activeVersionId
      ? versionMap.get(b.project.activeVersionId)
      : undefined,
  };
  return {
    project,
    samples,
    feedback,
    versions: b.versions.map((v) => ({
      id: versionMap.get(v.id)!,
      projectId,
      createdAt: v.createdAt,
      artifact: validateArtifact(v.artifact),
    })),
  };
}

import { trackTransaction } from "../../lib/db";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

export async function restoreProject(file: Blob) {
  const snapshot = await decodeBackup(file);
  // Decode images before transaction; never keep IDB transactions alive across canvas work.
  for (const s of [...snapshot.samples, ...snapshot.feedback]) {
    const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(s.blob);
    try {
      if (bitmap.width > 768 || bitmap.height > 768)
        throw new Error("Backup image exceeds normalized dimensions.");
    } finally {
      bitmap.close();
    }
  }
  const db = await database(),
    tx = trackTransaction(
      db.transaction(
        ["projects", "samples", "versions", "feedback"],
        "readwrite",
      ),
    );
  await tx.objectStore("projects").add(snapshot.project);
  for (const s of snapshot.samples) await tx.objectStore("samples").add(s);
  for (const v of snapshot.versions) await tx.objectStore("versions").add(v);
  for (const f of snapshot.feedback) await tx.objectStore("feedback").add(f);
  await tx.done;
  return snapshot.project;
}

      setError(errorMessage(e));

      setBusy(false);

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { packStatus, downloadPack, removePack } from "../../pwa/asset-manager";
import {
  getRegistration,
  offlineState,
  subscribeOffline,
} from "../../pwa/register";
import { bytes } from "../../lib/capabilities";

export function RuntimeSettings() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState({ ready: false, bytes: 0, error: "" }),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [progress, setProgress] = useState(0),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [, render] = useState(0);
  const control = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    void packStatus().then(setStatus);
    const unsubscribe = subscribeOffline(() => render((n) => n + 1));
    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
      control.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);
  async function download() {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    const c = new AbortController();
    control.current = c;
    try {
      await downloadPack(c.signal, (done, total) => setProgress(done / total));
      setStatus(await packStatus());
    } catch (e) {
      setError(
        c.signal.aborted
          ? "Download cancelled. No incomplete pack was installed."
          : errorMessage(e),
      );
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      control.current = null;
    }
  }
  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <h2>Offline readiness</h2>
      <dl className="summary-list">
        <div>
          <dt>Application shell</dt>
          <dd>
            {offlineState.controlled
              ? "Installed"
              : import.meta.env.DEV
                ? "Development mode"
                : "Installing / unavailable"}
          </dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt>Image encoder</dt>
          <dd>
            {status.ready ? `Verified · ${bytes(status.bytes)}` : "Not ready"}
          </dd>
        </div>
      </dl>
      <p>
        Both the production app shell and verified encoder must be installed
        before disconnecting. Storage can still be cleared or evicted by your
        browser.
      </p>
      {busy ? (
        <>
          <progress value={progress} max={1} />
          <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => control.current?.abort()}>
            Cancel download
          </Button>
        </>
      ) : (
        <div className="inline wrap">
          <Button disabled={status.ready} onClick={() => void download()}>
            Download image encoder (~14 MB)
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            disabled={!status.ready}
            onClick={() => {
              if (
                confirm(
                  "Remove the cached encoder? Existing models and images remain, but future page sessions need another download.",
                )
              )
                void removePack()
                  .then(() => packStatus())
                  .then(setStatus)
                  .catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)));
            }}
          >
            Remove encoder pack
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            onClick={() => void packStatus().then(setStatus)}
          >
            Verify pack
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
      {(error || status.error || offlineState.error) && (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {error || status.error || offlineState.error}
        </p>
      )}
      <Button
        variant="ghost"
        onClick={() =>
          void getRegistration()
            ?.update()
            .catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)))
        }
      >
        Check for app update
      </Button>
      <p className="phase-note">
        Offline reload works in a production build only: pnpm build, then pnpm
        --filter @neuron/web preview. Open localhost:4173, wait for shell
        installation and download the encoder. Development Vite sessions
        deliberately do not install a service worker.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  getRegistration,
  offlineState,
  subscribeOffline,
} from "../../pwa/register";
import { installUpdate } from "../../pwa/update-manager";
import { errorMessage } from "../../lib/types";
export function OfflineBanner() {
  const [online, setOnline] = useState(navigator.onLine),
    [, render] = useState(0),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => setOnline(navigator.onLine);
    window.addEventListener("online", update);
    window.addEventListener("offline", update);
    const unsub = subscribeOffline(() => render((n) => n + 1));
    return () => {
      unsub();
      window.removeEventListener("online", update);
      window.removeEventListener("offline", update);
    };
  }, []);
  return (
    <>
      {!online && (
        <div className="notice offline-notice">
          You are offline. Saved projects remain local. Training and predictions
          require the verified encoder pack.{" "}
          <a href="#/settings">Check readiness →</a>
        </div>
      )}
      {offlineState.updateAvailable && (
        <div className="notice offline-notice">
          A new app version is ready. Save your work first.{" "}
          <button
            className="btn btn-secondary"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => {
              const r = getRegistration();
              if (!r) return;
              setBusy(true);
              void installUpdate(r)
                .catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)))
                .finally(() => setBusy(false));
            }}
          >
            Apply safe update
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
