import { trackTransaction } from "../../lib/db";
import { database } from "../../lib/db";
import { sha256 } from "../../lib/checksums";
import { uid, type Sample } from "../../lib/types";
export const MAX_SAMPLES = 1000;
export async function decodeImage(blob: Blob): Promise<ImageBitmap> {
  try {
    return await createImageBitmap(blob, { imageOrientation: "from-image" });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(
      "Could not decode this image. Use a valid JPEG, PNG or WebP.",
    );
  }
}
export async function normalizeImage(file: File): Promise<Blob> {
  if (!["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp"].includes(file.type))
    throw new Error(`${file.name}: only JPEG, PNG and WebP are supported.`);
  if (file.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024)
    throw new Error(`${file.name}: maximum upload size is 15 MB.`);
  const bitmap = await decodeImage(file);
  try {
    if (bitmap.width * bitmap.height > 40_000_000)
      throw new Error("Image exceeds the 40-megapixel safety limit.");
    const scale = Math.min(1, 768 / Math.max(bitmap.width, bitmap.height));
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.width * scale));
    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.height * scale));
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) throw new Error("Canvas unavailable.");
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    return await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) =>
      canvas.toBlob(
        (b) => (b ? resolve(b) : reject(new Error("Image encoding failed."))),
        "image/jpeg",
        0.88,
      ),
    );
  } finally {
    bitmap.close();
  }
}
export async function addImages(
  projectId: string,
  labelId: string,
  files: File[],
  currentCount: number,
  onProgress: (n: number) => void,
) {
  if (currentCount + files.length > MAX_SAMPLES)
    throw new Error(
      `This phase supports at most ${MAX_SAMPLES} samples per project.`,
    );
  const errors: string[] = [];
  let saved = 0;
  for (const file of files) {
    try {
      const blob = await normalizeImage(file);
      const sample: Sample = {
        id: uid(),
        projectId,
        labelId,
        blob,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
      };
      sample.hash = await sha256(blob);
      const db = await database();
      // Lazily hash Phase 1 samples without recreating records deleted by another tab.
      for (const old of await db.getAllFromIndex(
        "samples",
        "by-project",
        projectId,
      )) {
        if (old.hash) continue;
        const hash = await sha256(old.blob);
        const update = trackTransaction(db.transaction("samples", "readwrite"));
        const current = await update.store.get(old.id);
        if (current) await update.store.put({ ...current, hash });
        await update.done;
      }
      const tx = trackTransaction(
        db.transaction(["projects", "samples"], "readwrite"),
      );
      const project = await tx.objectStore("projects").get(projectId);
      const current = await tx
        .objectStore("samples")
        .index("by-project")
        .getAll(projectId);
      if (
        !project ||
        !project.labels.some((l) => l.id === labelId) ||
        current.length >= MAX_SAMPLES ||
        current.some((s) => s.hash === sample.hash)
      ) {
        tx.abort();
        await tx.done.catch(() => {});
        throw new Error(
          !project
            ? "Project deleted."
            : current.some((s) => s.hash === sample.hash)
              ? "Duplicate image already exists in this project."
              : "Class changed or project sample limit reached.",
        );
      }
      await tx.objectStore("samples").add(sample);
      await tx
        .objectStore("projects")
        .put({ ...project, updatedAt: Date.now() });
      await tx.done;
      saved++;
    } catch (e) {
      errors.push(
        `${file.name}: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Save failed"}`,
      );
      if (e instanceof DOMException && e.name === "QuotaExceededError") break;
    }
    onProgress(saved);
  }
  return { saved, errors };
}
export async function removeSample(id: string) {
  await (await database()).delete("samples", id);
}

import { tf, embed, makeHead } from "../../lib/ml";
import { toBase64 } from "../../lib/model-format";
import type {
  Project,
  Sample,
  EpochMetric,
  Evaluation,
  ModelArtifact,
} from "../../lib/types";
import { sha256 } from "../../lib/checksums";
import { runActivity } from "../../pwa/update-manager";
import { validateLabels } from "../projects/project.service";
export function random(seed: number) {
  return () => {
    seed |= 0;
    seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}
export function splitIndices(labels: number[], seed: number) {
  const rng = random(seed),
    train: number[] = [],
    validation: number[] = [];
  for (const label of [...new Set(labels)]) {
    const indices = labels
      .map((v, i) => (v === label ? i : -1))
      .filter((i) => i !== -1);
    if (indices.length < 5)
      throw new Error("Every class needs at least 5 images.");
    for (let i = indices.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1));
      [indices[i], indices[j]] = [indices[j], indices[i]];
    }
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.floor(indices.length * 0.2));
    validation.push(...indices.slice(0, count));
    train.push(...indices.slice(count));
  }
  return { train, validation };
}
export function evaluate(
  actual: number[],
  predicted: number[],
  classes: number,
): Evaluation {
  if (!actual.length || actual.length !== predicted.length)
    throw new Error("Invalid evaluation data.");
  const matrix = Array.from({ length: classes }, () =>
    Array<number>(classes).fill(0),
  );
  let correct = 0;
  actual.forEach((a, i) => {
    const p = predicted[i];
    if (
      a < 0 ||
      a >= classes ||
      p < 0 ||
      p >= classes ||
      !Number.isInteger(a) ||
      !Number.isInteger(p)
    )
      throw new Error("Invalid prediction index.");
    matrix[a][p]++;
    if (a === p) correct++;
  });
  return { accuracy: correct / actual.length, matrix, total: actual.length };
}
export type TrainingOptions = {
  epochs: number;
  learningRate: number;
  seed: number;
};
export type TrainingProgress = {
  stage: string;
  done: number;
  total: number;
  metrics: EpochMetric[];
};
async function trainInternal(
  project: Project,
  samples: Sample[],
  options: TrainingOptions,
  signal: AbortSignal,
  progress: (p: TrainingProgress) => void,
): Promise<ModelArtifact> {
  validateLabels(project.labels);
  if (
    !Number.isInteger(options.epochs) ||
    options.epochs < 1 ||
    options.epochs > 100 ||
    options.learningRate < 0.00001 ||
    options.learningRate > 0.1 ||
    !Number.isFinite(options.learningRate)
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid training settings.");
  const ids = project.labels.map((l) => l.id);
  const targets = samples.map((s) => ids.indexOf(s.labelId));
  if (targets.some((i) => i < 0))
    throw new Error("Dataset contains an unknown class.");
  const { train: training, validation } = splitIndices(targets, options.seed);
  const check = () => {
    if (signal.aborted)
      throw new DOMException("Training cancelled.", "AbortError");
  };
  const vectors: Float32Array[] = [];
  const metrics: EpochMetric[] = [];
  progress({
    stage: "Downloading / loading image encoder",
    done: 0,
    total: samples.length,
    metrics: [],
  });
  for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
    check();
    vectors.push(await embed(samples[i].blob));
    progress({
      stage: "Extracting image features",
      done: i + 1,
      total: samples.length,
      metrics: [],
    });
    await tf.nextFrame();
  }
  check();
  const makeX = (indices: number[]) =>
    tf.tensor2d(
      indices.map((i) => Array.from(vectors[i])),
      [indices.length, 1280],
    );
  const makeY = (indices: number[]) =>
    tf.tidy(() =>
      tf.oneHot(
        tf.tensor1d(
          indices.map((i) => targets[i]),
          "int32",
        ),
        ids.length,
      ),
    );
  let x: ReturnType<typeof makeX> | undefined,
    y: tf.Tensor | undefined,
    vx: ReturnType<typeof makeX> | undefined,
    vy: tf.Tensor | undefined;
  const head = makeHead(ids.length, options.seed);
  const optimizer = tf.train.adam(options.learningRate);
  try {
    x = makeX(training);
    y = makeY(training);
    vx = makeX(validation);
    vy = makeY(validation);
    head.compile({
      optimizer,
      loss: "categoricalCrossentropy",
      metrics: ["accuracy"],
    });
    await head.fit(x, y, {
      epochs: options.epochs,
      batchSize: Math.min(16, training.length),
      shuffle: true,
      validationData: [vx, vy],
      callbacks: {
        onBatchEnd: async () => {
          if (signal.aborted) head.stopTraining = true;
          await tf.nextFrame();
        },
        onEpochEnd: async (epoch, logs) => {
          const metric: EpochMetric = {
            epoch: epoch + 1,
            loss: Number(logs?.loss ?? 0),
            accuracy: Number(logs?.acc ?? logs?.accuracy ?? 0),
            valLoss: Number(logs?.val_loss ?? 0),
            valAccuracy: Number(logs?.val_acc ?? logs?.val_accuracy ?? 0),
          };
          if (!Object.values(metric).every(Number.isFinite)) {
            head.stopTraining = true;
            throw new Error("Training diverged. Reduce learning rate.");
          }
          metrics.push(metric);
          progress({
            stage: "Training classifier",
            done: epoch + 1,
            total: options.epochs,
            metrics: [...metrics],
          });
        },
      },
    });
    check();
    const predicted = tf.tidy(() =>
      (head.predict(vx!) as tf.Tensor).argMax(-1),
    );
    let indices: number[];
    try {
      indices = Array.from(await predicted.data());
    } finally {
      predicted.dispose();
    }
    const evaluation = evaluate(
      validation.map((i) => targets[i]),
      indices,
      ids.length,
    );
    // getWeights() references model-owned variables. encode before head disposal.
    const weights = head.getWeights();
    const named: tf.NamedTensorMap = {};
    weights.forEach((w, i) => (named[`head_${i}`] = w));
    const encoded = await tf.io.encodeWeights(named);
    check();
    const rows = await Promise.all(
      samples.map(async (s) => ({
        hash: await sha256(s.blob),
        labelId: s.labelId,
      })),
    );
    const provenance = {
      datasetHash: await sha256(
        JSON.stringify({
          labels: project.labels,
          rows: [...rows].sort((a, b) =>
            (a.hash + a.labelId).localeCompare(b.hash + b.labelId),
          ),
        }),
      ),
      validationHash: await sha256(
        JSON.stringify({
          labels: project.labels,
          rows: validation
            .map((i) => rows[i])
            .sort((a, b) =>
              (a.hash + a.labelId).localeCompare(b.hash + b.labelId),
            ),
        }),
      ),
      seed: options.seed,
      sampleCount: samples.length,
    };
    return {
      provenance,
      format: "neuron-image",
      version: 1,
      encoder: "mobilenet-v2-1.0",
      embeddingSize: 1280,
      labels: structuredClone(project.labels),
      weightSpecs: encoded.specs as ModelArtifact["weightSpecs"],
      weightData: toBase64(encoded.data),
      epochs: metrics,
      evaluation,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
    };
  } finally {
    x?.dispose();
    y?.dispose();
    vx?.dispose();
    vy?.dispose();
    head.dispose();
    optimizer.dispose();
  }
}

export function train(...args: Parameters<typeof trainInternal>) {
  return runActivity(() => trainInternal(...args));
}

import type { ModelArtifact } from "./types";
export const MAX_MODEL_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
export function toBase64(buffer: ArrayBuffer) {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
  let result = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 8192)
    result += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(i, i + 8192));
  return btoa(result);
}
export function fromBase64(s: string): ArrayBuffer {
  const raw = atob(s);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(raw.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) bytes[i] = raw.charCodeAt(i);
  return bytes.buffer;
}
function fail(): never {
  throw new Error("Invalid or incompatible NEURON image model.");
}
export function validateArtifact(value: unknown): ModelArtifact {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return fail();
  const a = value as ModelArtifact;
  if (
    a.format !== "neuron-image" ||
    a.version !== 1 ||
    a.encoder !== "mobilenet-v2-1.0" ||
    a.embeddingSize !== 1280
  )
    return fail();
  if (!Array.isArray(a.labels) || a.labels.length < 2 || a.labels.length > 20)
    return fail();
  const ids = new Set<string>(),
    names = new Set<string>();
  for (const l of a.labels) {
    if (
      !l ||
      typeof l.id !== "string" ||
      !l.id ||
      l.id.length > 100 ||
      typeof l.name !== "string" ||
      !l.name.trim() ||
      l.name.length > 64 ||
      ids.has(l.id) ||
      names.has(l.name.trim().toLowerCase())
    )
      return fail();
    ids.add(l.id);
    names.add(l.name.trim().toLowerCase());
  }
  const n = a.labels.length;
  if (!Array.isArray(a.weightSpecs) || a.weightSpecs.length !== 2)
    return fail();
  const expected = [[1280, n], [n]];
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    const s = a.weightSpecs[i];
    if (
      !s ||
      s.dtype !== "float32" ||
      s.name !== `head_${i}` ||
      JSON.stringify(s.shape) !== JSON.stringify(expected[i])
    )
      return fail();
  }
  if (
    typeof a.weightData !== "string" ||
    a.weightData.length > MAX_MODEL_BYTES ||
    !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$/.test(a.weightData)
  )
    return fail();
  let buffer: ArrayBuffer;
  try {
    buffer = fromBase64(a.weightData);
  } catch {
    return fail();
  }
  if (buffer.byteLength !== (1280 * n + n) * 4) return fail();
  for (const x of new Float32Array(buffer))
    if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return fail();
  if (
    !Number.isFinite(a.createdAt) ||
    !Array.isArray(a.epochs) ||
    a.epochs.length > 100
  )
    return fail();
  for (const e of a.epochs)
    if (
      !e ||
      ![e.epoch, e.loss, e.accuracy, e.valLoss, e.valAccuracy].every(
        Number.isFinite,
      )
    )
      return fail();
  const v = a.evaluation;
  if (
    !v ||
    !Number.isInteger(v.total) ||
    v.total < 1 ||
    v.total > 1000 ||
    !Number.isFinite(v.accuracy) ||
    v.accuracy < 0 ||
    v.accuracy > 1 ||
    !Array.isArray(v.matrix) ||
    v.matrix.length !== n
  )
    return fail();
  let total = 0,
    correct = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const row = v.matrix[i];
    if (!Array.isArray(row) || row.length !== n) return fail();
    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
      const c = row[j];
      if (!Number.isInteger(c) || c < 0) return fail();
      total += c;
      if (i === j) correct += c;
    }
  }
  if (total !== v.total || Math.abs(correct / total - v.accuracy) > 1e-6)
    return fail();
  if (a.provenance) {
    const p = a.provenance;
    if (
      !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(p.datasetHash) ||
      !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(p.validationHash) ||
      !Number.isInteger(p.seed) ||
      !Number.isInteger(p.sampleCount) ||
      p.sampleCount < 10 ||
      p.sampleCount > 1000
    )
      return fail();
  }
  return structuredClone(a);
}
export async function readModel(file: File) {
  if (file.size > MAX_MODEL_BYTES)
    throw new Error("Model file exceeds the 8 MB safety limit.");
  let value: unknown;
  try {
    value = JSON.parse(await file.text());
  } catch {
    throw new Error("This file is not valid JSON.");
  }
  return validateArtifact(value);
}
export function exportModel(artifact: ModelArtifact, name: string) {
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(validateArtifact(artifact))], {
    type: "application/json",
  });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `${name.replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/gi, "_")}.neuron.json`;
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}

import { trackTransaction } from "../../lib/db";
import { database, activateVersion } from "../../lib/db";
import { sha256 } from "../../lib/checksums";
import {
  uid,
  type FeedbackItem,
  type ModelVersion,
  type Sample,
} from "../../lib/types";
import { runActivity } from "../../pwa/update-manager";
export function comparable(a: ModelVersion, b: ModelVersion) {
  return (
    !!a.artifact.provenance?.validationHash &&
    a.artifact.provenance.validationHash ===
      b.artifact.provenance?.validationHash
  );
}
export async function queueFeedback(
  projectId: string,
  versionId: string,
  labelId: string,
  blob: Blob,
  predictedLabel: string,
) {
  if (blob.type !== "image/jpeg" || blob.size > 1024 * 1024)
    throw new Error("Feedback must be a normalized JPEG under 1 MB.");
  const db = await database(),
    tx = trackTransaction(
      db.transaction(["projects", "versions", "feedback"], "readwrite"),
    ),
    p = await tx.objectStore("projects").get(projectId),
    v = await tx.objectStore("versions").get(versionId);
  const existing = await tx
    .objectStore("feedback")
    .index("by-project")
    .getAllKeys(projectId);
  if (
    !p ||
    !v ||
    v.projectId !== projectId ||
    !p.labels.some((l) => l.id === labelId) ||
    existing.length >= 100
  ) {
    tx.abort();
    await tx.done.catch(() => {});
    throw new Error(
      "Class/model changed or feedback queue has reached 100 items.",
    );
  }
  const item: FeedbackItem = {
    id: uid(),
    projectId,
    versionId,
    labelId,
    blob,
    predictedLabel: predictedLabel.slice(0, 64),
    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };
  await tx.objectStore("feedback").add(item);
  await tx.done;
  return item;
}
export async function listFeedback(projectId: string) {
  return (await database()).getAllFromIndex(
    "feedback",
    "by-project",
    projectId,
  );
}
export async function discardFeedback(id: string) {
  await (await database()).delete("feedback", id);
}
export async function approveFeedback(id: string) {
  return runActivity(async () => {
    const db = await database(),
      item = await db.get("feedback", id);
    if (!item) throw new Error("Feedback no longer exists.");
    const hash = await sha256(item.blob);
    // Legacy samples can be hashed before opening the final write transaction.
    for (const old of await db.getAllFromIndex(
      "samples",
      "by-project",
      item.projectId,
    )) {
      if (old.hash) continue;
      const value = await sha256(old.blob);
      const t = trackTransaction(db.transaction("samples", "readwrite"));
      const current = await t.store.get(old.id);
      if (current) await t.store.put({ ...current, hash: value });
      await t.done;
    }
    const tx = trackTransaction(
      db.transaction(["projects", "samples", "feedback"], "readwrite"),
    );
    const live = await tx.objectStore("feedback").get(id),
      p = await tx.objectStore("projects").get(item.projectId),
      samples = await tx
        .objectStore("samples")
        .index("by-project")
        .getAll(item.projectId);
    if (
      !live ||
      !p ||
      !p.labels.some((l) => l.id === item.labelId) ||
      samples.length >= 1000 ||
      samples.some((s) => s.hash === hash)
    ) {
      tx.abort();
      await tx.done.catch(() => {});
      throw new Error(
        "Feedback changed, image already exists, or sample limit reached. Discard duplicates.",
      );
    }
    const sample: Sample = {
      id: uid(),
      projectId: item.projectId,
      labelId: item.labelId,
      blob: item.blob,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      hash,
    };
    await tx.objectStore("samples").add(sample);
    await tx.objectStore("feedback").delete(id);
    await tx.objectStore("projects").put({ ...p, updatedAt: Date.now() });
    await tx.done;
  });
}

import { useState } from "react";
import type { Project } from "../../lib/types";
import { errorMessage } from "../../lib/types";
import { queueFeedback } from "../evolution/evolution.service";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/Button";
export function FeedbackCapture({
  project,
  versionId,
  blob,
  predictedLabel,
}: {
  project: Project;
  versionId: string;
  blob: Blob;
  predictedLabel: string;
}) {
  const [label, setLabel] = useState(project.labels[0]?.id ?? ""),
    [consent, setConsent] = useState(false),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  return (
    <section className="feedback-capture">
      <h3>Teach it from this prediction</h3>
      <p>
        Choose the correct class. With your permission, save this image to a
        local review queue. No automatic retraining or uploads.
      </p>
      <label className="field">
        Correct class
        <select value={label} onChange={(e) => setLabel(e.target.value)}>
          {project.labels.map((l) => (
            <option key={l.id} value={l.id}>
              {l.name}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </label>
      <label className="check-label">
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          checked={consent}
          onChange={(e) => setConsent(e.target.checked)}
        />{" "}
        Save this image locally for review.
      </label>
      <Button
        variant="secondary"
        disabled={!consent || busy}
        onClick={() => {
          setBusy(true);
          void queueFeedback(project.id, versionId, label, blob, predictedLabel)
            .then(() => {
              setMessage("Saved to the review queue.");
              setConsent(false);
            })
            .catch((e) => setMessage(errorMessage(e)))
            .finally(() => setBusy(false));
        }}
      >
        Add to review queue
      </Button>
      <p role="status">{message}</p>
      <a className="small-link" href={`#/projects/${project.id}/evolve`}>
        Review feedback & model history →
      </a>
    </section>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  approveFeedback,
  discardFeedback,
  listFeedback,
} from "./evolution.service";
import { type FeedbackItem, type Project, errorMessage } from "../../lib/types";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/Button";
function ReviewImage({ blob }: { blob: Blob }) {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    const u = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    setUrl(u);
    return () => URL.revokeObjectURL(u);
  }, [blob]);
  return (
    <img
      className="review-image"
      src={url}
      alt="Feedback image awaiting approval"
    />
  );
}
export function FeedbackQueue({ project }: { project: Project }) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<FeedbackItem[]>([]),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  async function refresh() {
    setItems(await listFeedback(project.id));
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh().catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)));
  }, [project.id]);
  async function task(action: () => Promise<unknown>) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await action();
      await refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <h2>Review queue · {items.length}/100</h2>
      <p>
        Approve adds an image to its chosen training class. Your saved model
        does not change until you retrain and activate a new version.
      </p>
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      {message && <p role="status">{message}</p>}
      {!items.length ? (
        <p className="muted">
          No pending feedback. Add a prediction image from the Predict page.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <div className="review-grid">
          {items.map((item) => (
            <article key={item.id}>
              <ReviewImage blob={item.blob} />
              <strong>
                {project.labels.find((l) => l.id === item.labelId)?.name ??
                  "Class removed"}
              </strong>
              <p>Predicted: {item.predictedLabel}</p>
              <div className="inline">
                <Button
                  disabled={busy}
                  onClick={() =>
                    void task(async () => {
                      await approveFeedback(item.id);
                      setMessage("Added to the dataset. Retrain when ready.");
                    })
                  }
                >
                  Approve
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  disabled={busy}
                  onClick={() => void task(() => discardFeedback(item.id))}
                >
                  Discard
                </Button>
              </div>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      <a className="btn btn-secondary" href={`#/projects/${project.id}/train`}>
        Retrain with approved examples
      </a>
    </section>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import type { ModelVersion } from "../../lib/types";
import { comparable } from "./evolution.service";
export function ComparisonPanel({ versions }: { versions: ModelVersion[] }) {
  const [left, setLeft] = useState(versions[0]?.id ?? ""),
    [right, setRight] = useState(versions[1]?.id ?? versions[0]?.id ?? "");
  const a = versions.find((v) => v.id === left),
    b = versions.find((v) => v.id === right);
  if (!a || !b)
    return (
      <section className="panel">
        <h2>Version comparison</h2>
        <p>Train and save a model to begin comparing versions.</p>
      </section>
    );
  return (
    <section className="panel">
      <h2>Version comparison</h2>
      <div className="comparison-selects">
        {[
          { name: "Version A", value: left, set: setLeft },
          { name: "Version B", value: right, set: setRight },
        ].map((field) => (
          <label className="field" key={field.name}>
            {field.name}
            <select
              value={field.value}
              onChange={(e) => field.set(e.target.value)}
            >
              {versions.map((v, i) => (
                <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>
                  Version {versions.length - i} ·{" "}
                  {new Date(v.createdAt).toLocaleString()}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="metric-grid">
        <div>
          <small>Version A validation</small>
          <strong>{(a.artifact.evaluation.accuracy * 100).toFixed(1)}%</strong>
          <small>{a.artifact.evaluation.total} held-out images</small>
        </div>
        <div>
          <small>Version B validation</small>
          <strong>{(b.artifact.evaluation.accuracy * 100).toFixed(1)}%</strong>
          <small>{b.artifact.evaluation.total} held-out images</small>
        </div>
      </div>
      {comparable(a, b) ? (
        <p className="success">
          Same held-out image hashes and label vocabulary. These validation
          scores share an evaluation set; they are still not an independent
          test.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <p className="notice">
          These versions do not have the same verified validation-set
          fingerprint (or use Phase 1 artifacts). Their accuracy difference is
          not a reliable improvement measurement. Compare on a common
          independent test set before making claims.
        </p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

export function VersionHistory({
  versions,
  activeId,
  projectId,
  onActivate,

  versions: ModelVersion[];
  activeId?: string;
  projectId: string;
  onActivate: (id: string) => void;

                      variant="secondary"
                      disabled={busy || v.id === activeId}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setBusy(true);
                        void activateVersion(projectId, v.id)
                          .then(() => onActivate(v.id))
                          .catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)))
                          .finally(() => setBusy(false));
                      }}
                    >
                      Activate / roll back
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      onClick={() => {
                        try {
                          exportModel(
                            v.artifact,
                            "neuron-v" + (versions.length - i),
                          );
                        } catch (e) {
                          setError(errorMessage(e));
                        }
                      }}
                    >
                      Export
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      {!versions.length && <p className="muted">No versions saved yet.</p>}
    </section>
  );

import { useEffect, useState, lazy, Suspense } from "react";
import { AppShell } from "../components/layout/AppShell";
import { HomePage } from "../pages/HomePage";
import { ProjectsPage } from "../pages/ProjectsPage";
import { ProjectPage } from "../pages/ProjectPage";
const TrainingPage = lazy(() =>
  import("../pages/TrainingPage").then((m) => ({ default: m.TrainingPage })),
);
const PredictPage = lazy(() =>
  import("../pages/PredictPage").then((m) => ({ default: m.PredictPage })),
);
import { SettingsPage } from "../pages/SettingsPage";
import { NotFoundPage } from "../pages/NotFoundPage";
const EvolutionPage = lazy(() =>
  import("../pages/EvolutionPage").then((m) => ({ default: m.EvolutionPage })),
);
function currentRoute() {
  return location.hash.slice(1) || "/";
}
export function App() {
  const [route, setRoute] = useState(currentRoute);
  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => {
      setRoute(currentRoute());
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    };
    window.addEventListener("hashchange", update);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("hashchange", update);
  }, []);
  const match = route.match(
    /^\/projects\/([^/]+)(?:\/(train|predict|evolve))?$/,
  );
  let page;
  if (route === "/") page = <HomePage />;
  else if (route === "/projects") page = <ProjectsPage />;
  else if (route === "/settings") page = <SettingsPage />;
  else if (match) {
    const id = match[1];
    page =
      match[2] === "evolve" ? (
        <EvolutionPage key={route} id={id} />
      ) : match[2] === "train" ? (
        <TrainingPage key={route} id={id} />
      ) : match[2] === "predict" ? (
        <PredictPage key={route} id={id} />
      ) : (
        <ProjectPage key={route} id={id} />
      );
  } else page = <NotFoundPage />;
  return (
    <AppShell route={route}>
      <Suspense fallback={<p role="status">Loading image studio…</p>}>
        {page}
      </Suspense>
    </AppShell>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Camera, Download, Image, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { getProject, listVersions, activateVersion } from "../lib/db";
import {
  type Project,
  type ModelVersion,
  type Prediction,
  errorMessage,
} from "../lib/types";
import { predictor } from "../features/inference/inference.service";
import { normalizeImage } from "../features/datasets/dataset.service";
import { exportModel } from "../lib/model-format";
import { FeedbackCapture } from "../features/inference/FeedbackCapture";
import { Button } from "../components/ui/Button";
import { FileDropzone } from "../components/ui/FileDropzone";
export function PredictPage({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const [project, setProject] = useState<Project | null>(null),
    [versions, setVersions] = useState<ModelVersion[]>([]),
    [selected, setSelected] = useState(""),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [ready, setReady] = useState(false),
    [results, setResults] = useState<Prediction[]>([]),
    [preview, setPreview] = useState(""),
    [camera, setCamera] = useState(false),
    [latency, setLatency] = useState(0);
  const [feedbackBlob, setFeedbackBlob] = useState<Blob | null>(null);
  const engine = useRef<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof predictor>> | null>(null),
    stream = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null),
    video = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null),
    alive = useRef(true),
    inFlight = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    Promise.all([getProject(id), listVersions(id)])
      .then(([p, v]) => {
        if (!alive.current) return;
        setProject(p ?? null);
        setVersions(v);
        setSelected(p?.activeVersionId ?? v[0]?.id ?? "");
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (alive.current) setError(errorMessage(e));
      });
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      stream.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
    };
  }, [id]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!camera || !video.current || !stream.current) return;
    video.current.srcObject = stream.current;
    void video.current.play().catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)));
  }, [camera]);
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setReady(false);
    setResults([]);
    setFeedbackBlob(null);
    const version = versions.find((v) => v.id === selected);
    if (!version) return;
    predictor(version.artifact)
      .then((p) => {
        if (cancelled) p.dispose();
        else {
          engine.current = p;
          setReady(true);
        }
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (!cancelled) setError(errorMessage(e));
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      engine.current?.dispose();
      engine.current = null;
    };
  }, [selected, versions]);
  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      if (preview) URL.revokeObjectURL(preview);
    },
    [preview],
  );
  async function predict(blob: Blob) {
    if (!engine.current || inFlight.current) return;
    inFlight.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    const start = performance.now();
    try {
      const result = await engine.current.predict(blob);
      if (alive.current) {
        setFeedbackBlob(blob);
        setResults(result);
        setLatency(performance.now() - start);
        setPreview(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current) setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      inFlight.current = false;
      if (alive.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  async function fromFile(files: File[]) {
    if (!files[0] || inFlight.current) return;
    setError("");
    try {
      await predict(await normalizeImage(files[0]));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    }
  }
  async function startCamera() {
    try {
      if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia)
        throw new Error(
          "Camera requires HTTPS or localhost and browser camera support.",
        );
      const s = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { width: 640, height: 480 },
        audio: false,
      });
      if (!alive.current) {
        s.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
        return;
      }
      stream.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      stream.current = s;
      setCamera(true);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    }
  }
  function stopCamera() {
    stream.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
    stream.current = null;
    setCamera(false);
  }
  async function capture() {
    const v = video.current;
    if (!v || !v.videoWidth || busy) return;
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = v.videoWidth;
    canvas.height = v.videoHeight;
    canvas.getContext("2d")!.drawImage(v, 0, 0);
    const blob = await new Promise<Blob | null>((resolve) =>
      canvas.toBlob(resolve, "image/jpeg", 0.9),
    );
    if (blob) await predict(blob);
  }
  const version = versions.find((v) => v.id === selected);
  return (
    <>
      <a className="back-link" href={`#/projects/${id}`}>
        ← Dataset
      </a>
      <div className="page-heading">
        <div>
          <div className="eyebrow">03 / ACTIVATE YOUR IDEA</div>
          <h1>Meet your model.</h1>
          <p>
            Test a new image or a camera frame. Predictions run on this device.
          </p>
        </div>
        {version && (
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={() => {
              try {
                exportModel(version.artifact, project?.name ?? "model");
              } catch (e) {
                setError(errorMessage(e));
              }
            }}
          >
            <Download size={16} /> Export model
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
      <a className="small-link" href={`#/projects/${id}/evolve`}>
        Feedback review, comparisons & version history →
      </a>
      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      {!versions.length ? (
        <div className="empty-state">
          <Image size={40} />
          <h2>No saved model yet</h2>
          <p>
            Train your dataset first, or import a supported model in Settings.
          </p>
          <a className="btn btn-primary" href={`#/projects/${id}/train`}>
            Go to training
          </a>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <section className="panel version-bar">
            <label className="field">
              Model version
              <select
                disabled={busy}
                value={selected}
                onChange={(e) => setSelected(e.target.value)}
              >
                {versions.map((v, i) => (
                  <option value={v.id} key={v.id}>
                    Version {versions.length - i} ·{" "}
                    {new Date(v.createdAt).toLocaleString()} ·{" "}
                    {(v.artifact.evaluation.accuracy * 100).toFixed(1)}%
                    validation
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              disabled={
                busy || !project || selected === project.activeVersionId
              }
              onClick={() => {
                if (!project) return;
                void activateVersion(id, selected)
                  .then(() =>
                    setProject({ ...project, activeVersionId: selected }),
                  )
                  .catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)));
              }}
            >
              Make active
            </Button>
          </section>
          <div className="prediction-layout">
            <section className="panel">
              <h2>Give it something new</h2>
              <FileDropzone
                multiple={false}
                disabled={!ready || busy}
                onFiles={(files) => void fromFile(files)}
              />
              <div className="camera-actions">
                {camera ? (
                  <>
                    <Button
                      variant="secondary"
                      disabled={busy || !ready}
                      onClick={() => void capture()}
                    >
                      <Camera size={16} /> Predict this frame
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="ghost" onClick={stopCamera}>
                      Stop camera
                    </Button>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    onClick={() => void startCamera()}
                  >
                    <Camera size={16} /> Use camera
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
              {camera && (
                <video
                  className="camera-video"
                  ref={video}
                  autoPlay
                  muted
                  playsInline
                  aria-label="Camera preview"
                />
              )}
              {preview && !camera && (
                <img
                  className="prediction-image"
                  src={preview}
                  alt="Image being classified"
                />
              )}
            </section>
            <section className="panel">
              <div className="section-heading">
                <h2>Predictions</h2>
                <span className="tag">
                  {busy ? "PROCESSING" : ready ? "LOCAL INFERENCE" : "LOADING"}
                </span>
              </div>
              {results.length ? (
                <>
                  <div className="prediction-winner">
                    {results[0].label}
                    <strong>{(results[0].score * 100).toFixed(1)}%</strong>
                  </div>
                  {results.map((r) => (
                    <div className="prediction-row" key={r.label}>
                      <div>
                        <span>{r.label}</span>
                        <strong>{(r.score * 100).toFixed(1)}%</strong>
                      </div>
                      <progress value={r.score} max={1} />
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  <p className="phase-note">
                    {Math.round(latency)} ms including feature extraction.
                    Scores are relative softmax outputs, not calibrated

                  </p>
                </>
              ) : (
                <div className="empty-monitor">

    [epochs, setEpochs] = useState(20),
    [rate, setRate] = useState(0.001),
    [running, setRunning] = useState(false),
    [progress, setProgress] = useState<TrainingProgress | null>(null),
    [result, setResult] = useState<ModelArtifact | null>(null);
  const controller = useRef<AbortController | null>(null),
    alive = useRef(true),
    lock = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    Promise.all([getProject(id), listSamples(id)])
      .then(([p, s]) => {
        if (alive.current) {
          if (!p) setError("Project not found.");
          setProject(p ?? null);
          setSamples(s);
        }
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (alive.current) setError(errorMessage(e));
      });
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      controller.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [id]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const warn = (e: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
      if (lock.current) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.returnValue = "";
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("beforeunload", warn);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", warn);
  }, []);
  async function start() {
    if (!project || lock.current) return;
    lock.current = true;
    setRunning(true);
    setError("");
    setResult(null);
    const c = new AbortController();
    controller.current = c;
    try {
      const artifact = await train(
        project,
        samples,
        { epochs, learningRate: rate, seed: 42 },
        c.signal,
        (p) => {
          if (alive.current) setProgress(p);
        },
      );
      if (c.signal.aborted) return;
      await commitVersion({
        id: uid(),
        projectId: id,
        artifact,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
      });
      if (alive.current) setResult(artifact);
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current)
        setError(
          e instanceof DOMException && e.name === "AbortError"
            ? "Training cancelled. The previous saved model is unchanged."
            : errorMessage(e),
        );
    } finally {
      lock.current = false;
      if (alive.current) setRunning(false);
      controller.current = null;
    }
  }
  const last = progress?.metrics.at(-1);
  const ready =
    project &&
    project.labels.every(
      (l) => samples.filter((s) => s.labelId === l.id).length >= 5,
    );
  return (
    <>
      <a className="back-link" href={`#/projects/${id}`}>
        ← Dataset
      </a>
      <div className="page-heading">
        <div>
          <div className="eyebrow">02 / TRAIN ON YOUR DEVICE</div>
          <h1>Let your model learn.</h1>
          <p>Real image features. Real weight updates. No cloud training.</p>
        </div>
        <span className="tag">{project?.name ?? "IMAGE STUDIO"}</span>
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <a className="small-link" href={`#/projects/${id}/evolve`}>
        Review feedback & compare saved versions →
      </a>
      <div className="training-layout">
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>Training settings</h2>
          <p className="muted">
            MobileNet v2 extracts image features; a local classifier learns your
            classes.
          </p>
          <label className="field">
            Epochs
            <input
              type="number"
              min="1"
              max="100"
              step="1"
              value={epochs}
              disabled={running}
              onChange={(e) => setEpochs(Number(e.target.value))}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="field">
            Learning rate
            <select
              value={rate}
              disabled={running}
              onChange={(e) => setRate(Number(e.target.value))}
            >
              <option value="0.0001">0.0001 — careful</option>
              <option value="0.001">0.001 — recommended</option>
              <option value="0.01">0.01 — aggressive</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <dl className="summary-list">
            <div>
              <dt>Dataset</dt>
              <dd>{samples.length} images</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Classes</dt>
              <dd>{project?.labels.length ?? 0}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Validation split</dt>
              <dd>20% per class</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Split seed</dt>
              <dd>42</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
          {running ? (
            <Button
              variant="danger"
              onClick={() => controller.current?.abort()}
            >
              <Square size={15} /> Cancel training
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <Button disabled={!ready} onClick={() => void start()}>
              <Play size={16} /> Train model
            </Button>
          )}
          {!ready && (
            <p className="muted">
              Add at least 5 images to each class to begin.
            </p>
          )}
          <p className="phase-note">
            First run installs a verified encoder pack if needed. Keep this page
            open; leaving cancels the job. CPU fallback can be slow.
          </p>
        </section>
        <section className="panel training-monitor">
          <div className="section-heading">
            <h2>
              <Activity size={19} /> Training monitor
            </h2>
            <span className="tag">
              {running ? "RUNNING" : result ? "SAVED" : "READY"}
            </span>
          </div>
          {progress ? (
            <>
              <p role="status">
                {progress.stage} · {progress.done}/{progress.total}
              </p>
              <progress
                className="progress"
                value={progress.done}
                max={progress.total}
              />
              <div className="metric-grid">
                <div>
                  <small>Training accuracy</small>
                  <strong>
                    {last ? `${(last.accuracy * 100).toFixed(1)}%` : "—"}
                  </strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <small>Validation accuracy</small>
                  <strong>
                    {last ? `${(last.valAccuracy * 100).toFixed(1)}%` : "—"}
                  </strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <small>Training loss</small>
                  <strong>{last?.loss.toFixed(4) ?? "—"}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <small>Runtime</small>
                  <strong>{backendName()}</strong>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div
                className="chart"
                aria-label="Epoch training and validation accuracy chart"
              >
                {progress.metrics.map((m) => (
                  <div
                    className="chart-pair"
                    key={m.epoch}
                    title={`Epoch ${m.epoch}: training ${(m.accuracy * 100).toFixed(1)}%, validation ${(m.valAccuracy * 100).toFixed(1)}%`}
                  >
                    <span
                      style={{ height: `${Math.max(1, m.accuracy * 100)}%` }}
                    />
                    <span
                      style={{ height: `${Math.max(1, m.valAccuracy * 100)}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <p className="chart-legend">
                <span>● Training</span>
                <span>● Validation</span>
              </p>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div className="empty-monitor">
              <Activity size={40} />
              <h3>Your training journey starts here</h3>
              <p>
                Live progress and actual epoch metrics will appear when training
                begins.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
          {result && (
            <div className="success">
              <h3>Model trained and saved</h3>
              <p>
                Held-out validation:{" "}
                {(result.evaluation.accuracy * 100).toFixed(1)}% on{" "}
                {result.evaluation.total} images.
              </p>
              <a className="btn btn-primary" href={`#/projects/${id}/predict`}>
                Try your model <ArrowRight size={16} />
              </a>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
      {result && (
        <section className="panel evaluation">
          <h2>Validation confusion matrix</h2>
          <p className="muted">
            Rows: actual class. Columns: predicted class. This is validation
            performance, not a separate test set.
          </p>
          <div className="table-scroll">
            <table>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th scope="col">Actual / predicted</th>
                  {result.labels.map((l) => (
                    <th scope="col" key={l.id}>
                      {l.name}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {result.evaluation.matrix.map((row, i) => (
                  <tr key={result.labels[i].id}>
                    <th scope="row">{result.labels[i].name}</th>
                    {row.map((n, j) => (
                      <td className={i === j ? "diagonal" : ""} key={j}>
                        {n}
                      </td>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ShieldCheck, Upload, HardDrive } from "lucide-react";
import { storageInfo, bytes, capabilities } from "../lib/capabilities";
import { listProjects, importVersion } from "../lib/db";
import { readModel } from "../lib/model-format";
import { type Project, errorMessage, uid } from "../lib/types";
import { RuntimeSettings } from "../features/settings/RuntimeSettings";
import { BackupPanel } from "../features/settings/BackupPanel";
import { Button } from "../components/ui/Button";
export function SettingsPage() {
  const [storage, setStorage] = useState<Awaited<
      ReturnType<typeof storageInfo>
    > | null>(null),
    [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]),
    [selected, setSelected] = useState(""),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [message, setMessage] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const support = capabilities();
  useEffect(() => {
    storageInfo()
      .then(setStorage)
      .catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)));
    listProjects()
      .then((p) => {
        setProjects(p);
        setSelected(p[0]?.id ?? "");
      })
      .catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)));
  }, []);
  async function importFile(file: File) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
    try {
      const artifact = await readModel(file);
      const p = projects.find((p) => p.id === selected);
      if (!p) throw new Error("Create and select a project first.");
      if (
        !confirm(
          `Import this model into “${p.name}”? Its class vocabulary will be replaced and all its existing training images deleted. Existing saved model versions remain available. Export does not restore images.`,
        )
      )
        return;
      await importVersion(p, {
        id: uid(),
        projectId: p.id,
        artifact,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
      });
      setMessage("Model imported. Open this project’s Predict page to use it.");
      setProjects(await listProjects());
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <>
      <div className="page-heading">
        <div>
          <div className="eyebrow">YOUR WORKSPACE, YOUR RULES</div>
          <h1>Privacy & storage</h1>
          <p>Understand what stays here—and what needs a backup.</p>
        </div>
        <ShieldCheck className="accent-icon" size={36} />
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      {message && (
        <p className="success" role="status">
          {message}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="settings-grid">
        <RuntimeSettings />
        <BackupPanel />
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>
            <HardDrive size={20} /> Browser storage
          </h2>
          <div className="storage-number">
            {storage ? bytes(storage.usage) : "…"}
            <small> used by this origin</small>
          </div>
          <p className="muted">
            Estimated quota: {storage ? bytes(storage.quota) : "…"}. Browser
            estimates can change.
          </p>
          <p>
            Persistence:{" "}
            <strong>
              {storage?.persistent ? "Granted" : "Not guaranteed"}
            </strong>
          </p>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={() =>
              void (async () => {
                try {
                  const granted = await navigator.storage?.persist?.();
                  setMessage(
                    granted
                      ? "Persistent storage granted. Still keep backups."
                      : "Your browser did not grant persistence. Export important models.",
                  );
                  setStorage(await storageInfo());
                } catch (e) {
                  setError(errorMessage(e));
                }
              })()
            }
          >
            Request persistent storage
          </Button>
          <p className="phase-note">
            Clearing browser/site data deletes projects. Model exports do not
            include training images. Use the full project backup panel to export
            images and models together.
          </p>
        </section>
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>
            <Upload size={20} /> Import a model
          </h2>
          <p className="muted">
            Only validated NEURON image models exported by this phase. Maximum 8
            MB. Arbitrary TensorFlow graphs or scripts are not accepted.
          </p>
          <label className="field">
            Target project
            <select
              value={selected}
              disabled={busy}
              onChange={(e) => setSelected(e.target.value)}
            >
              {projects.map((p) => (
                <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                  {p.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <input
            ref={input}
            hidden
            type="file"
            accept=".json,application/json"
            onChange={(e) => {
              const file = e.target.files?.[0];
              e.target.value = "";
              if (file) void importFile(file);
            }}
          />
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            disabled={busy || !selected}
            onClick={() => input.current?.click()}
          >
            <Upload size={16} />
            {busy ? "Importing…" : "Choose model file"}
          </Button>
          {!projects.length && (
            <p>
              <a href="#/projects">Create a project first →</a>
            </p>
          )}
        </section>
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>Device capabilities</h2>
          <dl className="summary-list">
            <div>
              <dt>IndexedDB</dt>
              <dd>{support.storage ? "Available" : "Unavailable"}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Camera API</dt>
              <dd>{support.camera ? "Available" : "Unavailable"}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Secure context</dt>
              <dd>{support.secure ? "Yes" : "No"}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>WebGPU API</dt>
              <dd>{support.webgpu ? "Detected (not used)" : "Not detected"}</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
          <p className="phase-note">
            This phase trains with WebGL or CPU—not WebGPU. Detection is not a
            certification of training performance.
          </p>
        </section>
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>The local-first promise</h2>
          <ul className="privacy-list">
            <li>No account or application backend for this workflow.</li>
            <li>No analytics or sample uploads.</li>
            <li>
              Encoder weights download from Google-hosted model endpoints.
            </li>
            <li>Exporting a model is an explicit user action.</li>
            <li>Private mode or storage eviction can remove local data.</li>
            <li>
              Offline reload requires an installed production shell and encoder
              pack. Online share links are not yet implemented.
            </li>
          </ul>
        </section>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

----- CONTENT START -----
# NEURON — Phase 2

Requires the 40-file Phase 1 baseline plus this 40-file Phase 2 update. Do not delete unrelated scaffold files. Node.js 20.19+ or 22.12+, pnpm 9.15.5.

## Run and verify

    pnpm install
    pnpm typecheck
    pnpm test
    pnpm build
    pnpm dev

## Test offline on the PRODUCTION build

    pnpm build
    pnpm --filter @neuron/web preview --port 4173

Open http://localhost:4173. In Settings wait for Application shell → Installed; download the ~14 MB image encoder and wait for Verified. Then disconnect networking and reload. Local projects, training, model import/export and inference are available subject to browser APIs/hardware. Vite development deliberately does not install a service worker. A production service worker precaches hashed application bundles including lazy routes; the encoder is separately SHA-256 pinned. If upstream assets change unexpectedly installation fails closed. Investigate/model-license-review before updating pins, never disable verification.

## Origins matter

Browser storage is scoped to scheme + hostname + port. Projects at localhost:5173 do not automatically appear at localhost:4173, and a deployed domain has separate storage too. This does not mean the projects were deleted. With Phase 2 running on the original origin, export a full project backup there, then restore it on the new origin. Model caches are downloaded separately for each origin. Do not clear site data as a troubleshooting shortcut. Development and production previews should use different ports so a production service worker does not intercept a development session.

## Phase 2 features

- Production app-shell offline caching and explicit safe waiting-update UI.
- Streaming bounded encoder downloads, cancellation, staging-cache commit, cryptographic verification on installation and every cached load. Cache corruption yields an actionable recovery path.
- Full project JSON backups: normalized images, feedback, model versions and active selection. Restores always create a NEW project and remap IDs in a single transaction, after validating checksums, schemas and decoding bounded JPEG images. No executable graphs are imported.
- Explicitly consented prediction feedback → review queue → approve to dataset → manual retrain → choose/rollback model.
- Dataset duplicate detection based on normalized JPEG bytes. This is NOT semantic/near-duplicate detection.
- Model-version comparisons warn when validation fingerprints differ or are missing (legacy Phase 1 artifacts remain usable).
- IndexedDB v1→v2 additive migration preserves existing projects/images/models; adds a feedback store.

Backup limits: 1,000 samples, 100 feedback items, 50 model versions, 32 MB images and a 64 MB JSON file. Limits deliberately bound memory use. Backups are NOT encrypted and contain your images. A model-only export still contains no samples. Do not confuse the two.

## Security and lifecycle

No account or cloud training. Download requests go to Google/Kaggle endpoints; images are never uploaded by local workflows. Explicit local export can reveal sensitive data. Browser storage and caches remain evictable; keep backups outside the browser. Existing shell caches are retained to avoid breaking old open tabs; storage cleanup for old shell versions is not automated in this phase.

Safe explicit updates coordinate running training/download/backup jobs using Web Locks across same-origin tabs. If Web Locks is unavailable, close all NEURON tabs and reopen to apply updates. A first installation claims clients but never forces a waiting update into an existing session. A future browser restart or closing all tabs can also activate a waiting service worker normally.

The app assumes deployment at origin root /. HTTPS/localhost required. Hosting response headers need provider-specific configuration; public/\_headers is honored only by compatible hosts. Keep correct JavaScript MIME types and do not rewrite service-worker.js to HTML. This phase does not deploy the original scaffold's infrastructure stubs.

## Still not completed

Training remains on the main browser thread with async yields. No encrypted public share links, WebRTC, non-image modalities, independent test-dataset UI, continuous camera streaming, semantic duplicate detection, encrypted backups, resumable training, browser-wide storage locks against all manual edits, or universal hardware/performance guarantee. Model evolution is explicit reviewed retraining, never silent self-modification. An accessibility/security/model-license audit and physical-device validation remain release gates. Mobile/OS PWA installation support varies; SVG manifest icon support alone does not certify installability on every device.

## Numerical meaning

Frozen MobileNet V2 [0,1] input normalization matches the published TFJS encoder configuration. Model training updates the local softmax head. Validation data stays out of fit. Fingerprints identify exact normalized bytes and class vocabulary; matching sets do not create an independent test or remove selection bias. Softmax scores are relative outputs, not calibrated certainty.

import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { MODEL_FILES, validateEncoderManifest } from "../pwa/asset-manager";
import { runActivity, activeJobs } from "../pwa/update-manager";
describe("pinned encoder boundary", () => {
  it("pins every shard and manifest", () => {
    expect(MODEL_FILES).toHaveLength(5);
    for (const f of MODEL_FILES) {
      expect(f.hash).toMatch(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
      expect(f.bytes).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }
  });
  it("rejects manifest paths that escape the approved pack", () =>
    expect(() =>
      validateEncoderManifest({
        modelTopology: {},
        weightsManifest: [{ paths: ["../../evil"], weights: [] }],
      }),
    ).toThrow());
  it("accepts the exact bounded shard list", () =>
    expect(
      validateEncoderManifest({
        modelTopology: {},
        weightsManifest: [
          { paths: MODEL_FILES.slice(1).map((f) => f.name), weights: [] },
        ],
      }),
    ).toBeTruthy());
  it("tracks and releases activity on failure", async () => {
    await expect(
      runActivity(async () => {
        expect(activeJobs()).toBe(1);
        throw new Error("cancel");
      }),
    ).rejects.toThrow("cancel");
    expect(activeJobs()).toBe(0);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import {
  encodeBackup,
  decodeBackup,
  validateBackupShape,
  type Snapshot,
} from "../lib/backup-format";
import { sha256 } from "../lib/checksums";
function snapshot(): Snapshot {
  return {
    project: {
      id: "p",
      name: "Plants",
      labels: [
        { id: "a", name: "A" },
        { id: "b", name: "B" },
      ],
      createdAt: 1,
      updatedAt: 2,
    },
    samples: [
      {
        id: "s",
        projectId: "p",
        labelId: "a",
        createdAt: 1,
        blob: new Blob([new Uint8Array([255, 216, 255, 224, 0, 0])], {
          type: "image/jpeg",
        }),
      },
    ],
    versions: [],
    feedback: [],
  };
}
describe("full project backup", () => {
  it("hashes known vectors", async () =>
    expect(await sha256("abc")).toBe(
      "ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad",
    ));
  it("round trips media and remaps IDs without overwriting the source", async () => {
    const s = snapshot(),
      file = await encodeBackup(s),
      restored = await decodeBackup(file);
    expect(restored.project.id).not.toBe("p");
    expect(restored.samples[0].id).not.toBe("s");
    expect(restored.samples[0].projectId).toBe(restored.project.id);
    expect(
      new Uint8Array(await restored.samples[0].blob.arrayBuffer()),
    ).toEqual(new Uint8Array(await s.samples[0].blob.arrayBuffer()));
  });
  it("rejects corrupted media before restore", async () => {
    const raw = JSON.parse(await (await encodeBackup(snapshot())).text());
    raw.samples[0].hash = "0".repeat(64);
    await expect(decodeBackup(new Blob([JSON.stringify(raw)]))).rejects.toThrow(
      "checksum",
    );
  });
  it("rejects missing active versions", async () => {
    const raw = JSON.parse(await (await encodeBackup(snapshot())).text());
    raw.project.activeVersionId = "absent";
    expect(() => validateBackupShape(raw)).toThrow("Active model");
  });
  it("rejects duplicate labels", async () => {
    const raw = JSON.parse(await (await encodeBackup(snapshot())).text());
    raw.project.labels[1].name = "A";
    expect(() => validateBackupShape(raw)).toThrow("classes");
  });
  it("rejects unknown backup formats", async () =>
    await expect(
      decodeBackup(new Blob(['{"format":"javascript"}'])),
    ).rejects.toThrow());
  it("rejects invalid JSON", async () =>
    await expect(decodeBackup(new Blob(["{"]))).rejects.toThrow("JSON"));
  it("enforces sample count", async () => {
    const raw = JSON.parse(await (await encodeBackup(snapshot())).text());
    raw.samples = Array(1001).fill(raw.samples[0]);
    expect(() => validateBackupShape(raw)).toThrow("limits");
  });
});

import "fake-indexeddb/auto";
import { beforeEach, afterAll, describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { openDB, deleteDB } from "idb";
import {
  activateVersion,
  database,
  closeDatabase,
  getProject,
  deleteProject,
  snapshotProject,
} from "../lib/db";
import {
  queueFeedback,
  approveFeedback,
  discardFeedback,
  listFeedback,
  comparable,
} from "../features/evolution/evolution.service";
import type { ModelVersion, Project } from "../lib/types";
const project: Project = {
  id: "p",
  name: "Test",
  labels: [
    { id: "a", name: "A" },
    { id: "b", name: "B" },
  ],
  createdAt: 1,
  updatedAt: 1,
};
const artifact = {
  format: "neuron-image",
  version: 1,
  labels: project.labels,
} as unknown as ModelVersion["artifact"];
const version: ModelVersion = {
  id: "v",
  projectId: "p",
  createdAt: 1,
  artifact,
};
beforeEach(async () => {
  await closeDatabase();
  await deleteDB("neuron-local");
});
afterAll(closeDatabase);
async function setup() {
  const db = await database();
  await db.put("projects", project);
  await db.put("versions", version);
  return db;
}
describe("storage migration and consent workflow", () => {
  it("activation preserves the latest class vocabulary", async () => {
    const db = await setup();
    await db.put("projects", {
      ...project,
      labels: [
        { id: "a", name: "Updated A" },
        { id: "b", name: "B" },
      ],
    });
    await activateVersion("p", "v");
    expect((await getProject("p"))?.labels[0].name).toBe("Updated A");
    expect((await getProject("p"))?.activeVersionId).toBe("v");
  });
  it("rejects activating a version from another project", async () => {
    const db = await setup();
    await db.put("versions", {
      ...version,
      id: "foreign",
      projectId: "different",
    });
    await expect(activateVersion("p", "foreign")).rejects.toThrow("not found");
    expect((await getProject("p"))?.activeVersionId).toBeUndefined();
  });
  it("preserves original v1 records during additive upgrade", async () => {
    const old = await openDB("neuron-local", 1, {
      upgrade(db) {
        db.createObjectStore("projects", { keyPath: "id" });
        db.createObjectStore("samples", { keyPath: "id" }).createIndex(
          "by-project",
          "projectId",
        );
        db.createObjectStore("versions", { keyPath: "id" }).createIndex(
          "by-project",
          "projectId",
        );
      },
    });
    await old.put("projects", project);
    await old.put("versions", version);
    await old.put("samples", {
      id: "legacy",
      projectId: "p",
      labelId: "a",
      createdAt: 1,
      blob: new Blob(["jpeg"], { type: "image/jpeg" }),
    });
    old.close();
    expect(await getProject("p")).toEqual(project);
    const snapshot = await snapshotProject("p");
    expect(snapshot.samples).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(snapshot.versions).toHaveLength(1);
    expect((await database()).objectStoreNames.contains("feedback")).toBe(true);
  });
  it("does not approve a queued image until explicit review", async () => {
    await setup();
    const f = await queueFeedback(
      "p",
      "v",
      "a",
      new Blob(["jpeg"], { type: "image/jpeg" }),
      "B",
    );
    expect((await snapshotProject("p")).samples).toHaveLength(0);
    await approveFeedback(f.id);
    expect((await snapshotProject("p")).samples).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(await listFeedback("p")).toHaveLength(0);
  });
  it("rejects duplicate feedback without consuming the pending item", async () => {
    await setup();
    const blob = new Blob(["same"], { type: "image/jpeg" });
    const a = await queueFeedback("p", "v", "a", blob, "A");
    await approveFeedback(a.id);
    const b = await queueFeedback("p", "v", "b", blob, "A");
    await expect(approveFeedback(b.id)).rejects.toThrow("already exists");
    expect(await listFeedback("p")).toHaveLength(1);
  });
  it("discard does not modify training samples", async () => {
    await setup();
    const f = await queueFeedback(
      "p",
      "v",
      "a",
      new Blob(["jpeg"], { type: "image/jpeg" }),
      "A",
    );
    await discardFeedback(f.id);
    expect((await snapshotProject("p")).samples).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(await listFeedback("p")).toHaveLength(0);
  });
  it("deleting a project deletes related feedback too", async () => {
    await setup();
    await queueFeedback(
      "p",
      "v",
      "a",
      new Blob(["jpeg"], { type: "image/jpeg" }),
      "A",
    );
    await deleteProject("p");
    expect(await listFeedback("p")).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(await getProject("p")).toBeUndefined();
  });
  it("rejects removed classes", async () => {
    await setup();
    await expect(
      queueFeedback(
        "p",
        "v",
        "missing",
        new Blob(["jpeg"], { type: "image/jpeg" }),
        "A",
      ),
    ).rejects.toThrow();
  });
  it("warns on incomparable legacy models", () =>
    expect(comparable(version, version)).toBe(false));
  it("compares only identical validation fingerprints", () => {
    const a = {
      ...version,
      artifact: {
        ...artifact,
        provenance: {
          datasetHash: "1".repeat(64),
          validationHash: "2".repeat(64),
          seed: 42,
          sampleCount: 10,
        },
      },
    };
    expect(comparable(a, a)).toBe(true);
    expect(
      comparable(a, {
        ...a,
        artifact: {
          ...a.artifact,
          provenance: {
            ...a.artifact.provenance,
            validationHash: "3".repeat(64),
          },
        },
      }),
    ).toBe(false);
  });
});
