import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { ArrowRight, Plus, Trash2, Image as ImageIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { getProject, listSamples, saveProject, deleteLabel } from "../lib/db";
import { type Project, type Sample, uid, errorMessage } from "../lib/types";
import { cleanName } from "../features/projects/project.service";
import { addImages, removeSample } from "../features/datasets/dataset.service";
import { Button } from "../components/ui/Button";
import { FileDropzone } from "../components/ui/FileDropzone";
function Thumbnail({
  sample,
  onRemove,
  disabled,
}: {
  sample: Sample;
  onRemove: () => void;
  disabled: boolean;
}) {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    const u = URL.createObjectURL(sample.blob);
    setUrl(u);
    return () => URL.revokeObjectURL(u);
  }, [sample.blob]);
  return (
    <div className="sample-thumb">
      <img src={url} alt="Training sample" />
      <button aria-label="Remove sample" disabled={disabled} onClick={onRemove}>
        ×
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
export function ProjectPage({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const [project, setProject] = useState<Project | null>(null),
    [samples, setSamples] = useState<Sample[]>([]),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [loading, setLoading] = useState(true),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [status, setStatus] = useState("");
  async function refresh() {
    try {
      const [p, s] = await Promise.all([getProject(id), listSamples(id)]);
      if (!p) throw new Error("Project not found.");
      setProject(p);
      setSamples(s);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
  }, [id]);
  async function mutate(action: () => Promise<unknown>) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await action();
      await refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  async function upload(labelId: string, files: File[]) {
    if (!files.length || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const result = await addImages(id, labelId, files, samples.length, (n) =>
        setStatus(`Saved ${n} of ${files.length} images`),
      );
      setStatus(`Added ${result.saved} images.`);
      if (result.errors.length) setError(result.errors.slice(0, 5).join("\n"));
      await refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  async function rename(labelId: string, current: string) {
    if (!project) return;
    const name = prompt("Class name", current);
    if (name === null) return;
    await mutate(async () => {
      const clean = cleanName(name);
      if (
        project.labels.some(
          (l) =>
            l.id !== labelId && l.name.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase(),
        )
      )
        throw new Error("Class name already exists.");
      await saveProject({
        ...project,
        labels: project.labels.map((l) =>
          l.id === labelId ? { ...l, name: clean } : l,
        ),
        updatedAt: Date.now(),
      });
    });
  }
  if (loading) return <p role="status">Loading your project…</p>;
  if (!project)
    return (
      <p className="error" role="alert">
        {error || "Project not found."}
      </p>
    );
  const ready = project.labels.every(
    (l) => samples.filter((s) => s.labelId === l.id).length >= 5,
  );
  return (
    <>
      <a className="back-link" href="#/projects">
        ← All projects
      </a>
      <div className="page-heading">
        <div>
          <div className="eyebrow">01 / CHOOSE YOUR DATA</div>
          <h1>{project.name}</h1>
          <p>
            Give each class a name, then add diverse examples. At least 5 images
            per class.
          </p>
        </div>
        <a
          className={`btn btn-primary ${!ready || busy ? "disabled" : ""}`}
          aria-disabled={!ready || busy}
          href={ready && !busy ? `#/projects/${id}/train` : undefined}
        >
          Train model <ArrowRight size={17} />
        </a>
      </div>
      <a className="small-link" href={`#/projects/${id}/evolve`}>
        Review feedback, compare versions & roll back →
      </a>
      <div className="workflow-tabs">
        <span className="current">1. Dataset</span>
        <a href={`#/projects/${id}/train`}>2. Train & evaluate</a>
        <a href={`#/projects/${id}/predict`}>3. Predict & export</a>
      </div>
      <div className="notice">
        <ImageIcon size={18} />
        <span>
          Your images are processed locally. Uploads are resized to at most
          768px and stored in this browser. Existing models keep their original
          class names until retrained.
        </span>
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      {status && (
        <p role="status" className="muted">
          {status}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="dataset-grid">
        {project.labels.map((label, index) => {
          const images = samples.filter((s) => s.labelId === label.id);
          return (
            <section className="panel class-panel" key={label.id}>
              <div className="section-heading">
                <div className="class-heading">
                  <span className="class-number">
                    {String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    className="class-name"
                    title="Rename class"
                    disabled={busy}
                    onClick={() => void rename(label.id, label.name)}
                  >
                    {label.name} <small>edit</small>
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div className="inline">
                  <span className="count-pill">{images.length}</span>
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    disabled={busy || project.labels.length <= 2}
                    aria-label={`Delete ${label.name}`}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (confirm(`Delete ${label.name} and its samples?`))
                        void mutate(() => deleteLabel(project, label.id));
                    }}
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={15} />
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <FileDropzone
                disabled={busy}
                onFiles={(files) => void upload(label.id, files)}
              />
              <div className="sample-grid">
                {images.slice(0, 120).map((s) => (
                  <Thumbnail
                    key={s.id}
                    sample={s}
                    disabled={busy}
                    onRemove={() => void mutate(() => removeSample(s.id))}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
              {images.length > 120 && (
                <small>Showing the first 120 of {images.length} images.</small>
              )}
              <p
                className={`sample-status ${images.length >= 5 ? "ready" : ""}`}
              >
                {images.length >= 5
                  ? "✓ Ready to train"
                  : `${5 - images.length} more images needed`}
              </p>
            </section>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <Button
        variant="secondary"
        disabled={busy || project.labels.length >= 20}
        onClick={() =>
          void mutate(async () => {
            const name = prompt("New class name");
            if (name === null) return;
            const clean = cleanName(name);
            if (
              project.labels.some(
                (l) => l.name.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase(),
              )
            )
              throw new Error("Class name already exists.");
            await saveProject({
              ...project,
              labels: [...project.labels, { id: uid(), name: clean }],
              updatedAt: Date.now(),
            });
          })
        }
      >
        <Plus size={16} /> Add class
      </Button>
      <p className="phase-note">
        {samples.length} / 1,000 images · Diverse backgrounds and lighting
        improve your model. Avoid duplicate frames: they can inflate validation
        scores.
      </p>
    </>
  );
}
----- CONTENT END -----

WHAT PHASE 3 IMPLEMENTS
------------------------
- Saved model -> explicit consent -> fresh AES-256-GCM encryption -> actual relay
  upload -> expiring link. Every upload uses a fresh CSPRNG key and 96-bit IV, with
  authenticated protocol-specific additional data and a 128-bit authentication tag.
- Whitelisted model fields only. Unknown imported fields are stripped. Project images
  and feedback are not part of the encrypted payload. Model weights may still reveal
  training information, which the consent UI explicitly warns about.
- The encryption key is only in the URL fragment; it is never an API parameter or
  upload header. Recipient strips the incoming key from the visible address bar and
  keeps it in memory. Preserve the ORIGINAL secret link if reopening is needed.
- Recipient explicitly downloads/decrypts, validates the supported artifact, inspects
  its metadata, then imports as a NEW local project. No arbitrary executable model
  graphs or scripts are accepted. Existing local projects are not overwritten.
- Independent deletion capability: a separate random 256-bit token, stored locally
  and sent only in the DELETE Authorization header. Relay stores its SHA-256 hash.
- Downloadable/importable sensitive deletion receipts, separate from project backups.
  Conflicting receipts cannot overwrite existing access/deletion capabilities.
- Local receipt management clearly distinguishes Revoke remote link from Forget local
  receipt. Deleting a project is NOT remote revocation. Lost tokens cannot be recovered
  without a saved receipt. Expiry remains enforced even if a receipt is lost.
- A real Cloudflare Worker router, private R2 ciphertext storage, a transactional
  SQLite-backed Durable Object budget service and an hourly expiry-cleanup handler.
- Strict body sizes, bounded response parsing, canonical secret encodings, route and
  TTL validation, explicit same-origin mutation policy, no-store API responses and
  a service-worker bypass for /api/shares. No secret route data is rendered in nav.
- A usable same-origin development/production-preview proxy and fail-closed cloud
  configuration, not an invented public endpoint or a silently created cloud resource.

REAL LIMITS AND SECURITY BOUNDARIES
------------------------------------
This is a working phase, NOT a claim that the entire NEURON roadmap is finished,
perfect, audited or publicly deployed. Keep later features labeled honestly.

The relay sees client connection metadata, ciphertext length, timing and expiry.
It does not get the encryption key through this protocol. Any holder of the full
secret link can decrypt or reshare. Encryption is not guaranteed availability.
Compromised frontend code, browser extensions, endpoints and recipients are outside
this cryptographic boundary. Do not add analytics/error logs that capture links,
fragments, Authorization headers, receipt files or plaintext model payloads.

A trained model can leak information. "No source image transfer" is not a guarantee
of anonymity or privacy against model inference attacks. Labels/model names can also
be sensitive. Receipts contain BOTH access and deletion capabilities: keep them private.
Project backups deliberately do not contain them; export receipts separately.

Link lifetimes accepted by protocol: 60 seconds, 15 minutes, 1 hour, 24 hours. UI shows
15 minutes / 1 hour / 24 hours. API download denies expired objects immediately and
removes stale data on access. Hourly cron cleans unaccessed expired ciphertext. Cloud
provider backup/retention policy still applies. Revocation cannot erase data someone
already downloaded/imported. The browser verification explicitly demonstrates that.
If an upload is cancelled after server receipt but before the response, an unconfirmed
object can remain until expiry because its reference was not received. No fake claim
of guaranteed cancellation/revocation is made for that distributed-systems case.

Envelope maximum: 8 MB +64 bytes. Model payload maximum: 8 MB. Receipts: 16 KB import.
Worker validates framing and size, NOT the encrypted content's semantics (it lacks
the key). A malicious direct client can upload arbitrary framed bytes. Official
client payload sanitization is not proof that all Internet traffic is a model.

Anonymous fixed-hour budgets, enforced atomically by Durable Object:
  Per client: 3 upload reservations, 30 downloads, 20 deletions per hour.
  Global:     50 uploads, 500 downloads, 500 deletions per hour.
Client keys are salted hashes of Cloudflare's connecting IP; NAT users share limits.
Development may group local users under a local IP. A request rejected after reserving
budget is intentionally not refunded. Restarting/clearing local emulator state is NOT
an application quota bypass feature and is not a production reset mechanism.

Origin/header checks defend browser-origin misuse, not non-browser clients able to
forge HTTP headers. Quotas cannot cap every edge/DO/R2 cost or prevent every DoS.
Provider edge rate limits, billing alerts, kill switches, retention/governance and
abuse review are MANDATORY before exposing anonymous uploads publicly.

DEPLOYMENT IS EXPLICIT, NOT DONE BY THIS HANDOFF
------------------------------------------------
Cloudflare configuration is supplied, but no cloud account, bucket or deployment was
created by the assistant. services/relay/wrangler.toml defaults uploads OFF and has
no permitted production origin. It needs actual operator configuration:
  * Provision the private neuron-encrypted-shares R2 bucket or change its real name.
  * NEVER expose a public bucket URL that bypasses API expiry and deletion.
  * Configure the SQLite Durable Object migration/binding and hourly cron.
  * Set exact ALLOWED_ORIGINS for your actual app origin.
  * Set a strong random >=32-character RATE_SALT using provider secret management.
  * Set ENABLE_UPLOADS=true only after billing/abuse/retention safeguards and tests.
  * Route SAME-ORIGIN /api/shares* to the Worker on the real application domain.
  * Apply HTTPS, correct script MIME types and host-specific security headers.
  * Use a reviewed Wrangler installation under Node 22.12+ to deploy intentionally.

Local development allows localhost and HTTPS *.e2b.app preview origins; production
DOES NOT inherit that preview wildcard. Do not deploy ENVIRONMENT=development.
Do not deploy the original unrelated scaffold's infrastructure placeholders as if
implemented. Static hosting alone does not provide R2, DOs, cron or API routing.
See docs/sharing-protocol.md for exact API/framing/operational requirements.

import { defineConfig, transformWithEsbuild, type Plugin } from "vite";
import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
function offlineShell(): Plugin {
  return {
    name: "neuron-offline-shell",
    apply: "build",
    enforce: "post",
    async generateBundle(_, bundle) {
      const paths = [
        "/offline.html",
        "/favicon.svg",
        "/manifest.webmanifest",
        ...Object.keys(bundle)
          .filter((p) => !p.endsWith(".map"))
          .map((p) => "/" + p),
      ].sort();
      const workerTemplate = readFileSync(
        new URL("./src/pwa/service-worker.ts", import.meta.url),
        "utf8",
      );
      const publicRevision = [
        "offline.html",
        "favicon.svg",
        "manifest.webmanifest",
      ]
        .map((name) =>
          readFileSync(new URL("./public/" + name, import.meta.url), "utf8"),
        )
        .join("\n");
      const revision = createHash("sha256")
        .update(workerTemplate)
        .update(publicRevision)
        .update(paths.join("\n"))
        .update(
          String(
            bundle["index.html"]?.type === "asset"
              ? bundle["index.html"].source
              : "",
          ),
        )
        .digest("hex")
        .slice(0, 16);
      const source = readFileSync(
        new URL("./src/pwa/service-worker.ts", import.meta.url),
        "utf8",
      )
        .replace("__NEURON_PRECACHE__", JSON.stringify(paths))
        .replace("__NEURON_REVISION__", revision);
      const compiled = await transformWithEsbuild(source, "service-worker.ts", {
        loader: "ts",
        target: "es2022",
        minify: true,
      });
      this.emitFile({
        type: "asset",
        fileName: "service-worker.js",
        source: compiled.code,
      });
    },
  };
}
const relayTarget = process.env.NEURON_RELAY_TARGET || "http://127.0.0.1:8787";
const relayURL = new URL(relayTarget);
if (
  !["http:", "https:"].includes(relayURL.protocol) ||
  relayURL.username ||
  relayURL.password
)
  throw new Error("Invalid NEURON_RELAY_TARGET");
const proxy = { "/api/shares": { target: relayTarget, changeOrigin: false } };
export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react(), offlineShell()],
  server: { host: "0.0.0.0", allowedHosts: [".e2b.app", "localhost"], proxy },
  preview: { host: "0.0.0.0", allowedHosts: [".e2b.app", "localhost"], proxy },
  build: {
    target: "es2022",
    rollupOptions: {
      output: {
        manualChunks(id) {
          if (id.includes("@tensorflow")) return "tensorflow";
        },
      },
    },
  },
});

import { AppShell } from "../components/layout/AppShell";
import { HomePage } from "../pages/HomePage";
import { ProjectsPage } from "../pages/ProjectsPage";
import { ProjectPage } from "../pages/ProjectPage";
const TrainingPage = lazy(() =>
  import("../pages/TrainingPage").then((m) => ({ default: m.TrainingPage })),
);
const PredictPage = lazy(() =>
  import("../pages/PredictPage").then((m) => ({ default: m.PredictPage })),
);
import { SettingsPage } from "../pages/SettingsPage";
import { NotFoundPage } from "../pages/NotFoundPage";
const EvolutionPage = lazy(() =>
  import("../pages/EvolutionPage").then((m) => ({ default: m.EvolutionPage })),
);
import "../styles/phase3.css";
const ReceivePage = lazy(() =>
  import("../pages/ReceivePage").then((m) => ({ default: m.ReceivePage })),
);
const SharesPage = lazy(() =>
  import("../pages/SharesPage").then((m) => ({ default: m.SharesPage })),
);
function currentRoute() {
  return location.hash.slice(1) || "/";
}
export function App() {
  const [route, setRoute] = useState(currentRoute);
  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => {
      setRoute(currentRoute());
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    };
    window.addEventListener("hashchange", update);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("hashchange", update);
  }, []);
  const match = route.match(
    /^\/projects\/([^/]+)(?:\/(train|predict|evolve))?$/,
  );
  const received = route.match(
    /^\/receive\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{32})(?:\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}))?$/,
  );
  let page;
  if (route === "/") page = <HomePage />;
  else if (route === "/projects") page = <ProjectsPage />;
  else if (route === "/shares") page = <SharesPage />;
  else if (received)
    page = (
      <ReceivePage
        key={received[1]}
        id={received[1]}
        secret={received[2] ?? ""}
      />
    );
  else if (route === "/settings") page = <SettingsPage />;
  else if (match) {
    const id = match[1];
    page =
      match[2] === "evolve" ? (
        <EvolutionPage key={route} id={id} />
      ) : match[2] === "train" ? (
        <TrainingPage key={route} id={id} />
      ) : match[2] === "predict" ? (
        <PredictPage key={route} id={id} />
      ) : (
        <ProjectPage key={route} id={id} />
      );
  } else page = <NotFoundPage />;
  return (
    <AppShell route={route}>
      <Suspense fallback={<p role="status">Loading image studio…</p>}>
        {page}
      </Suspense>
    </AppShell>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Camera, Download, Image, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { getProject, listVersions, activateVersion } from "../lib/db";
import {
  type Project,
  type ModelVersion,
  type Prediction,
  errorMessage,
} from "../lib/types";
import { predictor } from "../features/inference/inference.service";
import { normalizeImage } from "../features/datasets/dataset.service";
import { exportModel } from "../lib/model-format";
import { FeedbackCapture } from "../features/inference/FeedbackCapture";
import { Button } from "../components/ui/Button";
import { FileDropzone } from "../components/ui/FileDropzone";
import { LinkShareDialog } from "../features/sharing/LinkShareDialog";
export function PredictPage({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const [shareOpen, setShareOpen] = useState(false);
  const [project, setProject] = useState<Project | null>(null),
    [versions, setVersions] = useState<ModelVersion[]>([]),
    [selected, setSelected] = useState(""),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [ready, setReady] = useState(false),
    [results, setResults] = useState<Prediction[]>([]),
    [preview, setPreview] = useState(""),
    [camera, setCamera] = useState(false),
    [latency, setLatency] = useState(0);
  const [feedbackBlob, setFeedbackBlob] = useState<Blob | null>(null);
  const engine = useRef<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof predictor>> | null>(null),
    stream = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null),
    video = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null),
    alive = useRef(true),
    inFlight = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    Promise.all([getProject(id), listVersions(id)])
      .then(([p, v]) => {
        if (!alive.current) return;
        setProject(p ?? null);
        setVersions(v);
        setSelected(p?.activeVersionId ?? v[0]?.id ?? "");
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (alive.current) setError(errorMessage(e));
      });
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      stream.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
    };
  }, [id]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!camera || !video.current || !stream.current) return;
    video.current.srcObject = stream.current;
    void video.current.play().catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)));
  }, [camera]);
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setReady(false);
    setResults([]);
    setFeedbackBlob(null);
    const version = versions.find((v) => v.id === selected);
    if (!version) return;
    predictor(version.artifact)
      .then((p) => {
        if (cancelled) p.dispose();
        else {
          engine.current = p;
          setReady(true);
        }
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (!cancelled) setError(errorMessage(e));
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      engine.current?.dispose();
      engine.current = null;
    };
  }, [selected, versions]);
  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      if (preview) URL.revokeObjectURL(preview);
    },
    [preview],
  );
  async function predict(blob: Blob) {
    if (!engine.current || inFlight.current) return;
    inFlight.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    const start = performance.now();
    try {
      const result = await engine.current.predict(blob);
      if (alive.current) {
        setFeedbackBlob(blob);
        setResults(result);
        setLatency(performance.now() - start);
        setPreview(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (alive.current) setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      inFlight.current = false;
      if (alive.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  async function fromFile(files: File[]) {
    if (!files[0] || inFlight.current) return;
    setError("");
    try {
      await predict(await normalizeImage(files[0]));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    }
  }
  async function startCamera() {
    try {
      if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia)
        throw new Error(
          "Camera requires HTTPS or localhost and browser camera support.",
        );
      const s = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { width: 640, height: 480 },
        audio: false,
      });
      if (!alive.current) {
        s.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
        return;
      }
      stream.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      stream.current = s;
      setCamera(true);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    }
  }
  function stopCamera() {
    stream.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
    stream.current = null;
    setCamera(false);
  }
  async function capture() {
    const v = video.current;
    if (!v || !v.videoWidth || busy) return;
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = v.videoWidth;
    canvas.height = v.videoHeight;
    canvas.getContext("2d")!.drawImage(v, 0, 0);
    const blob = await new Promise<Blob | null>((resolve) =>
      canvas.toBlob(resolve, "image/jpeg", 0.9),
    );
    if (blob) await predict(blob);
  }
  const version = versions.find((v) => v.id === selected);
  return (
    <>
      <a className="back-link" href={`#/projects/${id}`}>
        ← Dataset
      </a>
      <div className="page-heading">
        <div>
          <div className="eyebrow">03 / ACTIVATE YOUR IDEA</div>
          <h1>Meet your model.</h1>
          <p>
            Test a new image or a camera frame. Predictions run on this device.
          </p>
        </div>
        {version && (
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={() => {
              try {
                exportModel(version.artifact, project?.name ?? "model");
              } catch (e) {
                setError(errorMessage(e));
              }
            }}
          >
            <Download size={16} /> Export model
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
      <a className="small-link" href={`#/projects/${id}/evolve`}>
        Feedback review, comparisons & version history →
      </a>
      {version && (
        <div className="share-entry">
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setShareOpen(true)}>
            Create encrypted share link
          </Button>
          <a href="#/shares">Manage share links →</a>
        </div>
      )}
      {shareOpen && version && project && (
        <LinkShareDialog
          project={project}
          version={version}
          onClose={() => setShareOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      {!versions.length ? (
        <div className="empty-state">
          <Image size={40} />
          <h2>No saved model yet</h2>
          <p>
            Train your dataset first, or import a supported model in Settings.
          </p>
          <a className="btn btn-primary" href={`#/projects/${id}/train`}>
            Go to training
          </a>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <section className="panel version-bar">
            <label className="field">
              Model version
              <select
                disabled={busy}
                value={selected}
                onChange={(e) => setSelected(e.target.value)}
              >
                {versions.map((v, i) => (
                  <option value={v.id} key={v.id}>
                    Version {versions.length - i} ·{" "}
                    {new Date(v.createdAt).toLocaleString()} ·{" "}
                    {(v.artifact.evaluation.accuracy * 100).toFixed(1)}%
                    validation
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              disabled={
                busy || !project || selected === project.activeVersionId
              }
              onClick={() => {
                if (!project) return;
                void activateVersion(id, selected)
                  .then(() =>
                    setProject({ ...project, activeVersionId: selected }),
                  )
                  .catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)));
              }}
            >
              Make active
            </Button>
          </section>
          <div className="prediction-layout">
            <section className="panel">
              <h2>Give it something new</h2>
              <FileDropzone
                multiple={false}
                disabled={!ready || busy}
                onFiles={(files) => void fromFile(files)}
              />
              <div className="camera-actions">
                {camera ? (
                  <>
                    <Button
                      variant="secondary"
                      disabled={busy || !ready}
                      onClick={() => void capture()}
                    >
                      <Camera size={16} /> Predict this frame
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="ghost" onClick={stopCamera}>
                      Stop camera
                    </Button>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    onClick={() => void startCamera()}
                  >
                    <Camera size={16} /> Use camera
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
              {camera && (
                <video
                  className="camera-video"
                  ref={video}
                  autoPlay
                  muted
                  playsInline
                  aria-label="Camera preview"
                />
              )}
              {preview && !camera && (
                <img
                  className="prediction-image"
                  src={preview}
                  alt="Image being classified"
                />
              )}
            </section>
            <section className="panel">
              <div className="section-heading">
                <h2>Predictions</h2>
                <span className="tag">
                  {busy ? "PROCESSING" : ready ? "LOCAL INFERENCE" : "LOADING"}
                </span>
              </div>
              {results.length ? (
                <>
                  <div className="prediction-winner">
                    {results[0].label}
                    <strong>{(results[0].score * 100).toFixed(1)}%</strong>
                  </div>
                  {results.map((r) => (
                    <div className="prediction-row" key={r.label}>
                      <div>
                        <span>{r.label}</span>
                        <strong>{(r.score * 100).toFixed(1)}%</strong>
                      </div>
                      <progress value={r.score} max={1} />
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  <p className="phase-note">
                    {Math.round(latency)} ms including feature extraction.
                    Scores are relative softmax outputs, not calibrated
                    probabilities or proof of correctness.
                  </p>
                </>
              ) : (
                <div className="empty-monitor">
                  <RefreshCw size={34} />
                  <p>
                    {ready
                      ? "Add an unseen image to see actual predictions."
                      : "Loading the saved classifier…"}
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="notice">
                No image is uploaded. The verified cached encoder works offline.
                Camera frames are processed only when you choose “Predict this
                frame”.
              </div>
              {feedbackBlob && project && version && results[0] && (
                <FeedbackCapture
                  key={preview}
                  project={project}
                  versionId={version.id}
                  blob={feedbackBlob}
                  predictedLabel={results[0].label}
                />
              )}
            </section>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ShieldCheck, Upload, HardDrive } from "lucide-react";
import { storageInfo, bytes, capabilities } from "../lib/capabilities";
import { listProjects, importVersion } from "../lib/db";
import { readModel } from "../lib/model-format";
import { type Project, errorMessage, uid } from "../lib/types";
import { RuntimeSettings } from "../features/settings/RuntimeSettings";
import { BackupPanel } from "../features/settings/BackupPanel";
import { Button } from "../components/ui/Button";
export function SettingsPage() {
  const [storage, setStorage] = useState<Awaited<
      ReturnType<typeof storageInfo>
    > | null>(null),
    [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]),
    [selected, setSelected] = useState(""),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [message, setMessage] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const support = capabilities();
  useEffect(() => {
    storageInfo()
      .then(setStorage)
      .catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)));
    listProjects()
      .then((p) => {
        setProjects(p);
        setSelected(p[0]?.id ?? "");
      })
      .catch((e) => setError(errorMessage(e)));
  }, []);
  async function importFile(file: File) {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
    try {
      const artifact = await readModel(file);
      const p = projects.find((p) => p.id === selected);
      if (!p) throw new Error("Create and select a project first.");
      if (
        !confirm(
          `Import this model into “${p.name}”? Its class vocabulary will be replaced and all its existing training images deleted. Existing saved model versions remain available. Export does not restore images.`,
        )
      )
        return;
      await importVersion(p, {
        id: uid(),
        projectId: p.id,
        artifact,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
      });
      setMessage("Model imported. Open this project’s Predict page to use it.");
      setProjects(await listProjects());
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorMessage(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <>
      <div className="page-heading">
        <div>
          <div className="eyebrow">YOUR WORKSPACE, YOUR RULES</div>
          <h1>Privacy & storage</h1>
          <p>Understand what stays here—and what needs a backup.</p>
        </div>
        <ShieldCheck className="accent-icon" size={36} />
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p className="error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      {message && (
        <p className="success" role="status">
          {message}
        </p>
      )}
      <section className="panel sharing-settings">
        <h2>Encrypted model sharing</h2>
        <p>
          Create expiring links from a saved model’s Predict page. An optional
          relay stores ciphertext—not your dataset. Keep the deletion receipt to
          revoke a link before expiry.
        </p>
        <a className="btn btn-secondary" href="#/shares">
          Manage encrypted links
        </a>
      </section>
      <div className="settings-grid">
        <RuntimeSettings />
        <BackupPanel />
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>
            <HardDrive size={20} /> Browser storage
          </h2>
          <div className="storage-number">
            {storage ? bytes(storage.usage) : "…"}
            <small> used by this origin</small>
          </div>
          <p className="muted">
            Estimated quota: {storage ? bytes(storage.quota) : "…"}. Browser
            estimates can change.
          </p>
          <p>
            Persistence:{" "}
            <strong>
              {storage?.persistent ? "Granted" : "Not guaranteed"}
            </strong>
          </p>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={() =>
              void (async () => {
                try {
                  const granted = await navigator.storage?.persist?.();
                  setMessage(
                    granted
                      ? "Persistent storage granted. Still keep backups."
                      : "Your browser did not grant persistence. Export important models.",
                  );
                  setStorage(await storageInfo());
                } catch (e) {
                  setError(errorMessage(e));
                }
              })()
            }
          >
            Request persistent storage
          </Button>
          <p className="phase-note">
            Clearing browser/site data deletes projects. Model exports do not
            include training images. Use the full project backup panel to export
            images and models together.
          </p>
        </section>
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>
            <Upload size={20} /> Import a model
          </h2>
          <p className="muted">
            Only validated NEURON image models exported by this phase. Maximum 8
            MB. Arbitrary TensorFlow graphs or scripts are not accepted.
          </p>
          <label className="field">
            Target project
            <select
              value={selected}
              disabled={busy}
              onChange={(e) => setSelected(e.target.value)}
            >
              {projects.map((p) => (
                <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                  {p.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <input
            ref={input}
            hidden
            type="file"
            accept=".json,application/json"
            onChange={(e) => {
              const file = e.target.files?.[0];
              e.target.value = "";
              if (file) void importFile(file);
            }}
          />
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            disabled={busy || !selected}
            onClick={() => input.current?.click()}
          >
            <Upload size={16} />
            {busy ? "Importing…" : "Choose model file"}
          </Button>
          {!projects.length && (
            <p>
              <a href="#/projects">Create a project first →</a>
            </p>
          )}
        </section>
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>Device capabilities</h2>
          <dl className="summary-list">
            <div>
              <dt>IndexedDB</dt>
              <dd>{support.storage ? "Available" : "Unavailable"}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Camera API</dt>
              <dd>{support.camera ? "Available" : "Unavailable"}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Secure context</dt>
              <dd>{support.secure ? "Yes" : "No"}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>WebGPU API</dt>
              <dd>{support.webgpu ? "Detected (not used)" : "Not detected"}</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
          <p className="phase-note">
            This phase trains with WebGL or CPU—not WebGPU. Detection is not a
            certification of training performance.
          </p>
        </section>
        <section className="panel">
          <h2>The local-first promise</h2>
          <ul className="privacy-list">
            <li>No account or application backend for this workflow.</li>
            <li>No analytics or sample uploads.</li>
            <li>
              Encoder weights download from Google-hosted model endpoints.
            </li>
            <li>Exporting a model is an explicit user action.</li>
            <li>Private mode or storage eviction can remove local data.</li>
            <li>
              Offline reload requires an installed production shell and encoder
              pack. Encrypted links require the optional sharing relay; they do
              not work offline.
            </li>
          </ul>
        </section>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

/// <reference lib="webworker" />
export {};
const worker = globalThis as unknown as ServiceWorkerGlobalScope;
// Replaced by the production Vite plugin, never evaluated dynamically.
const ASSETS: string[] = __NEURON_PRECACHE__;
const CACHE = "neuron-shell-__NEURON_REVISION__";
declare const __NEURON_PRECACHE__: string[];
worker.addEventListener("install", (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    (async () => {
      const cache = await caches.open(CACHE);
      try {
        await cache.addAll(
          ASSETS.map((path) => new Request(path, { cache: "reload" })),
        );
      } catch (e) {
        await caches.delete(CACHE);
        throw e;
      }
      // Do not skipWaiting: an existing tab must explicitly authorize the update.
    })(),
  );
});
worker.addEventListener("activate", (event) =>
  event.waitUntil(
    (async () => {
      // Keep prior shell caches. Existing tabs may still reference old lazy chunks.
      // Their explicit cleanup is a later feature, not a destructive automatic action.
      await worker.clients.claim();
    })(),
  ),
);
worker.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  if (event.data?.type === "ACTIVATE_UPDATE")
    event.waitUntil(worker.skipWaiting());
});
worker.addEventListener("fetch", (event) => {
  const request = event.request,
    url = new URL(request.url);
  if (url.pathname.startsWith("/api/shares")) return;
  if (request.method !== "GET" || url.origin !== worker.location.origin) return;
  if (request.mode === "navigate") {
    event.respondWith(
      (async () => {
        const cache = await caches.open(CACHE);
        return (
          (await cache.match("/index.html")) ??
          (await cache.match("/offline.html")) ??
          new Response("Offline app unavailable.", { status: 503 })
        );
      })(),
    );
    return;
  }
  if (
    ASSETS.includes(url.pathname) ||
    /^\/assets\/[^/]+\.(js|css)$/.test(url.pathname)
  )
    event.respondWith(
      (async () => {
        const current = await caches.open(CACHE);
        const hit = await current.match(url.pathname);
        if (hit) return hit;
        // A previous tab can still reference a previous content-hashed lazy chunk.
        for (const name of await caches.keys()) {
          if (name === CACHE || !name.startsWith("neuron-shell-")) continue;
          const cached = await (await caches.open(name)).match(url.pathname);
          if (cached) return cached;
        }
        return fetch(request);
      })(),
    );
});

SHA256: 1d7df4cf9877f9ac0bfb0c140a61c964dfe60ef1b0f13ec4b42fa6e1ed43a1cf

const MAGIC = new Uint8Array([78, 82, 78, 1]);
const AAD = new TextEncoder().encode("NEURON-MODEL-SHARE:v1");
export const MAX_CIPHER_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024 + 64;
export function base64url(bytes: Uint8Array) {
  let raw = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 8192)
    raw += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(i, i + 8192));
  return btoa(raw).replace(/\+/g, "-").replace(/\//g, "_").replace(/=+$/, "");
}
export function unbase64url(value: string, bytes: number) {
  if (
    !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(value) ||
    value.length !== Math.ceil((bytes * 4) / 3)
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid secret encoding.");
  let raw: string;
  try {
    raw = atob(
      value.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/") +
        "=".repeat((4 - (value.length % 4)) % 4),
    );
  } catch {
    throw new Error("Invalid secret encoding.");
  }
  const data = Uint8Array.from(raw, (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
  if (data.length !== bytes || base64url(data) !== value)
    throw new Error("Noncanonical secret encoding.");
  return data;
}
export function randomSecret() {
  return base64url(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32)));
}
export async function secretHash(value: string) {
  unbase64url(value, 32);
  const bytes = await crypto.subtle.digest(
    "SHA-256",
    new TextEncoder().encode(value),
  );
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(bytes), (b) =>
    b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"),
  ).join("");
}
export async function encryptModel(plaintext: Uint8Array) {
  if (plaintext.length > MAX_CIPHER_BYTES - 32)
    throw new Error("Model is too large to share.");
  const secret = randomSecret(),
    iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "raw",
    unbase64url(secret, 32),
    { name: "AES-GCM" },
    false,
    ["encrypt"],
  );
  const encrypted = await crypto.subtle.encrypt(
    { name: "AES-GCM", iv, additionalData: AAD, tagLength: 128 },
    key,
    plaintext as BufferSource,
  );
  const output = new Uint8Array(16 + encrypted.byteLength);
  output.set(MAGIC);
  output.set(iv, 4);
  output.set(new Uint8Array(encrypted), 16);
  return { secret, bytes: output };
}
export async function decryptModel(envelope: Uint8Array, secret: string) {
  if (
    envelope.length < 33 ||
    envelope.length > MAX_CIPHER_BYTES ||
    !MAGIC.every((b, i) => envelope[i] === b)
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid encrypted model envelope.");
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "raw",
    unbase64url(secret, 32),
    { name: "AES-GCM" },
    false,
    ["decrypt"],
  );
  try {
    return new Uint8Array(
      await crypto.subtle.decrypt(
        {
          name: "AES-GCM",
          iv: envelope.slice(4, 16),
          additionalData: AAD,
          tagLength: 128,
        },
        key,
        envelope.slice(16),
      ),
    );
  } catch {
    throw new Error(
      "Cannot decrypt this model. The key is incorrect or the encrypted file was altered.",
    );
  }
}

import { validateArtifact } from "../../lib/model-format";
import type { ModelArtifact } from "../../lib/types";
export type SharedModel = {
  format: "neuron-shared-model";
  version: 1;
  name: string;
  artifact: ModelArtifact;
};
export function shareableArtifact(value: unknown): ModelArtifact {
  const a = validateArtifact(value);
  // Whitelist fields. Unknown fields in an imported model must not hitchhike into shares.
  return {
    format: a.format,
    version: a.version,
    encoder: a.encoder,
    embeddingSize: a.embeddingSize,
    labels: a.labels.map((l) => ({ id: l.id, name: l.name })),
    weightSpecs: a.weightSpecs.map((s) => ({
      name: s.name,
      shape: [...s.shape],
      dtype: s.dtype,
    })),
    weightData: a.weightData,
    epochs: a.epochs.map((e) => ({
      epoch: e.epoch,
      loss: e.loss,
      accuracy: e.accuracy,
      valLoss: e.valLoss,
      valAccuracy: e.valAccuracy,
    })),
    evaluation: {
      accuracy: a.evaluation.accuracy,
      total: a.evaluation.total,
      matrix: a.evaluation.matrix.map((row) => [...row]),
    },
    createdAt: a.createdAt,
    ...(a.provenance
      ? {
          provenance: {
            datasetHash: a.provenance.datasetHash,
            validationHash: a.provenance.validationHash,
            seed: a.provenance.seed,
            sampleCount: a.provenance.sampleCount,
          },
        }
      : {}),
  };
}
export function encodeShared(name: string, artifact: ModelArtifact) {
  if (!name.trim() || name.length > 64) throw new Error("Invalid model name.");
  const payload: SharedModel = {
    format: "neuron-shared-model",
    version: 1,
    name: name.trim(),
    artifact: shareableArtifact(artifact),
  };
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(payload));
  if (bytes.length > 8 * 1024 * 1024)
    throw new Error("Model exceeds the 8 MB sharing limit.");
  return bytes;
}
export function decodeShared(bytes: Uint8Array): SharedModel {
  if (bytes.length > 8 * 1024 * 1024)
    throw new Error("Shared model exceeds the size limit.");
  let value: SharedModel;
  try {
    value = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes));
  } catch {
    throw new Error("Decrypted model is not valid UTF-8 JSON.");
  }
  if (
    !value ||
    value.format !== "neuron-shared-model" ||
    value.version !== 1 ||
    typeof value.name !== "string" ||
    !value.name.trim() ||
    value.name.length > 64
  )
    throw new Error("Unsupported shared model format.");
  return {
    format: "neuron-shared-model",
    version: 1,
    name: value.name,
    artifact: shareableArtifact(value.artifact),
  };
}

import { unbase64url } from "./crypto";
export const validShareId = (id: string) => /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32}$/.test(id);
export function shareLink(origin: string, id: string, secret: string) {
  if (!validShareId(id)) throw new Error("Invalid share reference.");
  unbase64url(secret, 32);
  const url = new URL(origin);
  if (!["https:", "http:"].includes(url.protocol) || url.origin !== origin)
    throw new Error("Invalid application origin.");
  return `${origin}/#/receive/${id}/${secret}`;
}
export function parseShareLink(value: string) {
  const url = new URL(value);
  const match = url.hash.match(
    /^#\/receive\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{32})\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})$/,
  );
  if (
    !match ||
    url.username ||
    url.password ||
    url.search ||
    url.pathname !== "/" ||
    !["https:", "http:"].includes(url.protocol)
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid NEURON share link.");
  unbase64url(match[2], 32);
  return { id: match[1], secret: match[2], origin: url.origin };
}

===== BEGIN FILE 16/40: apps/web/src/features/sharing/relay-client.ts =====
SHA256: 1f7c1042f7c28ca9932841c8609385ec4c505b6f08f331a1a1f4ccb7cfb809ff

import { MAX_CIPHER_BYTES } from "./crypto";
import { validShareId } from "./share-links";
export type RelayHealth = {
  service: "neuron-encrypted-relay";
  version: 1;
  uploadsEnabled: boolean;
  maxBytes: number;
  maxTtlSeconds: number;
};
async function bounded(response: Response, limit: number) {
  if (!response.body) throw new Error("Relay returned an empty response.");
  const reader = response.body.getReader(),
    chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let size = 0;
  try {
    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      size += value.byteLength;
      if (size > limit) {
        await reader.cancel();
        throw new Error("Relay response exceeds the safety limit.");
      }
      chunks.push(value);
    }
  } finally {
    reader.releaseLock();
  }
  const result = new Uint8Array(size);
  let i = 0;
  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    result.set(chunk, i);
    i += chunk.length;
  }
  return result;
}
async function request(
  path: string,
  options: RequestInit = {},
  signal?: AbortSignal,
) {
  let response: Response;
  try {
    response = await fetch("/api/shares" + path, {
      ...options,
      credentials: "omit",
      cache: "no-store",
      redirect: "error",
      signal: signal
        ? AbortSignal.any([signal, AbortSignal.timeout(60000)])
        : AbortSignal.timeout(60000),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    if (signal?.aborted)
      throw new DOMException("Sharing cancelled.", "AbortError");
    throw new Error(
      "Sharing relay is unreachable. Start pnpm dev:relay or configure a same-origin /api/shares route. " +
        (e instanceof Error ? e.message : ""),
    );
  }
  if (!response.ok) {
    let detail = "";
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(
        new TextDecoder().decode(await bounded(response, 8192)),
      );
      if (typeof data.error === "string") detail = data.error.slice(0, 300);
    } catch {
      /* never display untrusted HTML */
    }
    throw new Error(
      `Relay ${response.status}: ${detail || (response.status >= 500 ? "Sharing relay unavailable. Start pnpm dev:relay or check same-origin routing." : "request failed")}`,
    );
  }
  return response;
}
export async function relayHealth(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<RelayHealth> {
  const data = JSON.parse(
    new TextDecoder().decode(
      await bounded(await request("/health", {}, signal), 8192),
    ),
  );
  if (
    data.service !== "neuron-encrypted-relay" ||
    data.version !== 1 ||
    typeof data.uploadsEnabled !== "boolean" ||
    !Number.isInteger(data.maxBytes) ||
    !Number.isInteger(data.maxTtlSeconds)
  )
    throw new Error("Incompatible sharing relay.");
  return data;
}
export async function uploadEncrypted(
  bytes: Uint8Array,
  deleteHash: string,
  ttl: number,
  signal: AbortSignal,
) {
  if (
    bytes.length > MAX_CIPHER_BYTES ||
    !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(deleteHash) ||
    ![60, 900, 3600, 86400].includes(ttl)
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid upload parameters.");
  const response = await request(
    "",
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream",
        "X-Neuron-Client": "1",
        "X-Neuron-Delete-Hash": deleteHash,
        "X-Neuron-TTL": String(ttl),
      },
      body: bytes as BodyInit,
    },
    signal,
  );
  const result = JSON.parse(
    new TextDecoder().decode(await bounded(response, 8192)),
  );
  if (
    !validShareId(result.id ?? "") ||
    !Number.isFinite(result.expiresAt) ||
    result.expiresAt <= 0
  )
    throw new Error("Relay returned invalid share metadata.");
  return result as { id: string; expiresAt: number };
}
export async function downloadEncrypted(id: string, signal: AbortSignal) {
  if (!validShareId(id)) throw new Error("Invalid share reference.");
  return bounded(await request("/" + id, {}, signal), MAX_CIPHER_BYTES);
}
export async function revokeEncrypted(
  id: string,
  token: string,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
) {
  if (!validShareId(id) || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/.test(token))
    throw new Error("Invalid deletion capability.");
  await request(
    "/" + id,
    {
      method: "DELETE",
      headers: { "X-Neuron-Client": "1", Authorization: "Bearer " + token },
    },
    signal,
  );
}

import { openDB } from "idb";
import { parseShareLink, validShareId } from "./share-links";
import { unbase64url } from "./crypto";
export type ShareReceipt = {
  format: "neuron-share-receipt";
  version: 1;
  id: string;
  projectId: string;
  versionId: string;
  name: string;
  createdAt: number;
  expiresAt: number;
  deleteToken: string;
  link: string;
};
const db = () =>
  openDB("neuron-sharing", 1, {
    upgrade(database) {
      database.createObjectStore("receipts", { keyPath: "id" });
    },
  });
export function validateReceipt(value: unknown): ShareReceipt {
  const r = value as ShareReceipt;
  if (
    !r ||
    r.format !== "neuron-share-receipt" ||
    r.version !== 1 ||
    !validShareId(r.id ?? "") ||
    typeof r.projectId !== "string" ||
    r.projectId.length > 100 ||
    typeof r.versionId !== "string" ||
    r.versionId.length > 100 ||
    typeof r.name !== "string" ||
    !r.name.trim() ||
    r.name.length > 64 ||
    !Number.isFinite(r.createdAt) ||
    !Number.isFinite(r.expiresAt) ||
    r.expiresAt <= r.createdAt ||
    typeof r.link !== "string" ||
    r.link.length > 2048
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid share receipt.");
  unbase64url(r.deleteToken, 32);
  if (parseShareLink(r.link).id !== r.id)
    throw new Error("Receipt link does not match its reference.");
  return structuredClone(r);
}
export async function saveReceipt(receipt: ShareReceipt) {
  const database = await db();
  try {
    const safe = validateReceipt(receipt);
    const tx = database.transaction("receipts", "readwrite");
    void tx.done.catch(() => {});
    const existing = await tx.store.get(safe.id);
    if (
      existing &&
      (existing.link !== safe.link || existing.deleteToken !== safe.deleteToken)
    ) {
      tx.abort();
      await tx.done.catch(() => {});
      throw new Error(
        "A conflicting receipt already exists. Existing access/deletion capabilities were not replaced.",
      );
    }
    await tx.store.put(safe);
    await tx.done;
  } finally {
    database.close();
  }
}
export async function listReceipts(): Promise<ShareReceipt[]> {
  const database = await db();
  try {
    return (await database.getAll("receipts"))
      .map(validateReceipt)
      .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
  } finally {
    database.close();
  }
}
export async function forgetReceipt(id: string) {
  const database = await db();
  try {
    await database.delete("receipts", id);
  } finally {
    database.close();
  }
}
export async function importReceipt(file: File, origin: string) {
  if (file.size > 16384) throw new Error("Receipt exceeds the 16 KB limit.");
  const receipt = validateReceipt(JSON.parse(await file.text()));
  if (parseShareLink(receipt.link).origin !== origin)
    throw new Error(
      "This receipt belongs to another application origin. Open that origin to manage it.",
    );
  await saveReceipt(receipt);
  return receipt;
}

import { randomSecret, secretHash, encryptModel, decryptModel } from "./crypto";
import { encodeShared, decodeShared, type SharedModel } from "./share-format";
import { shareLink, parseShareLink } from "./share-links";
import {
  uploadEncrypted,
  downloadEncrypted,
  revokeEncrypted,
} from "./relay-client";
import {
  saveReceipt,
  forgetReceipt,
  type ShareReceipt,
} from "./receipt.repository";
import { runActivity } from "../../pwa/update-manager";
import { database, trackTransaction } from "../../lib/db";
import { uid, type Project, type ModelVersion } from "../../lib/types";
export async function createShare(
  project: Project,
  version: ModelVersion,
  ttl: number,
  origin: string,
  signal: AbortSignal,
) {
  return runActivity(async () => {
    if (version.projectId !== project.id)
      throw new Error("Model does not belong to this project.");
    const token = randomSecret(),
      encoded = encodeShared(project.name, version.artifact),
      encrypted = await encryptModel(encoded);
    signal.throwIfAborted();
    const remote = await uploadEncrypted(
      encrypted.bytes,
      await secretHash(token),
      ttl,
      signal,
    );
    const receipt: ShareReceipt = {
      format: "neuron-share-receipt",
      version: 1,
      id: remote.id,
      projectId: project.id,
      versionId: version.id,
      name: project.name,
      createdAt: remote.expiresAt - ttl * 1000,
      expiresAt: remote.expiresAt,
      deleteToken: token,
      link: shareLink(origin, remote.id, encrypted.secret),
    };
    let persisted = true;
    try {
      await saveReceipt(receipt);
    } catch {
      persisted = false;
    }
    return { receipt, persisted };
  });
}
export async function receiveShare(
  id: string,
  secret: string,
  signal: AbortSignal,
) {
  return runActivity(async () =>
    decodeShared(
      await decryptModel(await downloadEncrypted(id, signal), secret),
    ),
  );
}
export async function importReceived(model: SharedModel) {
  return runActivity(async () => {
    const safe = decodeShared(encodeShared(model.name, model.artifact)),
      now = Date.now(),
      project: Project = {
        id: uid(),
        name: safe.name,
        labels: safe.artifact.labels,
        createdAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
      },
      version: ModelVersion = {
        id: uid(),
        projectId: project.id,
        artifact: safe.artifact,
        createdAt: now,
      };
    project.activeVersionId = version.id;
    const db = await database(),
      tx = trackTransaction(
        db.transaction(["projects", "versions"], "readwrite"),
      );
    await tx.objectStore("projects").add(project);
    await tx.objectStore("versions").add(version);
    await tx.done;
    return project;
  });
}
export async function revokeShare(receipt: ShareReceipt, origin: string) {
  if (parseShareLink(receipt.link).origin !== origin)
    throw new Error(
      "Manage this receipt from its original application origin.",
    );
  return runActivity(async () => {
    await revokeEncrypted(receipt.id, receipt.deleteToken);
    await forgetReceipt(receipt.id);
  });
}

import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import {
  encryptModel,
  decryptModel,
  randomSecret,
  secretHash,
  base64url,
  unbase64url,
} from "../features/sharing/crypto";
describe("authenticated model encryption", () => {
  it("roundtrips bytes with a fresh key and IV", async () => {
    const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode("sensitive weights");
    const a = await encryptModel(bytes),
      b = await encryptModel(bytes);
    expect(a.secret).not.toBe(b.secret);
    expect(a.bytes).not.toEqual(b.bytes);
    expect(await decryptModel(a.bytes, a.secret)).toEqual(bytes);
  });

  });

  });

export interface Env {
  SHARES: R2Bucket;
  LIMITER: DurableObjectNamespace;
  ENVIRONMENT: string;
  ENABLE_UPLOADS: string;
  ALLOWED_ORIGINS: string;
  RATE_SALT: string;
}
export const MAX_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024 + 64;
export const TTL_VALUES = [60, 900, 3600, 86400];
export function allowedOrigin(origin: string | null, env: Env) {
  if (!origin) return false;
  let parsed: URL;
  try {
    parsed = new URL(origin);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
  if (parsed.origin !== origin) return false;
  if (
    env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS.split(",")
      .map((s) => s.trim())
      .filter(Boolean)
      .includes(origin)
  )
    return true;
  return (
    env.ENVIRONMENT === "development" &&
    ((["localhost", "127.0.0.1"].includes(parsed.hostname) &&
      parsed.protocol === "http:") ||
      (parsed.hostname.endsWith(".e2b.app") && parsed.protocol === "https:"))
  );
}
export function checkProduction(env: Env) {
  if (
    env.ENVIRONMENT !== "development" &&
    (!env.RATE_SALT || env.RATE_SALT.length < 32)
  )
    throw new HttpError(
      503,
      "Relay operator must configure a strong RATE_SALT secret.",
    );
}
export class HttpError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public status: number,
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
  }
}
export function secure(response: Response) {
  const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
  headers.set("Cache-Control", "no-store, max-age=0");
  headers.set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
  headers.set("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer");
  headers.set("Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy", "same-origin");
  return new Response(response.body, { status: response.status, headers });
}

import { HttpError, MAX_BYTES, TTL_VALUES } from "../config";
export const validId = (s: string) => /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32}$/.test(s);
export function ttlValue(value: string | null) {
  if (!value || !/^\d+$/.test(value) || !TTL_VALUES.includes(Number(value)))
    throw new HttpError(400, "Unsupported link lifetime.");
  return Number(value);
}
export function deletionHash(value: string | null) {
  if (!value || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(value))
    throw new HttpError(400, "Invalid deletion capability hash.");
  return value;
}
export function deletionToken(request: Request) {
  const match = request.headers
    .get("Authorization")
    ?.match(/^Bearer ([A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})$/);
  if (!match) throw new HttpError(401, "Deletion capability required.");
  return match[1];
}
export async function hashToken(value: string) {
  const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest(
    "SHA-256",
    new TextEncoder().encode(value),
  );
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hash), (b) =>
    b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"),
  ).join("");
}
export function constantEqual(a: string, b: string) {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  let difference = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++)
    difference |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
  return difference === 0;
}
export function randomId() {
  return btoa(
    String.fromCharCode(...crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(24))),
  )
    .replace(/\+/g, "-")
    .replace(/\//g, "_")
    .replace(/=+$/, "");
}
export async function readCiphertext(request: Request) {
  const type = request.headers
    .get("Content-Type")
    ?.split(";")[0]
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();
  if (type !== "application/octet-stream")
    throw new HttpError(415, "Only encrypted binary envelopes are accepted.");
  const declared = request.headers.get("Content-Length");
  if (declared && (!/^\d+$/.test(declared) || Number(declared) > MAX_BYTES))
    throw new HttpError(413, "Encrypted model exceeds the size limit.");
  if (!request.body) throw new HttpError(400, "Missing encrypted envelope.");
  const reader = request.body.getReader(),
    chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let total = 0;
  try {
    while (true) {
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      total += value.byteLength;
      if (total > MAX_BYTES) {
        await reader.cancel();
        throw new HttpError(413, "Encrypted model exceeds the size limit.");
      }
      chunks.push(value);
    }
  } finally {
    reader.releaseLock();
  }
  const output = new Uint8Array(total);
  let offset = 0;
  for (const c of chunks) {
    output.set(c, offset);
    offset += c.length;
  }
  if (
    output.length < 33 ||
    output[0] !== 78 ||
    output[1] !== 82 ||
    output[2] !== 78 ||
    output[3] !== 1
  )
    throw new HttpError(400, "Invalid encrypted-envelope header.");
  return output;
}

import { type Env, HttpError } from "../config";
import { constantEqual, hashToken } from "./validation";
const objectKey = (id: string) => "share/" + id;
export async function storeCipher(
  env: Env,
  id: string,
  bytes: Uint8Array,
  deleteHash: string,
  expiresAt: number,
) {
  await env.SHARES.put(objectKey(id), bytes, {
    customMetadata: { deleteHash, expiresAt: String(expiresAt) },
    httpMetadata: { contentType: "application/octet-stream" },
  });
}
export async function fetchCipher(env: Env, id: string) {
  const object = await env.SHARES.get(objectKey(id));
  if (!object) throw new HttpError(404, "Share not found or already removed.");
  const expiry = Number(object.customMetadata?.expiresAt);
  if (!Number.isFinite(expiry) || expiry <= Date.now()) {
    await env.SHARES.delete(object.key);
    throw new HttpError(410, "Expired share.");
  }
  return new Response(object.body, {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream",
      "Content-Length": String(object.size),
      "Content-Disposition": 'attachment; filename="neuron-model.enc"',
      "X-Neuron-Expires-At": String(expiry),
    },
  });
}
export async function removeCipher(env: Env, id: string, token: string) {
  const object = await env.SHARES.head(objectKey(id));
  if (!object) throw new HttpError(404, "Share not found or already removed.");
  if (
    !constantEqual(
      await hashToken(token),
      object.customMetadata?.deleteHash ?? "",
    )
  )
    throw new HttpError(403, "Incorrect deletion capability.");
  await env.SHARES.delete(object.key);
}
export async function purgeExpired(env: Env) {
  let cursor: string | undefined;
  let deleted = 0;
  do {
    const page = await env.SHARES.list({
      prefix: "share/",
      cursor,
      limit: 200,
      include: ["customMetadata"],
    });
    const expired = page.objects
      .filter(
        (o) =>
          !Number.isFinite(Number(o.customMetadata?.expiresAt)) ||
          Number(o.customMetadata?.expiresAt) <= Date.now(),
      )
      .map((o) => o.key);
    if (expired.length) {
      await env.SHARES.delete(expired);
      deleted += expired.length;
    }
    cursor = page.truncated ? page.cursor : undefined;
  } while (cursor);
  return deleted;
}

import { type Env, HttpError } from "../config";
import { hashToken } from "./validation";
export async function reserve(
  env: Env,
  request: Request,
  action: "upload" | "download" | "delete",
) {
  // Cloudflare supplies CF-Connecting-IP at the edge. Do not trust client-supplied
  // forwarding headers on an unrelated production Node reverse proxy.
  const ip = request.headers.get("CF-Connecting-IP") || "local-development";
  const client = await hashToken(env.RATE_SALT + "|" + ip);
  const stub = env.LIMITER.get(
    env.LIMITER.idFromName("neuron-global-budget-v1"),
  );
  const response = await stub.fetch("https://budget.internal/reserve", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({ client, action }),
  });
  if (response.status === 429)
    throw new HttpError(
      429,
      "Sharing rate limit reached. Retry after the hourly window resets.",
    );
  if (!response.ok)
    throw new HttpError(503, "Sharing budget service unavailable.");
}

type Counts = { upload: number; download: number; delete: number };
type Budget = { hour: number; global: Counts; clients: Record<string, Counts> };
const empty = (): Counts => ({ upload: 0, download: 0, delete: 0 });
const PER_CLIENT: Counts = { upload: 3, download: 30, delete: 20 };
const GLOBAL: Counts = { upload: 50, download: 500, delete: 500 };
export class RateLimiter {
  constructor(private state: DurableObjectState) {}
  async fetch(request: Request) {
    let input: { client?: string; action?: keyof Counts };
    try {
      input = await request.json();
    } catch {
      return new Response("Invalid budget request", { status: 400 });
    }
    const action = input.action,
      client = input.client;
    if (
      !action ||
      !["upload", "download", "delete"].includes(action) ||
      !client ||
      !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(client)
    )
      return new Response("Invalid budget request", { status: 400 });
    const allowed = await this.state.storage.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const hour = Math.floor(Date.now() / 3600000);
      let budget = await tx.get<Budget>("budget");
      if (!budget || budget.hour !== hour)
        budget = { hour, global: empty(), clients: {} };
      if (budget.global[action] >= GLOBAL[action]) return false;
      const personal = budget.clients[client] ?? empty();
      if (personal[action] >= PER_CLIENT[action]) return false;
      // The global budgets bound successful new client entries to <=1050/hour.
      budget.global[action]++;
      personal[action]++;
      budget.clients[client] = personal;
      await tx.put("budget", budget);
      return true;
    });
    return new Response(null, { status: allowed ? 204 : 429 });
  }
}

import {
  type Env,
  HttpError,
  MAX_BYTES,
  allowedOrigin,
  checkProduction,
} from "./config";
import {
  validId,
  ttlValue,
  deletionHash,
  deletionToken,
  randomId,
  readCiphertext,
} from "./lib/validation";
import { storeCipher, fetchCipher, removeCipher } from "./lib/object-store";
import { reserve } from "./lib/rate-limit";
export async function route(request: Request, env: Env) {
  const url = new URL(request.url),
    base = "/api/shares";
  if (url.search)
    throw new HttpError(400, "Query parameters are not supported.");
  if (url.pathname === base + "/health" && request.method === "GET")
    return Response.json({
      service: "neuron-encrypted-relay",
      version: 1,
      uploadsEnabled: env.ENABLE_UPLOADS === "true",
      maxBytes: MAX_BYTES,
      maxTtlSeconds: 86400,
    });
  if (!url.pathname.startsWith(base)) throw new HttpError(404, "Not found.");
  checkProduction(env);
  const origin = request.headers.get("Origin");
  if (origin && !allowedOrigin(origin, env))
    throw new HttpError(403, "Application origin is not allowed.");
  if (request.method === "POST" || request.method === "DELETE") {
    if (
      !allowedOrigin(origin, env) ||
      request.headers.get("X-Neuron-Client") !== "1"
    )
      throw new HttpError(403, "Same-origin application request required.");
  }
  if (url.pathname === base && request.method === "POST") {
    if (env.ENABLE_UPLOADS !== "true")
      throw new HttpError(503, "Relay uploads are disabled by the operator.");
    const ttl = ttlValue(request.headers.get("X-Neuron-TTL")),
      hash = deletionHash(request.headers.get("X-Neuron-Delete-Hash"));
    await reserve(env, request, "upload");
    const bytes = await readCiphertext(request),
      id = randomId(),
      expiresAt = Date.now() + ttl * 1000;
    await storeCipher(env, id, bytes, hash, expiresAt);
    return Response.json({ id, expiresAt }, { status: 201 });
  }
  const match = url.pathname.match(/^\/api\/shares\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{32})$/);
  if (!match || !validId(match[1]))
    throw new HttpError(404, "Share route not found.");
  const id = match[1];
  if (request.method === "GET") {
    await reserve(env, request, "download");
    return fetchCipher(env, id);
  }
  if (request.method === "DELETE") {
    const token = deletionToken(request);
    await reserve(env, request, "delete");
    await removeCipher(env, id, token);
    return new Response(null, { status: 204 });
  }
  throw new HttpError(405, "Method not allowed.");
}

import { type Env, HttpError, secure } from "./config";
import { route } from "./router";
import { purgeExpired } from "./lib/object-store";
export { RateLimiter } from "./durable-objects/RateLimiter";
export default {
  async fetch(request: Request, env: Env): Promise<Response> {
    try {
      return secure(await route(request, env));
    } catch (e) {
      const known = e instanceof HttpError;
      return secure(
        Response.json(
          { error: known ? e.message : "Relay operation failed. Retry later." },
          {
            status: known ? e.status : 503,
            headers: known && e.status === 429 ? { "Retry-After": "3600" } : {},
          },
        ),
      );
    }
  },
  async scheduled(_event: ScheduledEvent, env: Env, context: ExecutionContext) {
    context.waitUntil(purgeExpired(env));
  },
};

# NEURON encrypted model sharing — protocol v1

Training remains local. Sharing is optional and online. It distributes the selected supported image classifier, never the project dataset. A trained model can still reveal sensitive information.

## Secrets and framing

The sender creates a fresh AES-256-GCM key and independent 256-bit deletion token using Web Crypto's CSPRNG. Ciphertext bytes are: ASCII NRN, version byte 1, 12-byte random IV, AES-GCM ciphertext with a 128-bit tag. Authenticated additional data is `NEURON-MODEL-SHARE:v1`. Payload is bounded UTF-8 JSON: format/version, model name and a whitelisted validated artifact. Unknown imported fields are stripped before encryption.

A relay POST receives ciphertext, SHA-256 of the deletion token and requested TTL. It generates a 192-bit random object reference. The encryption key NEVER enters the API request; it is in `/#/receive/{reference}/{key}`. URL fragments are not sent in HTTP requests. A recipient removes the incoming key from the visible address bar using replaceState and keeps it in memory; a refresh loses it. Preserve the original secret link to reopen.

The full link is a bearer capability. Anyone holding it can download/decrypt before expiry. The separate deletion token is stored locally in a receipt and sent only in the Authorization header on DELETE. No server-side decryption is possible through this protocol. The relay does not receive or store the decryption key. IP addresses, timing, ciphertext length and expiry are NOT hidden. Browser extensions, compromised client code and shared-link recipients are outside this encryption boundary.

## API (same-origin routing required)

- GET `/api/shares/health`: protocol/version and upload availability.
- POST `/api/shares`: binary body, `X-Neuron-Client: 1`, `X-Neuron-TTL`, `X-Neuron-Delete-Hash`. Returns reference and server expiry timestamp.
- GET `/api/shares/{id}`: bounded ciphertext; no deletion metadata returned.
- DELETE `/api/shares/{id}`: `Authorization: Bearer {deletion token}` and application header. Successful deletion returns 204.

All API responses are no-store. The service worker bypasses this prefix. Mutation requests must have an explicitly allowed browser Origin and application header. This is CSRF/origin hardening, NOT authentication against non-browser clients that can forge headers. No-account anonymous upload always requires abuse/billing oversight; do not call it abuse-proof.

Limits: encrypted envelope <=8 MB +64 bytes. Allowed TTLs: 60, 900, 3600, 86400 seconds; UI exposes 15 minutes/1 hour/24 hours. Download checks enforce expiry immediately; hourly cron physically removes expired objects even if never fetched. Provider backup/retention policy still applies. A scheduled delay does not grant post-expiry downloads through this API. Revocation cannot remove already-downloaded copies or plaintext exports.

A single transactional Durable Object enforces fixed-hour budgets: per-client upload 3, download 30, delete 20; global upload 50, download 500, delete 500. A salted hash of Cloudflare's connecting IP is used, not raw IP in application storage. The worker secret must be strong in production. Global budgets bound successful new client entries; NAT users share limits. These budgets do not cap every possible edge/R2/DO billing cost, and are not a replacement for provider rate controls, alerts and a kill switch. Failed reservations are not refunded to prevent retry abuse.

The server can validate envelope framing/size, NOT prove ciphertext decrypts to a model: it lacks the key. The official client encrypts only whitelisted model content. A malicious direct API client can upload arbitrary bytes disguised as an envelope; governance/abuse controls remain necessary. Expiry and deletion are capabilities, not account recovery.

Receipts live in a SEPARATE IndexedDB database so deleting a project does not lose revocation access automatically. They contain both link and deletion secret. Download them privately. Project backups deliberately omit them. Import receipts only into the same app origin. Forget local receipt is NOT revoke. Clearing browser data without exporting a receipt loses early-revocation access, while expiry remains enforced.

## Deployment

Worker implementation: `services/relay/src`; R2 binding SHARES; SQLite-backed Durable Object LIMITER; scheduled cron. `wrangler.toml` fails closed with uploads disabled. The bucket name is a real resource to provision, not a credential. Keep the R2 bucket private: never enable a public bucket endpoint that bypasses API expiry/deletion. Set exact production ALLOWED_ORIGINS; generate a >=32-character random RATE_SALT using the provider secret manager. Enable uploads only after setting billing alerts, edge rate controls, retention review and tests. Deploy via a reviewed Wrangler installation under Node 22.12+; no deployment is performed by local scripts.

Static frontend and API must share the browser origin. Route `/api/shares*` to the Worker at the provider; do not rely on Vite's development proxy in production. The existing public/\_headers needs host-specific application. Do not ship storage credentials or RATE_SALT in frontend/VITE variables. Do not log full links, fragments, Authorization headers or receipt JSON. Configure access logs and error monitoring accordingly. Cloudflare infrastructure may retain connection metadata independently.

Local Miniflare uses actual Worker/R2/DO runtime behavior but is NOT a public production deployment. It listens on 8787, with ciphertext state under services/relay/.local (gitignored). That state is development-only and may disappear in ephemeral sandboxes or manual cleanup. Web dev and production-preview proxies use server-only NEURON_RELAY_TARGET, default http://127.0.0.1:8787. Browser code always uses relative paths. Local dev allows localhost and HTTPS \*.e2b.app origins; production does not inherit that wildcard.

## Toolchain pins

The root pnpm overrides pin Miniflare’s transitive undici to 7.30.2 and sharp to 0.35.5, tested with this runtime. Earlier resolved versions had registry advisories. Keep these overrides and the generated lockfile; do not silently switch package managers or remove them. Advisory checks are point-in-time, not proof of security.
