# NEURON — Phase 3

Apply this 40-file update on top of the complete Phase 1 + Phase 2 baseline. Real local image training, offline packs, backups and reviewed evolution remain intact. Phase 3 adds optional encrypted, expiring model links using a real Worker/R2/Durable Object relay. No cloud deployment or billing resources are silently created.

## Requirements and commands

Node.js **22.12+** (tested with 22.23.4), pnpm 9.15.5. Relay tooling requires Node 22; do not run the new whole-workspace tests on Node 20.

    pnpm install
    pnpm typecheck
    pnpm test
    pnpm build

Terminal 1: `pnpm dev:relay` (8787). Terminal 2: `pnpm dev` (usually 5173). The relay compiles on startup; restart it after relay source edits. Frontend requests `/api/shares` relative to the app; Vite proxies to 8787. `NEURON_RELAY_TARGET` is a SERVER-ONLY override, not a browser API URL or VITE secret. Both servers must be running for local sharing. Training itself needs no relay.

For production-build/offline testing: `pnpm build`, then `pnpm --filter @neuron/web preview --port 4173 --strictPort`. Keep the relay running for online sharing. Install the production shell and verified encoder in Settings before disconnecting. A complete offline reload is not installed by the dev server. Browser data is origin-specific: a change in scheme/host/port creates a different storage scope. Use a Phase 2 full backup to transfer projects between origins; model caches must be installed separately.

## Share workflow

1. Train/save a model or restore/import an existing supported image model.
2. Open Predict → Create encrypted share link. Approve upload and choose expiry.
3. The model is sanitized, encrypted locally, uploaded as ciphertext; images and feedback are omitted.
4. Copy the full secret link; privately download the deletion receipt as a backup.
5. Recipient opens link, explicitly downloads/decrypts, inspects metadata, then imports as a NEW local project. Existing projects are not overwritten.
6. Sender manages receipts at Encrypted share links. Revoke remote link uses the separate deletion token. Forget local receipt is explicitly not revocation.

The recipient page removes the key from the visible address bar. Refreshing that page loses the in-memory key; reopen the original secret link. All links/receipts are sensitive. Models may leak training information. Encryption does not hide network metadata, ciphertext size or expiry. A relay operator can withhold availability; cryptographic confidentiality is not guaranteed availability. Downloaded copies cannot be revoked. An upload cancelled after receipt by the server can leave ciphertext until expiry if the response/reference is lost.

Receipts have a separate IndexedDB database, not a main-project schema migration. Phase 2 data remains database version 2. Close older app tabs before upgrading, preserve existing user changes, and do not clear site data to fix build problems. Project backups do not include share receipts. Keep receipts private and backed up separately. The root pnpm overrides for Miniflare’s undici/sharp dependencies are deliberate tested advisory fixes; retain them and the generated lockfile.

## What is production code vs production deployment

The encryption, client, Worker/R2/DO service, expiry/deletion and browser flows are implemented and exercised locally. Cloud provisioning is NOT performed. Production operator must provision R2, configure the same-origin route, exact allowed origins, RATE_SALT secret, cron, HTTPS/security headers, billing/abuse safeguards and provider retention review. The supplied production config disables uploads by default. See docs/sharing-protocol.md. Static hosting alone cannot asynchronously distribute models without optional storage infrastructure.

The server cannot inspect encrypted content; it checks framing/limits, and the official browser client restricts payloads. Origin checks are not account authentication. Anonymous services remain vulnerable to cost/abuse pressure; quotas, provider controls and alerts are mandatory before public exposure. Local emulation is not cloud deployment certification.

## Remaining work

No WebRTC/P2P, non-image training modalities, worker-isolated training, independent test-set UI, continuous camera streaming, resumable training, encrypted dataset backups, universal device certification or completed release audit. Existing Phase 2 safeguards and limits remain. Old shell caches are retained for old open tabs. Accessibility, physical hardware/GPU/memory, model licensing, security and deployed operational audits remain release gates. The app is not claimed perfect or feature-complete merely because a build passes.

## Next work is capability-driven, not arithmetic

Prioritize one real remaining subsystem at a time: local text classification; audio/keyword training with explicit microphone consent; bounded video frame workflows; compatible custom model contracts; encrypted CSV sharing; optional P2P signaling/transfer; package consolidation; operator deployment automation and broader performance/accessibility/physical-browser coverage. The order depends on the product’s needs. None of these are implicitly complete because a file exists.

Existing full project backups are the migration boundary. Preserve image/CSV/sharing databases and deletion capabilities while adding future formats. Do not overwrite a user's real repository with the original generator to make the ledger look complete.

# NEURON encrypted model sharing — protocol v1

Training remains local. Sharing is optional and online. It distributes the selected supported image classifier, never the project dataset. A trained model can still reveal sensitive information.

## Secrets and framing

The sender creates a fresh AES-256-GCM key and independent 256-bit deletion token using Web Crypto's CSPRNG. Ciphertext bytes are: ASCII NRN, version byte 1, 12-byte random IV, AES-GCM ciphertext with a 128-bit tag. Authenticated additional data is `NEURON-MODEL-SHARE:v1`. Payload is bounded UTF-8 JSON: format/version, model name and a whitelisted validated artifact. Unknown imported fields are stripped before encryption.

A relay POST receives ciphertext, SHA-256 of the deletion token and requested TTL. It generates a 192-bit random object reference. The encryption key NEVER enters the API request; it is in `/#/receive/{reference}/{key}`. URL fragments are not sent in HTTP requests. A recipient removes the incoming key from the visible address bar using replaceState and keeps it in memory; a refresh loses it. Preserve the original secret link to reopen.

The full link is a bearer capability. Anyone holding it can download/decrypt before expiry. The separate deletion token is stored locally in a receipt and sent only in the Authorization header on DELETE. No server-side decryption is possible through this protocol. The relay does not receive or store the decryption key. IP addresses, timing, ciphertext length and expiry are NOT hidden. Browser extensions, compromised client code and shared-link recipients are outside this encryption boundary.

## API (same-origin routing required)

- GET `/api/shares/health`: protocol/version and upload availability.
- POST `/api/shares`: binary body, `X-Neuron-Client: 1`, `X-Neuron-TTL`, `X-Neuron-Delete-Hash`. Returns reference and server expiry timestamp.
- GET `/api/shares/{id}`: bounded ciphertext; no deletion metadata returned.
- DELETE `/api/shares/{id}`: `Authorization: Bearer {deletion token}` and application header. Successful deletion returns 204.

All API responses are no-store. The service worker bypasses this prefix. Mutation requests must have an explicitly allowed browser Origin and application header. This is CSRF/origin hardening, NOT authentication against non-browser clients that can forge headers. No-account anonymous upload always requires abuse/billing oversight; do not call it abuse-proof.

Limits: encrypted envelope <=8 MB +64 bytes. Allowed TTLs: 60, 900, 3600, 86400 seconds; UI exposes 15 minutes/1 hour/24 hours. Download checks enforce expiry immediately; hourly cron physically removes expired objects even if never fetched. Provider backup/retention policy still applies. A scheduled delay does not grant post-expiry downloads through this API. Revocation cannot remove already-downloaded copies or plaintext exports.

A single transactional Durable Object enforces fixed-hour budgets: per-client upload 3, download 30, delete 20; global upload 50, download 500, delete 500. A salted hash of Cloudflare's connecting IP is used, not raw IP in application storage. The worker secret must be strong in production. Global budgets bound successful new client entries; NAT users share limits. These budgets do not cap every possible edge/R2/DO billing cost, and are not a replacement for provider rate controls, alerts and a kill switch. Failed reservations are not refunded to prevent retry abuse.

The server can validate envelope framing/size, NOT prove ciphertext decrypts to a model: it lacks the key. The official client encrypts only whitelisted model content. A malicious direct API client can upload arbitrary bytes disguised as an envelope; governance/abuse controls remain necessary. Expiry and deletion are capabilities, not account recovery.

Receipts live in a SEPARATE IndexedDB database so deleting a project does not lose revocation access automatically. They contain both link and deletion secret. Download them privately. Project backups deliberately omit them. Import receipts only into the same app origin. Forget local receipt is NOT revoke. Clearing browser data without exporting a receipt loses early-revocation access, while expiry remains enforced.

## Deployment

Worker implementation: `services/relay/src`; R2 binding SHARES; SQLite-backed Durable Object LIMITER; scheduled cron. `wrangler.toml` fails closed with uploads disabled. The bucket name is a real resource to provision, not a credential. Keep the R2 bucket private: never enable a public bucket endpoint that bypasses API expiry/deletion. Set exact production ALLOWED_ORIGINS; generate a >=32-character random RATE_SALT using the provider secret manager. Enable uploads only after setting billing alerts, edge rate controls, retention review and tests. Deploy via a reviewed Wrangler installation under Node 22.12+; no deployment is performed by local scripts.

Static frontend and API must share the browser origin. Route `/api/shares*` to the Worker at the provider; do not rely on Vite's development proxy in production. The existing public/\_headers needs host-specific application. Do not ship storage credentials or RATE_SALT in frontend/VITE variables. Do not log full links, fragments, Authorization headers or receipt JSON. Configure access logs and error monitoring accordingly. Cloudflare infrastructure may retain connection metadata independently.

Local Miniflare uses actual Worker/R2/DO runtime behavior but is NOT a public production deployment. It listens on 8787, with ciphertext state under services/relay/.local (gitignored). That state is development-only and may disappear in ephemeral sandboxes or manual cleanup. Web dev and production-preview proxies use server-only NEURON_RELAY_TARGET, default http://127.0.0.1:8787. Browser code always uses relative paths. Local dev allows localhost and HTTPS \*.e2b.app origins; production does not inherit that wildcard.

## Toolchain pins

The root pnpm overrides pin Miniflare’s transitive undici to 7.30.2 and sharp to 0.35.5, tested with this runtime. Earlier resolved versions had registry advisories. Keep these overrides and the generated lockfile; do not silently switch package managers or remove them. Advisory checks are point-in-time, not proof of security.

import { readFile, stat } from "node:fs/promises";
import { resolve, dirname, relative, extname } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
const root = fileURLToPath(new URL("../", import.meta.url)),
  web = resolve(root, "apps/web"),
  visited = new Set(),
  queue = [resolve(web, "src/main.tsx")],
  failures = [];
async function locate(path) {
  for (const suffix of [
    "",
    ".ts",
    ".tsx",
    ".js",
    ".mjs",
    ".css",
    ".json",
    "/index.ts",
    "/index.tsx",
  ]) {
    try {
      const candidate = path + suffix;
      if ((await stat(candidate)).isFile()) return candidate;
    } catch {}
  }
  return null;
}
while (queue.length) {
  const file = queue.pop();
  if (visited.has(file)) continue;
  visited.add(file);
  const text = await readFile(file, "utf8");
  if (/PLANNED MODULE|Not implemented\. See the architecture/.test(text))
    failures.push("Reachable scaffold placeholder: " + relative(root, file));
  if (![".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".mjs"].includes(extname(file))) continue;
  const imports = [
    ...text.matchAll(
      /(?:\bfrom\s*|\bimport\s*\(\s*|\bimport\s*)(['"])([^'"\n]+)\1/g,
    ),
  ].map((m) => m[2]);
  // Vite statically bundles these module worker URLs as a separate graph.
  for (const match of text.matchAll(
    /new URL\(\s*(['"])([^'"\n]+)\1\s*,\s*import\.meta\.url\s*\)/g,
  ))
    imports.push(match[2]);
  for (const specifier of imports) {
    if (!specifier.startsWith(".")) {
      if (/^node:|^miniflare$|^wrangler$/.test(specifier))
        failures.push(
          "Server dependency in browser graph: " + relative(root, file),
        );
      continue;
    }
    const path = resolve(dirname(file), specifier);
    if (!path.startsWith(web + "/") && !path.startsWith(web + "\\")) {
      failures.push(
        "Browser source escapes app boundary: " + relative(root, file),
      );
      continue;
    }
    const found = await locate(path);
    if (!found)
      failures.push(
        "Missing relative module: " + relative(root, file) + " -> " + specifier,
      );
    else queue.push(found);
  }
}
if (failures.length) {
  console.error(failures.join("\n"));
  process.exitCode = 1;

export interface Env {
  SHARES: R2Bucket;
  LIMITER: DurableObjectNamespace;
  ENVIRONMENT: string;
  ENABLE_UPLOADS: string;
  ALLOWED_ORIGINS: string;
  RATE_SALT: string;
}
export const MAX_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024 + 64;
export const TTL_VALUES = [60, 900, 3600, 86400];
export function allowedOrigin(origin: string | null, env: Env) {
  if (!origin) return false;
  let parsed: URL;
  try {
    parsed = new URL(origin);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
  if (parsed.origin !== origin) return false;
  if (
    env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS.split(",")
      .map((s) => s.trim())
      .filter(Boolean)
      .includes(origin)
  )
    return true;
  return (
    env.ENVIRONMENT === "development" &&
    ((["localhost", "127.0.0.1"].includes(parsed.hostname) &&
      parsed.protocol === "http:") ||
      (parsed.hostname.endsWith(".e2b.app") && parsed.protocol === "https:"))
  );
}
export function checkProduction(env: Env) {
  if (
    env.ENVIRONMENT !== "development" &&
    (!env.RATE_SALT || env.RATE_SALT.length < 32)
  )
    throw new HttpError(
      503,
      "Relay operator must configure a strong RATE_SALT secret.",
    );
}
export class HttpError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public status: number,
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
  }
}
export function secure(response: Response) {
  const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
  headers.set("Cache-Control", "no-store, max-age=0");
  headers.set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
  headers.set("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer");
  headers.set("Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy", "same-origin");
  return new Response(response.body, { status: response.status, headers });
}

===== FILE services/relay/src/durable-objects/RateLimiter.ts | bytes=1715 | sha256=4eebb9e97deb10705dc939f90ee698e92836e1614566455eecd3f04b7655c3d9 =====
CONTENT START
type Counts = { upload: number; download: number; delete: number };
type Budget = { hour: number; global: Counts; clients: Record<string, Counts> };
const empty = (): Counts => ({ upload: 0, download: 0, delete: 0 });
const PER_CLIENT: Counts = { upload: 3, download: 30, delete: 20 };
const GLOBAL: Counts = { upload: 50, download: 500, delete: 500 };
export class RateLimiter {
  constructor(private state: DurableObjectState) {}
  async fetch(request: Request) {
    let input: { client?: string; action?: keyof Counts };
    try {
      input = await request.json();
    } catch {
      return new Response("Invalid budget request", { status: 400 });
    }
    const action = input.action,
      client = input.client;
    if (
      !action ||
      !["upload", "download", "delete"].includes(action) ||
      !client ||
      !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(client)
    )
      return new Response("Invalid budget request", { status: 400 });
    const allowed = await this.state.storage.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const hour = Math.floor(Date.now() / 3600000);
      let budget = await tx.get<Budget>("budget");
      if (!budget || budget.hour !== hour)
        budget = { hour, global: empty(), clients: {} };
      if (budget.global[action] >= GLOBAL[action]) return false;
      const personal = budget.clients[client] ?? empty();
      if (personal[action] >= PER_CLIENT[action]) return false;
      // The global budgets bound successful new client entries to <=1050/hour.
      budget.global[action]++;
      personal[action]++;
      budget.clients[client] = personal;
      await tx.put("budget", budget);
      return true;
    });
    return new Response(null, { status: allowed ? 204 : 429 });
  }
}

  async fetch(request: Request, env: Env): Promise<Response> {

===== FILE services/relay/src/lib/object-store.ts | bytes=2248 | sha256=0f4df409e768a5d1f7b8b37fc962f91f0ddaa0a46164181e1f37d25d62d2af6b =====

import { type Env, HttpError } from "../config";
import { constantEqual, hashToken } from "./validation";
const objectKey = (id: string) => "share/" + id;
export async function storeCipher(
  env: Env,
  id: string,
  bytes: Uint8Array,
  deleteHash: string,
  expiresAt: number,
) {
  await env.SHARES.put(objectKey(id), bytes, {
    customMetadata: { deleteHash, expiresAt: String(expiresAt) },
    httpMetadata: { contentType: "application/octet-stream" },
  });
}
export async function fetchCipher(env: Env, id: string) {
  const object = await env.SHARES.get(objectKey(id));
  if (!object) throw new HttpError(404, "Share not found or already removed.");
  const expiry = Number(object.customMetadata?.expiresAt);
  if (!Number.isFinite(expiry) || expiry <= Date.now()) {
    await env.SHARES.delete(object.key);
    throw new HttpError(410, "Expired share.");
  }
  return new Response(object.body, {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream",
      "Content-Length": String(object.size),
      "Content-Disposition": 'attachment; filename="neuron-model.enc"',
      "X-Neuron-Expires-At": String(expiry),
    },
  });
}
export async function removeCipher(env: Env, id: string, token: string) {
  const object = await env.SHARES.head(objectKey(id));
  if (!object) throw new HttpError(404, "Share not found or already removed.");
  if (
    !constantEqual(
      await hashToken(token),
      object.customMetadata?.deleteHash ?? "",
    )
  )
    throw new HttpError(403, "Incorrect deletion capability.");
  await env.SHARES.delete(object.key);
}
export async function purgeExpired(env: Env) {
  let cursor: string | undefined;
  let deleted = 0;
  do {
    const page = await env.SHARES.list({
      prefix: "share/",
      cursor,
      limit: 200,
      include: ["customMetadata"],
    });
    const expired = page.objects
      .filter(
        (o) =>
          !Number.isFinite(Number(o.customMetadata?.expiresAt)) ||
          Number(o.customMetadata?.expiresAt) <= Date.now(),
      )
      .map((o) => o.key);
    if (expired.length) {
      await env.SHARES.delete(expired);
      deleted += expired.length;
    }
    cursor = page.truncated ? page.cursor : undefined;
  } while (cursor);
  return deleted;
}

import { type Env, HttpError } from "../config";
import { hashToken } from "./validation";
export async function reserve(
  env: Env,
  request: Request,
  action: "upload" | "download" | "delete",
) {
  // Cloudflare supplies CF-Connecting-IP at the edge. Do not trust client-supplied
  // forwarding headers on an unrelated production Node reverse proxy.
  const ip = request.headers.get("CF-Connecting-IP") || "local-development";
  const client = await hashToken(env.RATE_SALT + "|" + ip);
  const stub = env.LIMITER.get(
    env.LIMITER.idFromName("neuron-global-budget-v1"),
  );
  const response = await stub.fetch("https://budget.internal/reserve", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({ client, action }),
  });
  if (response.status === 429)
    throw new HttpError(
      429,
      "Sharing rate limit reached. Retry after the hourly window resets.",
    );
  if (!response.ok)
    throw new HttpError(503, "Sharing budget service unavailable.");
}

===== FILE services/relay/src/lib/validation.ts | bytes=2838 | sha256=f47f3bb0a925a47d143115ef347ac3b4b44e63bca762a9d09c3b7b7e92e80905 =====
CONTENT START
import { HttpError, MAX_BYTES, TTL_VALUES } from "../config";
export const validId = (s: string) => /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32}$/.test(s);
export function ttlValue(value: string | null) {
  if (!value || !/^\d+$/.test(value) || !TTL_VALUES.includes(Number(value)))
    throw new HttpError(400, "Unsupported link lifetime.");
  return Number(value);
}
export function deletionHash(value: string | null) {
  if (!value || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(value))
    throw new HttpError(400, "Invalid deletion capability hash.");
  return value;
}
export function deletionToken(request: Request) {
  const match = request.headers
    .get("Authorization")
    ?.match(/^Bearer ([A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})$/);
  if (!match) throw new HttpError(401, "Deletion capability required.");
  return match[1];
}
export async function hashToken(value: string) {
  const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest(
    "SHA-256",
    new TextEncoder().encode(value),
  );
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hash), (b) =>
    b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"),
  ).join("");
}
export function constantEqual(a: string, b: string) {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  let difference = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++)
    difference |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
  return difference === 0;
}
export function randomId() {
  return btoa(
    String.fromCharCode(...crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(24))),
  )
    .replace(/\+/g, "-")
    .replace(/\//g, "_")
    .replace(/=+$/, "");
}
export async function readCiphertext(request: Request) {
  const type = request.headers
    .get("Content-Type")
    ?.split(";")[0]
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();
  if (type !== "application/octet-stream")
    throw new HttpError(415, "Only encrypted binary envelopes are accepted.");
  const declared = request.headers.get("Content-Length");
  if (declared && (!/^\d+$/.test(declared) || Number(declared) > MAX_BYTES))
    throw new HttpError(413, "Encrypted model exceeds the size limit.");
  if (!request.body) throw new HttpError(400, "Missing encrypted envelope.");
  const reader = request.body.getReader(),
    chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let total = 0;
  try {
    while (true) {
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      total += value.byteLength;
      if (total > MAX_BYTES) {
        await reader.cancel();
        throw new HttpError(413, "Encrypted model exceeds the size limit.");
      }
      chunks.push(value);
    }
  } finally {
    reader.releaseLock();
  }
  const output = new Uint8Array(total);
  let offset = 0;
  for (const c of chunks) {
    output.set(c, offset);
    offset += c.length;
  }
  if (
    output.length < 33 ||
    output[0] !== 78 ||
    output[1] !== 82 ||
    output[2] !== 78 ||
    output[3] !== 1
  )
    throw new HttpError(400, "Invalid encrypted-envelope header.");
  return output;
}

===== FILE services/relay/src/router.ts | bytes=2504 | sha256=af9be8b2fd04a296967c3549f7262e014f9b4445f2536a60fc7881fb99b26bd0 =====
CONTENT START
import {
  type Env,
  HttpError,
  MAX_BYTES,
  allowedOrigin,
  checkProduction,
} from "./config";
import {
  validId,
  ttlValue,
  deletionHash,
  deletionToken,
  randomId,
  readCiphertext,
} from "./lib/validation";
import { storeCipher, fetchCipher, removeCipher } from "./lib/object-store";
import { reserve } from "./lib/rate-limit";
export async function route(request: Request, env: Env) {
  const url = new URL(request.url),
    base = "/api/shares";
  if (url.search)
    throw new HttpError(400, "Query parameters are not supported.");
  if (url.pathname === base + "/health" && request.method === "GET")
    return Response.json({
      service: "neuron-encrypted-relay",
      version: 1,
      uploadsEnabled: env.ENABLE_UPLOADS === "true",
      maxBytes: MAX_BYTES,
      maxTtlSeconds: 86400,
    });
  if (!url.pathname.startsWith(base)) throw new HttpError(404, "Not found.");
  checkProduction(env);
  const origin = request.headers.get("Origin");
  if (origin && !allowedOrigin(origin, env))
    throw new HttpError(403, "Application origin is not allowed.");
  if (request.method === "POST" || request.method === "DELETE") {
    if (
      !allowedOrigin(origin, env) ||
      request.headers.get("X-Neuron-Client") !== "1"
    )
      throw new HttpError(403, "Same-origin application request required.");
  }
  if (url.pathname === base && request.method === "POST") {
    if (env.ENABLE_UPLOADS !== "true")
      throw new HttpError(503, "Relay uploads are disabled by the operator.");
    const ttl = ttlValue(request.headers.get("X-Neuron-TTL")),
      hash = deletionHash(request.headers.get("X-Neuron-Delete-Hash"));
    await reserve(env, request, "upload");
    const bytes = await readCiphertext(request),
      id = randomId(),
      expiresAt = Date.now() + ttl * 1000;
    await storeCipher(env, id, bytes, hash, expiresAt);
    return Response.json({ id, expiresAt }, { status: 201 });
  }
  const match = url.pathname.match(/^\/api\/shares\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{32})$/);
  if (!match || !validId(match[1]))
    throw new HttpError(404, "Share route not found.");
  const id = match[1];
  if (request.method === "GET") {
    await reserve(env, request, "download");
    return fetchCipher(env, id);
  }
  if (request.method === "DELETE") {
    const token = deletionToken(request);
    await reserve(env, request, "delete");
    await removeCipher(env, id, token);
    return new Response(null, { status: 204 });
  }
  throw new HttpError(405, "Method not allowed.");
}

import { beforeAll, afterAll, describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { Miniflare } from "miniflare";
import { build } from "esbuild";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";

import { purgeExpired } from "../src/lib/object-store";
import { route } from "../src/router";
let mf: Miniflare;
let ip = 0;
const origin = "http://localhost:5173";
const hash = createHash("sha256").update("a".repeat(43)).digest("hex");
const cipher = () => new Uint8Array([78, 82, 78, 1, ...Array(60).fill(7)]);
function headers(extra: Record<string, string> = {}) {
  return {
    Origin: origin,
    "CF-Connecting-IP": "198.51.100." + ++ip,
    "X-Neuron-Client": "1",
    ...extra,
  };
}
async function upload(extra: Record<string, string> = {}) {
  return mf.dispatchFetch("https://relay.test/api/shares", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: headers({
      "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream",
      "X-Neuron-TTL": "3600",
      "X-Neuron-Delete-Hash": hash,
      ...extra,
    }),
    body: cipher(),
  });
}

  const result = await build({
    entryPoints: [fileURLToPath(new URL("../src/index.ts", import.meta.url))],
    bundle: true,
    write: false,
    format: "esm",
    platform: "browser",
    target: "es2022",
  });
  mf = new Miniflare({
    modules: true,
    script: result.outputFiles[0].text,
    compatibilityDate: "2026-07-01",
    r2Buckets: ["SHARES"],

      ENABLE_UPLOADS: "true",

      RATE_SALT: "test-only-salt-not-a-production-secret",
    },
  });
  await mf.ready;
});
afterAll(async () => {
  await mf?.dispose();

describe("real Worker + R2 + Durable Object relay", () => {
  it("fails closed when production has no rate secret", () =>
    expect(() =>
      checkProduction({ ENVIRONMENT: "production", RATE_SALT: "" } as Env),
    ).toThrow("RATE_SALT"));
  it("does not inherit the development preview-origin wildcard in production", () =>
    expect(
      allowedOrigin("https://untrusted.e2b.app", {
        ENVIRONMENT: "production",
        ALLOWED_ORIGINS: origin,
      } as Env),
    ).toBe(false));

    const env = {
      ENVIRONMENT: "production",
      RATE_SALT: "x".repeat(32),
      ALLOWED_ORIGINS: origin,
      ENABLE_UPLOADS: "false",
    } as Env;
    const request = new Request("https://relay.test/api/shares", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: headers(),
    });
    await expect(route(request as never, env)).rejects.toThrow("disabled");
  });

    const bucket = await mf.getR2Bucket("SHARES");
    await bucket.put("share/expired-for-cron", cipher(), {
      customMetadata: {
        expiresAt: String(Date.now() - 1000),
        deleteHash: hash,
      },
    });
    await bucket.put("share/live-for-cron", cipher(), {
      customMetadata: {
        expiresAt: String(Date.now() + 3600000),
        deleteHash: hash,
      },
    });
    expect(
      await purgeExpired({ SHARES: bucket } as unknown as Env),
    ).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(await bucket.get("share/expired-for-cron")).toBeNull();
    expect(await bucket.get("share/live-for-cron")).not.toBeNull();

  });
  it("rejects wrong deletion capability, then revokes with the right one", async () => {

    const path = "https://relay.test/api/shares/" + data.id;
    const bad = await mf.dispatchFetch(path, {
      method: "DELETE",
      headers: headers({ Authorization: "Bearer " + "b".repeat(43) }),
    });
    expect(bad.status).toBe(403);
    const good = await mf.dispatchFetch(path, {
      method: "DELETE",

    bytes.set([78, 82, 78, 1]);

        "X-Neuron-TTL": "3600",
        "X-Neuron-Delete-Hash": hash,

      body: bytes,

  });
  it("limits each client to three upload reservations per hour", async () => {
    const sameIP = "203.0.113.9";
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++)
      expect((await upload({ "CF-Connecting-IP": sameIP })).status).toBe(201);
    const r = await upload({ "CF-Connecting-IP": sameIP });
    expect(r.status).toBe(429);
    expect(r.headers.get("retry-after")).toBe("3600");

async function imageProject(page: import("@playwright/test").Page) {
  await page.goto("/#/projects");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "New project", exact: true }).click();
  await page
    .getByLabel("Project name", { exact: true })

    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 900, 1200);

test("real normalization worker bounds images; metadata export excludes names/pixels/secrets", async ({
  page,
}) => {

      r.onsuccess = () => resolve(r.result);
    });
    const sample = await new Promise<{ blob: Blob }>((resolve) => {
      const q = db.transaction("samples").objectStore("samples").getAll();
      q.onsuccess = () => resolve(q.result[0]);
    });
    db.close();
    const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(sample.blob);
    const size = [bitmap.width, bitmap.height];

      "No reference, stored checksum or numeric model-format issues were found in the checked records.",
      { exact: true },
    ),
  ).toBeVisible();
  const downloaded = page.waitForEvent("download");
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Download metadata-only diagnostics" })
    .click();
  const file = await downloaded,
    contents = await readFile((await file.path())!, "utf8"),
    report = JSON.parse(contents);
  expect(report.format).toBe("neuron-local-diagnostics");
  expect(report.inventory.image.samples).toBe(1);
  for (const value of [
    "Private source project",
    "private-photo",
    "deleteToken",
    "weightData",
    "labelId",
    "data:image",
  ])
    expect(contents).not.toContain(value);
});
test("read-only integrity scan detects corrupt image checksum and does not delete data", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await imageProject(page);
  await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const r = indexedDB.open("neuron-local", 2),
      db = await new Promise<IDBDatabase>((resolve) => {
        r.onsuccess = () => resolve(r.result);
      });
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction("samples", "readwrite"),
        q = tx.objectStore("samples").getAll();
      q.onsuccess = () =>
        tx.objectStore("samples").put({ ...q.result[0], hash: "0".repeat(64) });
      tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
    });
    db.close();
  });
  await page.goto("/#/settings");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Scan local data integrity" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText(/Integrity scan complete:/)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator(".storage-report")).toContainText(
    "checksum does not match",
  );
  await page.getByRole("link", { name: "My projects", exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByRole("link", { name: /Private source project/ }).click();
  await expect(page.locator(".sample-thumb")).toHaveCount(1);
});
test("safe image-model import creates a new project without deleting source samples", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await imageProject(page);
  const weightData = Buffer.alloc((1280 * 2 + 2) * 4).toString("base64");
  const model = {
    format: "neuron-image",
    version: 1,
    encoder: "mobilenet-v2-1.0",
    embeddingSize: 1280,
    labels: [
      { id: "a", name: "One" },
      { id: "b", name: "Two" },
    ],
    weightSpecs: [
      { name: "head_0", shape: [1280, 2], dtype: "float32" },
      { name: "head_1", shape: [2], dtype: "float32" },
    ],
    weightData,
    epochs: [
      { epoch: 1, loss: 0.69, accuracy: 0.5, valLoss: 0.69, valAccuracy: 0.5 },
    ],
    evaluation: {
      accuracy: 0.5,
      total: 2,
      matrix: [
        [1, 0],
        [1, 0],
      ],
    },
    createdAt: Date.now(),
  };
  await page.goto("/#/settings");
  await page
    .getByRole("button", {
      name: "Import image model as new project",
      exact: true,
    })
    .click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");
  await dialog.locator("input[type=file]").setInputFiles({
    name: "fixture.neuron.json",
    mimeType: "application/json",
    buffer: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(model)),
  });
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Validated image model" }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await page
    .getByRole("checkbox", {
      name: /Import these weights and labels into a NEW local project/,
    })
    .check();
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Import image model as new", exact: true })
    .click();
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Meet your model." }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole("link", { name: "My projects", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.locator(".project-card")).toHaveCount(2);
  await page.getByRole("link", { name: /Private source project/ }).click();
  await expect(page.locator(".sample-thumb")).toHaveCount(1);
});

test("sample pagination exposes records beyond the old 120-thumbnail limit", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  const route = await imageProject(page);
  // Seed a view-only pagination fixture, not a training-quality/duplicate test.
  // Normal ingestion's real duplicate guard is covered by the regression run.
  await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const request = indexedDB.open("neuron-local", 2);
    const db = await new Promise<IDBDatabase>((resolve) => {
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
    });
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction("samples", "readwrite"),
        store = tx.objectStore("samples"),
        read = store.getAll();
      read.onsuccess = () => {
        const original = read.result[0];
        for (let i = 1; i < 130; i++)
          store.add({
            ...original,
            id: crypto.randomUUID(),
            createdAt: Date.now() + i,
          });
      };
      tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
    });
    db.close();
  });
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.locator(".sample-thumb")).toHaveCount(48);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Next samples", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(
    page.getByText("Page 2/3 · 130 samples", { exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Next samples", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.locator(".sample-thumb")).toHaveCount(34);
  await expect(
    page.getByText("Page 3/3 · 130 samples", { exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Remove sample", exact: true })
    .first()
    .click();
  await expect(page.locator(".sample-thumb")).toHaveCount(33);
  await expect(
    page.getByText("Page 3/3 · 129 samples", { exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  expect(page.url()).toBe(route);
});

test("class rename rejects duplicates without losing the edit, then saves a valid name", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await imageProject(page);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Class 1 edit", exact: true }).click();
  const field = page.getByRole("textbox", {
    name: "New name for Class 1",
    exact: true,
  });
  await field.fill("Class 2");
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Save class name", exact: true })
    .click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("alert")).toContainText(
    "Class name already exists",
  );
  await expect(field).toBeVisible();
  await field.fill("Plants");
  await page
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Save class name", exact: true })
    .click();
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("button", { name: "Plants edit", exact: true }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator(".sample-thumb")).toHaveCount(1);
});
